A&N UT Health Mission Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post No. of Post Consolidated Salary (In Rs.)
Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) 01 Rs. 25,000/-

Eligibility Criteria

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science, knowledge of logistic and supply management or public health or ITI in R/AC TRAT and PGDCA.
  • Experience: At least 2–3 years of experience in cold chain management, logistics, or a related field.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong technical knowledge of cold chain management, including equipment maintenance and temperature monitoring.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with stakeholders at all levels.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated Salary (In Rs.): Rs. 25,000/- per month is payable for the post of Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization).

Age Limit

  • Age: Not more than 60 years.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the vacancy notice.

 

Selection Process

  • The appointment will be made purely on merit basis.
  • Only the eligible candidates who have submitted application are required to attend the interview.
  • No individual call letters will be issued for appearing in the interview.
  • No TA/DA shall be payable for appearing in the interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment will be made purely on merit basis.
  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility are requested to apply in the prescribed format in A4 size paper.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other norms and that the particulars furnished by him/her are correct in all respects; suppression of information would lead to disqualification at any stage.
  • Interested candidates shall be ready to work in remote / hard areas as and when directed and also may have to travel to remote/hard areas as required.
  • Incomplete/defective applications, applications without photograph of the candidates shall be summarily rejected.
  • The engagement will be on Contract basis for period of 11 months from the day of signing the contract within the stipulated period as per the offer of appointment letter.
  • Any extension or renewal of appointment beyond 11 months will be subject to a review on performance and contribution in work and an agreement on mutually agreed terms.
  • This would not be construed in any manner a promise for the regular appointment under State Health Society (A&N Islands).

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility are requested to apply in the prescribed format in A4 size paper.
  • Attested photocopies of Mark Sheets and Certificates in support of Educational Qualifications (Degree, Post-graduation, Professional Qualifications etc. as applicable) must be enclosed.
  • Experience certificate(s) specifying nature and period of experience should be enclosed.
  • Application should be sent in a cover superscripted “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF “……………………………………”
  • Applications should be addressed to: A & N Union Territory Health Mission, Office of State Health Society (A&N Islands), Quarter No. AP-III, Atlanta Point, Sri Vijaya Puram-744104, Telefax: 03192-234965, e-mail: [email protected].

EdCIL District Career and Mental Health Counsellors Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Location Number of Vacancies
District Career and Mental Health Counsellors Across various districts and mandals of Andhra Pradesh 424

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualification

Candidates possessing any one of the following qualifications are eligible:

  • M.Sc. / M.A. in Psychology
    • Applied Psychology
    • Counselling Psychology
    • Clinical Psychology
    • Child Psychology
    • Adolescent Psychology
  • M.Sc. / M.Phil. in Psychiatric Social Work
  • M.Sc. in Psychiatric Nursing
  • Master of Social Work (MSW) with specialization in Medical & Psychiatric Social Work or Counselling
  • B.A. / B.Sc. (Honours) in Psychology
  • Candidates must have demonstrated proficiency in English (written & verbal)
  • Only those freshers who have appeared for their final degree examination and are awaiting their results are eligible to apply

Desirable Qualification

  • Working knowledge of Telugu language
  • Diploma in Career Guidance & Counselling

Experience Required

  • NIL for Postgraduate candidates
  • For B.A./B.Sc. Psychology: At least 2-year experience in counselling

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated Remuneration: Rs. 30,000 per month
  • Conveyance Allowance: Upto Rs. 4,000/- on reimbursement basis
  • Total Maximum: Rs. 34,000 per month

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age: 45 Years
  • Cut-off Date: 31st December 2025

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: No fees are required to be paid for application for the aforesaid posts

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 06/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 06/01/2026
Last Date for Online Application 18/01/2026
Cut-off Date for Age and Experience 31/12/2025

Selection Process

  • The selection process will be based on academic/professional qualifications
  • Interview will be conducted on prescribed date & time as decided by the competent authority
  • A waiting list will be prepared for counselors
  • If selected candidate does not join or any consequential vacancy arises, suitable candidates based on experience and qualifications from the waiting list will be given opportunity to join
  • Documents to prove Qualifications, Age, Experience, etc. have to be produced in original when called for Interview
  • Screening and subsequent shortlisting shall be strictly based on the details provided by the candidates in their respective online application form

General Information/Instructions

  • Only online applications will be accepted
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible for applying
  • The workplace will be across various Districts and Mandals of Andhra Pradesh
  • The prescribed Qualifications shall be from Government recognized institutions only
  • Candidate should have strong verbal & written communication skills with excellent working knowledge of computer (MS Word, MS Excel & Power Point etc.) and presentation skills
  • Candidates must upload all required documents (educational certificates, resume, experience certificate etc.) in PDF format only
  • Failure to upload required documents will result in disqualification or rejection of the application
  • Applicants should ensure that they meet the eligibility criteria as on 31st December 2025
  • Furnishing of any incomplete, wrong/false information, concealment/misrepresentation of facts will lead to automatic disqualification
  • If at any stage it is found that any candidate has furnished false or wrong information, his/her candidature will be cancelled or service terminated
  • Interview letters and correspondence intimations will be sent only to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail
  • Applicants should ensure that the e-mail id given in their online application is maintained in an active mode
  • Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle candidate to be called for Interview
  • The engagement shall be purely on a contractual basis, initially valid upto March 31, 2026
  • Contract may be renewed for an additional academic period of 10 months, from June 2026 to March 2027
  • Extensions will be contingent upon the needs of Samagra Shiksha (Andhra Pradesh) and performance of individual counsellors
  • The competent authority reserves the right of any amendment, cancellation and changes to this advertisement
  • This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular engagement or permanent absorption
  • EdCIL reserves the right to cancel/withdraw/postpone this recruitment notice

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply through online mode only
  • Online application form is available in English only
  • Visit the official website: https://www.edcilindia.co.in/TCareers for complete details
  • Fill the online application form available at the official link
  • Upload all required documents (educational certificates, resume, experience certificate etc.) in PDF format only
  • Ensure all information provided is accurate, complete and correct
  • Submit the application before the last date: 18/01/2026
  • Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference
  • Note the advertisement number 04/2026 for future reference
  • For any query, candidates may write/contact on email id: [email protected]

Broad Job Description

  • Conduct one-on-one counseling sessions with students to discuss career aspirations, academic interests, and personal strengths
  • Engage with parents and teachers to provide information on career counseling services and encourage their involvement in the career planning process
  • Work closely with teachers, administrators, and community organizations to ensure a holistic approach to student career development
  • Provide one-on-one counseling sessions for students dealing with anxiety, depression, stress, and other mental health challenges
  • Coordinate with the principal and parents to identify slums, bastis, and rural areas for visits to observe the local conditions and environment
  • Conduct workshops and seminars on mental health awareness, coping strategies, and emotional regulation for students and staff

VPA Executive Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post Department No. of Vacant Posts
Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority 03

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities who possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as per Recruitment Rules for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I).
  • Educational qualification for direct recruitment: Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
  • Experience for direct recruitment: Five years’ experience in Executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking.
  • Method of recruitment as per Recruitment Rules: By promotion failing which by absorption/deputation, failing both by direct recruitment.
  • Promotion: From Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs. 9100–15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade; failing which Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs. 9100–15100 with 2 years regular service in the grade and combined regular service of 8 years in the scales Rs. 9100–15100 and Rs. 8600–14600 in Civil Engineering Department.
  • Absorption/deputation: Officers holding analogous posts or feeder posts with experience as mentioned in Recruitment Rules in a Major Port.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) carries the scale of pay of Rs. 50,000–1,60,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 10,750–16,750) in the Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
  • Officers selected on deputation will have the option either to get their pay fixed in the deputation post under normal rules or to draw pay of the post held in parent department plus deputation (duty) allowance as per applicable government orders.
  • Dearness Allowance, local allowances, residential accommodation charges, and other benefits during deputation will be regulated as per Visakhapatnam Port Authority rules and the deputation terms.

Age Limit (as on 19-01-2026)

  • As per Recruitment Rules, the upper age limit for direct recruitment to Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) is 35 years.
  • The crucial date for determining eligibility with respect to educational qualifications, experience and age will be the last date of closing of applications i.e. 19.01.2026.
  • The vacancy is to be filled by promotion/absorption/deputation from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities; direct recruitment is a fallback mode as per Recruitment Rules.

Application Fee

  • The vacancy circular does not mention any application fee for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) on absorption/deputation basis.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be considered from eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities forwarded by the Competent Authority of the respective organizations.
  • No advance copy of application from the applicant will be accepted; only applications forwarded by the Competent Authority within due date will be considered.
  • Incomplete applications, applications received after the last date, or without ACRs/APARs or required enclosures will not be considered.
  • The officer selected for the post will be appointed on absorption/deputation basis and will be governed by the terms and conditions of deputation as per Annexure-VII.
  • VPA reserves the right to cancel or change the number of vacancies without assigning reasons; decision of the Appointing Authority is final in all recruitment matters.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited for filling up three vacant posts of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) in Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority on absorption/deputation basis from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities.
  • Port Authorities are requested to circulate the vacancy among eligible officials and forward applications in the prescribed proforma duly superscribing “Application for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil)” on the envelope to Secretary, Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
  • Applications must be accompanied by certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020–2021 to 2024–2025) duly attested, with No Report/Non-availability certificate where APAR for a year is not available.
  • Attested copies of all certificates towards educational qualifications, present and past work experience in respective post and pay scale, duly verified by the administrative port, must be enclosed.
  • Undertaking of the applicant that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected; withdrawal after selection may lead to debarment from future selection in VPA for two years.
  • Applications must include No Objection Certificate from competent authority, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, verification of university certificates and recognition of degrees, and complete service details in prescribed formats.
  • Vacancy circular along with Annexures is also available on VPA website www.vizagport.com.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities should submit their applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-II) through proper channel.
  • Envelope should be superscribed “Application for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil)” and sent to: Secretary, Visakhapatnam Port Authority, 1st Floor, Administrative Office Building, Port Area, Visakhapatnam – 530035.
  • Applications must be forwarded by the Competent Authority of the respective organizations; advance copies from applicants will not be accepted.
  • Along with the application, forward certified copies of ACRs/APARs for last 5 years, attested copies of educational and experience certificates, undertaking of non-withdrawal of candidature, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, certificate of verification of degree and university recognition, details of penalties if any, and complete service details.
  • Port Authorities must ensure applications with complete details reach VPA on or before 19.01.2026.

  • Qualifications: Under graduation (Regular – Full time) in any discipline from a University / Institution recognized by AICTE / DOTE / UGC. The candidates should have appeared for the examination, passed and received the degree certificate in any of the years from July 2021 to 2025.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.07.2021. Candidate with 100% complete profile on the Apprenticeship portal only are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: The candidate possesses one year or more of work experience in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Private Organization as on 01.12.2025. (Not eligible if have experience)

Salary/Stipend

  • A monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- shall be paid to the apprentice during the period of apprenticeship training. The Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/ benefits.
  • United India Insurance Company will make a payment of 4,500/- into the apprentices account on a monthly basis.

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Selection Process for Samagra Shiksha KGBV Recruitment 2026

  • Selection will be conducted through Walk-in Interviews at district level
  • District Level Selection Committee under Chairmanship of District Collector will conduct recruitment
  • Committee Members include:
    • District Collector (Chairman)
    • District Educational Officer (Member)
    • Additional Project Coordinators (Member Convener)
    • Deputy Educational Officer (Member)
    • Girl Child Development Officer/Assistant Girl Child Development Officer (Member)
  • First priority given to candidates living in the Mandal where KGBVs are located
  • Mandal is the selection unit for filling up all non-teaching posts
  • Provisional selection list prepared Mandal-wise on 12.01.2026
  • Final selection list prepared after conducting interviews (merit list 1:1 ratio) on 28.01.2026
  • Date of birth verification for certain posts as per Aadhar card
  • Reservation rules as per A.P. State Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 (Rule 22) with modifications in GO. Ms. No. 77, dated 02.08.2023
  • Roster points shall continue from last point of previous recruitment 2024

General Information/Instructions

  • All posts shall be filled up with female candidates only
  • All appointments are purely on outsourcing and temporary basis
  • No person eligible unless above 18 years and below 45 years as on 01.07.2025
  • Physically challenged candidates are not eligible by nature of these posts

  • Reservation rule: If rosters earmarked for general candidates filled with women candidates of that community

  • Apply through respective Additional Project Coordinator (APC) offices
  • Application submission period: 03.01.2026 to 11.01.2026

  • Attach required documents:

  • Carry original documents and one set of photocopies for verification

HSL Various Posts 2025 – Important Details

Advertisement
Details Information
Organization Name Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL)
Post Name General Manager (Technical/HR), Deputy General Manager (HR), Manager (HR), Deputy Manager (Safety/Finance), Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical), Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works) and other posts as per detailed advertisement
Total Vacancies 11 Posts 
Salary/Pay Scale IDA pay scales from Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000 (E2) up to Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000 (E7) with Industrial DA, HRA, Allowances etc. and consolidated pay of approx. Rs. 2,15,000/- per month for FTC and Rs. 1,20,000/- per month for Consultant.
Educational Qualification Full-time Graduate/Engineering/PG Degree/Diploma in relevant disciplines with minimum prescribed percentage (generally 60% marks) from recognized University/Institute as per post-wise requirements.
Age Limit Maximum age 52 years for General Manager posts, 45 years for Deputy General Manager/Manager HR, 35 years for Deputy Manager posts, 56 years for Senior Chief Project Superintendent and 62 years for Senior Consultant, as on 23/12/2025 (relaxations as per rules).
Application Start Date 23/12/2025 from 10:00 hrs
Application End Date 13/01/2026 up to 17:00 hrs
Application Mode Online only through the official website; no other mode is accepted.
Official Website hslvizag.in

HSL Various Posts 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for HSL Recruitment 2025 as per the detailed advertisement is distributed as follows:

  • On Permanent Absorption Basis:
    • P1 – General Manager (Technical) (E7) – Post Code 04/2025/GM01 – 01 Post (OBC)
    • P2 – General Manager (HR) (E7) – Post Code 04/2025/GM02 – 01 Post (OBC)
    • P3 – Deputy General Manager (HR) (E5) – Post Code 04/2025/DGM01 – 01 Post (UR)
    • P4 – Manager (HR) (E3) – Post Code 04/2025/MGR01 – 03 Posts (01 OBC; 01 SC; 01 ST)
    • P5 – Deputy Manager (Safety) (E2) – Post Code 04/2025/DM01 – 01 Post (UR)
    • P6 – Deputy Manager (Finance) (E2) – Post Code 04/2025/DM02 – 01 Post (UR)
  • On Fixed Term Contract (FTC) Basis:
    • F1 – Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) [Equivalent to CGM (E8)] – Post Code 04/2025/CGM01 – 02 Posts (01 UR; 01 OBC)
  • Consultant on Fixed Term Contract & Part Time Basis:
    • C1 – Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works) – Post Code 04/2025/CON01 – 01 Post

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • General Manager (Technical) (E7): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture disciplines from a recognised University/Institute registered with AICTE. Desirable – Post-graduation in Engineering/Management.
  • General Manager (HR) (E7): Full-time Graduate in any discipline with not less than 60% marks and full-time Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in HR/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare from UGC-recognised University/Institute with not less than 60% marks. Desirable – Degree in Law.
  • Deputy General Manager (HR) (E5): Full-time Graduate with 60% marks and full-time PG Degree/Diploma in Management specializing in HR/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare with 60% marks. Desirable – Degree in Law.
  • Manager (HR) (E3): Full-time Graduate with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST) and full-time PG Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in HR/Personnel Management/Labour Laws from UGC-recognised University/Institute. Desirable – LLB/LLM.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety) (E2): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in any discipline from AICTE-recognised University/Institute and full-time Diploma (not less than 1 year) in Industrial Safety from recognised University/AICTE.
  • Deputy Manager (Finance) (E2): Graduate with Qualified/Passed Final Examination from ICAI/ICWAI; MBA Finance desirable.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) (FTC): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture disciplines; Post-graduation in Engineering/Management desirable.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Engineering Graduate or equivalent in Civil Engineering from AICTE-recognised University/Institute; Post-graduation in Civil Engineering and Marine works course from IIT/other reputed institute desirable.

2. Experience

  • GM (Technical/HR): At least 22 years of post-qualification experience in Indian Navy/PSUs/large reputed private companies with specified shipbuilding/HR experience and minimum 3 years in immediate lower grade or equivalent CTC and level in private sector.
  • DGM (HR): At least 15 years’ post-qualification HR/Personnel/IR experience with required lower grade/CTC experience.
  • Manager (HR): Minimum 9 years’ post-qualification experience in HR/Personnel/IR/Legal/Administration in Govt/PSU/large private companies; preference for legal and RTI experience.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety): Minimum 5 years’ experience in Safety department in PSUs/large industrial establishments with statutory compliance exposure under Factories Act and AP Factory Rules.
  • Deputy Manager (Finance): Minimum 5 years’ post-qualification experience in Finance/Cost Accounting/Management/Funds/Budgeting/Auditing/Cost control in Govt/PSU/Private of repute.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical): At least 24 years’ post-qualification experience with shipbuilding/design/repairs/warships/submarines and specified minimum service in lower grade/CTC levels.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): At least 25 years’ experience in planning/construction of defence projects, marine works (jetties/bridges), with structural design knowledge; retired Group A officers in pay level 13 of 7th CPC preferred.

3. Age Limit (as on 23/12/2025)

  • GM (Technical/HR): Maximum 52 years.
  • DGM (HR) & Manager (HR): Maximum 45 years.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety/Finance): Maximum 35 years.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical): Maximum 56 years.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Maximum 62 years.
  • Relaxations: 5 years relaxation in age and 1 year in lower-grade experience for internal permanent employees; age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen as per Government rules.

Selection Process

  • Candidates meeting essential qualification, experience and grade/CTC criteria will be shortlisted for interview, conducted either online (VC mode) or physically at HSL, Visakhapatnam.
  • The selection process may include group discussion, preliminary screening interview and final selection interview; decision of the selection committee will be final.
  • Shortlisting may be in a ratio not exceeding 06 times the number of vacancies, based on percentage of marks in essential qualification/graduation if large number of applications are received.
  • Shortlisted candidates called for physical interview will be reimbursed 1st AC train fare (P1–P4 posts) and 2nd AC train fare (P5–P6 etc.) by shortest route; air travel is allowed at candidate’s option but reimbursement limited to train fare.
  • Detailed scrutiny of applications will be done and mere issuance of call letter does not imply eligibility; management reserves right to change selection criteria or cancel the recruitment process.

Application Fee

  • Application fee: Rs. 300/- (Rupees Three Hundred only).
  • No registration fee for SC/ST/PH and internal candidates.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances; candidates must verify eligibility before applying.
  • Payment should be made through online mode; receipt of online payment is to be saved for future reference.

How To Apply

  • Visit the official website: hslvizag.in.
  • Go to “Careers” under “Human Resources” and open “Current Openings” to view the advertisement and posts.
  • Read the detailed advertisement and ensure you meet all eligibility criteria as on 23/12/2025.
  • Submit application online only via https://www.hslvizag.in; no other mode is accepted.
  • Register and complete three stages: Personal Details, Educational Details and Payment Details.
  • Upload mandatory self-attested documents: SSC/Intermediate/Diploma/Degree/PG mark sheets and certificates, proof of date of birth, caste/PH certificate, experience certificates, latest salary certificate, Annexure-I and other relevant documents.
  • Upload photograph (20–50 KB) and signature (10–20 KB) in prescribed size and format.
  • Select “Experienced” or “Management Trainee” appropriately against “Type of post” as per instructions.
  • Use SAVE button to avoid data loss and SUBMIT only after verifying all details; once submitted, editing is not allowed.
  • After successful submission, receive confirmation message and email with Registration ID and link to view submitted application; take a print-out for future reference.
  • For registration issues or clarifications, contact [email protected] electronically.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement / Cut-off Date (Age & Experience) 23/12/2025
Date of commencement of ONLINE application for all posts 23/12/2025 from 10:00 hrs
Last Date for ONLINE submission for all posts 13/01/2026 up to 17:00 hrs (once submitted, editing not allowed)
Possible extension for selective posts May be extended at the discretion of HSL (if decided)

Salary/Stipend

  • Permanent Positions: IDA pay scales – E7: Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000; E5: Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000; E3: Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000; E2: Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000.
  • In addition to Basic Pay, regular officers are entitled to Industrial DA, HRA, Allowances (27% of Basic Pay under cafeteria approach subject to Govt review), Contributory PF, Gratuity, reimbursement of medical expenses at CGHS rates for in-patient treatment, leave encashment, subsidized lunch and other benefits as per company policies/Govt regulations.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) – FTC: Approx. consolidated pay of Rs. 2,15,000/- per month on fixed term contract for 3 years extendable by 1+1 years or till 60 years of age, whichever earlier.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month with retention incentive of Rs. 3,000/- on completion of every year till contract closure, with TA/DA, travel arrangements (for non-Vizag residents) and accommodation as per E7-equivalent rules.

Instructions

  • Indian Nationals only are eligible to apply.
  • All vacancies are primarily for Visakhapatnam; selected officers may be transferred to project locations for up to 2 years in one stretch and may undertake outstation duties to Delhi/Yards/Vendor premises as required.
  • Applications submitted other than the prescribed online method will be rejected; incomplete applications or those lacking requisite documents will be summarily dismissed.
  • Aggregate percentage of marks shall not be rounded off; for CGPA/OGPA/Grade, conversion to percentage must follow University formula or factor 10 with documentary proof where no formula is prescribed.
  • Training period, teaching experience, apprenticeship/internship and sabbatical/extraordinary leave will not be counted toward required experience.
  • Reservation rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS will apply; category certificates must be in prescribed format and within one year from date of advertisement for OBC (non-creamy layer) and EWS “Income & Asset” certificates.
  • Candidates from Govt/PSU/private sector must submit NOC/CTC and turnover proof as applicable; failure to do so may lead to summary rejection.
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview; non-production will debar the candidate from interview and travel fare reimbursement.
  • Management reserves the right to create and operate a panel, increase/decrease number of posts, consider candidates for lower posts/grades, relax qualification/experience/age in exceptional cases, or cancel the recruitment process without notice.
  • All correspondence including interview call letters will be through email only; candidates must keep the registered email active and also check spam/junk folders.
  • Appointments are subject to medical fitness and submission of dependents’ medical history declaration and medical test reports prior to joining; canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature.

Candidates must possess a Doctoral Degree in Science or a Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent. A first author peer-reviewed publication in infectious disease/virology research and experience in virus research, mammalian cell culture, virus assays, protein expression and purification, and molecular biology techniques are required.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for IISER Tirupati Project Scientist - I Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Maximum Age: Not more than 55 years on the date of the interview
  • Age calculation date: On the date of the interview

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian nationals as mentioned in the notification.

Selection Process for IISER Tirupati Project Scientist - I 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Walk-in interview
  • Shortlisting of candidates for interview may be done based on qualifications and experience over and above the minimum prescribed

Note: The prescribed educational qualifications are the bare minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle candidates to be called for an interview.

  • Essential Qualifications: PG in Psychology in M.Phil in Rehabilitation Psychology

  • Essential Qualifications: Must possess Degree of B.A or B.Sc of any recognized university OR Masters Degree in Occupational Therapy of any recognized institution

  • Desirable: Preference shall be given to candidate with Hospital experience for minimum period of six months

  • Essential Qualifications: Must possess Intermediate with science Groups and 2 years Diploma in Anesthesia Technician

  • Essential Qualifications: Graduation from recognized university with diploma in yoga from recognized institution by the government
  • OR: Graduate in yoga sciences from recognized university

  • Essential Qualifications: Must have any Degree with Computer from any recognized University
  • Essential: Must have Passed PG. Diploma in Computer Applications

  • Essential Qualifications: Must have passed SSC or its equivalent

Category Fee Amount

Event Date
Notification Published on Official Website 03/01/2026
Application Form Available From 05/01/2026 (10:30 AM)
Applications Received From (Except Public Holidays) 05/01/2026 to 12/01/2026 (upto 05:00 PM)

  • Total Marks: 100
  • 75% Marks: Allocated for aggregate of marks obtained in all years in qualifying examination or any other equivalent qualification
  • Up to 10 Marks: 1.0 mark per completed year after acquiring requisite Qualification as mentioned in pass certificate. Weightage reckoned up to date of notification as per Govt. Memo no.4274/D1/2013
  • Up to 15% Weightage: Given to candidates working on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis including COVID-19 service subject to Satisfactory service certified by competent authority
  • Weightage to Contract Employment Based on Working Area:
  • 2.5 marks per six months in Tribal Area
  • 2.0 marks per six months in Rural Area
  • 1.0 marks per six months in Urban Areas
  • No weightage for services less than six months for Non-COVID service
  • COVID-19 Weightage: If individual work less than 6 months for COVID, 0.8 marks per completed month will be awarded
  • COVID-19 weightage applicable only to persons who rendered services on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis and appointed by District Collector or competent authority
  • Candidates claiming service weightage shall submit original contract/outsourcing/honorarium service certificate in prescribed proforma issued by competent authority along with copy of appointment orders
  • Contract service will be reckoned up to date of notification as per DME AP VJA Memo no.Rc.No 2216683/P2/2023 dated 26.10.2023
  • Counselling will be conducted for all candidates and will be allowed to choose only one category while exercising option

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from eligible candidates for recruitment on Contract & Outsourcing basis
  • Proforma of application available on portal https://Kadapa.ap.gov.in/ from 10:30 AM on 05/01/2026 to 05:00 PM on 12/01/2026
  • Filled applications shall be submitted in specified counters in Principal Govt. Medical College Putlampalli, YSR Kadapa District
  • Candidates advised to apply as soon as possible without waiting till last date to avoid last hour rush
  • Obtain dated acknowledgement from receiving authority in proof of submission of application
  • District Jurisdiction for this recruitment is erstwhile district only
  • Number of 53 vacancies is provisional and likely to increase or decrease as per need of department
  • Merit List valid for one year for purpose of filling up arising vacancies if any
  • Reservations applicable as per Rule 22 of AP State and Subordinate Services Rules
  • Reservations to women as per General Rule 22-A
  • Presidential order applicable as per GO Ms No 674; GA (SPF.A) Dept
  • Reservations to Differently abled persons applicable as per G.O.Ms.No.2 Department for WCDA & SC
  • Reservations for economically weaker sections as per G.O.Ms.No.73 GA (Services-D) dept
  • Reservations for ex-servicemen applicable as per rules in force
  • Candidate should possess prescribed Academic/Technical/Professional qualifications as on date of notification
  • If applicant possesses equivalent qualification, enclose copy of Government orders to that effect
  • Tenure for contract/outsourcing posts initially one year from date of joining and may be extended
  • District Selection Committee reserves all rights to terminate contract/outsourcing services with one month notice
  • If selected, candidate should stay at bonafide Head Quarters compulsorily
  • Candidates furnishing incorrect information or making false declaration liable to be debarred from recruitment
  • Decision of department regarding acceptance or rejection of candidature shall be final in all respects
  • Application sent through any mode other than prescribed offline physical application will not be entertained
  • Candidates must submit clear, visible documents, failing which application will be summarily rejected
  • Roster registers will be maintained separately by Superintendent, Institute of Mental Health, Kadapa

How to Apply

  • Visit official website https://Kadapa.ap.gov.in/ from 05/01/2026 at 10:30 AM
  • Download the application proforma from portal
  • Fill the application form completely with all required details
  • Affix recent passport size colour photograph on application form
  • Obtain Demand Draft in favour of Principal, Govt. Medical College, Kadapa for application processing fee (₹300 for OC, ₹250 for SC/ST/BC/EWS/PwD)
  • For multiple posts, obtain separate DD for each post and apply separately
  • Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates in following order:
  • SSC or equivalent for date of birth
  • Qualifying examination pass certificates and marks memos of all years
  • Valid certificate of registration in AP Paramedical Board/Allied Health Care Sciences wherever applicable
  • Study certificates from class IV to X for local status
  • Valid caste certificate if claiming reservation
  • Latest EWS certificate for current financial year if applicable
  • Certificate of disability issued in SADAREM if applicable
  • Service certificate in prescribed proforma from controlling officer if claiming service weightage
  • Any other relevant certificates
  • Prepare checklist in 02 (two) copies - one will be returned as acknowledgement
  • Submit filled application with all documents at specified counters in Office of Principal Govt. Medical College Putlampalli, YSR Kadapa District
  • Submit application on or before 12/01/2026 by 05:00 PM
  • Obtain dated acknowledgement from receiving authority

Eligibility Criteria

  • Assistant Professor – Curriculum & Pedagogic Course (Manipuri, Chemistry, Economics)
    • Postgraduate degree in the concerned Pedagogy Subject (Manipuri / Chemistry / Economics) with 55% marks (or equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) from a recognized University/Institution.
    • M.Ed. degree with 55% from NCTE recognized institution.
    • Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC or CSIR or similar test accredited by UGC or SLET/SET for North East Region, OR have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and amendments.
    • For candidates registered for Ph.D. prior to 11 July 2009, exemption from NET/SLET/SET is allowed subject to conditions: regular mode Ph.D., thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, open viva voce conducted, at least two research papers from Ph.D. work (one in refereed journal), and at least two conference/seminar presentations sponsored/funded by UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or similar, duly certified by Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs).
    • NET/SLET/SET qualification shall be either in the respective pedagogic subject (Manipuri/Chemistry/Economics) or in Education; Ph.D. qualification shall be in the concerned pedagogic subject or in Education/Teacher Education.
  • Assistant Professor – Perspective in Education or Foundation Course
    • Option 1:
      • Postgraduate degree in Social Science (Economics / Geography / History / Political Science) with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/Institution, and
      • M.Ed. degree with 55% from NCTE recognized institution.
    • OR Option 2:
      • Postgraduate (M.A.) degree in Education with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/Institution, and
      • B.Ed./B.El.Ed. degree with 55% from NCTE recognized institution (Desirable: B.Ed. degree shall be of Secondary Education).

  • Relaxation Clauses (Common)
    • 5% relaxation at Bachelor’s and Master’s level for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy layer)/Differently Abled (blindness and low vision; deaf and hard of hearing; locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims, muscular dystrophy; autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness; multiple disabilities including deaf-blindness) for eligibility and assessing good academic record.
    • 5% relaxation (from 55% to 50%) in Master’s degree marks for Ph.D. degree holders who obtained their Master’s prior to 19 September 1991.
    • A relevant grade regarded as equivalent of 55% at Master’s level wherever grading system is followed by recognized University shall be considered valid.
    • Time taken to acquire M.Phil./Ph.D. degree shall not be counted as teaching/research experience; active service with simultaneous research without leave may be counted as teaching experience.
  • General Eligibility Conditions
    • Candidate must be a citizen of India.
    • Must be able to speak Manipuri, Meitei/Meetei lon or any of the Tribal dialects of Manipur.
    • Must be a permanent resident of Manipur; candidates whose parent/ancestor in direct lineage are/were permanent residents (with documentary proof such as electoral roll enrolment and birth certificate) are also eligible.
    • There will be no upper age limit.

Salary/Stipend

  • Scale of Pay: PB-3 Rs. 15,600–39,100/- plus Academic Grade Pay (AGP) Rs. 6,000/- (pre-revised).
  • Posts are classified as Class I, Group A under Government Colleges in Manipur; other allowances and benefits are as per State Government norms.

Application Fee

Category Application / Examination Fee
General & OBC Rs. 600/-
SC & ST Rs. 400/-
DAPs (Differently Abled Persons) No fee
  • Fee to be paid only through online mode (net banking, VISA/MASTER Card, Debit Card) via https://empsconline.gov.in.
  • Applications without prescribed fee/mode will be summarily rejected.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded nor kept in reserve for any other examination/selection.
  • Applicants whose payment details are not received from the bank will be treated as fictitious; list will be published, and only on receipt of documentary proof will genuine payment cases be revived.

Important Dates

Notification Date 24 December 2025 (Imphal)
Start Date for Online Application 29 December 2025
Last Date for Online Application Submission 26 January 2026 (up to 11:59 PM)
Last Date for Submission of Hard Copies (Research Publications, Awards, Annexure-A, Application Printout) On or before 26 January 2026 (to Secretary, MPSC)
Date & Venue of Interview To be notified in due course by the Commission

Selection Process

  • Selection procedure governed by Appendix-1 Table-3 / Appendix II Table-3B of UGC Regulations 2018 as adopted by Government of Manipur Order No. 10/187/2018-HE dated 3 July 2021 (Annexure-A).
  • Academic score as per Appendix-1 Table-3 (graduation, post-graduation, M.Phil., Ph.D., NET/JRF/SET, research publications, teaching/post-doctoral experience, awards) will be used only for short-listing candidates for interview.
  • Final selections shall be based solely on performance in the interview.
  • Academic score sheets (Annexure-A) must be duly filled, self-scored and authenticated by candidate, and uploaded in the online application (Table-3 section) and also submitted offline along with supporting documents.
  • All research publications (peer-reviewed / UGC listed) and awards claimed for eligibility and scoring must be submitted as hard copies to the Secretary, MPSC along with Annexure-A and application printout by hand/Speed Post/Courier on or before 26 January 2026.
  • The academic scores will be examined by a Committee of Experts under supervision of the Commission.
  • The decision of the Commission regarding eligibility or otherwise of a candidate shall be final; candidature may be cancelled at any stage if conditions are not fulfilled.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited on prescribed online forms for direct recruitment to 7 posts of Assistant Professors of D.M. College Teacher Education under Higher Education Department, Manipur.
  • Teaching/research experience: format of Experience Certificate is provided as Annexure-B; candidates must upload signed experience certificates and supporting documents in the Experience section during online application.
  • All candidates in service/Ad hoc/Contract/Guest Faculty/Part-time must submit/upload “No Objection Certificate” (NOC) issued by concerned Department/Authority.
  • No queries or representations regarding correction of candidate-entered details will be entertained; candidates must exercise due diligence while filling the online form as timely completion of examination process is of paramount importance.
  • All research publications and awards must match categories specified in Annexure-A; Commission will not be responsible for non-receipt of requisite documents by the last date.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or after appointment it is found that candidate does not fulfil eligibility conditions, his/her candidature/appointment will be cancelled.

How to Apply

  • Apply online at www.empsconline.gov.in from 29 December 2025 to 26 January 2026 up to 11:59 PM; no other mode of application is entertained.
  • Fill all personal, educational, experience and eligibility details carefully in the online application form.
  • Upload required documents including experience certificates (Annexure-B format) and academic score sheet (Annexure-A – Appendix-1 Table-3) in the specified sections.
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online using net banking, VISA/MASTER Card or Debit Card through the EMPSC online portal.
  • Download and print the duly filled application generated by the system after successful submission and fee payment.
  • Submit offline to the Secretary, MPSC: hard copies of research publications (peer-reviewed/UGC listed), awards, duly filled Annexure-A (academic score sheet), and printout of online application by hand or Speed Post/Courier on or before 26 January 2026.
  • Retain copies of all submitted documents and payment proof for future reference; regularly check MPSC website for interview date and further updates.

    • Computer Knowledge - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • English - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Logical Reasoning - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Mathematics - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Total: 60 Questions (60 Marks) in 60 Minutes (Composite time)
  • Test Medium: English only.
  • Negative Marking: There will NOT be any negative marking for wrong answers.
  • Personal Interview: Candidates shortlisted from the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test only will be considered for Personal Interview round. The same will be scheduled at various centres across the country at the discretion of the Bank.
  • Elimination Stage: Every selection round will be an elimination stage.
  • Shortlisting: Bank reserves the right to shortlist only the requisite number of candidates in the selection rounds based on administrative requirements.

  • Probation Period: Candidates selected for the post of Office Assistant will be on probation for a period of 6 months. The period of probation is liable to be extended if any candidate has not satisfactorily completed the initial period of probation.

  • Single Application: Candidates should submit only one application. Candidature of applicants submitting more than one application is liable to be cancelled without notice and compensation.
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidates should confirm their identity using a valid ID proof (Aadhar Card, Driving License, Passport, Voters ID or PAN) to participate in the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test. Ration Card is not considered as a valid id proof.

Candidates who have changed their name will be allowed only if they produce Gazette notification/their registered marriage certificate indicating the changes.
  • Late Reporting: Candidates reporting late i.e. after the reporting time specified on the admit card will not be permitted to participate in the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test.

  • Canvassing Disqualification: Any canvassing by or on behalf of the candidates or to bring political or other influence with regard to their selection shall be considered as a disqualification.

How to Apply

  • Step 4: Click the 'Send OTP' button and you will receive an OTP for validation.
  • Step 5: Enter your Personal, Academic, Experience and other details as required. Fill all fields in the registration portal correctly.
  • Step 6: Upload Photograph and Signature as per prescribed specifications.
  • Step 7: Proceed to payment of application fee through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, UPI or Internet Banking.
  • Step 8: Upon completion of registration, verify the status through automated Email sent to registered Email address.
  • Step 9: Receipt of confirmation mail and E-Receipt is mandatory for participating in the recruitment process.
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to carefully verify the details entered in the registration portal, as no change will be possible after clicking the 'I Agree' button.
  • Early Submission: Bank reserves the right to close the application window at any time before 08.01.2026 based on volume of applications received. Therefore, candidates are advised to submit their application at the earliest opportunity.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?

Q2. What is the age limit for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?

Q3. How many vacancies are available in IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?

Q4. What is the selection process for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT); final merit is prepared refinery-wise based solely on CBT marks among candidates who qualify SPPT and fulfil all eligibility conditions.

Q5. What is the application fee for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A5. General/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 300/- as non-refundable application fee, while SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from fee payment.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the IOCL Non-Executive CBT?

Q7. Can I edit my IOCL Non-Executive application form after submission?
A7. No, once the final online application is submitted and registration is completed, no change or correction is permitted; candidates must verify details carefully before final submission.

Q8. What is the salary of IOCL Non-Executive posts?

A9. No, the IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 notification does not prescribe GATE or any external score; selection is based on IOCL’s own CBT followed by SPPT and medical fitness.

Q10. Where will the IOCL Non-Executive examination be conducted?
A10. The CBT will be conducted at multiple test cities across India such as Visakhapatnam, Guwahati, Vadodara, Delhi/NCR, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and others listed in Annexure II of the notification.

  • A methodical approach to work for analysing samples and collating data.
  • Good IT and database skills.
  • The contract can be terminated at any time by giving notice of 15 days, by either side.
  • Candidate(s) will be required to join immediately, if provisionally selected. If a candidate does not join on the stipulated date as decided by management, upon intimation he/she will be allowed extension for another maximum of 15 (fifteen) days from the aforesaid stipulated date. Failure to join within the above-mentioned timeline will result in cancellation of his/her provisional selection.
  • Contract tenure will commence from the date of engagement and shall end on expiry of the prescribed period and no separate notice shall be required to be given.
  • Selected candidates will be entitled for the total Contract Emoluments, which will include both the Fixed and Variable components. However, in case selected candidate avails Maternity Leave during the course of Contractual engagement, only the Fixed component of the Contract Emoluments shall be paid.
  • No Travelling Allowance/ Daily Allowance will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the Walk-in-Interview.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangements to appear for the Walk-in-Interview viz. travel, accommodation etc. Further, no reimbursement shall be provided for joining.
  • If a candidate is found guilty of either of the following mentioned hereunder, such a candidate may, in addition to rendering himself/herself liable to criminal prosecution, will also be liable to be disqualified for the above contractual engagement for which he/she is a candidate and to be debarred, either permanently or for a specified period, from any examination or test conducted by OIL i.e. (i) using unfair means (ii) impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person (iii) misbehaving (iv) resorting to any irregular or improper means in connection with his/her candidature for selection (v) obtaining support for his/her candidature by any unfair means.
  • The above engagement is purely of Contractual nature. Accordingly, the above Contractual Engagement(s) shall not confer any right or claim whatsoever on the concerned contractual employee for employment/ regularization in Oil India Limited.
  • Any candidate found to have submitted false/forged/misleading certificates, documents, testimonials/declarations, or to have suppressed material information at any stage including after engagement, shall be liable for disqualification, rejection, termination, or any other action deemed appropriate. Verification of such discrepancies, including adverse findings related to character and antecedents, shall be carried out through the competent authority, and necessary action will be taken without exception and irrespective of the stage or timing of detection.
  • Canvassing in any form whether directly or indirectly shall amount to rejection of candidature.
  • The candidate should be of sound health and has to provide a fitness certificate from a Govt. registered medical practitioner at the time of joining in the prescribed format.
  • The provisionally selected candidate(s) will have to submit a character and antecedents verification certificate i.e. Police verification certificate/report from concerned authorities at the time of engagement.
  • Engagement of the selected candidate(s) will be subject to necessary pre-engagement formalities viz. document/certificate/testimonial checking, submission of required document/ certificate/testimonial, medical fitness certificate, Police verification certificate/report etc.
  • Candidate(s) working in any organization, if selected, has to produce Release Letter (in original), from concerned employer at the time of contractual engagement at OIL.
  • The selected candidate(s) on contract will be liable to be placed in any location as deemed fit by the Competent Authority.
  • The selected candidate(s) on contract will have to arrange accommodation at his/her own cost during the period of the above contractual engagement.
  • All taxes, as applicable will be borne individually by the selected candidate(s) on contract.
  • The selected candidate(s) on contract shall be entitled for 20 (twenty) days paid leave for 01 (one) year of contractual engagement period.
  • Any dispute with regards to the engagement against this advertisement will be under the jurisdiction of Dibrugarh district court only.
  • Oil India Limited reserves the right to cancel or postpone the Contractual Engagement Process at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • In addition to above, any other terms & conditions/rules & regulations/policy & procedures will also be applicable for Contractual Engagement as existing from time to time.
  • Candidates are advised to keep checking OIL’s website (https://www.oil-india.com > OIL for All > Carrer at OIL > Current Openings/ Results) regularly for any update/information pertaining to the above contractual engagement requirement(s).

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates who meet all the prescribed eligibility criteria are required to report for registration to appear in the Walk-in-Interview.
  • To appear for the Walk-in-Interview, first the candidate(s) need to mandatorily complete the Registration at the venue compulsorily between 09:00 A.M. to 11:00 A.M. No candidate will be allowed to register beyond the date & time frame stated herein above under any circumstances.
  • The process of Walk-in-Interview will proceed as per the list of candidate(s) registered for the same.
  • If the total number of candidate(s) registered for the Walk-in-Interview on the above scheduled date is beyond the adequate limit/capacity, please note that the Walk-in-Interview for the remaining registered candidate(s) will be carried forward/completed on the subsequent day(s), as required.
  • Before registering for Walk-in-Interview, a candidate should ensure that he/she fulfils the requisite qualification, experience and other eligibility conditions mentioned in this Advertisement.
  • If a candidate does not meet the eligibility conditions and other specifications as mentioned in this advertisement, the concerned candidate will not be allowed to appear in the Walk-in-Interview.
  • During the process of Registration for Walk-in-Interview, information furnished by the candidate will be verified from the Original documents and only those candidates meeting the notified eligibility criteria will be allowed to appear in the Walk-in-Interview.
  • Accordingly, candidate(s) without original document(s)/certificate(s)/ testimonial(s) will not be allowed to appear in the Walk-in-Interview.

RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
Post Name Bank's Medical Consultant
No of Posts 01
Salary Rs. 1000/- per hour
Qualification MBBS degree from any university recognized by the Medical Council of India in the allopathic system of medicine.
Start Date for Apply  21/12/2025
Last Date for Apply  22/01/2026
Official Website https://www.rbi.org.in

RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Bank's Medical Consultant 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants should at a minimum, possess MBBS degree from any university recognized by the Medical Council of India in the allopathic system of medicine.
  • Applicants having post graduate degree in General Medicine can also apply.
  • The applicants should have a minimum of two (02) years' of experience practicing medicine in any hospital or clinic.
  • The applicants should have his/her dispensary or place of residence within a radius of 10-15 kms from the dispensaries located at Bank's Office Premise/ Reserve Bank of India Officers' Colony at the aforementioned location.

Selection Process

  • The Reserve Bank of India, Guwahati will conduct an interview for selection of one Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC) on contract basis, with fixed hourly remuneration.
  • Selection will be made through interview of eligible candidates. The Bank reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards etc. in order to limit the number of candidates to be called for interview. The decision of the Bank in this regard will be final. The Bank will not entertain any correspondence with the applicants who have not been called for the interview.
  • The shortlisted applicant/s after interview will be subjected to medical tests as per prescribed norms before engagement as Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC). The cost of these medical tests will have to be borne by the applicant.
  • Candidate selected for the post will be appointed subject to their being found medically fit and acceptance of Terms and Conditions as per Annex-I and Code of Conduct as per Annex-II.
  • The selected candidate has to enter into an agreement with the Bank before engagement as Bank’s Medical Consultant on contract basis with fixed hourly remuneration.

How To Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates may make an application in the prescribed format as at Annex-III. The application should be sent in a sealed cover super scribed as- “Application for the Post of Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC) on Contract Basis with Fixed Hourly Remuneration”.
  • The candidates should submit their applications to, The Regional Director, Reserve Bank of India, Human Resource Management Department (Recruitment Section), Station Road, Panbazar, Guwahati – 781001 on or before 05:00 PM of January 22, 2026.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 21/12/2025
Last Date for Apply 22/01/2026

Instructions

  • You shall attend to the Bank’s Office dispensary located at RBI Dispensary, Main Office Premises, Reserve Bank of India, Station Road, Panbazar, Guwahati, Assam - 781001 and at Reserve Bank of India Officer’s Colony, G.S. Road, Christian Basti, Guwahati – 781005 with duty hours from as mentioned in Para 2(viii) of the advertisement (or for longer periods as may be necessary) excluding Bank holidays except days declared as holidays for purposes of half yearly closing and annual closing subject to the condition that the dispensary will not be kept closed for two successive days.
  • You will give medical advice free of charge, prescribe medicines and administer injections free of charge to the members of the staff including touring staff of the Bank, the members of their families including dependent parents and retired employee members / their spouses who are members of the Medical Assistance Fund Scheme, who present themselves during that time (the timings and / or duration may be changed as and when considered necessary by the Bank). You will be available for consultation at your private clinic in urgent cases in respect of employees of the Bank at any time with charges at the rate prescribed in the schedule. The Schedule of charges applicable to the Staff/Officers of the Bank would be made available on request.
  • You will provide the facilities referred to in paragraph (2) above to the relatives of the employees who have been permitted to reside with them in the Staff Quarters/leased flats and facilitate recovery of charges from the employees for credit to the Bank’s account at the rates prescribed by the Bank from time to time.
  • You will be required to perform duties similar to those of a General Medical Practitioner irrespective of whatever post-graduate or other medical qualifications you may possess / acquire in future. It shall be your responsibility to ensure that the qualifications you hold or acquire in future do not restrict you in any manner from rendering the services required of a General Medical Practitioner and if as per any stipulations by the Indian Medical Association, the qualification you hold or acquire as the case may be, comes into conflict with the Bank`s requirements as indicated above, to work as a general practitioner, you will be required to ensure that no liability or responsibility on this account devolves on the Bank under any circumstance and shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Bank at all times against the same.

Salary/Stipend

  • ₹ 1000/- per hour for the entire period of contract i.e., three years.
  • Out of the total monthly remuneration so payable, a sum of ₹1000/- per month shall be treated as conveyance expenses.
  • Reimbursement of mobile charges of ₹1,000/- per month.

Advertisement

Event Date
Publication of Advertisement on Institute Website 19/12/2025
Start Date for Online Application 20/12/2025
Last Date for Online Application 20/01/2026 (by 5:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • The Institute will conduct an interview through a committee
  • A panel will be drawn in each discipline for which VF is to be engaged as per Institutional requirement
  • Any empanelled candidate recommended by the Selection Committee may be required to deliver lectures as per requirements of Institutions
  • Decision of the committee will be final for selection of candidates
  • In case of any dispute or discrepancy, the decision of the Director, NID Assam, shall be final

General Information/Instructions

  • NID Assam is an autonomous Institution of National Importance under Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
  • Established at Jorhat through the NID Act, 2014 and NID (Amendment) Act, 2019 passed by the Parliament of India

  • Discipline Lead will verify the presence of the Visiting Faculty for the course and completion of the course at the end

  • Travel for local Visiting Faculty (within Jorhat) may either be arranged by the institute or will be reimbursed if arranged by the Visiting Faculty under intimation to the institute at the rates as per the institutional norms

How to Apply

Advertisement
Company Name State Level Police Recruitment Board, Assam (SLPRB Assam)
Post Name Constable (UB) & Constable (AB)
No of Posts 1715 (1052 UB + 663 AB)
Salary Rs. 14,000 - 70,000/- with Grade Pay Rs. 5,600/-

Start Date for Apply 16-12-2025
Last Date for Apply 16-01-2026
Official Website http://www.slprbassam.in

SLPRB Assam Constable (UB) & Constable (AB) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Vacancies
Constable (UB) - Unarmed Branch 1052
Constable (AB) - Armed Branch 663
Total 1715

Category-wise Reservation

Social Category UB AB
OBC/MOBC 27% 27%
Tea & Ex-Tea Garden Tribes (within OBC/MOBC quota) 3% 3%
SC 7% 7%
ST(P) 10% 10%
