Women (within each category) 30% 10%
Militancy-affected Areas 5% 5%
Former Member of Militant Organization (FMMOs) 5% 5%
Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers 1% 1%
Special Police Officers (SPOs) 1% 1%
Sports Person/NCC Certificate Holder 1% 1%

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Constable (UB): Higher Secondary (HS) or Class XII passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Constable (AB): HSLC or Class X passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Applicants having educational qualification of Higher Secondary and above may apply for both Armed Branch and Unarmed Branch with clear preference indication

Essential Requirements

  • Applicant must be a Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Assam
  • Must be registered with a local Employment Exchange in Assam
  • Must speak Assamese or any other State language fluently
  • Selected applicants will have to submit Proof of Residence after publication of Final Select List (SC, ST, OBC/MOBC exempted)

Experience

  • For Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers: Minimum 1 year service certificate required for reservation quota benefit; Minimum 3 years service for age relaxation
  • For SPOs: Appointment Certificate required for reservation and age relaxation benefits
  • For FMMOs: Certificate issued by Special Branch, HQrs. of Assam Police, Kahilipara, Guwahati required

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 14,000 - 70,000/- per month
  • Grade Pay: Rs. 5,600/-
  • Other Benefits: Allowances as admissible under the Rules
  • Pension Benefits: Selected applicants shall be entitled to pension benefits as per the pension scheme existing at the time of appointment

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Applicants born not later than 01-01-2008)
  • Maximum Age: 25 years (Applicants born not before 01-01-2001)

Age Relaxation

  • SC, ST(P) and ST(H): 5 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • OBC/MOBC: 3 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers (served 3 years or more): Additional 3 years relaxation
  • Former Members of Militant Organization (FMMOs)/SPOs: Additional 10 years relaxation
  • Age will be calculated based on Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Certificate issued by recognized Board/Council only
  • No other documents like Horoscope, Affidavit, Birth Extract etc. will be accepted for age proof

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: NIL - There will be no Application Fee for this recruitment

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 05-12-2025
Online Application Start Date 16-12-2025
Online Application Last Date 16-01-2026
Edit Option Available (After Last Date) 5 days from 16-01-2026 (Only once, subject to SLPRB approval)
Last Date for Document Submission 16-01-2026 (All documents must be issued on or before this date)
Age Calculation Date As on 01-01-2026
PET & PST Date Will be notified later on official website
Written Test Date Will be notified later on official website
Viva-Voce Date Will be notified later on official website

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 marks for Constable (UB) Male & Female, 40 marks for Constable (AB) Female, 60 marks for Constable (AB) Male
  • Stage 2: Medical Examination - Applicants will be examined by Medical & Health Officer for mental and bodily health parameters
  • Stage 3: Physical Standard Test (PST) - Height and Chest measurement (No marks, qualifying in nature)
  • Stage 4: Written Test - 50 marks (100 MCQ questions, 0.5 marks each, no negative marking)
  • Stage 5: Oral/Viva-Voce - 5 marks
  • Academic Weightage: 5 marks (Only for Constable UB based on HS percentage)
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at entry, exit and during all stages of recruitment
  • Shortlisting for Written Test: 5 times the number of posts based on PET merit
  • Shortlisting for Viva-Voce: 2 times the number of vacancies based on PET + Written Test merit

Total Marks Distribution

  • Constable (UB) Male & Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) + Academic (5) = 100 marks
  • Constable (AB) Male: PET (60) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 115 marks
  • Constable (AB) Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 95 marks

Physical Standards

Category Male Height Female Height Male Chest (Normal) Male Chest (Expansion)
General/OBC/MOBC/SC/ST(P) 162.5 cm 154 cm Min. 80 cm +5 cm
ST(H) 160 cm 152 cm Min. 78 cm +5 cm

Medical Standards

  • Applicants must be in good mental and bodily health
  • Must be free from physical deformities and diseases like diabetes, heart disease, hernia, piles, respiratory diseases, knock-knee, flat foot
  • Should not be colour blind or squint eyed
  • Eye Sight: Distance vision should be 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for the other without correction; Near vision should be normal
  • Varicose vein shall be considered as temporary disqualification

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must register in the application portal only once for all advertisements using single Application ID
  • Multiple Application IDs using different mobile numbers will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Name must be entered exactly as per HSLC Certificate
  • Valid mobile number and email address must be provided and kept active throughout recruitment process
  • Documents required: Latest passport photo (max 450 KB), Signature (max 100 KB in black/blue ink), Age proof, Mark sheets, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • All documents uploaded must be issued on or before 16-01-2026
  • Caste Certificate must be from Competent Authority authorized by Govt. of Assam only
  • Admit Card and Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License) mandatory for PET & PST
  • CCTV surveillance and RFID chips will be used for Race events
  • Individual statement of marks signed by applicant and conducting officer will be provided
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for journey and stay during any stage of recruitment
  • The number of posts may increase or decrease at any time due to administrative reasons
  • Final appointment subject to satisfactory Police Verification and Medical Examination Report
  • Selected candidates must undergo basic police training and serve minimum 3 years after posting
  • Selected applicants will be required to work in any District or Unit anywhere in Assam
  • No payment required at any stage except medical investigations in Government Hospital if required
  • Anonymous complaints will not be entertained
  • Incomplete, defective or invalid applications will be summarily rejected
  • Candidature will be rejected for providing wrong information, fake documents, misrepresentation or impersonation at any stage

Written Test Details

  • 100 Multiple Choice Questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Question level: Class IX and X standard
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical Reasoning/Mental Ability, Assam's History/Geography/Polity/Economy, General Awareness/GK and Current Affairs
  • Languages Available: Assamese, Bodo, Bengali, English

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the SLPRB portal at www.slprbassam.in with valid mobile number (Register only once for all advertisements)
  • Step 2: Provide accurate information including Employment Exchange Number, Highest Qualification, Permanent District, Gender, Caste/Category, Date of Birth, and Aadhaar Number
  • Step 3: After successful registration, an Application ID will be generated - keep it safe for future reference
  • Step 4: Login using Application ID or Registered Mobile Number along with Date of Birth
  • Step 5: Apply for the relevant Advertisement (SLPRB/REC/CONST (AB & UB)/727/2025/94)
  • Step 6: Upload mandatory documents - Photograph (450 KB max), Signature (100 KB max), Age Proof, HSLC/HS Mark sheets and Certificates, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Step 7: Upload additional documents if claiming reservation/quota benefits (Home Guard/VDP/SPO/FMMO/Sports/NCC certificates)
  • Step 8: Select post preferences clearly (UB/AB if applying for both)
  • Step 9: Fill in all personal and academic details carefully
  • Step 10: Generate OTP and download the Acknowledgement Slip
  • Step 11: Keep Acknowledgement Slip and Application ID safe for future reference
  • Edit option available for 5 days after last date (only once, subject to SLPRB approval) for inadvertent entry corrections
  • Bring all original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies on the day of PET & PST for verification
  • Detailed instructions available on SLPRB website at time of application submission

Selection Process

  • Stage-I Written examination: 120 marks The written examination (objective type multiple-choice) of 2 hours duration will be conducted on OMR sheets and will test the candidates' proficiency in English language, general knowledge, general aptitude, reasoning and Assamese language (20 marks).
  • The Assamese language proficiency segment will be of qualifying nature. Candidates securing at least 40% marks i.e. 8 out of 20 marks in the Assamese language proficiency segment shall be treated as qualified to appear in the next stage. The marks obtained in the Assamese language segment shall not be taken into account while preparing the merit list.
  • There shall be negative marking in the written examination. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 mark (one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question) will be deducted.
  • Interview/Viva-Voce: 20 marks Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit in the written examination will be called to appear in the Interview/Viva-Voce and verification of documents. A candidate must secure at least 60% i.e. 12 out of 20 marks in the Interview/Viva-Voce in order to be considered qualified.
  • Final selection will be made on the basis of the total marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination (Stage-I) and Interview/Viva-Voce (Stage-II). Where more than one candidate obtains same grand total marks, the candidate who obtains more marks in the written examination will get preference. Where the marks obtained by such candidates in the written examination are also same, then the candidate who is senior in age will get preference. In case of Present Employment, offer letter alone will not be considered as proof of experience, the candidate should also submit last Two Months’ salary slip of present employer for proof of experience. iii. Date of Birth/ class X passing certificate as proof of DOB. iv. Caste certificate/EWS Certificate/Age relaxation. Certificate issued should be in prescribed format as per Government of India's guidelines. v. Qualification Degree/Diploma and All semester/year Mark sheets for calculation of percentage in qualifying degree.

  • Candidates should mention percentage in the fields where percentage is required without rounding off. Percentage obtained in Essential Qualification as mentioned in consolidated mark sheet issued by University/Institution will be considered. In case where conversion into percentage is not provided by university/institutes: "if university/institute do not have the provision for conversion of CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or letter grade into percentage than minimum 6 on 10-point scale will be considered as 60%. On any scale different from 10-point scale the score will be prorated accordingly. ii. In case where conversion into percentage is provided by university/institutes: Wherever CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or letter grade in degree is awarded, equivalent % of marks should be indicated in the online application as per norms adopted by concerned university/institute.   • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

OSSSC Combined Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)
Post Name Revenue Inspector (RI), ICDS Supervisor, Village Agricultural Worker (VAW), Junior Assistant (JA), Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI), Amin & Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS)
No of Posts 3250
Salary Revenue Inspector, ICDS Supervisor: Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01
Village Agricultural Worker: Pay Scale ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01
Junior Assistant, Assistant Revenue Inspector: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01
Amin, Statistical Field Surveyor: Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01
Qualification Post-wise educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions as prescribed in the Detailed Advertisement for CRE-2025.
Age Limit 42 years as on 1st January, 2025 (post-wise as specified with admissible relaxations).
Start Date for Apply  07.01.2026
Last Date for Apply  31.01.2026 (online application submission)
Official Website www.osssc.gov.in

OSSSC Combined Posts Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Group Department Total Posts Scale of Pay & Pay Matrix Level
Revenue Inspector (RI) Group B Revenue & Disaster Management Department 165 ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01
ICDS Supervisor Group B Women & Child Development Department 286 ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01
Village Agricultural Worker (VAW) Group C Agriculture & Farmers’ Empowerment Department 520 ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01
Junior Assistant (JA) Group C Finance, Revenue & Disaster Management, A & FE, W & CD Departments 1237 ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01
Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI) Group C Revenue & Disaster Management Department 422 ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01
Amin Group C Revenue & Disaster Management Department 378 ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01
Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS) Group C Planning & Convergence Department 242 ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01
Total 3250  

Eligibility Criteria

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline or equivalent from a recognized University with knowledge in computer application. Age: over 20 years and below 42 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Bachelor’s Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce or its equivalent. Only women candidates; age not less than 21 years and not more than 42 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Passed +2 Science or +2 Vocational course in Agriculture related subject in Crop Production (CP) / Horticulture (HORT) / Repair and Maintenance of Power Driven Farm Machinery (PDFM) from a recognized Board/Council/Institution; Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic under OUAT is desirable and carries 5% extra marks in Written Test.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Passed +3 in Arts / Science / Commerce or equivalent with knowledge of Computer Skill.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, having knowledge in computer application.
  • Amin: Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, with knowledge in computer application (as per detailed table text).
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Passed 10+2 examination conducted by CHSE, Odisha or CBSE or CISCE or any other examination equivalent thereto.
  • Odia language: Must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed ME School Exam with Odia as language subject, or Matriculation with Odia as medium in non-language subjects, or passed Odia as a language subject in Class VII or above, or passed Odia language test in ME School Standard conducted by School & Mass Education Department.
  • Other criteria: Must be a citizen of India, of good character, and if married must not have more than one spouse living except as exempted under personal law.
  • Junior Assistant-specific: Must have registered name in an Employment Exchange of the concerned district (or State/Special Employment Exchange with Resident Certificate of concerned district) on or before the date of submission of online application.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Must possess Permanent Disability Certificate / UDID card with not less than 40% disability in the category and sub-category suitable for the post, as per Annexures I to VII.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Must possess Identity Card/Discharge Certificate/documents in support of defence service and furnish an undertaking about non-availment of earlier re-employment under Government of Odisha.

Salary/Stipend

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Pay Scale ₹ 35400–112400, Pay Matrix Level-9, Cell-01 under W & CD Department.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Pay Scale ₹ 21700–69100, Pay Matrix Level-5, Cell-01 under A & FE Department.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Finance, R & DM, A & FE, W & CD Departments.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • Amin: Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01 under R & DM Department.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Pay Scale ₹ 18000–56900, Pay Matrix Level-3, Cell-01 under Planning & Convergence Department.

Age Limit

  • Revenue Inspector (RI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • ICDS Supervisor: Not less than 21 years and not more than 42 years; Anganwadi Workers get additional 5 years relaxation for ICDS Supervisor only, besides general relaxation.
  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • Amin: As per post-wise age and educational qualification table, within 21–42 years.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • SC/ST/SEBC: Upper age relaxed by 5 years.
  • Women (for RI, ARI, VAW, JA, Amin & SFS): Upper age relaxed by 5 years; for ICDS Supervisor (women-only post) this additional 5 years is not applicable, except for Anganwadi Workers as stated.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Upper age relaxed by 10 years; PwDs of SC/ST/SEBC entitled to cumulative age relaxation over category relaxation as per Odisha Civil Service (Fixation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 1989.
  • Ex-Servicemen: For RI & ICDS Supervisor, upper age relaxed by 5 years; for other posts, relaxation by total period of defence service rendered, subject to conditions mentioned.
  • RI, ARI & Amin: Age relaxation up to five years for candidates having actual work experience in settlement/consolidation organisations.

Application Fee

  • As per Odisha Payment of Recruitment Examination Fees and Refund Rules, 2025.
  • Candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) shall pay Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- using Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI through Payment Gateway during online application.
  • SC, ST and PwDs candidates are exempted from payment of Examination Fee.
  • Examination fee of ₹ 500/- shall be refunded to applicants who actually appear in the examination, after verification of attendance records, to the same bank account / payment method used at registration.
  • No refund is admissible to applicants who fail to appear in the examination for any reason.
  • If Confirmation Page is not generated after fee payment, transaction will be cancelled and refund credited within 48 hours; applicant must make another payment for successful application in such cases.

Important Dates

Event Start Date End Date
Online Registration (Fresh candidates – New User who have not registered earlier) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Re-registration (Registered User who already have User ID for any previous post) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Submission of Online Application (after Registration / Re-registration) 07.01.2026 07.02.2026
Last date of receipt of online applications - 07.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Stage-I: Written Test – 100 marks, MCQ type in OMR/CBRE mode, of minimum standard of High School Certificate Examination.
  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (20, 20), English (20, 20), Odia (15, 15), Computer (15, 15), Logical Reasoning (10, 10); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks assigned to a question deducted for each wrong answer; multiple answers treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwDs, Ex-Servicemen and Sportspersons; 35% for others. VAW candidates with Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic (OUAT) get 5% extra marks (capped at total marks).
  • Stage-II: Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills – 50 marks, 1 hour; qualifying in nature with minimum 40% for all candidates.
  • Number of candidates shortlisted for Practical Skill Test: not less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category/special category wise, as per merit and availability; Commission may vary as per requirement.
  • Merit Lists: Provisional Master Merit List based on marks / normalized score in Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Practical Skill Test; Provisional Merit List of Practical Skill Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Provisional Select Lists post-wise / district-wise.
  • Document Verification & Counselling: Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification by District Level Board and then counselling for choice of post and Department/District/Range; allotment based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • Commission reserves right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Skill Test, reschedule tests, and cancel part or whole of recruitment at any stage.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online only through OSSSC website; applications other than online / incomplete shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions (except age) must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • No Admission Letter shall be issued to candidates whose application is incomplete or who do not fulfil prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Provisional Admission Letters / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Practical Skill Test shall be uploaded on www.osssc.gov.in only; no hard copy will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must regularly visit the Commission’s website to track notices, exam dates, and download Admission / Intimation Letters using User ID and Password.
  • Information uploaded on website will not be supplied separately under RTI Act, 2005 and will remain available for a specific period only; candidates should download and preserve it.
  • Candidature remains purely provisional and is liable to rejection at any stage for deficiency / misrepresentation / use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not permitted and will lead to cancellation of result and other penalties as per rules.
  • In CBRE mode, appearing in more than one shift/date by furnishing false information is treated as unfair means and penalised.
  • Commission’s decision on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalties, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allotment, preparation of merit list, allocation of post, and debarment is final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and click on “Apply Online”.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any recruitment of OSSSC must complete Registration by providing required details and uploading full specimen signature and passport-size photograph in prescribed formats and sizes.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post must login using existing User ID and select “Re-registration” option for this post.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not mean filing of online application; candidates must login again and fill and submit the detailed Online Application Form as per instructions on the screen.
  • Fill in all data and information as per certificates/records, upload required documents, and make Examination Fee payment (if applicable) through available online payment modes.
  • Ensure that the photograph and signature uploaded are clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise registration/application is liable to rejection.
  • Use own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment process for receiving Activation Key, alerts, and for downloading Admission Letters; do not share or change this contact during the process.
  • Submit online application well in advance without waiting for the last date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • Take printout of Confirmation Page after successful submission and fee payment (where applicable).

Advertisement

Federal Bank Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Number of Vacancies
Office Assistant Multiple Vacancies across Notified Branches/Offices in various States/UTs

State-wise Coverage: Assam, Delhi, Goa, Gujarat, Karnataka, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Meghalaya, Odisha, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (as on 01.12.2025):

  • Candidates should have passed 10th Standard or equivalent examination but not passed Graduation.
  • Candidates should have adequate knowledge in Microsoft Office and should have undergone at least a one-month (basic/foundation) training programme in Microsoft Office.
  • Certificate of Microsoft Office training undergone by the candidate shall be produced prior to the Personal Interview.

Essential Requirements:

  • Nationality: Candidates shall be a citizen of India.
  • Place of Domicile: The place of domicile of the candidate should be located in the same district of Notified Branch/Office OR within 20 kilometres from Notified Branch/Office.
  • Desirable Qualification: Possession of a valid Driving License issued in India will be considered desirable.
  • Criminal Record: Candidates applying for the selection process should not have any criminal record.

Salary/Stipend

  • Starting Basic Pay: ₹19,500-665/4-22,160-830/5-26,310-990/4-30,270-1,170/3-33,780-1,345/3-37,815 plus 11 stagnation increments
  • National Pension Scheme (NPS): Selected candidates will be covered under the National Pension Scheme.
  • Gratuity: Eligible as per rules in force from time to time.
  • Concessional Loans: Loans available on concessional interest rate as per Bank's rules.
  • Medical Insurance: Coverage for self and dependents as per rules in force.
  • Other Benefits: Additional benefits as per Bank's policies from time to time.

Age Limit (as on 01.12.2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 20 years
  • Date of Birth Range: Candidates should be born between 01.12.2005 and 01.12.2007 (both dates inclusive)
  • Age Relaxation (Maximum 5 years): Following categories are eligible for upper age relaxation up to a maximum of 5 years. Such candidates should be born between 01.12.2000 and 01.12.2007 (both dates inclusive):
    • Candidates who have previously served or are serving in any Branch or Office of Federal Bank as a temporary Office Assistant/Bankman, Driver or Caretaker, and who have been empanelled by the Bank on or before 01.12.2025.
    • Candidates belonging to SC/ST category.

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / Others ₹500
SC / ST ₹100
  • Additional Charges: Online transaction charges and GST at applicable rates (18%) to be charged extra.
  • Payment Mode: Debit Cards, Credit Cards, UPI or Internet Banking.
  • Refund Policy: Application fee once paid will not be refunded nor would be held in reserve for any future selection. The application fee will also not be refunded in case the application is rejected/not considered by Federal Bank.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification 30 December 2025
Online Application Start Date 30 December 2025
Last Date of Application 08 January 2026
Date of Centre Based Online Aptitude Test 01/02/2026
Admit Card Download Link (Expected) On or before 23/01/2026
Qualification/Age as on Date 01/12/2025
Request for Scribe (Last Date) 11/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Centre Based Online Aptitude Test: Conducted by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) as the assessment partner of Federal Bank.
  • Test Pattern: Objective type multiple choice questions consisting of 4 sections:
    • Computer Knowledge - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • English - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Logical Reasoning - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Mathematics - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Total: 60 Questions (60 Marks) in 60 Minutes (Composite time)
  • Test Medium: English only.
  • Negative Marking: There will NOT be any negative marking for wrong answers.
  • Personal Interview: Candidates shortlisted from the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test only will be considered for Personal Interview round. The same will be scheduled at various centres across the country at the discretion of the Bank.
  • Elimination Stage: Every selection round will be an elimination stage.
  • Shortlisting: Bank reserves the right to shortlist only the requisite number of candidates in the selection rounds based on administrative requirements.
  • Confidential Results: Marks/Ratings secured by candidates during any selection round will be confidential and will not be disclosed at any point of time.

Test Centres:

Guwahati (Assam), Delhi, Panaji (Goa), Ahmedabad (Gujarat), Bangalore (Karnataka), Ernakulam, Thrissur, Kottayam, Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram (Kerala), Indore (Madhya Pradesh), Mumbai, Pune (Maharashtra), Bhubaneswar (Odisha), Amritsar (Punjab), Chennai, Erode, Madurai (Tamil Nadu), Hyderabad (Telangana), Kolkata (West Bengal)

General Information/Instructions

  • Probation Period: Candidates selected for the post of Office Assistant will be on probation for a period of 6 months. The period of probation is liable to be extended if any candidate has not satisfactorily completed the initial period of probation.
  • Posting Location: Selected candidates shall be posted in any of the Branches/Offices of the Bank and are liable to be transferred to any Branch/Office depending upon the administrative requirements.
  • Single Application: Candidates should submit only one application. Candidature of applicants submitting more than one application is liable to be cancelled without notice and compensation.
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidates should confirm their identity using a valid ID proof (Aadhar Card, Driving License, Passport, Voters ID or PAN) to participate in the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test. Ration Card is not considered as a valid id proof.
  • Name Matching: Name appearing on the admit card of the candidate should exactly match with the name that appears in the photo identity proof. Candidates who have changed their name will be allowed only if they produce Gazette notification/their registered marriage certificate indicating the changes.
  • Late Reporting: Candidates reporting late i.e. after the reporting time specified on the admit card will not be permitted to participate in the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test.
  • Malpractice: Candidates found violating instructions/engaging in malpractices will be disqualified and/or may be asked to leave the examination hall.
  • Document Upload: Candidates shortlisted from the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test need to download the Fed-Recruit Mobile Application and upload required documents for further processing.
  • Medical Fitness: Onboarding of shortlisted candidates will be subject to being declared medically fit by the Bank's Medical Officer.
  • Background Verification: Satisfactory report about character and antecedents by Police Authorities, Credit History including CIBIL/Experian scores and status, satisfactory references from respectable referees required.
  • Social Media Prohibition: Recording or sharing the content/details of any selection rounds privately or on social media or discussion forums is strictly prohibited.
  • Canvassing Disqualification: Any canvassing by or on behalf of the candidates or to bring political or other influence with regard to their selection shall be considered as a disqualification.

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online only through Bank's official website.
  • Application Period: 30.12.2025 to 08.01.2026 (both days inclusive).
  • Step 1: Visit the Bank's website www.federalbank.in/careers and click on the link 'Explore Opportunities' or 'Join Our Team'.
  • Step 2: Click on 'View Details' button hosted under 'Office Assistant'. Read the recruitment notification carefully.
  • Step 3: Click on 'Apply' button and enter your valid Email address and Mobile Number which will be your registered contact throughout the process.
  • Step 4: Click the 'Send OTP' button and you will receive an OTP for validation.
  • Step 5: Enter your Personal, Academic, Experience and other details as required. Fill all fields in the registration portal correctly.
  • Step 6: Upload Photograph and Signature as per prescribed specifications.
  • Step 7: Proceed to payment of application fee through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, UPI or Internet Banking.
  • Step 8: Upon completion of registration, verify the status through automated Email sent to registered Email address.
  • Step 9: Receipt of confirmation mail and E-Receipt is mandatory for participating in the recruitment process.
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to carefully verify the details entered in the registration portal, as no change will be possible after clicking the 'I Agree' button.
  • Early Submission: Bank reserves the right to close the application window at any time before 08.01.2026 based on volume of applications received. Therefore, candidates are advised to submit their application at the earliest opportunity.

Documents Required for Upload (After Shortlisting):

  • 10th Mark List / Certificates
  • 12th / Diploma Mark List / Certificates (if applicable)
  • Graduation Mark Lists if pursued (if applicable)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Forester: Must have passed +2 Science from recognized University, Institution or Board with knowledge in basic Computer skills. Must have attained age of 18 years and not above 32 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Forest Guard: Must have passed High School Certificate Examination (10+) from recognized Board or Institution. Age: within 18–32 years as on 1st January, 2025 as per table.
  • Excise Constable: Must have passed +2 Examination or equivalent conducted by Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha or any other recognized Board or Council. Must have attained age of 21 years and not above 32 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Odia language: Must be able to read, write & speak Odia and must have passed Middle English School Examination with Odia as language subject, or Matriculation with Odia as medium in non-language subjects, or Odia as language subject in Class VII or above, or passed Odia test in ME School Standard conducted by School & Mass Education Department.
  • Other eligibility: Must be a citizen of India, of good character, and if married must not have more than one spouse living except where exempted under applicable personal law.
  • Sportsperson: Applicants claiming reservation as Sportsperson must possess valid Sportsperson Identity Card issued by Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha as on date of submission of application and upload scanned original card.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Must possess Permanent Disability Certificate / UDID card with not less than 40% disability in relevant category and sub-category, along with suitable physical requirements and functional classification as required for the post; must enter details in online application. Benchmark PwDs get compensatory time @ 20 minutes per hour in Written Test and may avail scribe with prior permission.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Must possess Identity Card / Discharge Certificate / documents supporting defence service and furnish undertaking that no re-employment under Government of Odisha has been availed earlier.
  • Excise Constable – Medical/Physical conditions: Must not have knock knee, bow legs, flat foot, varicose veins, squint in eyes, poor vision, colour blindness, inability to flex fingers properly, or other obvious deformities; no impediment in speech and hearing. Candidates with disability or deformity are not eligible for Excise Constable.
  • Forester/Forest Guard – PwD exclusion: No Persons with Disabilities shall be eligible for these posts except Leprosy Cured Persons and Acid Attack Victims as per prescribed reservation.

Salary/Stipend

  • Forester: Pay Scale ₹ 25500–81100, Pay Matrix Level-7, Cell-1 under Forest, Environment & Climate Change Department.
  • Forest Guard: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Forest, Environment & Climate Change Department.
  • Excise Constable: Pay Scale ₹ 19900–63200, Pay Matrix Level-4, Cell-01 under Excise Department.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Forester: Minimum 18 years and maximum 32 years.
  • Forest Guard: Age within 18–32 years as specified for the post; age reckoned as on 1st January, 2025.
  • Excise Constable: Must have attained age of 21 years and must not be above 32 years as on 1st January, 2025.
  • SC/ST/SEBC/Women: Upper age relaxable by 5 years.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): Upper age relaxable by 10 years.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Upper age relaxable by total period of defence service rendered, subject to not having more than six months of service remaining on last date of online application and conditions related to prior re-employment.
  • A candidate coming under more than one category is eligible for only one relaxation, which is most beneficial, except PwDs under SC/ST/SEBC who are entitled to cumulative 10 years relaxation over normal category relaxation as per Odisha Civil Service (Fixation of Upper Age Limit) Rules, 1989.

Application Fee

  • As per Odisha Payment of Recruitment Examination Fees and Refund Rules, 2025.
  • Candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) shall pay Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- using Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI through Payment Gateway during online application.
  • SC, ST and PwDs candidates are exempted from payment of Examination Fee.
  • Examination Fee of ₹ 500/- paid shall be refunded to applicants who actually appear for the examination after conduct of examination and verification of attendance records.
  • Refund shall be credited to the bank account or payment method used at the time of registration; applicants are advised to use their own account to avoid inconvenience.
  • No refund shall be admissible to applicants who fail to appear in the examination for any reason whatsoever.
  • If Confirmation Page is not generated after payment, the transaction will be cancelled and amount refunded within 48 hours; applicants then need to make another payment/transaction to complete the application.

Important Dates

Event Start Date End Date
Online Registration (Fresh candidates – New User) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Re-registration (Registered User) 07.01.2026 31.01.2026
Submission of Online Application (after Registration / Re-registration) 07.01.2026 07.02.2026
Last date of receipt of online applications - 07.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Stage-I: Written Test – 100 marks, MCQ type in OMR/CBRE mode, of minimum standard of High School Certificate Examination.
  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (25 questions, 25 marks), English (20 questions, 20 marks), Odia (15 questions, 15 marks), Computer (20 questions, 20 marks); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks for each question deducted for every wrong answer; more than one option marked is treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwD, Ex-Servicemen and Sportsperson categories; 35% for all other candidates.
  • Questions and answer options of all segments will be bilingual (except English and Odia language subjects); in case of any confusion in Odia version, English version shall prevail.
  • In CBRE mode, examination may be held on multiple dates/shifts using multiple question sets; normalization formula will be adopted to convert raw scores into normalized scores.
  • Candidates may select maximum three preferred districts for test centre; Commission may allot another district depending on infrastructure / capacity.
  • For Excise Constable, bonus marks are awarded to candidates possessing NCC certificates: NCC ‘B’ Certificate – 01 mark; NCC ‘C’ Certificate – 02 marks.
  • Stage-II: Physical Test – Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for all three posts; number of candidates shortlisted for Physical Test shall not be less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category-wise, subject to Commission’s discretion.
  • Physical Standard Measurement – Forester/Forest Guard: Minimum Height and Chest as prescribed by category and gender (e.g., Men UR/SEBC/SC: 168 cm height, chest 81 cm unexpanded with up to 5 cm expansion; Men ST: 158 cm height; Women UR/SEBC/SC/ST: 153 cm height). Color blindness is disqualification.
  • Physical Standard Measurement – Excise Constable: Category-wise minimum Height, Weight and Chest (e.g., Men UR/SEBC: 168 cm height, 55 kg weight, chest 79–84 cm; Men SC/ST: 163 cm, 50 kg, 76–81 cm; Women UR/SEBC: 158 cm, 47.5 kg; Women SC/ST: 153 cm, 45 kg). Minimum 5 cm difference between unexpanded and expanded chest.
  • Physical Efficiency Test – Forester/Forest Guard: Male (all categories): Walking Test 25 km in 4 hours; Female (all categories): Walking Test 16 km in 4 hours.
  • Physical Efficiency Test – Excise Constable: Male: Running 1.6 km in 7 minutes and Long Jump 3.66 m in 3 attempts; Female: Running 1.6 km in 9 minutes and Long Jump 2.75 m in 3 attempts.
  • Failure to qualify in any PSM/PET event leads to disqualification from recruitment for the concerned post.
  • Merit Lists & Further Stages: Provisional Master Merit List of Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Physical Test; Provisional Merit List of Physical Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Document Verification by District Level Board; Counselling for post and district/circle/division choice; Post-wise, District/Circle/Division-wise Provisional Select Lists based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • OSSSC reserves the right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Physical Test, reschedule tests, cancel part or whole of recruitment, and decide all matters of eligibility, selection and debarment.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited online through OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in; applications other than online mode or incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions except age must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • Provisional Admission / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Physical Test will be uploaded on the Commission’s website well before examination dates; dates of tests will also be advertised in local newspapers.
  • Candidates must download Admission / Intimation Letters from www.osssc.gov.in using their User ID & Password; no printed letters will be sent by post or any other mode.
  • Candidates should visit the Commission’s website at regular intervals for notices, exam schedules, results and other updates.
  • Information uploaded on the website will not be supplied under the RTI Act, 2005 and will remain there only for a specific period; candidates should download and keep necessary documents.
  • Candidature is purely provisional and liable to rejection at any stage for inadequacy, deficiency, misrepresentation, suppression, wrong information or use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not allowed; such cases will lead to cancellation of result and will be treated as unfair means.
  • Candidates who fail to appear/qualify at any stage of the recruitment process shall not be considered for final selection.
  • The Commission shall sponsor exactly the same number of candidates as total vacancies advertised, category-wise, for each post as per merit and availability.
  • The decision of the Commission on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalty, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allocation, preparation of merit lists, post allocation and debarment shall be final and binding; no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and refer to “How do I register/re-register/apply” on the Home page for step-by-step procedure.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any OSSSC recruitment must register by clicking “Apply Online” on the Home page and filling the Registration Form.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post with a User ID must login and select the “Re-registration” option under the Applicant Menu for this recruitment.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not constitute submission of Online Application; candidates must login again, furnish all required data and submit the Online Application Form as guided by the system.
  • Incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected; no Admission Letter will be issued to candidates with incomplete applications or who do not fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Pre-requisites: Payment of ₹ 500/- Examination Fee (for non-SC/ST/PwDs); scanned full specimen signature in jpg/jpeg/png (20–50 KB); scanned recent passport size colour photograph in jpg/jpeg/png (20–100 KB); certificates and mark sheets for entering educational details.
  • Photograph and signature must be clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise Registration / Application is liable to rejection.
  • Applicants must use their own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment for receiving Activation Key, alerts and Admission Letters; they should not share/change these details.
  • Submit Online Application well before the last date to avoid last-hour rush in the online application system.

  • M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology with 60% marks or CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale with minimum 3 years of relevant clinical experience

  • Experience in Counseling students of highly competitive residential Institute of higher learning

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

Eligibility Criteria

  • A medical Qualification included in the I or II schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956 (Persons possessing qualifications included in part II of third schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in section 13(3) of the Act.)
  • A postgraduate qualification e.g. MD/MS or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto in the respective discipline/subject.
  • Three years teaching and/or research experience in recognized Institution in the subject of specialty after obtaining the qualifying degree of M.D. /M.S. or qualification recognized equivalent thereto.
  • A medical Qualification included in the I or II schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956 (Persons possessing qualifications included in part II of third schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in section 13(3) of the Act.).
  • A postgraduate qualification e.g. MD/MS or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto in the respective discipline/subject.
  • D.M. in the respective discipline/subject for medical super specialties and M.Ch. in the respective discipline/subject for surgical super specialties (2 years or 3 years or 5 years recognized course) or a qualification recognized equivalent thereto.
  • One-year teaching and/or research experience in a recognized Institution in the subject of specialty after obtaining the qualifying degree of D.M./M.Ch. (2 years or 5 years recognized course after MBBS) or qualification recognized equivalent thereto. However, no experience is necessary for the candidates possessing the 3 years recognized degree of D.M/M.Ch. or qualification recognized equivalent thereto.
  • Postgraduate qualification e.g. Master degree in the discipline/allied subject.
  • A Doctorate degree of a recognized University in concerned discipline.
  • Three years teaching and/or research experience in the discipline/subject concerned after obtaining the Doctorate degree.
  • M.Sc. (Medical Anatomy) with PhD Medical Anatomy.
  • M.Sc. (Medical Biochemistry) with PhD Medical Biochemistry.
  • M.Sc. (Medical Physiology) with PhD Medical Physiology.
  • M.Sc. (Medical Pharmacology) with PhD Medical Pharmacology
  • A recognized Bachelor of Dental Surgery degree qualification included in part-I of the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • A recognized Dental qualification obtained upto 01.11.1972 under Part-II of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • A recognized Dental qualification granted by authority or institution outside India only when granted to a citizen of India upto 13.08.2009 under Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentists Act, 1948 (16 of 1948).
  • Any person who is citizen of India possessing foreign qualification and has appeared and passed the Screening Test Examination as per Screening Test Regulation 2009 w.e.f.13.08.2009.
  • A post-graduate degree in Dental Surgery from a recognized University or Institution.
  • Should be registered with any State Dental Council or Tribunal in India.
  • 3 years' teaching experience in the specialty as Tutor or Demonstrator or Registrar or Senior Resident or Lecturer after requisite post Graduate qualification from a recognized teaching institution.

  • No Application Fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women Candidates of any community.

Important Dates

Starting Date 22/12/2025
Last Date submission of the Online application The Cut-off date (the Last Date submission of the Online application Form) for the aforementioned Posts will be 30 days from the date of publication of Notification in the Employment News/ Rozgar Samachar.

Selection Process

  • Based on the application, the Screening Committee may short- list candidates for interview. If required there may be Screening test to shortlist candidates for interviews in case large number of candidates apply for a post or posts.
  • Candidates called for interview will have to produce all relevant original documents in proof of details furnished in their application at the time of interview.
  • They may also be asked to submit an affidavit/declaration as decided by the AIIMS, Bhubaneswar at time of Interview.
  • The methodology of Selection will be decided by the Standing Selection Committee as deemed fit besides any other matter relating to the selection process.

General Information/Instructions

  • The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Competent Authority, AIIMS Bhubaneswar reserves the right to alter the vacancies including reserved vacancies as per the Govt. of India Rules/ Circulars and requirements or otherwise.
  • Relaxation of One-year Teaching/Research experience for SC/ST candidates in Faculty selection will be given as per Rules/Guidelines issued by DoPT/ Govt of India.
  • Qualifications and experiences as prescribed may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Standing Selection Committee with prior approval of the Competent Authority.
  • 4% of the total vacancies are horizontally reserved for PwBD candidates as per the RPwD Act 2016 and as per the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment's Notification No. 16-15/2010-DD.III dated 29th July, 2013 as amended from time to time as applicable. The physical requirements for the posts involve performing tasks by S (Sitting), ST (Standing), W (Walking), MF (Manipulation by Fingers), and RW (Reading & Writing). All the instructions of Govt. of India as applicable in this regard will be followed.
  • Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) shall be applicable as per Govt. of India, Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) DoPT dated 19th January, 2019 and 31st January, 2019. EWS candidate must ensure that they have a valid EWS certificate, issued during the current financial year. EWSs Candidates will attach certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the form prescribed as per Annexure - A. In case suitable Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) candidates are not found, these posts will not be carried forward/or considered as backlog vacancy, hence Unreserved (UR) candidates may also be allowed provisionally to apply against EWSs posts advertised through above referred advertisement who may be considered incase suitable EWSs candidate are not found to fill up these posts reserved for EWSs.
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy.
  • The cut-off date to determine the maximum age limit, essential qualification & experiences will be the last date of submission of online application.
  • The period of experience wherever prescribed shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification.
  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on last date of submission of online applications.
  • No age relaxation would be available to SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.
  • Age relaxation permissible to various categories is as under: SC/ST 05 Years, OBC 03 Years, PwBD 10 Years, Government Servant (As per DoPT instruction) 05 Years
  • Age relaxation to other categories of the candidates will also be applicable as per the DoPT instructions.
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD will be as per Government of India Policy.
  • Candidates applying against any of the reserved category posts, viz. SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS will be considered on production of valid Caste/ PwBD/ EWS Certificate issued by the Appropriate/Competent Authority on the prescribed format. Community should be clearly and legibly mentioned in the Certificate.
  • Applicants applying for the posts reserved for OBC must obtain certificate of OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) in the prescribed format issued by Competent Authority. The certificate should be of the Current Financial Year and in accordance with instructions issued by the Government of India in this respect from time to time. Applicants should ascertain that they belong to the reserved categories (caste) enlisted in the Central List for the Other Backward Classes. OBC candidate(s) should not belong to Creamy Layer and their sub-caste should match with the entries in Central List of OBC, failing which their candidatures will not be considered under any of the applied reserved category post(s).
  • Reservation for candidates belonging to the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) shall be applicable in accordance with the Government of India Office Memoranda No. 36039/1/2019-Estt. (Res) dated 19th January 2019 and 31st January 2019, issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT). Candidates claiming reservation under the EWS category must possess a valid EWS certificate, issued during the current financial year. The certificate must be issued by the Competent Authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India. In the event that suitable EWS candidates are not available, the posts reserved for the EWS category shall neither be carried forward nor treated as backlog vacancies. Accordingly, Unreserved (UR) candidates are provisionally allowed to apply for these posts reserved for EWS and they may be considered for selection in the absence of suitable EWS candidates.
  • 4% of the total vacancies are horizontally reserved for PwBD candidates as per the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment's Notification No. 16-15/2010-DD.III dated 29th July, 2013 as amended from time to time as applicable. Out of the aforementioned 18 posts, 1 post has been earmarked for PwBD candidate. The vacancies only in the departments of Dermatology, General Medicine, General Surgery, Hospital Administration, Microbiology, Neurology, Paediatrics, Pathology and Radio diagnosis have been identified suitable for applicable category of PwBD candidates as mentioned at para 4 above.
  • Only such persons would be eligible for reservation under PwBD quota in service/posts who suffer from not less than 40% of physical disability. Person who wants to avail the benefit of reservation has to submit a Disability Certificate as issued by a Competent Authority in prescribed format. However, the candidature of PwBD applicant is subject to evaluation by a Medical Board duly constituted by the Executive Director, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar. This Medical Board will evaluate suitability of candidates for the post he/she is being considered for. All the instructions of Govt. of India as amended and as applicable in this matter will be followed if the same is not consistent in this connection.
  • The applicants who are already in Government service (including AIIMS Bhubaneswar Employees) shall have to produce No Objection Certificate from their present employer at the time of Interview or as per the instructions issued from time to time. However, they have to take prior permission from their employer while applying for the post. No candidate will be allowed to appear for the interview without NOC from his employer.
  • All the posts carry usual allowances as admissible to Central Government Employees of similar status as admissible under the rules.
  • The applicants applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for. They must be fulfilling Eligibility Criteria as on the cut-off date of online applications failing which their application will be rejected. They must possess the educational qualification and experiences as recognized by the Govt. of India. Their candidature will be cancelled at any stage if it is found that their educational qualification or experiences is not recognized by the Govt. of India.
  • The aspiring applicants satisfying the eligibility criteria in all respect can apply through ON-LINE application mode only. The On-line registration of application will be made available on official website of AIIMS, Bhubaneswar i.e. https://aiimsbhubaneswar.nic.in/. General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must possess a valid e-Mail ID and Mobile number while applying for the post and keep the same active till the completion of this recruitment process to receive important messages from the Commission.
  • The appointment will be only against one of the posts carrying the corresponding pay as indicated in the above table and candidates need to give option for the posts/services.
  • The candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay the Examination fee of Rupees Five Hundred (₹ 500/-) only. The examination fee paid shall be refunded to the candidates who actually appear in the recruitment examination.
  • Appointments shall be on a regular basis, carrying the level of pay as mentioned in the table above.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill all the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post as laid down in the advertisement. Admission of a candidate to the written examination and other tests shall be provisional and based on the information furnished by her/him in the Online Application Form.
  • Online applications submitted to OSSC found to be incomplete in any respect are liable for rejection without entertaining any correspondence with the applicants on that matter.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or thereafter, it is found that any information furnished by the candidate in her/his Online Application Form is false/incorrect or the candidate has suppressed any relevant information or the candidate otherwise does not satisfy the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post, her/his candidature for the posts shall be cancelled. She/ He may further be debarred either temporarily or permanently from the recruitment examination(s) conducted by the Commission.
  • Commission will adopt a “Normalisation Formula” published in Commission’s website vide Notice No.2444/ OSSC dated 02.09.2021 for processing the result if any examination is conducted through CBRE (Computer Based Recruitment Examination)/OMR in multiple batches using different sets of question papers so as to offset the difficulty level that may arise in such use of multiple sets of question papers in the said examination, and such normalized score will be used to determine the last selection marks of different categories. The Commission at its discretion will conduct the examination either through OMR or through CBRE mode.
  • No Admission Letter for recruitment at any stage shall be sent by post. The candidates are therefore advised to be in touch with the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in regularly to know updates regarding the status of application, downloading of Admission Letter and the date of examination etc.
  • The candidates are advised to submit the Online Application Form well in advance without waiting for the closing date to avoid the last-hour rush.
  • As regards the candidates applying for more than one post/ service as per their eligibility, the Commission will make the final allotment to a post/ service on the basis of merit-cum-preference of post/ service given by the candidate. Once a post is allotted, no change of posts will be made by the Commission due to non-fulfilment of any post-specific requirements of Physical/medical/educational standards, etc. Candidates thus must ensure that they fulfil all the requirements of the posts before giving their preference/options for any post/ service.
  • The candidate has to fill/confirm in the OMR answer sheet or CBRE Screen, as the case may be, correct Roll Number and other data as required in the place(s) indicated therein and darken the appropriate circles properly in Blue or Black Ball Point Pen only in case of OMR-based examination. If the information so furnished is incomplete or different from the application form or if appropriate circle is not darkened properly, then zero marks will be awarded.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/ re-checking of scores in the Examination. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Sharing of marks with the candidates: Marks obtained by an applicant in Preliminary Examination and Main Examination are proposed to be shared with her/him after final merit list is published.
  • All the posts are State Cadre posts. The candidate, on selection, may be asked to serve anywhere in Odisha.
  • If a candidate scoring more than the last selection mark at any stage of the examination is not qualified for the subsequent stage/ final selection due to any reason, he must represent to the Commission within 05 days of the declaration of the said result through e-mail [email protected].
  • Applicants who are Government servants or working under PSUs of the State Govt. or Central Govt. should obtain a “No Objection Certificate” from their controlling authority and upload the same with the Online Application form. In case a standing order of NOC is issued by any Department of Govt the same should be uploaded. At the certificate verification stage they must produce the “No Objection certificate” or “Standing order of NOC issued by the concerned Department of Govt.”. Those who are not Government Servants/working in PSUs at the time of submission of application but became Government Servants subsequently should have to submit “No Objection Certificate” or “Standing order of NOC” at the stage of certificate verification. If any candidate hides her/ his Govt. servant/PSU Employees status, and found to be a Govt. servant or a PSU Employee during Certificate Verification may not be considered for recommendation.

How to Apply

  • The applicants should go through the detail advertisement before filling up the online application form.
  • The candidate may apply for the post as per her/his eligibility as per terms of the advertisement.
  • All eligible candidates have to register themselves by clicking on "APPLY ONLINE" button on the home page of the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in.
  • Those candidates who are applying for the first time have to register for the post by clicking on "NEW USER" button shown on the screen. On submitting the registration form a User Id and Password will be generated.
  • On clicking "New user" or "Registered User", instruction for filling up the Online Registration/ Re-registration and Application Forms shall appear on the computer screen. These instructions should be read carefully before proceeding with filling up the Application Form.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science/Climate Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Economics: Post Graduate Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Financial Economics/Statistics/Data Science/Finance/Public Policy with minimum 55% marks

  • Cyber Security: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Electronics and Communications Engineering with minimum 60% marks OR Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks

  • Graphic Designing: Bachelor's degree in Digital Media/Multimedia/Graphic Design with minimum 60% marks
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Post graduate degree in Mass Media/Development Communication/Visual Communication/Journalism with minimum 55% marks
  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks
