  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025

Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form

Selection Process

  • Applications received within the prescribed date and time with requisite fee will be scrutinized by the scrutiny committee of the Institute.
  • Candidates found eligible after scrutiny will ONLY be called for personal interview by the Standing Selection Committee (SSC) of the Institute.
  • Mere fulfilling eligibility criteria does not confer the right to be called for interview or selection; eligibility will be decided based on duration and nature of experience, patient care, teaching/training, research, number and quality of publications, publication metrics, and administrative experience.
  • If the number of applicants is large, the Selection Committee may devise additional criteria and procedure for shortlisting, including holding a written examination if necessary.
  • Only eligible/shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, subject to verification of all requirements and documents; otherwise, they will not be allowed to appear for interview.
  • Interview schedule will be published on the official website of AIIMS Bilaspur.
  • Candidates called for interview must make a presentation on their work/achievements (maximum 05 minutes) in Microsoft PowerPoint as per prescribed proforma, to be submitted in a Pen Drive with the application and updated if required.
  • Candidates must appear personally and physically before the Selection Committee; no online interview through electronic media (e.g., Skype, Viber) will be allowed.
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates will be issued appointment letters subject to being declared medically fit by the Medical Board of the Institute and verification of documents, declarations, and antecedents.

General Information/Instructions

  • AIIMS Bilaspur reserves the right to increase or decrease or not to fill up any post(s)/vacancy and to amend, cancel, or change the advertisement wholly or partly without assigning any reason or notice.
  • Detailed advertisement is available on the website of the Institute and aspiring candidates may visit https://www.aiimsbilaspur.edu.in.
  • Further updates regarding the recruitment process will be available only on the Institute website.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • The posts are whole-time and private practice of any kind is prohibited.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by the New Pension Scheme as per Ministry of Finance Notification No.5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22.12.2003.

  • If any information or declaration is found false or if material facts are suppressed, candidature will be cancelled and, if detected after appointment, services will be summarily terminated.
  • Separate application is required for each post if a candidate is applying for more than one post.
  • Candidates are advised to visit AIIMS Bilaspur website regularly for further instructions, if any.
  • No age relaxation will be given to SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply under UR category and category once applied cannot be changed later.
  • The Executive Director, AIIMS Bilaspur is the final authority for decisions relating to this recruitment and courts of Himachal Pradesh will have exclusive jurisdiction for any dispute.

How to Apply

  • Application Fees (Step-1)
    • Pay the non-refundable application fee via online NEFT in favor of “Executive Director, AIIMS-Bilaspur” using the specified bank details.
    • Upload proof of fee payment with the application and retain the proof for production at the time of interview.
    • Applications without submission of application fee will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.
  • Application Form (Step-2)
    • Download the soft copy of the application form (Appendix-I) from the provided link.
    • Download the career graph form (Appendix-II) in MS Word format, fill it using Times New Roman, font size 12, and create a PDF (not scanned).
    • Download the presentation template in PPT format (Appendix-III) and fill it as per the proforma; rename the file with candidate name, post, and department as illustrated in the notification.
  • Online Application (Step-3)
    • Fill and submit the Google Form available at the link: https forms.gle/UAS4frrMvvQQFdfUA (as provided in the PDF).
    • Upload scanned copy of application forms in the prescribed format along with necessary documents and fee transaction details through the Google Form.
    • Failure to submit the online Google Form application will result in the candidature not being considered and liable to be rejected without notice.
    • Ensure that photo and signature uploaded are clearly visible; unclear or improperly sized images will lead to rejection of application.
  • Offline Application (Step-4)
    • Submit self-attested copies of all relevant certificates (Age, Qualification, Experience, Proof of Payment, Caste Certificate, EWS/PwBD Certificate, NOC, and other testimonials) along with printout of application (Appendix-I) and covering letter.
    • Ensure that the hard copy application reaches the following address on or before 27.01.2026 by 05:00 PM:
      Deputy Director (Administration), Administrative Block, 3rd Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Kothipura, Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh – 174037.
    • Super-scribe the envelope as “Application for the post of ………….., Department of …………………….. for AIIMS, Bilaspur (H.P.).”
    • Applications received through Courier/Ordinary Postal Dak etc. are not acceptable; applications received after the due date will not be accepted and AIIMS Bilaspur will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Through Proper Channel
    • Applicants already employed in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Institutions/Statutory organizations/PSUs should route their applications through proper channel.
    • Forwarding authority must certify that there is “No Objection” if the officer applies and is selected and provide Vigilance, Integrity and Penalty certificates.
    • In case of selection, the officer will join AIIMS Bilaspur only after submitting relieving or resignation certificate from the present employer.
    • Applicants may submit an advance copy of the application to avoid delay, but interview letters will be issued only after receipt of application through proper channel.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Date 31/12/2025

  • Applications will be accepted only through online mode on www.vmc.gov.in; postal or in-person applications will not be accepted.

  • Additional marks will be given for Government recognized Sanitary Inspector/MPHW course (maximum 10 marks), computer course (certificate/diploma/degree – maximum 5 marks), Vadodara city local residence (maximum 5 marks), general experience (maximum 20 marks), health sector experience and VMC health sector experience (maximum 20 marks), and COVID-19 work for VMCH (30 marks).

  • Details filled in the online application form will be treated as final; details in original certificates will be considered at verification stage, and documents must be produced in original as and when demanded.
  • Candidates cannot request category change after submitting the application form.

  • Candidates attempting political or other recommendations directly or indirectly during the process will be disqualified.
  • If any information in the application form is found incorrect at any stage, the application/appointment will be cancelled.
  • No travelling allowance will be payable for attending document verification, written test, or oral test.
  • The Municipal Commissioner, Vadodara Municipal Corporation, reserves full right to cancel or modify this advertisement at any stage.
  • After online application, candidates are advised to regularly check www.vmc.gov.in for further instructions and updates related to this recruitment.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates must apply online only through the Vadodara Municipal Corporation website: www.vmc.gov.in.
  • Online application can be submitted from 01/01/2026 (12:00 hours) to 10/01/2026 (23:59 hours).
  • Before applying online, candidates must read all instructions, eligibility details, and other information available on www.vmc.gov.in.
  • For each post, educational details must be filled by clicking on “વધુ એજ્યુકેશન માટે અહિંયા ક્લિક કરો” and entering relevant qualification information.

  • Government Share: Rs.4,500/- will be directly credited to the apprentices DBT enabled Bank Account registered with NATS Portals through Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT) mode
  • Other Allowances: The apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits

Age Limit (as on 01.12.2025)

  • Minimum Age: 20 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years
  • Date of Birth: The candidate must have been born not earlier than 02.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2005 (both days inclusive)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-creamy layer): 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for Persons With Benchmark Disabilities: 10 years
  • Note: The maximum age limit of 28 years is applicable to General Category and EWS candidates

Application Fee

Category Application/Examination/Intimation Fees
PwBD candidates Rs.400/- + GST
Schedule Caste / Schedule Tribe / All Women candidates Rs.600/- + GST
All Other Candidates Rs.800/- + GST
  • Payment Mode: Online payment only
  • Bank Transaction Charges: To be borne by the candidate
  • Refund Policy: Application fee is non-refundable
  • Note: Application fee to be remitted only on demand by BFSI SSC (scrutinizing/examining body) deputed by the Bank

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 01.12.2025
Relevant date for Age and Qualification 01.12.2025
Submission of online application commencing from 25.12.2025
Last date for submission of online application 10.01.2026
Tentative Date of Online Examination Will be advised separately

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Online Written Test: The test will consist of 100 questions for 100 marks with total duration of 90 minutes
  • Test Components:
    • General / Financial Awareness: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • English Language: 25 questions, 25 marks (Qualifying nature only)
    • Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • Computer Knowledge: 25 questions, 25 marks
  • Language: All tests except English Language will be available bilingually (English and Hindi)
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by Bank. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates entitled to 5% relaxation
  • Stage 2 - Test of Local Language: Conducted after qualifying the online written examination. Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the local language of the state
  • Exemption from Language Test: Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language
  • Final Merit List: Drawn state wise and category wise based on marks obtained in online examination in descending order
  • Tie Breaker: If marks are equal, merit order will be on the basis of Date of Birth (senior by age placed higher)
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Medical Fitness: Candidate must be declared medically fit as per Bank requirements

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for engagement in only one state and choose only one zone under that state
  • The number of training seats mentioned is provisional and may vary according to actual requirements of the Bank
  • Bank has right to post apprentices in any Branch/Offices within the state as per operational requirements
  • This is neither an employment nor a contract employment in the Bank. Engaged apprentices will only be "Trainees" and not treated as employees/workers
  • Period of engagement shall be restricted to One Year Apprenticeship Training Programme
  • Apprenticeship period shall not give the apprentice any lien/right on permanent employment with the Bank
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice and there is no reservation for them
  • Apprentices are prohibited from joining/forming any Union Body
  • Bank may issue certificate to candidate upon successful completion of Apprenticeship
  • Successful Apprentice will be issued a proficiency certificate by Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)
  • Bank has the rights to cancel the engagement of apprenticeship at any point of time without prior notice in case of any misconduct
  • No change of category as well as any other details will be permitted at any stage after registration on the apprenticeship portal
  • Multiple applications will result in only the latest valid application being retained
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Any resulting dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Mumbai

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in by navigating to "Student Register/Login" section
  • Step 2: After registration, login to the NATS portal using user ID and password at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php
  • Step 3: Apply for Apprenticeship against the advertisement published by "Bank of India" by going to the section "Apply against advertised vacancies"
  • Step 4: Eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] within 48 hours of applying on NATS portal
  • Step 5: Fill the final "Application cum Examination Fee Form" by providing personal data, choice of zone, category, PWBD status
  • Step 6: Make online payment of the requisite examination fee
  • Step 7: Note down the Enrolment ID issued by NATS portal for future reference
  • Step 8: After successful payment, you will receive an email from [email protected] with copy of "Application cum Examination Fee Form" within 48 hours
  • Application Period: 25.12.2025 to 10.01.2026
  • Mode of Application: Online only through NATS Portal
  • Important: Application process is complete only when examination fee is deposited with BFSI SSC
  • For Help: Refer to the help manual available at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf or email queries to [email protected]

  • Selection committee is the final authority in selecting the candidates and altering the number of vacancies

General Information/Instructions

  • The terms and conditions of staff to be employed in MRU SMIMER will be as per guidelines implementation of MRU scheme in Government medical colleges as stipulated by Department of Health Research, MoHFW, Govt. of India
  • The candidates are instructed to register their names before 9.30 am on the day of interview
  • Qualification & Pay: As per notification and guidelines of MRU scheme Department of Health Research, MoHFW, Govt. of India
  • The appointments shall on contract basis on monthly consolidated remuneration
  • The period of appointment is for 11 month for Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator and for 6 month, extendable to another 6 Months based on performance for Research Assistant and Field Investigator
  • Candidates working in Government sector/ Government Autonomous Medical colleges must produce “No Objection Certificate” from Head of the institution/Competent Authority in which the candidate is presently working
  • No TA DA will be paid to the Candidates for attending walk-in interview
  • The work may required travelling outside city and overnight stay for Research Assistant and Field Investigator
  • Above post is temporary in nature and will be filled up purely on contractual basis with initial appointments for Eleven (11) months as per rules and regulations of the MRU. The employment on this post will be temporary, for a fixed term and shall automatically cease on expiry of term without any notice unless renewed or reemployment letter issued
  • If the performance of the candidate is not satisfactory during any part of the tenure, the services of the candidate may be terminated with a notice period of 1 month. In case the candidate wishes to leave the contract, they may choose to do so with a notice period of 1 month
  • The appointment is purely on temporary basis and can be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice. The Controlling Authority, however, reserves the right to terminate the services of the appointee forthwith or before the expiry of notice period by making payment to the appointee of the consolidated salary for a period of notice or the un-expired portion thereof. The appointee cannot, however, surrender stipend/consolidated salary in lieu of the period of notice or un-expired portion thereof and may be required to serve the full period of notice
  • Applicable Govt. taxes are liable to be deducted from contractual candidate's monthly consolidated pay
  • Candidate has to perform all duties and work given by his/her higher authorities without fail with full sincerity and dedication
  • The appointee will have to work for a minimum period of one month. If he/she resigns before the stipulated period, he/she will have to refund the entire amount of salary/stipend received forthwith before being relieved. After one month's period, the appointee has to submit one month's prior notice for resignation/termination
  • The appointee will not be treated as an employee of the SMIMER, Surat or DHR/ICMR, New Delhi. The appointee will not have any claim on a regular post in this Institute or in any Dept. of Govt. of India. The appointee shall give an undertaking to this effect before joining the post
  • The appointee will be under the Administrative control of SMIMER, Surat and will be subject to all the rules and regulations of the Institute during tenure of the appointment. If there is any periodic amendment in guidelines from DHR regarding any component of scheme it will be applicable as per the guidelines issued by the Department of Health Research (DHR) of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
  • The appointee is not entitled for Medical aid, Bonus or any other such facilities extended to the regular staff of the Institute
  • He/ She shall be entitled for eleven (11) casual leaves and 1 sectional off for a period of eleven months. He / She shall be entitled for all public holidays which other staff of SMIMER are entitled for; other than that no leave shall be granted to him/her. He / She shall have to obtain written permission in advance from the Dean, SMIMER before proceeding for such leave
  • In regard to any disputes regarding service terms and conditions Dean, SMIMER, Surat decision will be final authority. All dispute matters will be under Surat city jurisdictions

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may appear for walk-in-interview with their application along with requisite documents to D-Block, Surat Municipal Institute of Medical Education & Research (SMIMER), Opp. Bombay Market, Umarwada, Surat-395010, Gujarat

National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 31 Deputy Registrar, Assistant Engineer and More Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official NFSU website. The last date to submit the application form is 18-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the NFSU Deputy Registrar, Assistant Engineer and More Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

The National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU), a prestigious Institution of National Importance operating under the Ministry of Home Affairs, has announced a significant recruitment drive for 28 various non-academic positions. The university is seeking qualified Indian Nationals to fill key administrative, engineering, and library roles across its numerous campuses nationwide. This direct recruitment offers an opportunity to join a leading forensic sciences institution, with all applications required to be submitted online via the official Samarth Portal between December 18, 2025, and January 18, 2026.

The advertised positions span multiple pay levels and departments, including vital roles like Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Deputy and Assistant Engineers (Civil/Electrical), Statistical Assistant, and library cadre staff. Candidates with the required educational qualifications and relevant experience are encouraged to apply. The selection process involves either an interview or a written test depending on the post applied for, and successful candidates should note that appointment is transferable across any of the NFSU's campuses nationwide, including Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, and Bhopal.

NFSU Various Non-Academic Positions 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for NFSU Recruitment 2025 is 28 posts, distributed across Non-Academic and Library Cadre positions as follows:

Post Name Total Posts
Deputy Registrar 7
Assistant Registrar 9
Deputy Engineer (Civil) 1
Assistant Engineer (Civil) 3

Library Assistant 3

Academic Pay. PwBD reservation is horizontal and adjusted against respective categories.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility varies by position, encompassing educational qualifications, age limits, and experience requirements.

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

  • Deputy Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 9 years experience as Assistant Professor (Level 10+) or 5 years as Assistant Registrar or equivalent.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 3 years experience in relevant university fields (Procurement/HR/Academics/Accounts/Examinations).
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil): Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering (55%) (Master's preferred), plus 2 years relevant experience.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical): Bachelor’s in Civil/Electrical Engineering (55%). Master’s degree is desirable.
  • Statistical Assistant: Bachelor Degree with Statistics as a special subject.
  • Assistant Librarian: Master’s Degree in Library Science (55%), consistently good academic record, and must have cleared UGC NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D. as per regulations.
  • Library Assistant: Bachelor’s degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent, typing speed 30 wpm in English, and computer knowledge.

2. Age Limit

Age is determined as of the closing date of application:

  • Deputy Registrar: Not more than 50 years.
  • Assistant Registrar / Deputy Engineer (Civil) / Assistant Librarian: Not more than 40 years.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) / Statistical Assistant: 21 to 35 years.
  • Library Assistant: Not more than 32 years.

Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government of India rules. The upper age limit is not applicable to existing government/university employees.

3. Nationality

Candidates must be citizens of India.

Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable:

  • General/EWS/OBC Candidates: ₹500/- + GST & transaction charges.
  • SC/ST Category, PwBD, and Women candidates: Exempted from paying the application fee.

Salary/Stipend

Posts fall under the 7th Pay Matrix system. Based on general Government of India norms for these levels, the approximate starting basic pay ranges are:

  • Deputy Registrar (Level 12): Basic Pay approx. ₹78,800 per month.
  • Assistant Registrar / Assistant Librarian (Level 10 / Academic Level 10): Basic Pay approx. ₹56,100 per month.
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil) (Level 9): Basic Pay approx. ₹53,100 per month.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) (Level 8): Basic Pay approx. ₹47,600 per month.
  • Statistical Assistant (Level 5): Basic Pay approx. ₹29,200 per month.
  • Library Assistant (Level 4): Basic Pay approx. ₹25,500 per month.

Selected candidates will receive basic pay within the respective pay matrix level, plus other admissible allowances as per government norms.

Selection Process

  • For Sr. No. 01, 02, and 07 (Registrar & Librarian posts): Selection will be based on overall record and performance in an interview. A screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates.
  • For Sr. No. 03, 04, 05, 06, and 08 (Engineer & Assistant posts): Selection will be based on merit in a written test. The university may conduct a screening test to shortlist candidates.
  • Original documents must be produced at the time of interview/document verification.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for NFSU Recruitment 2025 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the NFSU Samarth Portal link: https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.
  2. Fill in the online application form with correct details.
  3. Upload all required documents (Photo, Signature, Certificates, Category Certificates/NOC, etc.).
  4. Pay the application fee online if applicable.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications and fees for each post.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 18/12/2025
Online Application Start Date (Portal Open) 18/12/2025 (12:00 PM IST)
Online Application End Date (Last Date for Submission) 18/01/2026 (11:59 PM IST)

Instructions

The positions are for direct recruitment and candidates will be on probation for two years as per university norms. Selected candidates may be posted at any of the NFSU Campuses across India (Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, Agartala, Bhopal, Dharwad, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Raipur, Nagpur, Chennai, Jaipur) and positions are transferable across all campuses. No TA/DA will be paid for attending tests or interviews. Candidates in service must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications:

  • Professor (Arts, Commerce, Humanities, Law, Social Sciences, Sciences, Languages, Library Science, Journalism & Mass Communication):
    • Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline with published work of high quality.
    • Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade).

    • Total research score of 120 as per UGC criteria.
    • Minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor.
    • Evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates.
  • Professor (Computer Science):
    • Ph.D. degree in relevant field and First Class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level.
    • At least 10 research publications in SCI journals/UGC/AICTE approved list of journals.
    • Minimum of 10 years teaching/research experience, out of which at least 2 years shall be post Ph.D. experience.
    • Evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates.
  • Professor (Pharmacy):
    • Basic degree in pharmacy (B.Pharm.).
    • Registration as a pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.
    • Ph.D. Degree with First Class at Bachelor's or Master's Degree in appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmacy.
    • Experience of ten years in teaching, research, industry and/or profession at the level of Lecturer or equivalent grade.
  • Professor (Business Management):
    • Ph.D. degree in relevant field and First Class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level.
    • Minimum of 10 years experience in teaching/research/industry, out of which at least 3 years at Associate Professor level.
    • At least 10 research publications in SCI journals/UGC/AICTE approved list of journals.
  • Professor (Education):
    • Master's Degree in Arts/Humanities/Sciences/Commerce and M.Ed. each with minimum 55% marks, OR M.A. (Education) with 55% marks and B.Ed. with 55% marks.
    • Ph.D. in Education.
    • At least ten years of teaching experience in University department of education or College of Education, minimum five years at M.Ed. level with published work.
  • Associate Professor (Arts, Commerce, Humanities, Law, Social Sciences, Sciences, Languages, Library Science, Journalism & Mass Communication):
    • Good academic record with Ph.D. Degree in concerned/allied/relevant disciplines.
    • Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade).
    • Minimum of eight years of teaching and/or research experience.
    • Minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals.
    • Total research score of 75 as per UGC criteria.
  • Associate Professor (Computer Science):
    • Ph.D. degree in relevant field and First Class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level.
    • At least 8 research publications in SCI journals/UGC/AICTE approved list of journals.
    • Minimum of 8 years experience in teaching/research in university/college or National Level Institutions.
  • Associate Professor (Pharmacy):
    • Basic degree in pharmacy (B.Pharm.).
    • Registration as a pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.
    • Ph.D. Degree with First Class at Bachelor's or Master's Degree in appropriate branch of specialization in Pharmacy.
    • Experience of eight years in teaching, research, industry and/or profession at the level of Lecturer or equivalent grade.
  • Associate Professor (Education):
    • Master's Degree in Arts/Humanities/Sciences/Commerce and M.Ed. each with minimum 55% marks, OR M.A (Education) and B.Ed. each with minimum 55% marks.
    • Ph.D. in Education.
    • At least eight years teaching experience in University department of education or College of Education, minimum three years at M.Ed. level with published work.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Candidates must possess the required qualifications on the last date of online application (15.01.2026).
  • A minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at Master's level is essential.
  • Ph.D. Degree is mandatory for appointment to Professor and Associate Professor posts.
  • All degrees must be from recognized Indian University or equivalent degree from accredited foreign university.
  • Where Marksheet reflects grades only, it is mandatory to provide a Percentage Certificate issued by the Respective University.
  • Candidates awarded degrees by Foreign Universities shall be required to submit Equivalence Certificate issued by Association of Indian Universities or UGC, New Delhi.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/SEBC/EWS must submit valid category certificate.
  • SEBC candidates must submit Non-Creamy Layer Certificate in format prescribed by Government of Gujarat (certificate issued in Gujarati only accepted).
  • PwBD candidates must submit Disability Certificate issued by competent authority.
  • Candidates already in service must submit 'No Objection Certificate (NOC)' from present employer.
  • Appointed teachers must achieve necessary proficiency in Gujarati language within one year from date of appointment.

Desirable:

  • For Professor (Pharmacy):
    • Teaching, research industrial and/or professional experience in reputed organization.
    • Published work such as research papers, patents filed/obtained, books and/or technical reports.
    • Experience of guiding project work, dissertation of post graduate or research students.
    • Demonstrated leadership in planning and organizing academic, research, industrial and/or professional activities.
    • Capacity to undertake/lead sponsored R&D, consultancy and related activities.
  • For Associate Professor (Pharmacy):
    • Teaching, research industrial and/or professional experience in reputed organization.
    • Published work such as research papers, patents filed/obtained, books and/or technical reports.
    • Experience of guiding project work, dissertation of post graduate or research students.
  • One faculty member possessing Master's Degree in Psychology and another member in Philosophy/Sociology besides M.Ed. (for Education Department).

Experience:

  • For Professor: Minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates.
  • For Associate Professor: Minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor.
  • The time taken by candidates to acquire M.Phil. and/or Ph.D. Degree shall not be considered as teaching/research experience.
  • However, the period of active service spent on pursuing Research Degree simultaneously with teaching assignment without taking any kind of leave shall be counted as teaching experience.
  • Experience gained as honorary/Part-Time/Visiting/Trainee/Adjunct faculties will not be considered.
  • Experience will be counted subject to: Appointment letter, University Approval, Experience/Endorsement letter, and Proof of full salary (Bank Statement/Form-16/Form AS-26).

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic Level-14 with Rationalized Entry Pay Rs. 1,44,200/- Per Month as per 7th Pay Commission.
  • Associate Professor: Academic Level-13A with Rationalized Entry Pay Rs. 1,31,400/- Per Month as per 7th Pay Commission.
  • Pay Scales and other salary benefits as per approval by the Government of Gujarat.
  • Pay fixation and other monetary benefits for Gujarat state service shall be as per rules and approval of Government of Gujarat.
  • Pay Protection, other entitlements, and service conditions as per rules and regulations laid down by Government of Gujarat from time to time.

Age Limit

  • Age limit is not specified in the advertisement.
  • Retirement age is 65 years for University Teachers.
  • In event of non-availability of eligible candidates, retired Professor/Associate Professor in Education can be appointed on contract basis for a period not exceeding one year at a time till they complete sixty five years of age.

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
Unreserved (UR) Categories Rs. 1,500/- (One Thousand Five Hundred) - Non-refundable
SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/PwBD Categories Rs. 750/- (Seven Hundred and Fifty) - Non-refundable

  • Transaction receipt should be attached with the hardcopy of application.
  • Bank charges towards online payment service will be borne by the candidates.
  • Candidates applying for more than one teaching post must submit separate online applications with additional processing fee for each post.

Selection Process

  • The scrutiny and selection procedure will be governed by rules depicted in Gujarat Public Universities Act-2023 and Gujarat Public Universities Uniform Statutes-2024.
  • Direct Recruitment shall be on basis of merit through all India advertisement followed by selections by duly constituted Selection Committees.
  • All eligible applications received will be screened with respect to eligibility conditions.
  • For Professor: Candidates must have minimum research score of 120 as per UGC Table-2 criteria.
  • For Associate Professor: Candidates must have minimum research score of 75 as per UGC Table-2 criteria.
  • The research score shall be from minimum of three categories out of six categories.
  • In case of more eligible applications, shortlisting of candidates for interview will be done by duly constituted Screening Committee.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Personal Interview.
  • Interview Call Letter to eligible and shortlisted candidates will be sent to registered email only.
  • The University reserves right to restrict candidates to be called for interview to a reasonable number on basis of qualifications and experience higher than minimum prescribed.
  • Selection shall be based on performance in the interview.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for attending Personal Interview.
  • Appointed candidates shall be required to produce medical certificate of physical fitness.

General Information/Instructions

  • The recruitment process will be carried out as per UGC Regulations 2018, NCTE, AICTE, PCI Norms and subsequent amendments.
  • The process will follow guidelines from The Gujarat Public Universities Act, 2023 and The Gujarat Public Universities Uniform Statutes-2024.
  • Applicants must ensure they fulfill eligibility conditions for the post applied for.
  • No updates/additions will be entertained once candidate submits application online.
  • Application once submitted will not be editable.
  • Applicants must send TWO Hard Copies of application (without Spiral Binding) in single envelope by RPAD/SPEED POST/COURIER or IN PERSON.

GSSSB Physiotherapist Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement

GSSSB Physiotherapist Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts
Physiotherapist, Class-3 138

Note:

  • Reserved posts for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) will be announced through a special recruitment campaign separately
  • Ex-Servicemen reservation: 13 posts (10% of total vacancies)
  • The number of vacancies may increase or decrease
  • Reserved vacancies are meant only for candidates originally from Gujarat

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Essential: Bachelor Degree in Physiotherapy obtained from any University established or incorporated by or under the Central or State Act in India; or any other educational institution recognized as such or declared to be deemed as a University under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
  • Computer Knowledge: Basic knowledge of Computer Application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967
  • Language: Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or Both
  • Registration: Candidate shall require to get himself/herself registered with the Indian Association of Physiotherapist, if not already registered at the time of making application
  • Future Registration: Candidate shall require to get registered with the Gujarat State Council for Physiotherapist as soon as the said Council is constituted under section 3 of the Gujarat State Council for Physiotherapist Act, 2011

Experience

  • No prior experience required for this post

Salary/Stipend

  • Initial 5 Years: Fixed pay of Rs. 49,600/- per month as per Finance Department resolutions dated 16/02/2006, 29/04/2010, 06/10/2011, 20/10/2014, 20/10/2015, 18/01/2017, and 18/10/2023
  • After 5 Years: Upon satisfactory service completion, regular appointment in 7th Pay Commission pay scale of Rs. 39,900/- to Rs. 1,26,600/- (Level-7)
  • Additional Benefits: Other benefits as per government resolutions will be applicable
  • Note: This is subject to the judgment in SLP No.14124/2012 and SLP No.14125/2012 pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court

Age Limit (as on 15/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 35 years
  • Age Relaxation for General Category Women: 5 years (up to 40 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category Men: 5 years (up to 40 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category Women: 10 years (5+5) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for General Category PwD Men: 10 years (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for General Category PwD Women: 15 years (10+5) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category PwD Men: 15 years (5+10) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category PwD Women: 20 years (5+10+5) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Period of service rendered plus 3 years
  • Note: Upper age limit may be relaxed for candidates already in Gujarat Government service as per Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967

Application Fee

Category Preliminary Examination Fee
Unreserved Category Rs. 500/-
Reserved Categories (All Women candidates, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, Ex-Servicemen) Rs. 400/-

Important Notes:

  • Application fee must be paid online only through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets
  • Transaction charges as per rules will be applicable in addition to examination fee
  • Fee payment last date: 26/12/2025 (23:59 hours)
  • Fee Refund: Candidates who appear for the examination will be refunded the examination fee through the same medium used for payment
  • Candidates who do not appear for the examination will NOT be refunded the fee
  • Fee once paid will NOT be refunded if application is rejected by the Board

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Published 06/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 09/12/2025 (14:00 hours)
Online Application Last Date 15/01/2026 (23:59 hours)
Fee Payment Last Date 17/1/2026 (23:59 hours)
Qualifying Date for Age/Educational Qualification 15/01/2026
Examination Date To be announced on official website

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: One-stage competitive examination through MCQ (Multiple Choice Questions) based Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) method
  • Examination Parts: The examination will be conducted in two parts - Part-A and Part-B
  • Part-A (60 Marks, 60 Questions):
    • Logical Tests and Data Interpretation: 30 marks
    • Mathematical Tests: 30 marks
  • Part-B (150 Marks, 150 Questions):
    • Indian Constitution, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English Comprehension: 30 marks
    • Subject-related questions and their application: 120 marks
  • Total Questions: 210 questions (Part-A: 60 + Part-B: 150)
  • Total Marks: 210 marks
  • Duration: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Qualifying Standard: Minimum 40% marks required separately in both Part-A and Part-B for all categories
  • Merit List: Based on total marks obtained in both parts (after meeting qualifying standards)
  • Certificate Verification: Approximately twice the number of vacancies will be called for document verification based on merit
  • Final Selection: Based on merit, subject to certificate verification and medical fitness

General Information/Instructions

Citizenship

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India or hold nationality as per provisions of Rule-7 of Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967

For SC/ST/SEBC Candidates

  • Caste certificate must be in the prescribed format and obtained from competent authority as determined by Gujarat Government
  • SEBC Candidates: Must submit Non-Creamy Layer certificate as per Annexure-4 (Gujarati format) or Annexure-A (Central Government format for reservation under Central Government jobs)
  • Certificate should be based on income of Financial Year 2022-23/2023-24/2024-25
  • Certificate must be obtained between 01/04/2023 to 15/01/2026
  • Married SEBC women candidates must submit certificate based on parents' income, NOT husband's income

For EWS Candidates

  • Must submit Income and Asset Certificate as per Annexure-KH (English) or Annexure-G (Gujarati) format
  • Certificate should be obtained between 24/12/2022 to 15/01/2026
  • Alternatively, Income and Asset Certificate for EWS reservation under Central Government obtained between 01/04/2025 to 15/01/2026 based on Financial Year 2024-25 income is also acceptable

For PwD (Persons with Disabilities) Candidates

  • Disability certificate must be as per notifications/provisions issued by Government of India, Health and Family Welfare Department, Gujarat Government, or Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat Government
  • Eligible disabilities: Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV), Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH), One Arm (OA), One Leg (OL), Both Legs (BL), One Arm and One Leg (OAL), Dwarfism (Dw), Acid Attack Victim (AAV), Spinal Deformity (SD), Spinal Injury (SI) without neurological/limb dysfunction, Specific Learning Disability (SLD) 40-70%, Mental Illness (MI) 40-70%, Multiple Disabilities (MD)
  • 10 years age relaxation for PwD candidates (maximum up to 45 years)

For Ex-Servicemen Candidates

  • Must have rendered at least 6 months service in Navy/Air Force/Army
  • Must possess competent authority's identity card and discharge book
  • Age relaxation: Period of service rendered plus 3 years
  • Candidates retiring within one year from the last date of application can also apply

For Widow Candidates

  • 5% additional marks will be added to total marks/normalized marks obtained in the examination
  • Must not have remarried at the time of appointment
  • If widow status is acquired after application submission or during any stage of recruitment, benefit will be applicable from that stage onwards

For Sports Persons

  • 5% additional marks for candidates who represented at National/International level or Inter-University or All India School level competitions
  • Eligible sports: Athletics (Track and Field), Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Tennis, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Archery, Horse Riding, Shot Put, Rowing, Chess, Handball
  • Certificate must be obtained from prescribed authority in prescribed format

Computer Knowledge

  • Candidates must possess certificate/marksheet of Basic Computer Knowledge from any training institution as per Government resolution dated 13/08/2008 and 18/03/2016
  • Alternatively, any Computer Diploma/Degree/Certificate course from government recognized university/institution is acceptable
  • Certificate of passing Class 10 or Class 12 examination with Computer as a subject is also acceptable
  • Candidates without such certificate can apply but must submit it before appointment, otherwise appointment will be cancelled

Important Guidelines

  • Only online applications will be accepted through https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Candidates must carefully read the entire advertisement before applying
  • Keep all original certificates ready while filling online application
  • Information filled in online application will be final and cannot be changed after confirmation
  • Upload recent passport size photograph with white background (taken within 1 year from last date of application)
  • Photograph size: 5 cm height x 3.6 cm width
  • Signature size: 2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width
  • Photo and signature must be in JPG format (maximum 15 kb)
  • Same photograph must be used throughout the recruitment process
  • Keep mobile number and email ID active throughout recruitment process
  • Download and save application form and fee receipt for future reference
  • If multiple applications are submitted, only the last confirmed application will be considered valid

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Step 2: Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB
  • Step 3: Select Advertisement No. 328/202526, Physiotherapist, Class-3 and click on "Apply"
  • Step 4: Read "More Details" section carefully before applying
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Now" and skip the initial screen to open Application Format
  • Step 6: Fill "Personal Details" carefully (fields marked with red asterisk * are mandatory)
  • Step 7: Fill "Educational Details" section
  • Step 8: Accept terms and conditions in "Assurance" section by selecting "Yes" and click "Save"
  • Step 9: Application Number will be generated - save it for future reference
  • Step 10: Upload photograph and signature as per specifications
  • Step 11: Click on "Confirm Application" and verify all details thoroughly
  • Step 12: Once satisfied, click "Confirm Application" - NO changes possible after confirmation
  • Step 13: Confirmation Number will be generated - save it carefully
  • Step 14: Pay application fee online through Debit Card/Internet Banking/UPI/Wallets before 26/12/2025 (23:59 hours)
  • Step 15: Download and print payment receipt
  • Step 16: Download and print application form for future reference
  • Step 17: Keep checking official website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in for updates on examination date and admit card

For Technical Support: Contact GSSSB office at Phone: 079-23258916 for any assistance regarding educational qualification, age limit, online application, or fee payment

  • Candidates must possess required postgraduate qualification (MD/MS/DNB/MCh/DM or relevant M.Sc with Ph.D) in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institute by 31/01/2026, with results declared on or before that date.
  • Candidates who have appeared for exam/viva voce but whose results are awaited may be allowed to appear provisionally; if result is declared after 31/01/2026, their candidature will be cancelled.
  • In-service candidates in any Government Institution must produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview; absence of NOC will disqualify them from interview.
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD is applicable as per Government of India policy; AIIMS Rajkot follows 4% horizontal reservation for PwBD.
  • OBC-NCL candidates must produce valid OBC-NCL certificate issued in latest financial year 2025-26 as per Central List; otherwise they will be treated as UR.
  • EWS candidates must produce valid Income and Asset Certificate as per DoPT OM dated 31/01/2019, issued for the relevant financial year.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Resident (Medical) will receive pay as per Level 11 of the 7th CPC pay matrix (pre-revised PB-3, entry pay Rs. 67,700/- per month) plus Grade Pay Rs. 6,600/- and Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) as applicable.
  • Other usual allowances admissible under rules will also be paid as per Government norms; NPA is applicable only to eligible medical candidates.

Age Limit (as on 12-01-2026)

  • Maximum age limit: 45 years as on 12/01/2026 for all Senior Resident posts.
  • Relaxation:
    • SC/ST: up to 5 years.
    • OBC: up to 3 years.
    • PwBD (UR): up to 10 years; PwBD (OBC): up to 13 years; PwBD (SC/ST): up to 15 years.
  • No age relaxation will be available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying under UR category.

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Nil.
  • General/OBC/EWS candidates: Rs. 1,000/- + 18% GST = Rs. 1,180/-.
  • SC/ST candidates: Rs. 800/- + 18% GST = Rs. 944/-.
  • Application fee must be paid online only through payment link: https://erp.eshiksa.net/DirectFeesv3/AIIMSRajkotRecruitment.
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

Important Dates

Advertisement Issue Date 01/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 01/01/2026 (via AIIMS Rajkot website)
Last Date for Online Application Submission 12/01/2026 up to 16:00 hrs
Cut-off Date for Age Calculation 12/01/2026
Last Date by which qualifying exam must be passed & result declared 31/01/2026
Document Verification & Interview Date 16/01/2026
Reporting Time for Document Verification & Interview 08:30 AM on 16/01/2026
Venue for Document Verification & Interview 1st Floor, Office of Dean (Academics), Academic Block, AIIMS Rajkot

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based solely on interview performance; there is no separate written test mentioned.
  • Candidates must apply online via the specified Google Forms link: https://forms.gle/awKiiF23wHgJvgSy7 and subsequently appear for document verification and interview on the scheduled date.
  • Candidates may apply for only one department; multiple applications for more than one department/subject will result in cancellation of all applications.
  • List of selected candidates will be uploaded on the AIIMS Rajkot website; candidates should regularly check the website for notifications/circulars.
  • In case of reserved category posts (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) remaining unfilled due to non-availability of candidates, UR candidates may be allowed to appear and considered against such posts as UR, subject to conditions.
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview; failure to produce required originals will result in disqualification.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD candidates is as per Government of India policy; PwBD reservation is horizontal across categories.
  • Valid category certificate (OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS) must be issued before the date of interview and as per Central Government format; otherwise, candidates will be treated as UR.
  • PwBD candidates must possess valid disability certificate issued by duly constituted Medical Board of State/Central Government Hospitals, in line with Supreme Court guidelines and MoHFW instructions.
  • Candidates should not send hard copy of online application or documents by post; they must bring the printout of online application at the time of document verification.
  • Vacancies are provisional and subject to change; Executive Director, AIIMS Rajkot reserves the right to increase or decrease vacancies, change reservation and modify or cancel recruitment process without notice.
  • Candidates must follow discipline and conduct rules of AIIMS; canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or joining the post.
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Courts at Rajkot, Gujarat.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and interested Indian citizens must apply online through the registration link available on AIIMS Rajkot website: www.aiimsrajkot.edu.in, w.e.f. 01/01/2026.
  • Online application for Senior Resident (Non-DM/M.Ch) posts must be submitted on or before 12/01/2026, 16:00 hrs.
  • Candidates should not send hard copies; they must bring the print copy of the online application form at the time of document verification.
  • Applicants must pay the prescribed application fee online through the specified payment link and retain the transaction receipt for presenting during document verification.
  • On the day of interview (16/01/2026), candidates must report by 08:30 AM at the Office of Dean (Academics), AIIMS Rajkot, with:
    • Printout of online application form.
    • Original and one set of self-attested photocopies of:
      • Date of birth/10th certificate or marksheet showing date of birth.
      • MBBS/BDS/MSc marksheets and degree certificate.
      • FMGE certificate (for foreign medical graduates, if applicable).
      • MD/MS/DNB/MDS/Ph.D degree, marksheets and attempt certificates.
      • Registration certificates with MCI/NMC/DCI/State Medical or Dental Council as applicable.
      • Experience certificates (if any).
      • Identity proof (PAN, Passport, Driving License, Voter ID, Aadhaar, etc.).
      • No Objection Certificate from current employer (for Government employees).
      • Valid category certificate for OBC/SC/ST/EWS and PwBD certificate, as applicable.
      • Payment/transaction receipt of application fee.
      • First page of publications with indexing proof (PubMed/Scopus), if any.
  • Candidates who fail to produce any of the mandatory original documents at the time of interview will not be considered for selection.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Maximum age for Young Professional (Grade-2) is 30 years as on the date of receipt of application.
  • Essential qualifications are post-specific and include combinations of BE/B.Tech with MBA/PGDM, MBA/PGDM with Science/Engineering, and LLM as detailed for each position in Annexure-I.
  • Candidates must possess the required minimum 3 years of post-qualification work experience in relevant domains such as Government Ministries/Departments, geospatial/space technologies, trade and policy, strategy and planning, IT development, or legal work as specified.
  • Experience must be post-qualification and in roles like Young Professional, Consultant, Management Trainee, Management Consultant or equivalent in Ministry/Department of Government of India or its attached/subordinate/autonomous bodies where explicitly stated.
  • Applicants must meet all eligibility conditions and provide valid documents for educational qualifications, experience and identity during document verification; incorrect or false information will lead to cancellation of candidature and appropriate action as per rules.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated remuneration for Young Professional (Grade-2) is Rs. 90,000/- per month, subject to applicable professional tax/TDS.
  • No additional allowances or facilities are admissible beyond the consolidated fee, except TA/DA as per entitlement of Level-10/11 Central Government employee for official travel.
  • An annual increment of up to 10% may be granted after completion of one year of tenure, based on satisfactory performance and contribution, with specific parameters of 0%, 5% or 10% linked to performance assessment.

Age Limit (as on Date of Receipt of Application)

  • Maximum age limit for Young Professional (Grade-2) is 30 years as on the date of receipt of application.
  • The notification does not specify category-wise age relaxations; candidates must adhere strictly to the indicated maximum age limit.

Application Fee

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee for applying to Young Professional (Grade-2) posts.

Important Dates

Advertisement Number IN-SPACE: 07:2025
Last date for submission of online application 19/01/2026
Application window duration Within 30 days from date of advertisement (as per Annexure-III, via IN-SPACe Digital Platform)

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized and shortlisted based on marks obtained in educational qualifications and period of effective experience, as per criteria in Annexure-II.
  • Out of 100% index, 50% weightage is given to educational qualifications (from Class 12th to Post Graduate/MBA) and 20% to relevant post-qualification experience; remaining 30% weightage is based on performance in interview.
  • Marks of best 5 subjects in 12th standard and final examination marks for BE/B.Tech/MBA will be considered; percentage must be specified up to two decimal places without rounding.
  • Candidates having CGPA must provide conversion formula during document verification; failure may result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview by a duly constituted panel; final merit list will be prepared by combining scrutiny marks (70%) and interview score (30%).
  • Mere empanelment in the final merit list does not confer any right to selection; original documents will be verified at joining and any discrepancy will lead to cancellation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted only through the IN-SPACe Digital Platform (IDP); no other mode of submission will be accepted.
  • Incomplete applications or those not meeting the eligibility criteria will be summarily rejected without communication.
  • Candidates called for interview must bring original documents and one set of self-attested copies related to educational and professional qualifications, experience and photo ID proof for verification.
  • The engagement is purely contractual, project-specific and does not confer any right to claim permanent employment or future engagement with IN-SPACe or Government of India.
  • IN-SPACe reserves the right not to engage any person, to revise terms and conditions of engagement, and to reject any application without assigning reasons.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview; TA/DA is applicable only for official duties during engagement as per rules.
  • Young Professionals are governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, must sign a Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, and must not publish or communicate official information without prior sanction.
  • Engagement may be terminated by IN-SPACe at any time by giving 15 days’ notice or pay in lieu, and Young Professionals may also disengage with similar notice.
  • Engagement does not create any claim for subsequent employment in IN-SPACe or any Government organization; service is transferable anywhere in India as required.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the IN-SPACe Digital Platform (IDP) available at https://www.inspace.gov.in.
  • Applications have to be submitted in the prescribed Application Proforma available on the digital platform, complete in all respects, within 30 days from the date of advertisement and no later than 19/01/2026.
  • No other means of application (offline, email, hard copy) will be entertained.
  • Applicants must upload/enter accurate details of educational qualifications, professional qualifications, work experience and valid contact information (e-mail ID and mobile number).
  • All candidates called for interview must bring one set of self-attested copies and originals of relevant documents including educational certificates, professional qualification proof, experience certificates and photo ID.
  • Selected candidates must submit police verification and medical-cum-fitness certificate from authorized medical practitioner; in urgent cases, they may join subject to submission of police verification within two months.
  • All communication regarding screening, interview schedule and further instructions will be made only through registered e-mail and notices on the IN-SPACe website; no postal communication will be sent.
