NFSU Technical Posts Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post Pay Level Total Posts
Senior Scientific Officer (Centre of Excellence in Investigative Forensic Psychology) Level 10 01
Senior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing) Level 10 01
Junior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing) Level 7 01
Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics) Level 7 01
Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics) Level 7 01
Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics) Level 6 01
Laboratory Assistant Level 5 24#

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior Scientific Officer (both Centres): Not more than 40 years of age; Ph.D. in relevant discipline OR Master’s degree in Forensic Psychology/Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or other Psychology discipline; Ph.D. holders need minimum 2 years’ experience, Master’s degree holders need minimum 5 years’ analysis/research experience in eligible government/research/forensic/industry organizations; desirable experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Forensic/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or any Psychology/Forensic Psychology discipline or Master’s in Forensic Science with specialization in Psychology/Criminology; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant fields in government/research/forensic labs or industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research experience; desirable Ph.D. and experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 35 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR Master’s in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Physics/Forensic Science (with physical sciences)/Cyber Forensics/Digital Forensics/Information Security/Cyber Security/Multimedia Forensics/ICT/AI/Data Science/Cyber Security Management; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant field in forensic labs/recognised institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., familiarity with forensic audio-video tools and FSL experience.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Genetics/Human Genetics/Molecular Biology/Life/Biological Sciences/Forensic Biotechnology/Forensic Science (Biology/Biotechnology) OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology; 3 years’ analytical/research experience in relevant field in government/recognised labs/research institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., knowledge of forensic DNA technology and FSL experience.
  • Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 30 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR same set of relevant Master’s degrees as JSO (Multimedia Forensics) with Forensic Science (physical sciences) eligibility; desirable experience with forensic audio-video tools and FSL work.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Age between 18 and 27 years (relaxable for Govt. servants up to 40 years); Bachelor’s Degree in any one of Physics, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Physical Anthropology, Genetics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pharmacy, Forensic Science or Criminology from a recognised University/Institute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 10 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with corresponding monthly pay and allowances as per NFSU/GoI rules.
  • Junior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 7; Senior Scientific Assistant in Pay Level 6; Laboratory Assistant in Pay Level 5, all with pay and allowances as applicable to NFSU technical staff.
  • All posts are regular direct recruitment positions with probation and service conditions as per University norms.

Age Limit (as on 18-01-2026)

  • The date for determining eligibility including age shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of online application i.e. 18/01/2026.
  • Upper age: 40 years for Senior Scientific Officer; 35 years for all Junior Scientific Officer posts; 30 years for Senior Scientific Assistant; 18–27 years for Laboratory Assistant with relaxation for Government servants up to 40 years.
  • Upper age limit relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen as per Government of India rules; current employees of Central/State/UT Government/University/Board/Corporation are exempt from the specified upper age limit for some posts as mentioned.

Application Fee

  • Gen/EWS/OBC category applicants: Rs. 500/- plus GST and applicable transaction charges; application fee is non-refundable.
  • SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.
  • Separate online applications with separate fees must be submitted for each post applied.

Selection Process

  • Selection for Senior Scientific Officer posts (Sr. No. 1 and 2) will be based on overall record and performance in interview; University may conduct a screening test and/or apply higher qualification/experience norms to shortlist candidates.
  • Selection for Junior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant and Laboratory Assistant posts (Sr. No. 3 to 7) will be based on merit of marks obtained in written test; University may conduct a screening test and/or shortlist based on experience.
  • Call letters for screening test/written test/interview will be sent only to shortlisted candidates via email/Samarth portal; interviews will be conducted only in physical mode.
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD will be as per Government of India norms, including latest requirements for OBC-NCL (non-creamy layer) and EWS certificates issued on/after 01-04-2025.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens and must apply only through the online Samarth portal; incomplete applications or those without requisite documents will not be considered.
  • Experience will be counted only from the date of acquiring the essential qualification; qualifications from UGC-recognised universities or approved institutions only are considered valid.
  • The University reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all posts, to withdraw or modify the advertisement, and to increase or decrease the number of posts without notice.
  • Reservation claims must be supported by valid certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD) issued within specified dates; PwBD disability must be permanent and at least 40%.
  • Age, educational qualification, experience, and other details will be verified at the time of interview/document verification; if documents are found false or candidates have suppressed information, services may be terminated.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending screening test/written test/interview; selected candidates may be posted at any NFSU Campus and transfers across campuses are possible.
  • All updates, corrigenda and communication regarding recruitment will be published only on NFSU website and/or sent via email; candidates must regularly check their email and Samarth dashboard.

How to Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates must submit applications using the online Samarth portal accessible via NFSU website’s Career > Regular Recruitment section.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online applications and pay the application fee separately for each post (if applicable).
  • Before applying, candidates should carefully read “Details of Minimum Qualification and Experience” and “Instructions to the Candidates” sections in the advertisement.
  • At interview/document verification, candidates must produce all original documents related to educational qualifications, category, experience and other essential requirements, along with self-attested copies.
  • Candidates already in service must submit No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance from their employer at the time of interview/document verification as per rules.
  • For any queries, applicants may contact via email at [email protected]; online application link (Samarth) is https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.

NFSU Technical Posts Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the last date to apply for NFSU Scientific/Technical Posts Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The last date for submission of the online application through Samarth portal is 18 January 2026 up to 11:59 PM (IST).

2. How many vacancies are available under NFSU Technical Posts Advertisement No. NFSU/TECHNICAL POSTS/10/2025?

Ans: There are 30 vacancies in total, including Senior Scientific Officer, Junior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant and 24 Laboratory Assistants.

3. What is the eligibility for Senior Scientific Officer posts at NFSU?

Ans: Candidates must have Ph.D. in relevant discipline with at least 2 years’ experience or Master’s degree in specified Psychology/Forensic disciplines with 5 years’ analysis/research experience in eligible organisations.

4. What is the eligibility for Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics) at NFSU?

Ans: Candidates need BE/B.Tech in specified computing/electronics branches or relevant Master’s degrees in Computer/IT/Forensic/Cyber disciplines with 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant field.

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

A4. Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT); final merit is prepared refinery-wise based solely on CBT marks among candidates who qualify SPPT and fulfil all eligibility conditions.

Q5. What is the application fee for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A5. General/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 300/- as non-refundable application fee, while SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from fee payment.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the IOCL Non-Executive CBT?
A6. No, there is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test; all 100 questions are objective type with 1 mark each.

Q7. Can I edit my IOCL Non-Executive application form after submission?
A7. No, once the final online application is submitted and registration is completed, no change or correction is permitted; candidates must verify details carefully before final submission.

Q8. What is the salary of IOCL Non-Executive posts?
A8. Selected Non-Executive personnel are placed in the pay scale of Rs. 25,000–1,05,000/- with industrial DA and are eligible for HRA/housing, medical facilities, performance incentives, PF, gratuity, LTC, education allowance and other benefits as per IOCL rules.

Q9. Is any specific score like GATE required for this recruitment?
A9. No, the IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 notification does not prescribe GATE or any external score; selection is based on IOCL’s own CBT followed by SPPT and medical fitness.

Q10. Where will the IOCL Non-Executive examination be conducted?
A10. The CBT will be conducted at multiple test cities across India such as Visakhapatnam, Guwahati, Vadodara, Delhi/NCR, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and others listed in Annexure II of the notification.

Event Date
Online submission of application start date 26/12/2025 (0000 hrs)

THSTI Recruitment 2026

Advertisement

Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) Recruitment 2026 for 05 posts of DEO, Lab Technician And More. Candidates with Any Graduate, B.Com, B.Sc, M.Phil/ Ph.D, BMLT Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in starts from 16-01-2026, and ends on 30-01-2026. For detailed information please visit THSTI official website, thsti.in.

THSTI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Company Name BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI)
Post Name DEO, Lab Technician And More
No of Posts 5
Salary Rs. 26,000/- to Rs. 80,000/-
Qualification Graduation/ Post Graduation/ Ph.D
Age Limit 35 to 50 years
Official Website https://thsti.res.in/

Vacancy Details

Post Name No. of Posts
Data Entry Operator 1
Project Research Scientist-II 1
Senior Executive Assistant (Finance) 1
Quality Manager 1
Lab Technician 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Data Entry Operator: Graduate degree in Computer Science/ Computer application from a recognized University with at least one (1) year of post-qualification work experience in clinical data management.
  • Data Entry Operator Desirable: Candidates should have experience in handing large datasets and knowledge of MySQL, CSS, JavaScript.
  • Project Research Scientist-II: Post-Graduation degree, including the integrated PG degree, in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university with atleast three (3) years of post-qualification experience of working in a research lab. OR Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university.
  • Project Research Scientist-II Experience: Experience in mammalian cell culture, especially suspension culture, gene cloning and expression, protein purification, protein characterization, biochemical assays, ELISA.
  • Senior Executive Assistant (Finance): B.Com. or equivalent degree from a recognized university with atleast four (4) years of post-qualification experience of working in a Finance & Accounts department of a reputed organization. The candidate should have good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (especially MS Excel) and the latest version of Tally ERP.
  • Senior Executive Assistant (Finance) Desirable: Post-Graduate degree / diploma in Financial Management or equivalent.
  • Quality Manager: Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized University with atleast three (3) years’ of post-qualification experience in the relevant field in a laboratory. OR Post-Graduation in Life Sciences with atleast eight (8) years’ of post-qualification experience in the relevant field in a laboratory. Note: The duration of the Ph.D. shall not be counted into experience where Post-Graduation is considered the minimum qualification.
  • Quality Manager Desirable: Applicants with a strong background of hands-on data analysis from spectral data acquired on LCMS platforms will be preferred. At least one publication as first author in a scientific journal.
  • Lab Technician: B.Sc. in any branch of Life Sciences or BMLT from a recognized University with atleast one (1) year of post-qualification experience in the relevant field in a laboratory. Note: The duration of higher qualifications i.e. Master’s shall not be counted into experience.
  • Lab Technician Desirable: Experience in clinical research. Well versed in Good lab practice.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Data Entry Operator: Rs. 45,000/-
  • Project Research Scientist-II: Rs. 67,000/- plus HRA
  • Senior Executive Assistant (Finance): Rs. 45,000/-
  • Quality Manager: Rs. 80,000/-
  • Lab Technician: Rs. 26,000/-

Age Limit

  • Data Entry Operator: 35 years
  • Project Research Scientist-II: 40 years
  • Senior Executive Assistant (Finance): 35 years
  • Quality Manager: 40 years
  • Lab Technician: 50 years
  • By five years for candidates belonging to SC/ST communities.
  • By three years for candidates belonging to OBC communities.
  • For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) falling under the following categories: (i) UR - ten years, ii) OBC - 13 years (iii) SC/ST - 15
  • Age is relaxable for Central Government servants up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government, from time-to-time.
  • Institute employees will get the age relaxation to the extent of the service rendered by them as on closing date of advertisement.
  • For Ex-servicemen upto the extent of service rendered in defense forces (Army, Navy & Air force) plus 3 years provided they have put in a minimum of 6 months attested service.

Important Dates

Post Walk-in Interview Date
Senior Executive Assistant (Finance) 16 January 2026
Quality Manager 19 January 2026
Lab Technician 19 January 2026
Data Entry Operator 20 January 2026
Project Research Scientist-II 30 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Written test/skill test/interview
  • In case many candidates appear for the walk-in interview, screening will be done to limit the number of candidates to those possessing higher/relevant qualification and experience.

General Information / Instructions

These are the short-term positions, and extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbents and tenure of the project for which they are selected. Those appointed to these positions will not have any claim for regularization of their employment. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University. The experience requirement specified above shall be the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications specified for the post. The candidates are required to satisfy themselves, before applying /appearing for the selection process, that they possess the minimum eligibility criteria as laid down in the recruitment advertisement. No query will be entertained with regard to eligibility criteria. The date of Interview of the respective post will be the CRUCIAL DATE for determining eligibility with regard to age, experience, essential qualification etc. All results/notifications will only be published on our website. Therefore, the candidates should essentially visit THSTI website, regularly. All communications will only be made through email. The no. of vacancy indicated above may change subjected to the actual requirement at the time of Written test/skill test/interview. With regard to any provisions not covered in this notification, the bye laws of THSTI / Govt. of India rules / guidelines shall prevail. Canvassing wrong information in any form will be a disqualification. Government strives to have a work force which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply

How to Apply

  • For posts mentioned above, interested candidates fulfilling the criteria as mentioned above may walk-in for written test/skill test/interview at 9:00 am on the date mentioned against each positions at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001.
  • The candidates must bring their latest CV/resume, one set of photocopy of documents in support of their educational qualification and experience along with their originals and a valid ID card for verification.
  • Candidates coming after the time slot mentioned will not be entertained.
  • All the candidates coming for written test/skill test/interview at THSTI are mandatorily required to deposit their mobile phone along with valid Identity proof at the reception and the same will only be returned back on completion of the entire selection process.

For each question for which a wrong answer has been given by the candidate, one fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty. b) If a candidate gives more than one answer, it will be treated as a wrong answer even if one of the given answers happens to be correct and there will be same penalty as above for that question. c) If question is left blank i.e. no answer is given by the candidate, there will be no penalty for that question.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants Are Advised To Update Their One Time Registration Before Filling The Application Form.
  • The Application Form Together With Instructions For Filling Up The Application Forms Will Be Available On The Website Of The Commission From 05.01.2026.
  • Applicants Are Advised To Go Through The Instructions And All The Eligibility Conditions Prescribed For The Post, Before Filling Up The Online Application Form.
  • Last Date For Filling Up Of Online Application Form Complete In All Respects (Including Uploading Of The Requisite Documents) Alongwith The Requisite Fee (Online Mode Only) Is 04.02.2026.
  • The Last Date For Receipt Of Online Applications Provided In The Notification Shall Be The Cut-off Date For Determining The Eligibility As Regards Acquisition Of Educational / Professional Qualification Or Any Other Certificate On The Basis Of Which Any Reservation Is Claimed, Notwithstanding Any Extension In The Last Date Of Submission Of Applications.
  • The Minimum And Maximum Age Will However Be Reckoned With Reference To 1st January, 2025.
  • Applicants Can Edit Some Of The Fields In Their Online Application Form W.e.f 05.02.2026 To 07.02.2026. Instructions In This Regard Will Be Separately Made Available On The Website.
  • Applicants Are Required To Upload All The Mandatory Prescribed/requisite Documents Alongwith The Online Application Form.
  • An Applicant Seeking Consideration Under Any Reserved Category Must Ensure That He/she Possesses The Requisite Category Certificate Valid On The Cut Off Date And The Same Is Required To Be Uploaded While Submitting Online Application. It May Be Noted That No Further Opportunity To Upload Any Document Shall Be Provided After The Cut Off Date And Action Under Rules Including Rejection Of Application/candidature May Be Taken.
  • The Certificate Must Be In The Format Prescribed In The Rules As Applicable.
  • Applicants Will Not Be Required To Submit A Hard Copy Of The Online Application Form Or Any Other Documents To The Commission At The Time Of Filling Up Online Application Form.
  • The Applicant Will However Be Required To Present/produce A Downloaded Copy Of The Online Application Form Alongwith The Original Certificates At The Time Of Document Verification.
  • Applicants Are Advised In Their Own Interest To Submit Online Applications Much Before The Closing Date And Not Wait Till The Last Date To Avoid The Possibility Of Disconnection/inability To Pay Fee Or Failure To Login To The Online Application Portal On Account Of Heavy Load On The Website During The Closing Days.
  • Syllabus Is Available On The Website Of The Commission.
  • Tentatively The Written Examination Will Be Held In March, 2026.
  • The selected candidates shall not be permitted to continue their PG courses or tenure positions such as Senior Residency/ Registrars/Demonstrators. They will be given a one-time option to either accept the selection or continue with their ongoing PG/ tenure.
  • On appointment, the selected candidates shall have to serve mandatorily in peripheral and far-flung areas of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir, in the interest of equitable healthcare delivery.
  • An Applicant seeking his/her consideration under Reserved Categories must ensure that he/she possesses a valid Category certificate on the cut-off date in the format prescribed in the J&K Reservation Rules - 2005.
  • The candidature of the applicants will be provisional till the genuineness of the reserved Category certificate is verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • The Applicants may note that in case a claim for reservation is made on the basis of false/fake/fraudulent certificate, he/she shall be debarred from the examination(s) conducted by the J&K Public Service Commission, in addition to any other penal action as may be deemed appropriate.
  • Horizontal reservation @4% will be provided to the persons with benchmark disability, in terms of Government Order No. 127 of 2020 dated 20.04.2020 read with G.O. No. 59-JK (SWD) of 2021 dated 15.04.2021.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. https://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website https://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size color photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

Category Application Processing Fee

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of Advertisement 29.12.2025
Last date for receipt of application 12.01.2026 till 18:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Applications shall be invited from applicants against the advertisement published.
  • Shortlisting shall be done as per the eligibility criteria for the post.
  • Possession of the prescribed qualifications and experience does not automatically entitle a candidate to be shortlisted for further stages of the selection process.
  • Preference may be accorded to candidates possessing higher marks in the prescribed qualifications and/or greater relevant experience, as per the discretion of the client (Principal Employer).
  • The organization reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on higher qualifications or other suitable criteria as deemed fit.
  • The list of all the shortlisted applicants shall be forwarded to the client for further selection at their end.
  • Shortlisted applicants shall be informed via Email/phone calls for their interview/assessment/skill test (if any); applicants are advised to keep their email and phone updated.
  • Selected applicants shall be informed via email/phone about their selection and further process.
  • Only the final result, comprising the list of candidates selected for the post upon conclusion of the final interview conducted by the client, shall be published on the official website of BECIL.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicant must read the instructions and ensure that the application is submitted correctly.
  • Applicants must review their application forms carefully before final submission; no request for changes in the information submitted will be accepted.
  • The applicant should ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria and that the particulars furnished by them are correct in all respects; candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage for false/incorrect information or non-fulfilment of eligibility.
  • Applications that are not in conformity with the requirements indicated in this advertisement / incomplete applications will not be entertained.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the test/document verification/personal interaction (if any) & joining the duty on selection.
  • Preference shall be given to local applicants and to those who have work experience in the same/similar department.
  • Only shortlisted applicants as per eligibility criteria shall be called for further process.
  • The candidature of applicants at all stages of selection process will be provisional and is subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions.
  • BECIL/Client verifies eligibility with reference to original documents at various stages of selection and after selection.
  • Applicants are advised to ensure correctness of Email ID & Phone Number; BECIL shall not be responsible for typographical errors in the application forms.
  • If applying for more than one post against the same advertisement, application form must be submitted separately and fee will be applicable as per number of posts applied.
  • Applicants are advised to possess a valid e-mail ID and keep it active; important information and updates shall be made available through the website or email.
  • All communications will be made either on registered email or registered mobile number; no applicant shall make any communication with the client.
  • BECIL reserves the right to cancel/modify/restrict/increase/reopen the recruitment process without further notice; posts may be kept unfilled at the discretion of BECIL.
  • The number of vacancies may increase or decrease at any stage of selection process.
  • Indian Nationals only need to apply.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • All decisions taken by the organization regarding eligibility, shortlisting, interview and final selection shall be final and binding.
  • No correspondence will be entertained from candidates not invited / selected.
  • Any legal dispute with regard to the selection process shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts located at New Delhi.
  • The application processing fee shall not be refunded.
  • Advisory: BECIL does not engage or authorize any agents or intermediaries for recruitment advertisements or job offers and shall not be responsible for any amount paid by applicants to any person/agency.

How to Apply

  • The applications for selection to the above posts will be accepted through SPEED POST / REGISTERED POST ONLY; no other mode of application shall be entertained.
  • The interested applicants must submit an application along with copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates in a sealed envelope in the prescribed format attached.
  • The application should be addressed to “Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL), BECIL BHAWAN, C-56/A-17, Sector-62, Noida-201307 (U.P)” through SPEED POST / REGISTERED POST only.
  • The envelope carrying the duly filled-in application form should be super-scribed as “Advertisement No ...............” and “Post Applied For .........................”.
  • Application Processing Fee in the form of Demand Drafts (Mandatory) will be accepted in favour of “Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Ltd, Noida”.
  • Incomplete applications or those in a format other than the one prescribed in the Application Form will not be entertained and shall be summarily rejected.
  • BECIL shall not be responsible for any postal loss/postal delay in receipt of applications.
  • Necessary self-attested documents to be attached: Educational / Professional Certificates, 10th/12th (if applicable), Birth Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Work Experience Certificate (if applicable), PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, copy of EPF/ESIC Card (previous employer – if applicable), and Bank passbook copy mentioning bank account details.

Event Date
Notification Date 20/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Written test will be conducted for all Trades. The selection committee has discretion to fix minimum qualifying marks in any or all parts of papers. Skill test and Physical test (wherever applicable) will be conducted for candidates who pass the written test and come in merit. Skill test and Physical test (wherever applicable) will be qualifying in nature and the candidates who fail to qualify Skill/ Physical test shall not be eligible for selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Posts mentioned above are subject to "All India Transfer Liability and Field Service Liability rules", candidates selected may be posted to any "Unit or Location" depending on organisation interest. No representation will be entertained.
  • Persons working in Central/State Govt./ PSUs must provide the "NOC" document obtained through the competent authority his/her present organization to Recruitment Agency at the time of selection.
  • Application(s) will be shortlisted on the basis of the Essential Qualification referred at Para 2 and Admit card) be issued accordingly. No weightage will be given for additional/ higher qualification.
  • Merely fulfilling the essential qualification does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test.
  • Admit card will NOT be issued in case of rejection / late receipt of application. Candidates will not be intimated in case of rejection of their application and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Incomplete/ illegible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Application(s) without correct advertisement reference number will not be accepted.
  • No man who has more than one wife living and no woman who has more than one husband living, shall be eligible for appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/ documents along with application form. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/ documents or providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidate at any stage of recruitment selection will result in automatic rejection of his/ her candidature. The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard.
  • Date & Place of Bio-metric, Document Verification and Written Examination for each trade will be intimated via admit card which will be sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate alongwith the application and through Electronic means. Candidate to ensure that correspondence address, E-mail ID and telephone number provided in the application form remain valid for the future communication.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation and re-checking of the scores. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The decision of appointing authority regarding selection/ rejection will be final.
  • No Transportation Allowance/ Dearness Allowance will be admissible Examination including written / skill test / physical test where applicable) will be for 1 WO (02) to FIVE (05) days or more days and may spread across different dates. Candidates will have to make their own arrangement for loading / boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhaar card, PAN Card, Driving License) for confirmation while reporting for the bio-metric, document verification, written test, skill test and physical test (where applicable), which should have same name as given in the application form.
  • Capturing of Bio-metric details will be done on first day of documents verification and Bio-metric verification will be carried out on subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for the written test/ Skill Test/ Physical Test (where applicable) and on reporting to unit by selected candidates.
  • The recruitment process including any part of examination can be cancelled/ postponed/ suspended/ terminated without any prior notice/ assigning any reasons at any stage. Provisionally selected candidates have to produce original and photocopy of the following documents/ certificates duly self attested on the date and time intimated by the recruiting establishment:- a. Matriculation certificate/ Municipality Birth certificate in support for date of birth. b. Aadhaar Card. c. Mark Sheet of the educational qualification mentioned against the post applied for. d. Any certificate for the desirable qualification. e. SC/ ST/ OBC (Non creamy layer for OBC)/ EWS or any other reservation certificate, if applicable. f. Physically handicapped certificate showing 40% and above disability issued by competent authority if applicable. g. Discharge certificate in case of Ex-serviceman h. NOC in original from their present employer/ competent authority in case of Government servant including serving Armed Force's Personnel if applicable j. In case of Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husband, a certified copy of judgement degree of the appropriate court to prove the fact of divorce or the judicial separation, as the case may be. k. Address proof (Passport/ Ration Card/ Voter Card/ Driving License)
  • Candidates on selection are liable to be transferred anywhere across India including field services liability and not necessarily at the choice of location given at time of application.
  • Any representation for redressal of grievances with regard to the recruitment will be subject to the jurisdiction of the District Court of respective stations where candidate has submitted the application.
  • The unit will not liable / responsible for paying any compensation in case of any injury/ death suffered by the candidate during the recruitment process.
  • A candidate who claims to belong to any of the category-Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/ Other Backward Class/Economically Weaker Sections should submit in support of his/ her claim an attested/ certified copy of a certificate(s) issued from the competent authority as per list mentioned at para 29 below as applicable vide the provisions of Government of India, Department of Personnel & Training guidelines issued and amended from time to time.

Chief Presidency Magistrate/ Additional Chief Presidency Magistrate/ Presidency Magistrate. Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar, and Sub-Divisional Officer of the area where the candidate and/ or his family resides.

How to Apply

Candidate to ensure that valid E-mail ID Aadhar linked Mobile Number mentioned in the application form.

If closing date falls on holidays, then next working will be taken as closing date for receipt of application.

  • Pay the application fee through online mode viz. Net Banking, Credit or Debit cards.

  • Applicants are advised to go through the instructions and all the eligibility conditions prescribed for the post, before filling up the online application form.
  • Last date for filling up of online application form complete in all respects (including uploading of the requisite documents) alongwith the requisite fee (online mode only) is 04.02.2026.
  • The last date for receipt of online applications provided in the notification shall be the cut-off date for determining the eligibility as regards acquisition of educational / professional qualification or any other certificate on the basis of which any reservation is claimed, notwithstanding any extension in the last date of submission of applications.
  • The minimum and maximum age will however be reckoned with reference to 1st january, 2025.

The applicants who are submitting multiple applications should note that only the applications with higher Registration ID (RID) number shall be entertained by the Commission and fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID number. Besides a strict disciplinary action shall be taken including the cancellation of candidature and debarment for future examinations of J&K PSC will be taken against such applicants.

iii. procuring impersonation by any person, or

iv. submitting fabricated documents or documents which have been tampered with, or

vi. resorting to any other irregular or improper means in connection with his/her candidature for the selection, or

vii. using unfair means during the test, or

viii. writing irrelevant matter including obscene language or pornographic matter, in the script(s), or

ix. misbehaving in any other manner in the examination hall, or

x. harassing or doing bodily harm to the staff employed by the Commission for the conduct of their test, or any other candidate, or

xi. attempting to commit or, as the case may be, abetting the Commission of all or any of the acts specified in the foregoing clauses may, in addition to rendering himself/herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable:

i. to be disqualified by the Commission from selection for which he/she is a candidate; and/or

  • a) Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. http://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • b) Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website http://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • c) After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • d) The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size colour photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • e) Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • f) After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • g) On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • h) An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • i) On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • j) On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • k) Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • l) On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • m) Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • n) After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/ Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • o) After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • p) The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • q) Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

Public Relations Officer (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree in Mass Communication and Journalism or equivalent degree with 60% marks and above or equivalent grade 'B' in UGC seven-point scale OR Master Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with Post Graduate Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communications
  • Essential Experience: At least five years of experience in centre of any established English Newspaper, periodical, national news agency, radio or television or film media or equivalent experience as Public Relation Officer in recognized University
  • Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer applications, ability to communicate in local languages, preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, two years experience in writing reports/news/press release in print or electronic media, experience in handling social media

Assistant Registrar (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree or equivalent in any discipline from recognized University with 60% marks and above or equivalent Grade B in UGC seven-point scale with consistently good academic record
  • Essential Experience: At least 05 years relevant administrative experience in supervisory capacity in Govt. office/university/technological institution or organization of repute in Pay Matrix Level 7/Level 8 as per 7th CPC
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, degree in Law/Management/Engineering/Actuarial Science, Chartered or Cost Accountant qualification, SAS qualified, experience in handling computerized administration/financial matters, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Sports Officer (Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree with 60% marks and above in Physical Education/Sports Science or equivalent with 5 years of relevant experience in pay level 7/8 in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level OR Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 7 years of relevant experience
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination

Fire and Safety Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor Degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA from recognized University/Institute
  • Essential Certification: A diploma/certification for at least one year duration in Fire and Safety Management/Fire Technology & Industrial Safety Management/Safety and Disasters management or equivalent
  • Essential Experience: 05 years experience in capacity of Supervisor or equivalent safety professional in Fire Fighting in Civil/Defence Fire Service department/Public Undertaking/CFTIs or in reputed private organisation
  • Essential: Must be able to handle fire arms with sound health and active habits
  • Desirable: Post Graduate Degree/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety with 5 years relevant experience, valid driving license for LMVs

Senior Laboratory Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 6 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 07 years relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 08 years relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 08 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Junior Section Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in any discipline from recognized university with 60% marks and above with 03 year experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc. as Senior Assistant or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with 05 years experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc as Senior Assistant or equivalent
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, Higher Degree/PG Diploma in relevant discipline like HR, Labor Laws, Financial Management, inter ICWA/CA, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Assistant Sports Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 3 years of relevant experience in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, N.I.S Coaching Diploma holders and medal winners in inter University/national games, representation at international level, certificate from national/international federation recognized by GoI, at least 02 years experience in coaching at University level

  • Essential Qualifications: Master's Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 01 year relevant experience at Pay Matrix Level 2 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 02 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools, applications and latest trade related softwares

  • Examination will be held at Srinagar and Jammu centres; candidates shall indicate their preferred centre in the application form, but allotment of centre is at the sole discretion of the Commission.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are required to apply online through the JKPSC website (http://www.jkpsc.nic.in); no other means/mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Candidates are advised to update their One Time Registration (OTR) before filling the application form and to go through all instructions and eligibility conditions prescribed for the post.
  • Applicants must upload all mandatory prescribed documents along with the online application form; no further opportunity to upload any document shall be provided after the cut-off date.
  • An applicant seeking consideration under any reserved category must ensure that he/she possesses requisite category certificate valid on the cut-off date and upload the same while submitting online application, failing which action under rules including rejection of application/candidature may be taken.
  • Applicants will not be required to submit a hard copy of the online application form or any other documents to the Commission at the time of filling online application; however, they will be required to produce downloaded copy of the online application form along with original certificates at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates are advised to submit online applications much before the closing date and not wait till the last date to avoid the possibility of disconnection/inability to pay fee or failure to login due to heavy load on the website.
  • Admit cards, examination timetable and centre details will be uploaded on the Commission’s website about two weeks before the date of examination; candidates must bring printout of Admit Card/Roll Number Slip, recent photographs and valid photo ID proof to the examination hall.
  • Detailed instructions are provided regarding documents to be uploaded (Date of Birth certificate, Domicile certificate, Degree/Diploma and marks cards, In-service certificate, and any document for weightage as per rules such as NCC/NSS).
  • JKPSC will initially accept candidature provisionally and detailed scrutiny of applications will be undertaken later; if any claim is not substantiated by proof at the time of verification, candidature will be cancelled and the Commission’s decision shall be final.
  • Action against candidates found guilty of misconduct (including impersonation, fabricated documents, false statements, unfair means in examination, misbehaviour, etc.) includes disqualification, debarment from examinations/selection, and disciplinary action if already in Government service.

How to Apply

  • Visit the JKPSC website (http://www.jkpsc.nic.in) and click on “One Time Registration” (OTR) or “Login” if profile is already created.
  • Fill all requisite fields in OTR: personal information, contact information, educational qualification, service details etc., and upload date-stamped recent passport-size colour photograph and signature (size between 10 kB to 20 kB in .jpeg/.jpg format).
  • After updating OTR, check eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement, click on “Show Examination” for the relevant notification month, select the post and click on “APPLY”.
  • Read the instructions window carefully, then proceed; system will display particulars from OTR, candidate must fill remaining required fields, accept the declaration and click “SUBMIT”.
  • After successful submission of basic details, pay the requisite fee through online mode under “Submitted Applications” menu and upload requisite documents (Date of Birth, Degree/Diploma, Category certificate, Domicile etc.).

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

Candidates must possess the following essential qualification and experience for the Security Officer post:

  • Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with minimum of 10 years’ experience in security.

The applicant must be a citizen of India. All applicants must fulfill the essential requirements and conditions as on 02-02-2026.

Job Description

The Security Officer will be responsible for overall security management of CSIR-CIMFR campus and its units, including supervision of security measures, record maintenance, and handling security-related emergencies.

  • Supervising security measures for safety of CSIR-CIMFR properties and units.
  • Maintaining records related to movement of men and materials, deployment of security personnel in all shifts, handling visitors, security cameras, and enforcement of security rules and procedures.
  • Working round the clock (24x7) as required and attending in person to security-related emergencies.
  • Conducting investigations into theft, pilferage, accidents, sabotage or subversive activities and coordinating with local law and order authorities; knowledge of local language is an added advantage.
  • Use and maintenance of firearms.
  • Firefighting and combating fire in emergencies.
  • Any other duty assigned by the competent authority.

FTC engagement is purely on fixed tenure basis and it is not against any permanent vacancy. This placement will not entitle any candidate to claim for regular/permanent employment in the company.

HURL reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards.

If any in case of such cases.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.

  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).

  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.

Ans: Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India OR intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India and have not undergone similar training in other PSUs for one year or more.

4. What is the maximum age limit to apply for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Maximum upper age limit is 28 years for UR/EWS, 31 years for OBC (NCL) and 33 years for SC/ST, with applicable relaxations for PwDs.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited under CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Total 125 training slots are available across CIL and its subsidiaries.

6. What is the stipend for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.

7. What is the duration of training for Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) in CIL?

Ans: The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.

8. Is there any claim for employment in CIL after completion of Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) training?

Ans: Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.

9. What is the method of selection for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Selection is based on percentage of marks in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as per reservation policy and preference to Land Owners and wards of employees, with merit ranking and preference of posting.

10. How can candidates apply for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Candidates must apply online through CIL Online application portal in the career page of CIL website (coalindia.in) and upload all required documents in the prescribed formats and sizes.

11. Are there any reservations for PwD candidates in CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Yes, total 5 seats are reserved for PwD candidates within the overall 125 seats, as per Government of India guidelines.

12. What preference is given to Land Owners and wards of employees in this recruitment?

Ans: Additionally, 15% reservation is made for preference in selection and posting to the Land Owners and 20% reservation is made for preference in selection and posting to the wards of employees, as defined in the scheme.

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.

  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.

Kerala.contentHtml:
BEML Limited has announced a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST and OBC candidates, aiming to fill 50 backlog vacancies across various positions in Group A, Group B, and Group C categories. The recruitment includes roles such as Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer, Asst. Engineer, Diploma Trainee, and Office Assistant Trainee.

Candidates applying for these positions must meet specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications such as a First Class full-time Engineering Degree, MBA, CA/ICWA, or a Diploma for certain posts. The salary scales range from ₹90,000 to ₹2,40,000 for higher positions like Dy. General Manager and Asst. General Manager, while Diploma Trainees will receive a stipend ranging from ₹17,000 to ₹25,500 depending on the contract year. The age limit for applicants varies by post and category, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates, as well as an additional 10-year age relaxation for PwD candidates. Interested candidates must apply online by 7th January 2026.
