BEML Special Recruitment Drive Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name BEML Limited (BEML)
Post Name Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC – Group ‘A’ (Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer), Group ‘B’ (Asst. Engineer) & Group ‘C’ (Diploma Trainees, Office Assistant Trainees) Backlog Vacancies
No of Posts 50
Salary Rs 16,900 to 2,40,000
Qualification Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.
Age Limit Grade VII – 50 years (SC/ST), 48 years (OBC); Grade VI – 47/45 years; Grade V – 44/42 years; Grade IV – 39/37 years; Grade II – 34/32 years; Grade I – 34/32 years; Wage Group S1 & B – 34/32 years; PwD: additional 10 years; maximum age with relaxation not beyond 57 years.
Start Date for Apply  19/12/2025.
Last Date for Apply  07/01/2026 (till 18.00 Hrs).
Official Website bemlindia.in

BEML Special Recruitment Drive Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Designation Total
Dy. General Manager 13
Asst.General Manager 15
Sr.Manager 05
Manager 05
Officer/Engineer 03
Asst. Engineer 01
Diploma Trainee 06
Office Assistant 02

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, Qualification and Experience should be as on 07th January 2026.
  • Under qualifying marks, First Class is reckoned at 60% aggregate (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD); candidates with CGPA/credits must provide conversion formula.
  • SC/ST candidates must submit SC/ST Caste Certificate in the prescribed format for Government of India posts.
  • OBC candidates must submit OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format and a self-undertaking of OBC (NCL) status; OBC certificate should not be older than six months as on last date.
  • PwD candidates must submit PwD certificate in the prescribed format; age relaxation of additional 10 years is applicable for PwD with minimum 40% disability.
  • Post Qualification Experience (PQE) is counted only after obtaining the required qualification; only employment after the requisite qualification is considered.
  • Private sector candidates must be employed in regular capacity and submit experience certificate on company letterhead.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Govt., Autonomous bodies, Quasi-Govt. and PSUs must apply through proper channel or produce NOC, and should have worked at least one year in immediate lower scale (not applicable to Grade II, Group B & C).
  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD as applicable); any false information or discrepancy leads to cancellation/termination.
  • Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.

Salary/Stipend

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Pay Scale Rs. 90,000 – 2,40,000.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Pay Scale Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Pay Scale Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Pay Scale Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Pay Scale Rs. 40,000 – 1,40,000.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Pay Scale Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 23,910 – 85,570; stipend Rs. 17,000/- PM during 1 year training; Rs. 20,500/- PM & Rs. 25,500/- PM during first and second year of contract.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 16,900 – 60,650; stipend Rs. 20,000/- PM in first year and Rs. 23,500/- PM in second year of contract.
  • Besides Basic Pay, eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances (currently 13.78% of Basic Pay under Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per Company rules.

Age Limit (as on 07-01-2026)

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Upper age limit – 50 years for SC/ST, 48 years for OBC.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Upper age limit – 47 years for SC/ST, 45 years for OBC.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Upper age limit – 44 years for SC/ST, 42 years for OBC.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Upper age limit – 39 years for SC/ST, 37 years for OBC.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • For PwD candidates, upper age limit relaxable by additional 10 years over and above SC/ST/OBC relaxation; maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years.
  • Upper age limit can be relaxed for candidates of all categories subject to equivalent years of excess PQE, within the maximum limit of 57 years.

Application Fee

  • Eligible and interested OBC candidates applying for the above positions (not applicable for SC/ST/PwDs) must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/-.
  • Fee payment link is provided at the end of the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of Advertisement 03/12/2025 (Advt. No. KP/S/28/2025).
Crucial Date for Age, Qualification & Experience 07/01/2026.
Last Date for Online Registration 07/01/2026 up to 18:00 Hrs (online registration site available till this date and time).
Last Date for Receipt of Applications through Proper Channel (for Govt./PSU employees) Within 10 days from closing date of advertisement (i.e., within 10 days from 07/01/2026) to Sr. Manager, Recruitment Cell, BEML Soudha, Bengaluru.
Written Exam Date (for L036, L037, L038, L039) To be notified; assessment/written exam at Bangalore and details to be communicated via e-mail.
Intimation of Assessment / Interviews Intimation regarding assessments, provisional offer/final offer etc. will be only through e-mail; shortlisted/selected list will be uploaded on www.bemlindia.in under the advertisement in career portal.

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for assessment based on eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD etc.).
  • Based on assessment, shortlisted candidates must undergo pre-employment medical examination and original document verification; appointment is subject to meeting medical standards and satisfactory medical report.
  • Any shortcoming during document verification (falsification, wrong declaration, non-production of originals) results in rejection.
  • For post codes L036, L037, L038 and L039, selection will be based on written exam at Bangalore (to & fro fares reimbursed based on eligibility) assessing domain ability (not for L039), reasoning ability, general awareness and English ability.
  • Merely meeting conditions of advertisement does not entitle a candidate to be called for assessment; Screening Committee may adopt its own criteria for shortlisting.
  • Only candidates meeting all eligibility norms need apply; receiving call for assessment/interview does not guarantee selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC for Group ‘A’ (9th Attempt), Group ‘B’ & Group ‘C’ (7th Attempt) backlog vacancies.
  • BEML Limited is a multi-technology company under Ministry of Defence with core sectors Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Power, Mining & Construction; the drive is aligned with expansion initiatives like Vande Bharat sleeper trains, Metro coaches, high mobility vehicles, special application engines, AI-based mining equipment etc.
  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, qualification & experience are counted as on 07/01/2026; First Class is 60% aggregate (relaxable for SC/ST & PwD).
  • Candidates must upload all required documents (10th, 12th, degree/diploma, mark sheets with conversion formula, PG certificates, ID proof, caste/PwD certificates, experience letters, latest pay slip, detailed resume, current reporting structure) as per checklist; incomplete applications without documents are rejected.
  • Applications of Govt./PSU employees must be forwarded through proper channel or accompanied by specific NOC; such forwarded applications must reach BEML Soudha within 10 days from closing date.
  • Intimation of assessment, offers etc. will be via e-mail only and list of shortlisted/selected candidates will be hosted on www.bemlindia.in; BEML is not responsible for non-delivery due to invalid e-mail or mobile.
  • No request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, test centre location etc. as declared in online application will be entertained.
  • Any canvassing or influencing related to recruitment/selection will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be hosted only on BEML website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only (mandatory) after going through guidelines and ensuring correctness of data entered.
  • Online application form can be accessed in the career page at www.bemlindia.in; online registration site is available till 18:00 Hrs on 07th January 2026.
  • Candidates must have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration and further correspondence; change of e-mail or mobile will not be entertained during the recruitment process.
  • A Registration number will be generated and should be noted for all future correspondence.
  • While filling online application, experience section should first list latest experience, followed by previous experiences; a brief pen picture of experience relevant to the position must be written.
  • Candidates must upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, category certificates, academic certificates and mark sheets, identity proof, experience documents, detailed resume, current reporting structure and latest pay-slip as per checklist.
  • Experienced candidates must provide detailed pen picture of each experience; all experience documents must clearly indicate start and end dates of each employment.
  • OBC candidates (except SC/ST/PwD) must pay the non-refundable Rs. 500/- fee through the link at the end of application form.
  • Candidates with queries may e-mail [email protected].

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization ITI Limited (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
Department Corporate Office & Various Units of ITI Limited
Exam Name Young Professional Recruitment 2026
Post Young Professional – Graduate / Technician / Operator / Generalist / Official Language
Total Vacancies 215 Posts
Mode of Application Online
Registration Dates From advertisement date (22-12-2025) to 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs)
Educational Qualification BE/B.Tech/MBA/PG/ Diploma/ITI/Graduation depending on post and domain
Age Limit Upper age limit generally 35 years for YP Technician/Generalist; internal candidates relaxation up to 45 years
Selection Process Shortlisting + GD & PI for Graduates; Shortlisting + Skill Test for Technicians & Operators
Official Website itiltd.in

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification from ITI Limited specifies the advertisement date and the last date for receipt of online applications. Candidates should strictly adhere to the application deadline and regularly visit the official website for any corrigendum or addendum regarding the schedule.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

ITI Limited has announced a total of 215 Young Professional vacancies across multiple domains including Projects, Project Management, IS & IT, Computer Lab/Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, Production/Manufacturing, HR, Marketing, Finance and Hindi Cell. Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Only Indian Nationals with qualifications from recognized universities/institutes (AICTE/UGC/other statutory authorities) are eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various Young Professional categories and domains are summarised below.

For YP – Graduate (Projects):
BE/B.Tech in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil or MCA/M.Sc. (Electronics/CS/IT) from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Technician (Projects):
Diploma in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Projects):
ITI Trade Certificate in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Graduate (Project Management):
MBA in Project Management/Operations Management or M.Sc. in Project Management from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Graduate (IS & IT):
Essential: BE/B.Tech in IT/CS/ECE/EEE or MCA/M.Sc. (IT/CS) from a recognised University/Institute; desirable skills include proficiency in PHP/Python/Java, HTML/CSS/JS, MySQL/PostgreSQL and Linux server environment.

For YP – Technician (IS & IT):
Essential: B.Sc (IT)/BCA/Diploma in CS from a recognised University/Institute; desirable knowledge of network fundamentals, VPN, firewall basics, Linux/Windows systems and end-user support.

For YP – Graduate (Comp. Lab):
BE/B.Tech in IT/CS from a recognised University/Institute.

For Comp. Lab/Production (Graduate/Technician roles):
- B.Sc in Chemistry or Diploma in Chemical Engineering with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience in conformal coating, OR Diploma in CS/Electronics with minimum 2 years’ experience in testing/measurement systems as specified.

For YP – Operator (Computer Lab/Production):
ITI Trade Certificate in Electronics/Electronic Mechanic with minimum 2 years’ experience and VSSC Soldering School certification; or ITI Fitter with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.

For YP – Graduate (TSTL):
BE/B.Tech in ECE/CS/Telecommunications or MCA/M.Sc.(CS/IT)/M.Sc. Cybersecurity from a recognised University/Institute with minimum 2–5 years post-qualification experience (depending on slot) and industry-recognised certifications in IT/Telecom Security Testing desirable.

For YP – Technician (Production/Manufacturing):
Diploma in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Production/Manufacturing):
ITI Trade Certificate in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical/Fitter from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Generalist (HR):
Any Degree from a recognised University with mandatory knowledge of computer and applications.

For YP – Graduate (Marketing):
Any Degree with MBA in Marketing from a recognised University/Institute.

BBA/BBM/BMS from a recognised University/Institute with knowledge of computer.

For YP – Generalist (Finance):
Any Degree from a recognised University with mandatory knowledge of computer and applications.

For YP – Official Language (Hindi Cell):
Any degree from recognised University with Hindi as subject and English as medium of examination, OR any degree with English as subject and Hindi as medium, OR any degree with Hindi and English as elective/optional subjects.

Age Limit 

Candidates applying for Young Professional posts must satisfy the prescribed upper age limits as on the date of advertisement, with relaxations for internal candidates as per ITI rules. Internal candidates with relevant experience are eligible for age relaxation up to a maximum of 45 years, while general upper age limit for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist is indicated as 35 years in Table-A.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

ITI Young Professional Salary 2025-26

Candidates selected as Young Professionals in ITI Limited will receive consolidated monthly remuneration as per Table-A of the notification without additional allowances like DA, accommodation, medical reimbursement etc. In case of posting in tough locations, Young Professionals will be entitled to benefits under ITI’s Tough Location Policy in addition to the consolidated pay.

How to Apply for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 through the official website within the specified timeline. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted and incomplete applications are liable to be rejected.

  1. Visit the official website of ITI Limited: www.itiltd.in.
  2. Go to the “Careers” or “Career” section and open the relevant Young Professional 2026 notification (Ref. No. ITI/CRP/HR/2025/1534 dated 22-12-2025).
  3. Read the detailed notification carefully including eligibility, vacancies, service conditions and selection process.
  4. Click on the application link / application format available under the notification and start filling the online form.
  5. Enter personal details, educational qualifications, experience details, and select your preferred initial posting locations as per instructions.
  6. Provide a valid email ID and mobile number as all important communication will be sent through email only.
  7. Upload required documents/certificates in legible form as per the prescribed format and size.
  8. Verify all details carefully before final submission; only the latest application will be considered if multiple are submitted.
  9. Submit the online application on or before 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).
  10. Keep a copy/print of the submitted application and email acknowledgements for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A1. The last date to submit the online application is 12-01-2026 up to 23:59 hrs.

Q2. What is the age limit for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A2. The general upper age limit indicated is 35 years for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist, while internal candidates with relevant experience get relaxation up to a maximum of 45 years; detailed category-wise relaxation follows ITI/Government rules.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A3. A total of 215 Young Professional vacancies have been announced across various domains and posts.

Q4. What is the selection process for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A4. Selection for Young Professional – Graduates is through a two-stage process: shortlisting using a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Young Professional – Technicians & Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test.

Q5. What is the application fee for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Q6. What is the salary of ITI Young Professional?
A6. Young Professional – Graduate receive Rs. 60,000 per month, Young Professional – Technician/Generalist/Official Language receive Rs. 35,000 per month, and Young Professional – Operator receive Rs. 30,000 per month as consolidated pay.

Q7. Is this a permanent job in ITI Limited?
A7. No, Young Professionals are engaged on a purely temporary/contract basis initially for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years based on performance, with no obligation on ITI to offer regular employment.

Q8. What are the main posting locations for ITI Young Professional 2026?

Posting locations include ITI units at Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini, Palakkad, Rae Bareli and multiple project/marketing locations such as Leh/Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Bareilly, Kolkata, Tezpur, Delhi, Lucknow, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ahmedabad and North Eastern states, subject to company requirements.

Q9. What is the job nature and working hours for Young Professionals?
A9. Young Professionals are engaged full time to provide professional services in specific spheres and will follow the same working hours as ITI employees; no extra remuneration is paid for work beyond office hours or on holidays.

Q10. Where can I contact ITI Limited in case of technical issues with the application?

  • To work as per ESIC norms for Senior Residency
  • Remuneration will be paid as per orders issued by ESIC Headquarters from time to time

Super Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed

Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC, ST & OBC as per rules
  • No minimum age specified

Application Fee for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

Category Application Fee
General & OBC Candidates Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only)
SC/ST Candidates Rs. 50/- (Rupees Fifty only)
PWD/Female Applicants Exempted (No Fee)

Mode of Payment:

  • Application fee to be paid by way of Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • The Demand Draft should be submitted at the time of interview along with application form

Selection Process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

The selection process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 will be based on the following criteria:

  • Walk-in Interview: The selection will be based on qualification, experience & interview
  • The interview will be conducted at ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on 07/01/2026
  • Candidates will be assessed based on their educational qualifications, post-qualification experience, and performance in the personal interview
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview
  • Only shortlisted candidates based on qualification and experience will be called for final selection
  • The decision of the interview committee will be final and binding

General Information and Instructions for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

  • The applicants should bring along application in the prescribed proforma, all original documents including caste certificate (if applicable), one set of Xerox copies of all original documents, two recent passport size photographs (one affixed on the application) and the requisite application fee in the form of demand draft at the time of interview
  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will not be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Those who belong to OBC/SC/ST category should produce valid caste certificate issued by the Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer
  • OBC certificate should be in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions which should certify that the candidates do not belong to Creamy layer
  • EWS certificate must be valid and issued by Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions
  • Candidates applying in PWD Category must possess disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Government Hospitals/Institutions
  • Candidates who have already completed Senior Residency for 3 years in any Central Institutions are not eligible for the post of Senior Resident
  • Private practice of any kind will not be allowed except for Part time Superspecialists/Part time Specialists
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for Interview
  • Vacancies indicated may change as per actual requirement on the date of interview
  • Canvassing in any form shall be a disqualification
  • The Selected Specialist/Super Specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period of contractual engagement. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of error and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services
  • The minimum sum assured per annum should be:
    • Rs. 30 lakh for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc.
    • Rs. 20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologists, Obstetricians etc.
    • Rs. 10 lakhs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc.
  • A copy of the Insurance & Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to terminate the service of appointee at any time even before the tenure without assigning any reason by giving one month notice or immediately in case of any disciplinary action
  • Similarly, the engaged person will have to give one month prior notice before resigning or will have to pay an amount equivalent to one month's remuneration in lieu of the notice period
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the offer/advertisement without assigning any reason thereof
  • In case of selection, the candidate has to enter into an agreement with Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model & Super specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 200/-
  • The selected candidate has to submit a security deposit of Rs 15,000/- as DD in favour of ESIC Account No 2 payable at Kollam at the time of joining, which is refundable after successful completion of contract & production of no-due certificate
  • In case of applicants who are working in Central government/State government institutions, NOC should be obtained from the authority concerned and to be submitted in due course
  • Part time Engagement of one contractual employee in two ESIC hospital at the same time shall not be permissible
  • PWD candidate will be selected against suitable/notified posts as per government rules
  • The hospital is in the process of getting accreditation for conducting in house DNB training courses in various specialities

How to Apply for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

This is a Walk-in Interview process. Candidates need to follow these steps:

  • Step 1: Download the official notification from ESIC website: https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments
  • Step 2: Download the application form (Annexure 1) from the notification PDF
  • Step 3: Fill the application form completely in CAPITAL LETTERS ONLY with all required details:
    • Personal Information (Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Date of Birth, Category, Age)
    • Educational Qualification details with Year of passing, University, and Percentage of Marks
    • Experience details with Name of Hospital, Post Held, Period (From-To), Total Period
    • MCI Registration Number and Name of Medical Council
    • Present and Permanent Address
    • Contact Number & Email ID
    • Place where presently working
    • Particulars of DD (Number and Date)
  • Step 4: Affix one recent passport-size photograph on the application form
  • Step 5: Prepare Demand Draft for application fee:
    • Rs. 250/- for General/OBC candidates
    • Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates
    • PWD/Female candidates are exempted
    • DD should be drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • Step 6: Prepare all required documents in original and one set of self-attested Xerox copies:
    • MBBS Degree certificate
    • MCI/Central Council Registration Certificate (For basic and additional Qualifications)
    • Matriculation certificate in support of Date of Birth
    • PG Degree/Diploma Certificate (Qualification prescribed for the post)
    • Experience Certificate
    • Caste Certificate and Non creamy layer certificate, if applicable
    • PWD Certificate, if applicable
    • LPC/No Due Certificate from previous employer, if applicable
    • Any other relevant document
    • 2 Passport Size Photos
  • Step 7: Report to the interview venue on 07/01/2026 at 09:00 AM
  • Step 8: Registration will be done from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM at Conference Hall, ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam
  • Step 9: Submit the filled application form along with all original documents, one set of Xerox copies, two passport-size photographs, and Demand Draft at the registration counter
  • Step 10: Attend the interview as per the schedule

Important Notes:

  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will NOT be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Candidates must bring their own filled application form and all documents
  • Late arrivals after registration time may not be entertained
  • Check the official website regularly for any corrigenda or updates

Eligibility Criteria for CSL Nurse 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a Three year Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery.

Candidates should have four years of experience as Nurse in a Hospital or Nursing Home or Primary Health Centre or First Aid Centre in a Factory.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: 40 years as on 14 January 2026
  • Age Relaxation: For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Ex-servicemen as per Government of India guidelines (however, in no case shall the age limit after applying all relaxations exceed 50 years)
  • Age calculation date: 14 January 2026

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens as the notification is issued by Cochin Shipyard Limited, a Government of India company.

Selection Process for CSL Nurse 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Objective Type Test (35 minutes, 30 multiple choice questions, 1 mark each, no negative marking; 10 marks General, 20 marks Discipline related)
  • Practical Test (70 marks)
  • Document/Certificate Verification
  • Medical Examination as prescribed by CSL

The minimum pass mark for each of the Objective Type Test and Practical Test is 50% of total marks for unreserved posts and 40% of total marks for PwBD candidates. CSL may relax the minimum pass mark if the number of qualified candidates is insufficient.

Application Fee for CSL Nurse 2026

  • Application Fee: ₹ 300/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra)
  • Exempted Categories: Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD)
  • Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking using the online application facility from 29 December 2025 to 14 January 2026; no other mode of payment shall be accepted

For applicants for whom the fee is applicable, candidature shall be considered only on receipt of the application fee.

How to Apply for CSL Nurse Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for CSL Nurse 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: cochinshipyard.in
  2. Go to Career page → CSL, Kochi and read the User Manual and FAQ before filling the online application
  3. Complete the One Time Registration in the SAP Online portal
  4. Submit the online application for the Nurse posts between 29 December 2025 and 14 January 2026
  5. Ensure all certificates towards proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste and a recent passport size colour photograph are uploaded in the SAP online application portal
  6. Pay the applicable application fee online using the available payment options
  7. Ensure all entries in the online application are correctly filled and the application is successfully submitted (status shown as “In process” in “My Applications”)
  8. Retain a soft copy/printout of the online application with the unique registration number generated by the system for future reference

Applicants should not send the online application printout/certificates/application fee by post to Cochin Shipyard Limited.

  • Candidates appearing for the screening test should bring passport size photograph and original certificates for identity proof, proof of age, proof of educational qualification, experience and publications, along with one set of self-attested photocopies and duly filled application form (Annexure I).

How to Apply

  • Applications which are not received in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) of the notification along with supporting documents will not be considered.
  • Candidates may send the application as a single PDF attachment in the following order: (a) Annexure-I (b) Educational qualifications (in chronological order) (c) ID proof (d) Experience certificate(s) (e) Publications (f) any other document.
  • In case of any discrepancy in the name and address, one and the same certificate/any valid proof supporting the same issued by government/local bodies shall be submitted.

General Information / Instructions

  2. The applicants are required to go through the detailed notification carefully and decide themselves about their eligibility for this empanelment before applying online.
  3. KIIFCON/CMD shall not be responsible for any discrepancy in submitting the online application.
  4. Applicants must compulsorily fill-up all relevant fields of the online application.
  5. Incomplete/incorrect application form will be summarily rejected. KIIFCON/CMD under any circumstances will not entertain the information, if any, furnished by the candidate subsequently. Applicants should be careful in filling-up the application form at the time of submission. If any lapse is detected during the scrutiny, the candidature will be rejected even though he/she comes through the final stage of empanelment process or even at a later stage.
  6. The applicant should not furnish any false, tampered, fabricated information or suppress any material information while filling up the application form. If the particulars furnished in the online application form do no tally with the original documents produced by the Candidate, his/her candidature will be rejected.
  7. The qualification stipulated for the post must be from a recognized University/ Institute. Those applicants having qualification equivalent to any of the prescribed qualification should submit equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority and without such certificate, their applications shall not be considered.

  10. Candidates must upload either the original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority when submitting their educational qualification certificates.   11. Applicants should have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Empanelment Process. CMD may send intimation to download call letters for written test/proficiency assessment/interview through the registered e-mail ID. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying online and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  12. The copy of the Appointment letters, Salary Certificates, pay slip etc. will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificate. In the case of latest experience, applicants may upload an AFFIDAVIT with details of employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities. Affidavit is applicable only for latest experience. Experience certificates submitted without specific information like date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, signature and seal of authorised person will not be considered.

  14. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will receive intimations via email, SMS, or phone call regarding the selection process.
  15. Enable email notifications to stay informed about updates and communications. Also, regularly check your spam or junk email folder for important messages
  16. Applications with blurred/ illegible Photograph/ Signature/ ambiguous experience certificates will be rejected.

  18. Rights for the rules for the cut off marks/shortlisting in all stages of empanelment are reserved by CMD/KIIFCON
  19. The CMD/KIIFCON reserves the right to debar any candidate for any malpractice, including for a fraudulent claim of any kind of benefit/ relaxation/ concession, misconduct.

  • The desirous eligible applicants may apply online by satisfying themselves with terms and conditions of this empanelment through the website of Centre for Management Development (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in).

  • Telephone Operator: Plus Two or equivalent. Diploma in Electronics awarded by an Institution recognized by the Government. Six months experience as Telephone Operator/Receptionist and in Computer Operation.

 Age Limit

  • For Scheduled Castes Candidates: Born between 02/01/1984 and 01/01/2007 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Candidates who are Ex-serviceman or Ex-General Reserve Engineer Force person or a disembodied Territorial Army person can exclude the period of service in defence forces and period of unemployment on discharge up to a maximum of five years, provided they have not completed the age of 50 years
  • Age Relaxation for Differently Abled: Up to 15 years for candidates belonging to Blindness and Low Vision categories and 10 years to candidates belonging to other categories of disabilities, subject to upper age limit not exceeding 50 years
  • Age Relaxation for Widows: Up to 5 years will be granted to widows subject to the condition that upper age limit shall not exceed 50 years

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: No application fee is charged for this recruitment
  • Payment Mode: Not Applicable
  • Fee Exemption: All candidates are exempted from payment of application fee
  • Note: This is a special recruitment for Scheduled Castes candidates with no application fee requirement

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 16/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 19/12/2025
Online Application Last Date 17/01/2026
Last Date for Uploading Documents 17/01/2026
Admit Card Download (if Written Test conducted) Three weeks before test date
Interview Call Letter Download Two weeks before interview date

Selection Process

  • Selection Method: Selection will be on the basis of Interview OR Written Test & Interview having regard to the number of candidates
  • Written Test (if conducted): Objective type multiple choice pattern with 75 minutes duration consisting of three sections (Total 100 marks):
    • Questions based on syllabus related to Diploma in Electronics - 50 marks
    • General Knowledge/Current Affairs - 30 marks
    • Questions to test proficiency in English language - 20 marks
  • Number of Questions: 100 questions, each carrying 1 mark
  • Negative Marking: For every incorrect answer, 1/4 mark will be deducted
  • Interview: Total marks for Interview shall be 10
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Candidate must secure minimum 35% marks in the Interview to be considered for inclusion in the ranked list
  • Examination Centre: Written Test (if conducted) will be held at Ernakulam

General Information/Instructions

  • This is a No Candidate Available (NCA) recruitment notification exclusively for Scheduled Castes community candidates in Kerala
  • Applications from candidates belonging to other communities will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates must complete One Time Registration before applying for the post
  • All communications will be sent through email and SMS only
  • Candidates should possess a valid email ID which should be kept active
  • Documents in original to prove age, qualification, community etc. should be produced as and when called for
  • The Caste/Community Certificate which is valid on the date of closure of application or on the date of certificate verification shall be produced to claim reservation benefits
  • Differently abled candidates claiming age relaxation shall produce Job oriented physical and functionality certification as per G.O.(P) No. 5/2023/SJD dated 01.10.2023
  • Government employees must obtain No Objection Certificate/Service Certificate from their Head of Office
  • Candidates should ensure they fulfill eligibility norms before applying
  • Furnishing incorrect/false information or suppression of material facts will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Canvassing in any form will entail cancellation of candidature
  • High Court reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification at any stage
  • Decisions of High Court regarding eligibility and selection would be final and binding

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Scrutiny of online applications and uploaded documents
  • Stage 2: Written Test (if conducted) - Objective type examination covering Diploma in Electronics syllabus, General Knowledge and English proficiency
  • Stage 3: Interview for shortlisted candidates - Assessment of technical knowledge, communication skills, and suitability for the post
  • Stage 4: Document Verification - Verification of all original certificates including educational qualifications, caste certificate, experience certificate
  • Stage 5: Medical Examination (if required) - Fitness certificate from competent medical authority
  • Final Selection: Preparation of ranked list based on performance in written test (if conducted) and interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official Recruitment Portal of High Court of Kerala at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in
  • Step 2: Complete "One Time Registration" using "One Time Registration Login" link
  • Step 3: Keep ready scanned images of:
    • Passport size photograph (face and shoulder clearly visible, white/light colored background)
    • Signature
    • Plus Two or equivalent certificate
    • Diploma in Electronics certificate
    • Experience certificate (in prescribed format)
    • Scheduled Castes certificate
    • Any other relevant documents
  • Step 4: After logging into profile, select "My Profile" option and enter required details
  • Step 5: Select "Upload Documents" option and upload all qualification documents
  • Step 6: Ensure documents are properly scanned and legible
  • Step 7: Preview uploaded documents before submitting (once submitted, documents cannot be re-uploaded or deleted)
  • Step 8: Once documents are uploaded, select "Apply Now" option from dashboard
  • Step 9: Fill in the online application form with accurate details:
    • Personal information
    • Educational qualifications
    • Experience details
    • Community information (SC certificate details)
    • Language proficiency details
    • Contact details
  • Step 10: Check preview of application before final submission
  • Step 11: Submit the application (no changes can be made after submission)
  • Step 12: Take printout/save soft copy of submitted application for future reference
  • Step 13: Do not send printout to High Court (keep for personal records only)
  • Important: Candidates will be called for Written Test (if conducted) only after scrutiny of uploaded documents
  • Note: Read notification and "How to apply" instructions carefully before applying

  • Qualifications (Manager): Graduation in any discipline. 12 years relevant administrative experience in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Asst Administrative Officer/Assistant/Junior Assistant): Graduation in any discipline with relevant administrative/clerical experience in specified pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Junior Engineer): 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engg (8 yrs experience) OR B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engg (3 yrs experience) in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Library & Info Asst): Bachelor's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent. 6 years relevant experience.
  • Qualifications (Accountant/Junior Accountant): b.com/Inter-CA/Inter-ICWA with 6/5 years relevant post qualification experience in specified pay levels.
  • Relevant experience means experience in administrative/office clerical matters, preferably in Central/State Govt. Service or academic institutions.
  • Experience should not include Apprenticeship and Training of any form.

  • Chief Manager (Level-13): Rs. 123100-215900 (Gross Pay: Rs. 2.25 Lakh/month appx.).

  • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Assistant/Accountant (Level-06): Rs. 35400-112400 (Gross Pay: Rs. 62,000 /month appx.).
  • Junior Assistant/Junior Accountant (Level-04): Rs. 25500-81100 (Gross Pay: Rs. 45,000 /month appx.).

  • Chief Manager: Maximum 50 years.
  • Manager: Maximum 45 years.
  • Asst Administrative Officer: Maximum 40 years (OBC(NCL): 43 years).

  • Application fee of Rs. 118/- inclusive of GST is to be paid through an online payment system.
  • There is no application fee for SC/ST/Differently Abled/Women and Departmental Candidates of IIM Kozhikode.
  • Fee once remitted will not be refunded.
  • A separate fee is to be paid for each post if applying for multiple positions.

Selection Process

  • Method of selection:
    • Chief Manager: Interview only (at IIM Kozhikode Campus).
    • Manager: Interview only (at IIM Kozhikode Campus).
    • Assistant Administrative Officer: Written Test only.
    • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Assistant/Accountant/Junior Assistant/Junior Accountant: Written test only.
  • Shortlisted candidates alone will be called for the selection process.
  • Certificate verification will be part of the selection process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to fix the criteria for selection beyond minimum qualifications.

General Information/Instructions

  • Posts are on a regular basis. Place of posting can be IIM Kozhikode main campus or Kochi campus.
  • Selected candidates will join at the entry pay of the concerned Pay Level; no pay protection benefits.
  • Candidates must not apply for outside employment for the initial three years after joining.
  • Incomplete/unsigned applications and applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates working in Govt/PSUs must forward applications through the proper channel or submit NOC at the time of written test/interview.

How To Apply

  • Application is to be submitted online from December 12, 2025, to January 12, 2026, on the IIM Kozhikode website careers portal.
  • After online submission, take a printed copy of the application, sign it, and attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents (SSLC for DOB, education proof, experience certs, salary proofs, community certs, vigilance clearance, etc.).
  • Send the complete hard copy by Speed Post/Registered Post/Courier to: `HR In-charge, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O, Kozhikode, Kerala - 673 570`.
  • The envelope must be clearly superscribed with "Application for the post of , Post Code ".
  • Hard copy must be received by January 21, 2026, 5:30 PM.

  • Selection will be based on Online Examination conducted by IBPS Mumbai
  • Online Examination will consist of 200 questions for 200 marks with 120 minutes duration
  • Examination subjects include:
    • Computer Knowledge: 40 questions (20 marks) - 20 minutes
    • Reasoning: 40 questions (50 marks) - 25 minutes
    • English Language: 40 questions (40 marks) - 25 minutes
    • General Awareness: 40 questions (40 marks) - 20 minutes
    • Quantitative Aptitude: 40 questions (50 marks) - 30 minutes
  • Question paper will be objective type multiple choice with 5 alternatives in both English and Hindi (except English Language test)
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for every wrong answer
  • EWS candidates (MP domicile) will get 10% relaxation in cut-off marks
  • Merit list will be prepared based on total marks obtained in online examination

  • OBC candidates must submit valid certificate (not from Creamy Layer) dated within one year before last date
  • Reservation and age relaxation benefits only for Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates
  • PwBD candidates must have minimum 40% disability to avail benefits
  • Probation period: 12 months (extendable up to 24 months maximum)
  • Minimum service tenure: 5 years from date of appointment
  • Candidates serving in Government/PSU must produce No Objection Certificate at document verification
  • Family members of Board of Directors of respective DCCBs are not eligible to apply
  • Character verification from Police department required within 90 days of joining
  • Medical fitness certificate mandatory before joining
  • Examination centres: Bhopal, Gwalior, Indore, Jabalpur, Sagar, Ujjain, Satna (Madhya Pradesh)
  • Candidates must select 4 examination centre preferences
  • Minimum 10 times applications required for each post to conduct examination
  • For persons with benchmark disabilities using scribe: 20 minutes compensatory time per hour
  • Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid ID proofs
  • Jurisdiction for any litigation: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)

  • Click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • For new registration, click "Click here for New Registration"
  • Enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID to generate Provisional Registration Number and Password

  • Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

  • Submit the application and take printout of e-Receipt and application form for future reference

  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted

  • Photograph and signature should be in JPG/JPEG format with prescribed size
  • Photograph: Maximum 50 KB, Signature: Maximum 20 KB
  • Application form once submitted cannot be changed except during correction window
  • Candidates are advised to read complete notification carefully before applying
  • Any false information will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • The Commission reserves right to cancel or modify the recruitment process
  • Court jurisdiction will be at Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh only

  • Step 3: New candidates must register by providing basic details
  • Step 4: Create a password and complete the registration process
  • Step 5: Login using Registration ID and password after successful registration
  • Step 6: Fill in the application form with all required personal and educational details
  • Step 7: Upload scanned photograph, signature, and other required documents
  • Step 8: Select examination center preference from available options
  • Step 9: Verify all entered information carefully before submission
  • Step 10: Submit the application form after thorough verification
  • Step 11: After submission, click on "Proceed for Payment"
  • Step 12: Pay application fee online through available payment modes
  • Step 13: After successful payment, status will show "Payment Done"
  • Step 14: Take printout of submitted application and payment receipt
  • Step 15: Keep the printout safely for future reference
  • Step 16: Check official website regularly for updates regarding admit card

Important Instructions

  • Use only English alphabet and numerals while filling form
  • Do not use special characters in any field

  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.

  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Refer Official Notification

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Start date of submission of application form 01.01.2026
Closing date for receipt of application 30.01.2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants shall apply for the only one post from which he/she had superannuated. The application of the applicants applying for any other posts will not be considered.
  • Eligible applicants meeting the minimum eligibility criteria as specified under this notification will be assessed based on the specified parameters such as Physical Attendance and Annual Confidential Report (ACR) in the preceding three years of superannuation, excluding the year of superannuation except in case of employees who have superannuated on March 31st.
  • I. Physical Attendance - 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For above 90% of physical attendance in a year- 5 Marks, b) For 80% to 90% of physical attendance in a year - 3 Marks, c) For 70% to below 80% of physical attendance in a year - 2 Marks, d) For less than 70% of physical attendance in a year - 0(Zero) Marks
  • Note (b):- i. Physical Attendance would mean the actual attendance put in by an applicant employee excluding all forms of absence from work such as leave, sick etc. However, would include absence from duty by virtue of ‘on-duty’ approved on account of PME, VTC, other Training and release from duty on account of official tour/company events. ii. Percentage would be computed by taking the total number of days of working of the respective mine, including Sundays and holidays in a year, as denominator.
  • II. Annual Confidential Report (ACR) – 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For ‘Outstanding’/‘Excellent’ grade in a year- 5 Marks b) For ‘Very Good’ grade in a year- 3 Marks
  • Note (c):- i. ‘Year’ for the selection criteria mentioned above would mean a Financial Year for the calendar month of April to March. ii. The data of physical attendance and ACR earned will be taken from the official record of the employee concerned.
  • III. Other selection/eligibility criteria shall be as provided in the guidelines of CIL for availing the services of superannuated non-executive employees.
  • IV. In cases where more than one applicant secures equal marks for the post, the tie will be resolved by applying the following methods one after another: (i) Marks scored in the ACR (Higher grade will be given preference) (ii) Date of Birth (Younger will be given preference) (iii) Date of Appointment (Junior would be given preference)
  • V. Provisional merit panels of shortlisted applicants for different Posts, who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria, will be derived in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie as prescribed and by giving reservation as applicable.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before submitting the application, the applicant must ensure that he/ she fulfills all the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this Notification. He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Caste Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same. The basic details such as date of birth, date of appointment, date of superannuation, caste etc. will be considered as recorded in the service record of the candidate.
  • The decision of NCL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection to the post etc. shall be final and binding on all applicants. No correspondence will be entertained from the applicants found ineligible.
  • Applicants should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC-(NCL) in their Application form.
  • All correspondences with the applicants shall be done either through Speed Post / Registered email id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through NCL website. Applicants are advised to check/ visit NCL website (www.nclcil.in) regularly for further updates.
  • NCL will not take any responsibility for the applicants not being able to submit their applications within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons.
  • Selected applicants could be posted in any of the Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL and transferred to other Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL during the engagement period.
  • No TA/ DA will be paid for joining on being selected.
  • NCL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the engagement process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the NCL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Jabalpur M.P.
  • Reservation of SC/ST/OBC (NCL) CENTRE LIST will be applicable as per Govt. of India rules and guidelines, notifications and amendments from time to time issued in this regard.
  • Applicant(s) who wish to be considered against reserved vacancies and seek other concessions applicable to the reserved categories must submit requisite certificate(s) issued by Competent Authority for availing such reservation.
  • SC/ ST/ OBC (NCL) applicants who are selected on their merit will not be adjusted against the reserved vacancies. Such applicant (s) will be accommodated against the un- reserved vacancies earmarked for UR category. The reserved vacancies will be filled up separately from amongst the eligible SC/ST/OBC (NCL) applicants.
  • Provisional offer of Engagement will be issued, subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination (IME) as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • The candidates offered provisional offer of engagement shall have to report within 7 days from the date of receipt of the letter with all the original and valid educational and technical qualification certificates along with caste certificate, as applicable.
  • The initial engagement of the selected candidate would be for a period of one year from the date of joining subject to the upper age limit of 65 years as provided in the CIL guidelines. It is extendable for another term of one year subject to his performance during the initial term of engagement, medical fitness, mutual consent, norms and other terms and conditions stipulated in the guidelines of CIL mentioned above and also subject to the upper age limit of 65 years. In either case, the engagement period will be limited to the age of 65 years.

  • a) Specializing in different types of electrical systems (DCEXX, Gem, DC2000 etc) of Dragline / Excavators.
  • b) Experience in knowledge of Electrical system of Draglines with a foresight to the needs of maintenance and operation.
  • c) Experience of rewinding and repair of electrical motors, generators, transformers etc.
  • d) Repairing of Electronics Cards and components, like IC, Microprocessors etc and other Electronics components and assemblies.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Consolidated monthly compensation/ Honorarium For Retd. E-8 Gr. Executive ₹1,20,000/- per month
  • Conveyance charges: Company shall provide conveyance for Full-time Advisors as per availability. However, where conveyance is not provided, they shall be eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charge.
  • Accommodation Facility: Suitable company's accommodation shall be provided on availability. However, if company's accommodation is not available, HRA will be provided as per the applicable CIL HRA rules for X,Y and Z class of cities based on circular of DoE vide OM dated 07.07.2017
  • Re-imbursement for Mobile Telephones: Re-imbursement for the use of mobile telephones based on the actual bills or ₹1000/- per month whichever is less.
  • Medical: All executives of CIL covered under the Post Retiral Medical Benefits Scheme will continue to be governed by the said scheme. Those appointed, who were not under the roll of CIL, will be given the same coverage of benefit, if they are not covered under any post retiral medical scheme.
  • Leave: The Advisor shall be entitled for paid leave of 15 days in every six months spell in addition to the paid holidays in the establishment. The paid leave shall be regulated as per the provisions of EL (Earned Leave) applicable to the executive cadre employees under the CIL Executive Leave Rules. However, the paid leave admissible as above is not encashable. The accumulated leave shall stand lapsed on the expiry of each period of engagement of Advisor.
  • TA/DA and other boarding/ lodging charges: On official tour :- As per entitlement on their retirement restricted to air travel by Economy class only. On Joining: On engagement to the post of Advisor, if the Advisor is required to travel from out-station for joining duty, then he/she will be eligible for the cost of One ticket (for self) as per the entitlement mentioned above. On expiry of contract, also he/she will be eligible for one ticket (for self). Accommodation in Hotel: The Advisor will be entitled to Hotel Accommodation as per his entitlement at the time of his Retirement/Superannuation limited to Single Room, limited to the maximum of entitlement of E9 grade Executives. In case Boarding and Lodging is not provided by the Company, he/she will be eligible for DA as admissible at the time of his Retirement/Superannuation limited to maximum of entitlement of E9 level executives.

Age Limit (as on 12-01-2026)

  • Not more than 65 years during the Contract period.

Important Dates

Notification Date 29 December 2025
Cut-off date for the eligibility 12 January 2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 12 January 2026

  • The selected Advisor (Excavation) would be stationed at NCL HQ, Singrauli MP and will report to Director (Tech/Operation), NCL.
  • The engagement of Advisor (Excavation) shall be subject to Medical Fitness to be certified by Company's Medical Officer.
  • Notice period for termination of contract - one month's notice or consolidated compensation amount from either side.
  • Extension of Fixed Tenure - Tenure of engagement can be extended on the approval of the Chairman-cum-Managing Director, NCL as the case may be.
  • Signing of the documents - The Advisor shall give his proposals, suggestions, comments, advises, remarks, etc in writing under their signature and shall take accountability for the same. However, he will not supervise or control the day to day work of officials / employees of the company nor will he certify or pass bills pertaining to the department.
  • Secrecy-The Advisor will maintain all information/ documents/ materials gathered during the course of the engagement in strict confidence. They will not copy or make notes of such information/ documents except in conjunction with the work for the Company. They will not divulge to anyone outside the Company or use any of the information/ documents/ materials gathered during the course of engagement for their own or anyone else's benefit, either during or after the terms of engagement with the Company. The aforesaid obligation shall also apply to proprietary/ confidential information/ documents of third parties received by them or the company in the normal course of the engagement with the Company. The Advisor shall, while demitting the office, handover all information/ documents/ materials (in soft/ hard format) under their possession, during the engagement period, to the concerned HOD.
  • Tax - In case payment of GST is required, then the same shall be reimbursed on production of proof of such payment.
  • Reporting Relationships – During course of the engagement, the Advisor will employ himself/herself efficiently, diligently and to the best of his/her ability shall devote his/her whole time and attention to the interest of the Company and generally carry out work as assigned to him/her and shall comply with all lawful orders and directions given by the CMDs/ Directors/ HoDs. He/She shall honestly, diligently and faithfully serve the Company and use utmost endeavor to promote the interest of the Company.
  • Expiry of Terms of Engagement – Unless the ad-hoc period of engagement is extended further or terminated earlier by giving one-month notice or payment in lieu thereof, the engagement will come to an automatic end on the expiry of the period of engagement stipulated in the offer letter and no notice will be necessary.

In the event of failure to join within the stipulated period, the offer of engagement shall stand withdrawn automatically.

Further, compliance to circular No. 07/05/21 dated 03.06.2021 of Central Vigilance Commission to be made regarding procedure for obtaining Vigilance clearance before engaging retired officials other than that of Coal India Limited.

  • Qualifications for Chief LADC: Practice in Criminal law for at least 10 years; Excellent oral and written communication skills; Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others with capability to lead.
  • Qualifications for Deputy Chief LADC: Practice in Criminal law for at least 7 years; Excellent oral and written communication skills; IT Knowledge with proficiency in work.

  • Essential qualifications: A law degree is an implicit requirement for practice.
  • Desirable: LL.M. Degree, Ph.D. in Law, Knowledge of Information Technology and Legal Software Tools are additional qualifications that can be submitted.
  • Experience: Varies by post as listed above. Candidates must have handled minimum numbers of cases (e.g., Chief LADC must have handled at least 30 criminal trials in Sessions Courts).

Salary/Stipend

  • For a Category C district (which includes Mandla), the determined honorarium (retainership fee) per month is:
  • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹65,000/-
  • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹45,000/- each
  • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹25,000/- each

  • Eligible candidates will be called for an Interview before a selection committee chaired by the Principal District & Sessions Judge.
  • Selection is purely based on merit, taking into account knowledge, skills, practice, and experience.
  • The selection committee's merit list will be sent to the M.P. State Legal Services Authority, Jabalpur, for final approval.
  • Candidates must provide self-attested copies of judgments, orders, memos/vakalatnamas, etc., for evaluation of case handling experience.

  • The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals / Institutions and countersigned by Medical Superintendent /CMO / Head of Hospital / Institution
  • Only such persons would be eligible for reservation under PwBD quota who suffer from not less than 40% of physical disability
  • Person who wants to avail the benefit of reservation would have to submit a Disability Certificate as issued by a Competent Authority in prescribed format

For OBC Candidates:

  • Candidates applying under OBC category must produce the valid caste certificate in the format provided by the DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and further clarification issued by DoP&T OM No. 36036/2/2013-Estt(Res-I) dated 31.03.2016
  • The certificate must mention the non-creamy layer status of the applicant
  • The OBC applicants who belong to the 'Non-Creamy Layer' and whose caste appears in the Central List of the OBCs shall be eligible
  • The validity of the non-creamy layer certificate shall be issued for the financial year 2025-2026 (which is the year of advertisement), issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

For EWS Candidates:

  • Joining Period: Candidates have to join within one month from the date of issue of appointment letter. No extension will be allowed in any circumstances
  • Termination: The appointment can be terminated at any time by the Institute by giving one month notice or salary in lieu thereof
  • Full-time Position: This appointment is of full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited
  • Work Requirements: He/she will have to work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute
  • Leave: The leave entitlement of the appointee shall be governed by the Institute's leave rules as amended from time to time
  • No Benefits: The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc., or any other benefits available to Government Servants appointed on regular basis
  • NOC/Relieving Letter: If an appointee wishes to apply somewhere else or resign within the first 03 (Three) months of joining, then neither he/ she will be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) nor he/ she will receive any Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate
  • Experience Counting: The period of experience, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification
  • Government Employees: The candidates who are in service in any Government Institutions are required to submit "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of Interview
  • Discipline: He/ she should conform to the rules of discipline and conduct as applicable to the Institute employees
  • No Travelling Allowance: No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidates for interview and joining on selection
  • Court Conviction: The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will lead to a disqualification
  • Jurisdiction: All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Bathinda

Important Notes

  • The candidates who applied earlier vide Advertisement No. AIIMS/BTI/RC/SR/2076 dated 18 October 2025 shall be considered, and they are not required to apply again
  • The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda reserves the right to vary the vacancies including reserved vacancies as per the Govt. of India rules/circulars and requirements
  • Inadequately filled/ incomplete application form will be summarily rejected and no enquiry or representation will be entertained in this regard
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy
  • Candidates who fail to produce valid category certificate OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PWBD etc. during document verification or as and when required, the candidature will be cancelled
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained in this regard
