Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Candidates who successfully apply online will be called for an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination
  • Merit List Preparation: The merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination
  • Tie-Breaking Rules: In case of equal marks in the written examination:
    • First preference: Older candidate (based on date of birth)
    • Second preference: Higher percentage in required educational qualification
    • Third preference: Higher marks in Matriculation examination
  • Document Verification/Counseling: Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for document verification/counseling. The number of candidates called will be decided by the Board or competent authority considering category-wise vacancies
  • Final Selection: Only after successful verification of all documents and fulfillment of eligibility criteria, candidates' names will be recommended to the concerned department based on available vacancies
  • Important Note: Appearing in online application, written examination, merit list, or counseling does not guarantee selection. Final recommendation depends on complete eligibility verification and vacancy availability

General Information/Instructions

  • Punjab Domicile Mandatory: Only residents of Punjab State are eligible for reservation benefits. Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate (not older than 5 years) must be submitted during counseling
  • Category Certificates: SC/BC/Ex-Servicemen/PWD/EWS certificates must be as per Punjab Government's prevailing instructions
  • Category Code Selection: Candidates must carefully select category and category code while filling the online form as it cannot be changed at any stage
  • Ex-Servicemen Priority: ESM (Self) candidates will be given first preference. Only if ESM (Self) is not available, ESM (Dependent) candidates will be considered
  • Women Reservation: Recruitment will be done as per Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of Posts for Women) Rules, 2020, Notification No. G.S.R. 87/Const/Art.309 and 15/2020 dated 21/10/2020
  • Document Upload: Candidates must scan and upload required certificates in PDF format in a single file during online application
  • No Personal Communication: All recruitment-related information will be published only on the Board's website. No individual communication will be sent to candidates
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid for attending written examination or counseling
  • Board's Rights Reserved: The Board reserves the right to modify/cancel/increase/decrease the number of vacancies or category-wise distribution at any stage of recruitment
  • Final Decision: The decision of the Board or Committee constituted by the Board shall be final and binding on all candidates

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Visit Official Website: Visit the official website of PSSSB at https://sssb.punjab.gov.in
  • Step 2 - Click on Online Applications: Click on "Online Applications" link on the website
  • Step 3 - Select Post: For Advertisement 16, first click on Junior Engineer post, then select one from Civil/Mechanical/Electrical as per your qualification
  • Step 4 - Registration: Fill personal and educational details carefully and complete registration. A Username will be generated after successful registration
  • Step 5 - Login and Fill Form: Login using the generated Username and complete the application form step-wise
  • Step 6 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of passport size photograph, signature, Matriculation certificate (for date of birth), 12th certificate, Diploma/Degree certificates, and category certificates (if applicable)
  • Step 7 - Submit Application: After uploading all documents, submit the complete application form. The form will be accepted only after successful fee payment
  • Step 8 - Fee Payment: After submitting the form (skipping one day), pay the application fee through:
    • State Bank of India branch via Challan (on any working day)
    • Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI (anytime before 31-12-2025)
  • Step 9 - Download Application Form: After successful fee payment (after 2 days), download and print the application form for future reference
  • Step 10 - No Correction After Submission: Once submitted, no changes can be made to the application form. Candidates must fill the form carefully
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to apply themselves and not take help from cyber cafes to avoid errors. Self-application is recommended
  • Technical Support: For technical issues during online application, email at [email protected]

  • In case of CGPA, relevant CGPA to percentage conversion certificate from the college/university should be produced by the candidate
  • Selection will be purely merit-based and transparent

General Information/Instructions

Apprenticeship Period

  • The tenure of Apprenticeship would be One Year only
  • Apprenticeship training will commence from 09-02-2026
  • Before commencement of training, candidates will have to execute a Contract of Apprenticeship

Terms and Conditions

  • The engagement and training are strictly in compliance with provisions of Apprenticeship Act, 1961
  • There is no obligation for employment of Apprentices on completion of their training
  • The Apprentice after completion of training shall have no right to claim any employment in ECIL
  • Candidates selected for training will not be allowed to withdraw from training except for reasons beyond their control
  • Those who absent themselves are liable to refund the whole cost of their training as well as the amount received as stipend as determined by Central Apprenticeship Advisor

Registration Requirements

  • Candidates MUST register themselves on National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) website: www.nats.education.gov.in
  • Applications submitted on ECIL website shall only be accepted and considered
  • After applying online, candidate required to take printout of registered online application form with system-generated application serial number
  • Candidate must quote system-generated online application number for all future correspondence

Category Certificate Requirements

  • Category Certificate in support of SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS should be in prescribed proforma as hosted on www.ecil.co.in portal
  • The Degree of Disability for PwD Candidates to be eligible is 40% & above
  • Latest Caste & Disability (PwD) certificates wherever applicable should be produced

Documents Required at Time of Joining

ECIL being highly protected establishment, Selected Apprentices should produce the following documents at time of joining:

  • Character/Conduct certificate from the concerned institution where they last studied
  • Police verification certificate from concerned District Police Superintendent
  • A physical fitness certificate from a Civil Assistant Surgeon

Important Instructions

  • Before applying, candidate should read the advertisement carefully and ensure eligibility criteria is fulfilled in all respects
  • The application is liable for rejection at any stage of engagement process in case of suppression of facts/furnishing of false information
  • If any shortcoming is noticed even after Apprenticeship commencement, apprenticeship will be liable for termination forthwith
  • No separate communication will be sent to any candidate on their non-selection at any stage of engagement process
  • ECIL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the selection process, if need arises, without assigning any reason
  • ECIL reserves the right to increase or decrease the notified seats based on need
  • ECIL will not be responsible for Network/Internet related difficulties/issues
  • Canvassing in any form will result in immediate rejection of application
  • Any Legal proceeding can be instituted only in jurisdiction limited to Courts at Medchal District, Telangana

Important Caution

  • Some unscrupulous elements may approach candidates with assurance of procuring Apprenticeship through illegal gratification
  • Candidates must not fall prey to such assurance or exploitation
  • Selection exercise will be done only on basis of merit and in a transparent manner
  • Corrigendum, if any shall be published only on official website
  • Do not rely on other websites/social media handles for any information or updates

How to Apply

Application Process (Two Steps)

STEP 1: NATS Registration

  • Interested candidates who possess required criteria/educational qualification MUST register themselves on National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) website
  • Visit: www.nats.education.gov.in
  • Complete the registration process

STEP 2: ECIL Online Application

  • Subsequent to registration in NATS portal, interested eligible candidates shall submit online application through ECIL website
  • Visit: www.ecil.co.in > Careers > Current Job Openings
  • Fill and submit the online application form before 20/01/2026 (16:30 Hrs.)
  • Take printout of registered online application form with system-generated application serial number
  • Note down application serial number for all future references

IMPORTANT NOTE: Applications submitted on ECIL website shall only be accepted and considered.

Documents Required for Document Verification

Candidates called for document verification shall require to present following original documents mandatorily with a set of photocopies:

  • Online registered application form duly signed by candidate with recent color passport size photo affixed
  • All original certificates in support of NATS Registration
  • Date of Birth certificate
  • Identity proof (Govt. issued only like Aadhaar, Driving License, Passport etc.)
  • Educational Qualification certificates (B.E./B.Tech. or Diploma)
  • All mark sheets and consolidated marks sheet
  • CGPA to percentage conversion certificate (if applicable)
  • Latest Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/EWS) in prescribed proforma
  • Disability (PwD) certificate (wherever applicable) showing 40% or above disability

Document Verification Venue

  • Venue: Electronics Corporation of India Limited, Corporate Learning & Development Centre (CLDC), Nalanda Complex, ECIL (PO), Hyderabad-500062
  • Phone: 040-27186454, 040-27182279

Last Date for Apply 20th January 2026 (5:00 PM)

TGSRTC Traffic Supervisor Trainee & Mechanical Supervisor Trainee Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Note: LR – Limited Recruitment (Backlog) - All these vacancies will be filled up with the local candidates of the respective Revenue Zone only. DR – Direct Recruitment. The number of vacancies indicated is tentative and liable to change without any notice.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility by Gender

  • Men and Women are eligible for the Posts of Traffic Supervisor Trainee and Mechanical Supervisor Trainee
  • 33⅓% of the vacancies in each category are reserved for Women under Direct Recruitment on horizontal basis

Educational Qualifications

  • For Post Code No. 47 (Traffic Supervisor Trainee): Must possess a Graduate Degree awarded by any university in India, established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, Provisional Act of State or of any Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any other equivalent qualification as on 1st July 2025
  • For Post Code No. 48 (Mechanical Supervisor Trainee): Must have passed Diploma in Automobile/Mechanical Engineering conducted by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Telangana or its equivalent qualification in the same discipline as on 1st July 2025
  • Candidates possessing higher qualification of BE/B Tech/AMIE in the discipline of Automobile/Mechanical Engineering are also eligible for Post Code 48
  • Candidates who possess higher qualification than the prescribed one will also be considered for Post Code 47

Essential Qualifications

  • All educational qualifications must be obtained as on 1st July 2025
  • Degrees must be from universities in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, Provisional Act of State or from institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission
  • Diploma must be from the Department of Technical Education, Government of Telangana or equivalent

Desirable

  • For Departmental Candidates: Must have completed 5 years of service on regular basis as an approved probationer as on 25th December 2025

Experience

  • No specific experience mentioned as mandatory for external candidates
  • Departmental candidates must have 5 years of regular service in TGSRTC as on the date of notification

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: ₹27,080 – ₹81,400 per month
  • During Training Period (12 months): Selected candidates shall be eligible for stipend i.e., minimum of the time scale of Deputy Superintendent (Traffic)/Deputy Superintendent (Mechanic)
  • After Training: On successful completion of training, candidates will be appointed in the regular post as Deputy Superintendent (Traffic)/Deputy Superintendent (Mechanic)
  • During both regular and extended training period, candidates will receive the stipend amount

Age Limit (as on 1st July 2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 25 years
  • Upper Age Limit Relaxation: Government of Telangana vide GO Ms No. 30 dated 08-02-2024 have raised the upper age limit by 12 years (making it 37 years) for direct recruitment

Additional Age Relaxations

  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years in addition to the length of service rendered in the Armed Forces (Indian Army/Indian Navy/Indian Air Force/Indian Territorial Army)
  • SC, ST, BC and EWS Category: 5 years
  • Departmental Employees (SC/ST/BC): Age relaxation to the extent of service rendered in the Corporation on regular basis, subject to maximum age not exceeding 45 years as on 1st July 2025
  • Departmental Employees (Other than SC/ST/BC): Age relaxation up to maximum of 10 years regular service, subject to maximum age not exceeding 40 years as on 1st July 2025

Note: Date of Birth accepted is that entered in the Secondary School Certificate or Matriculation or equivalent examination certificate. No other document relating to age will be accepted.

Application Fee

Post Name SC/ST Local to Telangana All Others
Traffic Supervisor Trainee ₹400/- ₹800/-
Mechanical Supervisor Trainee ₹400/- ₹800/-
  • Fee is towards Registration of Application, Processing of Application, Conduct of Test, Maintenance of Portal etc.
  • Fee can be paid using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or any other mode available on TSLPRB Website
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Date 25th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 30th December 2025 (8:00 AM)
Last Date for Online Application 20th January 2026 (5:00 PM)
Age Calculation Date As on 1st July 2025
Qualification Date As on 1st July 2025

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: All eligible registered candidates shall be required to appear for Written Exam in one paper (three hours duration) for 200 marks (200 Questions - MCQs)
  • Paper Pattern for Traffic Supervisor Trainee (Post Code 47):
    • Supervisory Aptitude: 60 Questions
    • Numerical Aptitude: 40 Questions
    • Reasoning: 40 Questions
    • General English: 30 Questions
    • General Knowledge: 30 Questions
    • Total: 200 Marks
  • Paper Pattern for Mechanical Supervisor Trainee (Post Code 48):
    • Supervisory Aptitude: 60 Questions
    • Engineering Aptitude: 40 Questions
    • Reasoning: 40 Questions
    • General English: 30 Questions
    • General Knowledge: 30 Questions
    • Total: 200 Marks
  • Language of Question Paper: Questions will be set in English, Telugu and Urdu languages (except General English and Engineering Aptitude which will be in English only)
  • Answer Sheet: Candidates have to answer questions on an OMR answer sheet using Blue/Black Ball Point Pen only
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • OC including EWS: 40%
    • BC Category: 35%
    • SC/ST Category: 30%
  • Merit Determination: Selection shall be made strictly on relative merit based on score in Written Examination
  • Zone-wise Selection: First 5% of posts filled following combined Qualified Candidates List, remaining 95% filled by local candidates of respective zones
  • Tie-Breaking: When two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference given to candidate who was born earlier
  • Certificates Verification: Candidates must produce original documents for verification
  • Medical Examination: Provisionally selected candidates will undergo medical fitness examination
  • Biometrics: Fingerprints and photographs will be taken at the time of Written Examination and whenever required

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted through ONLINE mode only on TSLPRB Website (www.tgprb.in)
  • Candidates must check their eligibility carefully before applying
  • Only online applications will be considered
  • Candidates should not furnish any false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • All testimonials issued by competent authorities must be produced when required
  • Claims regarding Age, Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, Community etc. are accepted provisionally
  • If under-aged or over-aged candidates apply, their candidature will be rejected at any time
  • Candidates must use their personal mobile number as User ID which should remain active throughout recruitment process
  • No relevant column of Online Application Form should be left blank
  • Once submitted, no corrections can be made to the Online Application Form
  • Passport size photo and specimen signature must be combined as one file/image in jpg format (30kb to 100kb)
  • Application will be rejected if candidate uploads only photo without signature
  • Candidates should not submit more than one application
  • Giving false information will result in disqualification and prosecution
  • Candidature is provisional at all stages
  • TSLPRB reserves right to reject candidature at any stage without notice
  • Impersonation will be viewed adversely and prosecuted criminally
  • Candidates must behave in orderly and disciplined manner during examinations

Medical Standards

  • Candidate must be in good health mentally and bodily
  • Persons with disabilities are not eligible
  • Vision Test/Standards:
    • Distant Vision: Naked Eye vision 6/24 in each eye, corrected vision 6/9 with glasses in each eye
    • Near Vision: J1 with Glasses
    • Colour Vision: Normal (Colour blindness is disqualification)
    • Field of Vision: Normal
    • Fundus: Normal
  • Provisionally selected candidates will be referred to District Headquarters Hospital for medical examination
  • Candidates declared unfit in eye issues will be referred to Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital, Hyderabad
  • Candidates advised to have medical examination before applying

Reservation Information

  • Reservation as per Rule 22 and 22(A) of Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 applicable
  • 33⅓% vacancies reserved for Women on horizontal basis
  • Reservation for Local Candidates as per Presidential Order, 2018 and Regulation 8 of TGSRTC Recruitment Regulations
  • SC, ST and BC candidates must be local to Telangana to claim reservation
  • SC candidates must submit Community Certificate as per Act No. 15 of 2025 dated 14.04.2025 with sub-classification
  • BC candidates must submit Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • EWS candidates must submit Income and Asset Certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • BC-E Group relaxation subject to adjudication of litigation and government orders

Documents to be Uploaded

  • SSC/Matriculation Certificate for Date of Birth
  • Educational Qualification Certificates
  • Study Certificate from 1st to 7th class or Residence Certificate issued by MRO
  • Latest Community Certificate issued by Telangana Government
  • Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for BC candidates) issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable) issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • PPO/Discharge Book (for Ex-servicemen)
  • Service Certificate from TGSRTC (for Departmental candidates)

Training and Service Bond

  • Selected candidates will undergo 12 months training
  • Provisionally selected candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond to serve the Corporation for 5 years after training

Disqualification Grounds

  • Suppression of material facts
  • Canvassing for support
  • Having more than one spouse
  • Previously dismissed from government service
  • Convicted by court of law for offence involving moral turpitude

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on TSLPRB Website www.tgprb.in using Mobile Number as User ID
  • Step 2: Select the Post(s) for which you want to apply as per eligibility
  • Step 3: Note the fee amount depending on Post chosen and category
  • Step 4: Pay the fee using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or other available modes
  • Step 5: After payment, continue on TSLPRB Website with User ID and fill the Application Form
  • Step 6: Prepare combined image of Passport Photograph and Specimen Signature as one file in jpg format (30kb to 100kb)
  • Step 7: Scan and upload the photo+signature file with Online Application Form
  • Step 8: Fill all relevant columns carefully without leaving any column blank
  • Step 9: Carefully read all instructions before clicking "I AGREE"
  • Step 10: Endorse the declaration and confirm with OTP sent to registered mobile
  • Step 11: Verify all details carefully before submission
  • Step 12: Click Submit button to complete the application process
  • Step 13: Download a copy of submitted application form in PDF for future use
  • Use "Apply Online" option in main menu after payment of fee
  • Candidates advised to fill application themselves to avoid wrong entries
  • Ensure photo and signature are uploaded together as one file, otherwise application will be rejected
  • Even after payment, if Submit button is not pressed, application will be rejected
  • No corrections possible after submission
  • Do not submit more than one application

Karnataka.contentHtml:
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 44 Young Professional Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official NABARD website. The last date to submit the application form is 12-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the NABARD Young Professional Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026

NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
Post Name Young Professional (14 Disciplines)
No of Posts 44
Salary ₹70,000/- Per Month (All Inclusive Stipend)
Qualification Bachelor's/Master's degree as per discipline requirement
Age Limit 21 to 30 years
Start Date for Apply 26th December 2025
Last Date for Apply 12th January 2026
Official Website www.nabard.org

NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Discipline/Post Name Total Vacancies Location
Climate Action & Sustainability 3 Mumbai (1), Lucknow (1), Shimla (1)
Economics 3 Mumbai (2), Ranchi (1)
Data Science 4 Mumbai (3), Dehradun (1)
Cyber Security 1 Mumbai (1)
Academic Administration 2 Lucknow (1), Mangaluru (1)
Graphic Designing 1 Lucknow (1)
PR, Outreach and Documentation 2 Mumbai (1), Guwahati (1)
Information Technology 12 Mumbai (9), Guwahati (1), Aizawl (1), Kolkata (1)
Geoinformatics 1 Shimla (1)
Development Management 3 Lucknow (1), New Delhi (2)
Project Monitoring 4 Mumbai (1), Chennai (2), Chandigarh (1)
Finance 6 Mumbai (6)
UI/UX Designing 1 Mumbai (1)
Software Testing 1 Mumbai (1)
Total 44

Note: A candidate shall be permitted to apply only for one discipline/location. Multiple applications under the same/different disciplines shall lead to cancellation of candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science/Climate Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Economics: Post Graduate Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Financial Economics/Statistics/Data Science/Finance/Public Policy with minimum 55% marks
  • Data Science: B.E./B.Tech in Information Technology/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with minimum 60% marks
  • Cyber Security: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Electronics and Communications Engineering with minimum 60% marks OR Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks
  • Academic Administration: Bachelor's degree in Education/Business Administration/Computer Science/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Master's degree in Education (M.Ed.)/Educational Management/HRD/MBA (HR)/PGDM-HR with minimum 55% marks
  • Graphic Designing: Bachelor's degree in Digital Media/Multimedia/Graphic Design with minimum 60% marks
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Post graduate degree in Mass Media/Development Communication/Visual Communication/Journalism with minimum 55% marks
  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks
  • Geoinformatics: Post graduate degree in Geoinformatics/Geography/Remote Sensing/Environmental Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025
Last Date for Online Application 12th January 2026
Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted
  • Application will be rejected if only photo uploaded without signature
  • Left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged
  • Hand written declaration must be in candidate's handwriting and in English only
  • Keep valid personal email ID and mobile number active till completion of recruitment
  • Name should be spelt correctly as in Certificates/Mark sheets/Identity proof
  • No change possible after clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' button
  • Photo must be uploaded at place of photo and signature at place of signature
  • If photo not uploaded properly, admission for examination will be rejected/denied
  • For any problem, use "Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism" at https://cgrs.ibps.in/
  • Mention "NABARD – Recruitment of Young Professionals" in subject of email

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty

  • Do not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Using unfair means will lead to disqualification
  • Impersonating or procuring impersonation will lead to criminal prosecution
  • Misbehaving in examination/interview hall will lead to disqualification
  • Carrying mobile phones or electronic devices in examination/interview hall not allowed
  • May be debarred permanently or for specified period from any examination conducted by bank
  • If already joined, services may be terminated

Karnataka.contentHtml:
BEML Limited has announced a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST and OBC candidates, aiming to fill 50 backlog vacancies across various positions in Group A, Group B, and Group C categories. The recruitment includes roles such as Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer, Asst. Engineer, Diploma Trainee, and Office Assistant Trainee.

Candidates applying for these positions must meet specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications such as a First Class full-time Engineering Degree, MBA, CA/ICWA, or a Diploma for certain posts. The salary scales range from ₹90,000 to ₹2,40,000 for higher positions like Dy. General Manager and Asst. General Manager, while Diploma Trainees will receive a stipend ranging from ₹17,000 to ₹25,500 depending on the contract year. The age limit for applicants varies by post and category, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates, as well as an additional 10-year age relaxation for PwD candidates. Interested candidates must apply online by 7th January 2026.

  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • SBI 1146 SCO Online Form 2025
  • RRB Isolated Category 08/2025 2026
  • BARC Scientific Officers Online Form 2026
  • BSF Constable GD Online Form 2025-26

BEML Special Recruitment Drive Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name BEML Limited (BEML)
Post Name Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC – Group ‘A’ (Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer), Group ‘B’ (Asst. Engineer) & Group ‘C’ (Diploma Trainees, Office Assistant Trainees) Backlog Vacancies
No of Posts 50
Salary Rs 16,900 to 2,40,000
Qualification Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.
Age Limit Grade VII – 50 years (SC/ST), 48 years (OBC); Grade VI – 47/45 years; Grade V – 44/42 years; Grade IV – 39/37 years; Grade II – 34/32 years; Grade I – 34/32 years; Wage Group S1 & B – 34/32 years; PwD: additional 10 years; maximum age with relaxation not beyond 57 years.
Start Date for Apply  19/12/2025.
Last Date for Apply  07/01/2026 (till 18.00 Hrs).
Official Website bemlindia.in

BEML Special Recruitment Drive Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Designation Total
Dy. General Manager 13
Asst.General Manager 15
Sr.Manager 05
Manager 05
Officer/Engineer 03
Asst. Engineer 01
Diploma Trainee 06
Office Assistant 02

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, Qualification and Experience should be as on 07th January 2026.
  • Under qualifying marks, First Class is reckoned at 60% aggregate (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD); candidates with CGPA/credits must provide conversion formula.
  • SC/ST candidates must submit SC/ST Caste Certificate in the prescribed format for Government of India posts.
  • OBC candidates must submit OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format and a self-undertaking of OBC (NCL) status; OBC certificate should not be older than six months as on last date.
  • PwD candidates must submit PwD certificate in the prescribed format; age relaxation of additional 10 years is applicable for PwD with minimum 40% disability.
  • Post Qualification Experience (PQE) is counted only after obtaining the required qualification; only employment after the requisite qualification is considered.
  • Private sector candidates must be employed in regular capacity and submit experience certificate on company letterhead.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Govt., Autonomous bodies, Quasi-Govt. and PSUs must apply through proper channel or produce NOC, and should have worked at least one year in immediate lower scale (not applicable to Grade II, Group B & C).
  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD as applicable); any false information or discrepancy leads to cancellation/termination.
  • Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.

Salary/Stipend

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Pay Scale Rs. 90,000 – 2,40,000.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Pay Scale Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Pay Scale Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Pay Scale Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Pay Scale Rs. 40,000 – 1,40,000.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Pay Scale Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 23,910 – 85,570; stipend Rs. 17,000/- PM during 1 year training; Rs. 20,500/- PM & Rs. 25,500/- PM during first and second year of contract.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 16,900 – 60,650; stipend Rs. 20,000/- PM in first year and Rs. 23,500/- PM in second year of contract.
  • Besides Basic Pay, eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances (currently 13.78% of Basic Pay under Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per Company rules.

Age Limit (as on 07-01-2026)

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Upper age limit – 50 years for SC/ST, 48 years for OBC.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Upper age limit – 47 years for SC/ST, 45 years for OBC.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Upper age limit – 44 years for SC/ST, 42 years for OBC.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Upper age limit – 39 years for SC/ST, 37 years for OBC.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • For PwD candidates, upper age limit relaxable by additional 10 years over and above SC/ST/OBC relaxation; maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years.
  • Upper age limit can be relaxed for candidates of all categories subject to equivalent years of excess PQE, within the maximum limit of 57 years.

Application Fee

  • Eligible and interested OBC candidates applying for the above positions (not applicable for SC/ST/PwDs) must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/-.
  • Fee payment link is provided at the end of the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of Advertisement 03/12/2025 (Advt. No. KP/S/28/2025).
Crucial Date for Age, Qualification & Experience 07/01/2026.
Last Date for Online Registration 07/01/2026 up to 18:00 Hrs (online registration site available till this date and time).
Last Date for Receipt of Applications through Proper Channel (for Govt./PSU employees) Within 10 days from closing date of advertisement (i.e., within 10 days from 07/01/2026) to Sr. Manager, Recruitment Cell, BEML Soudha, Bengaluru.
Written Exam Date (for L036, L037, L038, L039) To be notified; assessment/written exam at Bangalore and details to be communicated via e-mail.
Intimation of Assessment / Interviews Intimation regarding assessments, provisional offer/final offer etc. will be only through e-mail; shortlisted/selected list will be uploaded on www.bemlindia.in under the advertisement in career portal.

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for assessment based on eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD etc.).
  • Based on assessment, shortlisted candidates must undergo pre-employment medical examination and original document verification; appointment is subject to meeting medical standards and satisfactory medical report.
  • Any shortcoming during document verification (falsification, wrong declaration, non-production of originals) results in rejection.
  • For post codes L036, L037, L038 and L039, selection will be based on written exam at Bangalore (to & fro fares reimbursed based on eligibility) assessing domain ability (not for L039), reasoning ability, general awareness and English ability.
  • Merely meeting conditions of advertisement does not entitle a candidate to be called for assessment; Screening Committee may adopt its own criteria for shortlisting.
  • Only candidates meeting all eligibility norms need apply; receiving call for assessment/interview does not guarantee selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC for Group ‘A’ (9th Attempt), Group ‘B’ & Group ‘C’ (7th Attempt) backlog vacancies.
  • BEML Limited is a multi-technology company under Ministry of Defence with core sectors Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Power, Mining & Construction; the drive is aligned with expansion initiatives like Vande Bharat sleeper trains, Metro coaches, high mobility vehicles, special application engines, AI-based mining equipment etc.
  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, qualification & experience are counted as on 07/01/2026; First Class is 60% aggregate (relaxable for SC/ST & PwD).
  • Candidates must upload all required documents (10th, 12th, degree/diploma, mark sheets with conversion formula, PG certificates, ID proof, caste/PwD certificates, experience letters, latest pay slip, detailed resume, current reporting structure) as per checklist; incomplete applications without documents are rejected.
  • Applications of Govt./PSU employees must be forwarded through proper channel or accompanied by specific NOC; such forwarded applications must reach BEML Soudha within 10 days from closing date.

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications:

  • Project Engineer (FTA Gr I) - Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication/Instrumentation/Computer Science: Full-Time Degree in Engineering/Technology or Post Graduate in Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication/Instrumentation/Computer Science from recognized Indian University/Institute with minimum 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC candidates (50% marks in aggregate for SC/ST).
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Electrical): Full-Time Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Electrical from recognized Indian University/Institute with minimum 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC candidates (50% marks in aggregate for SC/ST).
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Civil): Full-Time Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Civil from recognized Indian University/Institute with minimum 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC candidates (50% marks in aggregate for SC/ST).
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Mechanical): Full-Time Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical from recognized Indian University/Institute with minimum 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC candidates (50% marks in aggregate for SC/ST).
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Safety): Full-Time Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical diploma from recognized Indian University/Institute with Safety certification (NEBOSH/IOSH/OHSAS/Industrial Safety) with minimum 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC candidates (50% marks in aggregate for SC/ST).

Essential Qualifications:

  • Candidates should possess the required qualification and experience as on 12.01.2026.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/DGPA or Letter Grade in a degree/diploma is awarded, its equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated in the application form as per norms adopted by University/Institute.
  • Proof of norms adopted by the University/Institute to convert CGPA/OGPA/DGPA into percentage is to be submitted along with the application.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/Persons with Disability/Ex-Servicemen category should submit self-attested copy of the certificate issued by the Competent Authority.
  • OBC candidates are required to submit Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in the format as applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India not more than one year old from the date of application to BHEL.
  • Candidates should be of sound health and will have to undergo medical examination by Company's Authorized Medical Officer/Govt Officer in prescribed format.

Desirable:

  • For Project Engineer (FTA Gr I):
    • Candidate should possess inspiring leadership qualities and in-depth knowledge about the execution and delivery of electronic modules/sub-assemblies/systems for Railways Control & Signalling Systems.
    • Good understanding of relevant Rail & Signalling IEC/EN standards.
    • Knowledge of/exposure to cyber security features, devices and software packages.
    • Knowledge of best practices in software development processes.
    • Knowledge of system integration for rail transport systems.
    • Problem solving/root cause analysis skills for embedded systems.
    • Expertise of working in SIL Systems.
    • Exposure to and knowledge of relevant standards/frameworks such as IEEE, ISO, IEC, EN/CENELEC.
  • For Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Civil): Knowledge in Civil quality standards.
  • For Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Mechanical): Experience in erection of tracker based solar PV plant.
  • For Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Safety): Experience in construction or infrastructure works.

Experience:

  • Project Engineer (FTA Gr I): Minimum 5 years experience in any or more of the following:
    • Design of control systems
    • Design of embedded hardware & software systems
    • Design of safety critical control systems for defence/railways/aerospace/automotive
    • Experience of working with various communication protocols (UHF/LTE/GSM/GPS)
    • Knowledge of working on micro-processor/FPGA/DSP
    • SIL Certification, RAMS and its standards
    • Testing & trouble shooting of control systems
    • Knowledge on quality control, erection, commissioning and field maintenance of electrical/electronic/signalling systems in railway applications
    • Installation, testing & communication of Railway signalling systems such as RRI/PI/EI/Kavach etc in compliance with Railway electrical safety norms
    • Experience of working with software tools such as Matlab, Simulink, QT
    • Experience of software programming in C++, Java, .net, SQL etc
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Electrical): Minimum 2 years work experience in installation & Commissioning of any of the following:
    • Photovoltaic systems
    • Power Plant Control, Monitoring & Associated system
    • Instrumentation & PLC system
    • Power electronic system (inverters, UPS drives, rectifiers)
    • SCADA system/HVDC & Reactive power management
    • Switchyard substations
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Civil): Minimum 2 years work experience in Civil works associated with any of the following areas:
    • Solar Power Projects
    • Thermal power Projects
    • Infrastructure Projects
    • Industrial Construction Projects
    • Residential/Commercial Construction Projects
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Mechanical): Minimum 2 years work experience in Mechanical Installation works associated with any of the following areas:
    • Solar Power Projects
    • Thermal power Projects
    • Infrastructure Projects
    • Industrial Projects
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III - Safety): Minimum 2 years work experience of which 1 year experience in Industrial/Projects safety works.
  • Post qualification experience should be exclusive of Trainee/Apprenticeship Period if any.

Salary/Stipend

  • Project Engineer (FTA Gr I) - Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication/Instrumentation/Computer Science: Rs. 95,000/- per month in the first year, Rs. 1,00,000/- per month in the second year (All-inclusive Consolidated Remuneration).
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III) - Electrical/Civil/Mechanical/Safety: Rs. 45,000/- per month in the first year, Rs. 48,000/- per month in the second year (All-inclusive Consolidated Remuneration).
  • Medical Benefits: Reimbursement shall be made for premium paid for Mediclaim Policy up to Rs. 5 lakhs for Self, Spouse and dependent Children.
  • Insurance: The selected candidates shall be covered under the Group Personal Accident Policy of BHEL.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Project Engineer (FTA Gr I): Maximum 35 years
  • Project Supervisor (FTA Gr III): Maximum 32 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST candidates: 5 years (Maximum age: 40 years for Project Engineer, 37 years for Project Supervisor)

    • OBC (NCL): 13 years
    • SC/ST: 15 years

Category Application Fee

Selection Process

  • All eligible applications received will be screened with respect to the eligibility conditions.
  • Candidates fulfilling the eligibility conditions shall be called for Personal Interview.
  • In case of receipt of more number of eligible applications, shortlisting of Candidates for interview will be in the ratio of 1:10 in order of merit to the number of vacancies in each category.
  • The merit will be done based on marks secured in qualifying examination (Degree/Diploma as applicable).
  • Shortlisted candidates will be individually informed through e-mail (E-Mail ID as provided in the application form) about the Personal Interview.
  • Before joining, selected candidates will have to undergo medical examination by the Company's Authorized Medical Officer/Govt Officer in the prescribed format.
  • The appointment will be subject to meeting the health standards prescribed by the Company.
  • No relaxation in health standards is allowed.

General Information/Instructions

  • BHEL invites applications for 20 positions on Fixed Tenure basis in Solar Business Division, Bengaluru.
  • The posts are purely temporary in nature and offered on a Fixed Tenure basis for a period of initial Two Years or completion of assignment (whichever is earlier).
  • This post is not against any permanent vacancy and will not entitle the candidate for any regular/permanent employment in BHEL in future.
  • The positions of Project Engineers (FTA Gr I) shall be on PAN-India basis at user railway sites or BHEL SBD, Bengaluru as per requirement.
  • The positions of Project Supervisors (FTA Gr III) shall be at Khavda Solar Park, Gujarat.
  • Reservation for Persons with Disabilities candidates and Ex-servicemen will be in accordance with Government directives on horizontal basis.
  • Vacancies reserved for OBC Category are meant only for candidates coming under Non-Creamy Layer.
  • For positions where reservation points are not available, candidates may apply subject to meeting the general standards of eligibility and will be considered under UR category.
  • Candidates employed in Govt./Semi-Govt./Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous bodies are required to produce "No Objection Certificate" at the time of Interview.
  • Working hours shall be on shift basis as per requirement including night shift.
  • The requirement is specific to unit and no request for change in place of posting shall be entertained.
  • Company reserves the right to change the place of posting as per administrative needs.
  • BHEL reserves right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/reopen the recruitment process and increase/decrease vacancies, if the need so arises.
  • Posts indicated herein may be kept unfilled at the discretion of management.
  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only at Bengaluru and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Bengaluru shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Applications which are incomplete, not legible, without required enclosures, or received after the last date will be rejected.
  • The Candidature of applicants at all stages of selection process will be provisional and is subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Indian Nationals only need to apply.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official BHEL careers website: https://careers.bhel.in
  • Step 2: Fill the online application form with all required details carefully.
  • Step 3: Enter the particulars of the fee, if applicable.
  • Step 4: Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 236/- online through NEFT/UPI Payment (if applicable).
  • Step 5: Enter the receipt/transaction details of payment in the online Application Form.
  • Step 6: After successfully submitting the online application, print the application format which will have the unique acknowledgement number.
  • Step 7: Attach the following self-attested documents:
    • Class X (High School) certificate for Date of Birth
    • SC/ST/PwD/Ex-servicemen/EWS certificate (if applicable)
    • OBC Certificate & Self-Undertaking (if applicable)
    • Age relaxation certificate for J&K candidates (if applicable)
    • Mark Sheets of all semesters/consolidated mark sheet of Degree/Diploma
    • Pass certificate of Degree/Diploma
    • Additional qualification certificates (if any)
    • Proof of norms adopted by University/Institute to convert CGPA/OGPA/DGPA into percentage
    • Offer of Appointment/Joining Letter/Experience Certificate with First and Last Salary Slip
    • Fee receipt (wherever applicable)
  • Step 8: Send the printed application form along with all relevant self-attested documents and fee receipt by post to:

Address: Addl GM/HR, BHEL-SBD, Prof CNR Rao Circle, IISc Post, Bengaluru – 560012, Karnataka

  • Application should reach on or before 19.01.2026 (16:30 hrs) [27.01.2026 for far flung areas].
  • The envelope containing the application form should be super-scribed as "Application for Appointment as Project Engineer/Project Supervisor on Fixed Tenure Basis – [FTA Position Code]".
  • BHEL is not responsible for any postal loss/postal delay in receipt of application.
  • Candidates should provide a valid e-mail ID and keep it active for at least one year.
  • Keep tracking the website https://careers.bhel.in for updates and information.
  • Candidates called for Interview will be reimbursed second class return train fare by the shortest route.

NMPA Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

One post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay of Rs. 100000-260000 in New Mangalore Port Authority will be vacant with effect from June 1, 2026. The post is to be filled by absorption through a composite method from officers of Major Ports.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Essential):
    • Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
    • Fifteen years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking.
  • For absorption through composite method: Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust shall be eligible. The feeder post is Deputy Chief Engineer in the pay scale of Rs.80000-220000/-.

Salary/Stipend

  • Initial Scale of Pay: Rs. 100000-260000.
  • Note: The pay scale will be upgraded to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000/- after completion of three years regular service in the post, subject to fulfilling relevant conditions.

Age Limit (as on 01 June 2026)

  • There is 45 upper age limit specified for candidates applying via the absorption through composite method.
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be the date of arising of the vacancy, i.e., June 1, 2026.

Selection Process

  • The selection is by merit, for which the benchmark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports/APARs will not be below "Very Good" for the last five years (2020-2021 to 2024-2025).
  • Selection is made by the Services Selection Committee.
  • Port officials who withdraw their candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Ports for a period of two years.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only applications submitted through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) shall be accepted.
  • No application other than those submitted through OAP shall be accepted.
  • The administrative Ports are required to forward the hard copy applications with required documents (certified APARs, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance, NOC, etc.) to NMPA by January 30, 2026.
  • Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will not be considered.

How To Apply

  • Register and apply online through the 'online Application Portal' (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at `https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in` between December 16, 2025, and January 15, 2026.
  • Take a print-out of the online application form uploaded in OAP.
  • The print-out should be signed and sent through the proper channel (via the administrative Port Authority Secretary/Chairperson) along with certified copies of educational qualifications, experience, PPOs, and attested APARs for the last 5 years.
  • The envelope containing the hard copy must be superscribed "Application for the post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in New Mangalore Port Authority".
  • The hard copy must reach The Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010 before January 30, 2026.

Institutions issued before the date of interview, failing which he/she shall not be allowed to appear in interview for the reserved category. However, he/she can be treated as UR Candidate.
  6.
