(Res.) dated 30.05.2014 failing which benefits of reservation will not be given and their application shall be rejected. Certificate issued in other format will not be accepted and candidate will be treated as general category for all purpose (format enclosed).
  7. PAY & ALLOWANCES: a) ESIC has adopted Consolidated Remuneration structure for Contractual Faculty as per Headquarters Letter No. letter No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med-IV (Pt. file), dated 13.04.2022 & Z-11012/51/2022-MEDVI, dated. 08.12.2022 (updated from time to time). b) In addition to the above no other allowances like D.A, N.P.A, HRA etc. would be payable. c) No Private Practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC. d) Retirees from Central/State Govt./PSU from the equivalent posts are eligible to apply. Persons working in recognized / approved private Medical Institutions fulfilling eligibility criteria for the post may also apply.
  8. TERMS OF CONTRACT: a) Selected candidates shall be appointed purely on contractual basis for a period of one year, which may be extended for another one/two years on satisfactory performance subjected to approval of the Competent Authority. The contract would be terminated in case regular incumbent joins. b) The contractual engagement can be terminated/discontinued on either side after giving one-month notice. c) Barring serious misconduct/irregularity, continuation of the incumbent would be based on satisfactory annual appraisal and approval of the Competent Authority. Other terms and condition will be applicable as issued by competent authority from time to time. d) This being One-year contract, absence for period beyond 15 days without prior permission/approval of Competent Authority will be treated as abandonment of duty and the contract will be terminated without any notice and security deposit will be forfeited. e) The absence from work for a period of fifteen days without proper permission of the competent authority will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and automatic termination. The Medical Officers are required to mark attendance manually as well as on Aadhar Enabled Bio- metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily during scheduled working days. f) On selection, candidate has to open an SB Account in the State Bank of India (Any branches) [This is applicable to cases where SB account is not held in State Bank of India]. g) The Teaching Faculty so engaged will be required to enter into a contractual agreement for the purpose on a stamp paper of Rs.500/- h) Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of services in ESIC Hospital/Medical Institution. i) The appointment is subject to Medical Fitness. j) Official selected will be required to submit acceptance/consent letter in writing before appearing for medical examination. k) The doctors at any time found guilty of any gross misconduct or negligence of his/her duties shall be terminated without any notice or payment in lieu of notice period. l) Selected candidates have to report for joining within the date indicated in the offer of appointment to be issued after release of results, failing which the offer will be treated as cancelled. m) Official has to wear his/her own white coat with name badge during the duty hours. n) The engagement will be for a period till the joining of regular incumbent. The contract would initially be for one year, to be extended for another one year on satisfactory performance, with a minimum term of one year in respect of Teaching Faculty.
  9.  CAUTION DEPOSIT: a) He/ She will be required to deposit a Security Deposit of above mentioned amount for the post mentioned through Demand Draft in favor of ESI Corporation payable at Kalaburagi at the time of joining which is refundable after completion of contract period and production of “No Dues Certificate”. b) The Caution Deposit will be appropriated towards the ESI Fund in case the appointed candidate terminates his/her contract within six (06) months of the date of reporting towards Administrative cost. General Instructions: (i) Mere submission of application does not confer any right to the candidate to be eligible for interview unless they report on the scheduled date and time. (ii) Application should be submitted in the prescribed format only. The applications submitted in any other for- mat OR incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. (iii) The candidates may ascertain their eligibility and report for interview on the scheduled date and time for in- terview. Candidates reporting after scheduled time will not be allowed to attend the interview process. (iv) Wrong declarations/submission of false information or any other action contrary to law shall lead to cancel- lation of the candidature at any stage in addition to suitable legal action. (v) Opportunity for appearing in the interview given to the candidates is purely on provisional. Joining of the candidates will be subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility conditions/production of prescribed certificates in case of reservation. (vi) On the day of Walk-in-Interview, the candidates should produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer. (vii) Equivalent Teaching Experience Certificate issued by DGAFMS for retired Army Medical Teachers at the time of Interview. (viii) The candidates who have applied for higher post may opt for lower post during the interview in the same de - partment. (ix) The interview shall be conducted at the Office of the Dean, ESIC Medical College, Kalaburagi. However, ESIC reserves the right to change the venue and dates, if needed. (x) Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. (xi) Rules of reservation will be implemented as per Government of India’s instructions. (xii) No TA/DA will be admissible for interview or joining. (xiii) No claim for any services like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical allowances, Seniority, Promotion and Leave will be admissible. (xiv) He/She will be entitled to Earned Leave and Half Pay Leave as admissible to temporary Govern - ment servant under Central Civil Services (Leave rules), 1972.
  10. CRITERIA OF INCOME & ASSETS (For Economically Weaker Section or EWS) Persons who are not covered under the scheme of reservation for SCs, STs and OBCs and whose family has gross annual income below Rs.8.00 Lakh (Rupees Eight Lakh only) are to be identified as EWSs for the benefit of reservation. Income shall also include income from all sources i.e. salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc. for the financial year prior to the year of application. Also persons whose family owns or possesses any of the following assets shall be excluded from being identified as EWS, irrespective of the family income: - I. 5 acres of agricultural land and above; II. Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; III. Residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; IV. Residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than the notified municipalities. The property held by a “Family” in different locations or different places/cities would be clubbed while applying the land or property holding test to determine EWS status. The term “Family” for this purpose will include the person who seeks benefit or reservation, his/her parents and siblings below the age of 18 years as also his/her spouse and children below the age of 18 years.
  11. INCOME AND ASSET CERTIFICATE ISSUING AUTHORITY AND VERIFICATION OF CERTIFICATE: The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority. The Income and Asset Certificate issued by any one of the following authorities in prescribed format as given in Annexure- I shall only be accepted as proof of candidates claim as belonging to EWS: i. District Magistrate/ Additional District Magistrate/Collector/Deputy Commissioner/ Additional Deputy Commissioner/ 1st Class Stipendiary Magistrate/Sub-Divisional Magistrate/Taluka Magistrate/Executive Magistrate/Extra Assistant Commissioner. ii. Chief Presidency Magistrate/Additional Chief Presidency Magistrate/Presidency Magistrate. iii. Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar and iv. Sub-Divisional Officer or the area the candidate and/or his family normally resides.

Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 7 posts of General Manager and Deputy General Manager across various disciplines, including Signalling/Telecom, Operations, Safety, SSM, AFC/Tele, Stores, and P-Way. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official BMRCL website until 15th January 2026. After submitting the online application, candidates must send the signed print copy with supporting documents by 20th January 2026.

The salary for the General Manager position is a consolidated monthly pay of ₹2,06,250, while the Deputy General Manager position offers a consolidated pay of ₹1,64,000. For deputationists, the pay will be as per the parent department's pay structure, along with applicable allowances. To apply, candidates must hold an engineering degree in relevant disciplines (such as Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, etc.) and meet the required post-qualification experience. The age limit for General Manager posts is 55 years (Contract) and 56 years (Deputation), while for Deputy General Manager posts, it is 48 years.

  • General Manager (Operations)
    • Degree in Electrical / Mechanical / Electronics & Communication / Computer Science Engineering.
    • Post-qualification experience of 20 years in maintenance/project/operation in Railway / Modern Metro System.
    • Minimum 5 years’ experience in operation of Electric Loco / EMU / Modern Metro.
  • Deputy General Manager (Safety)
    • Engineering degree.

    • Degree in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Mechanical / Civil Engineering.

Graduate & Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2025

The Graduate & Technician (Diploma) Apprentice Recruitment 2025 at UCSL invites engineering graduates and diploma holders who passed during 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 and are seeking structured apprenticeship exposure in shipbuilding and allied engineering fields. The selection process of Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited includes shortlisting of candidates based on merit, domicile and eligibility followed by certificate verification and medical fitness assessment before engagement as apprentices. Candidates who are finally selected will undergo one year of apprenticeship training at UCSL facilities in Malpe, Karnataka.

This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical industrial experience in a central public sector environment along with monthly stipend and meals allowance as per category. Selected apprentices will work in mechanical and electrical engineering areas and will be associated with ongoing ship repair and construction related activities as per UCSL requirements.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the NATS portal https://nats.education.gov.in from 22.12.2025 to 21.01.2026 by searching for “UDUPI COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED” under advertised vacancies. There is no application fee for this apprenticeship engagement and candidates must carefully complete their NATS profiles before applying.

Graduate & Technician Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2025

Candidates willing to apply for the UCSL Graduate & Technician (Diploma) Apprentice posts must ensure that they fulfil all eligibility conditions specified in the notification. The criteria mainly cover educational qualification, age, domicile and previous apprenticeship status.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various apprentice categories are given below.

For Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Mechanical Engineering):
Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline granted by a Statutory University, by an Institution empowered by an Act of Parliament, or by professional bodies recognized by the Central/State Government as equivalent. Where universities issue grades (CGPA/OGPA/CPI etc.) without percentage, the percentage will be calculated as per the university formula or, if not defined, by multiplying aggregate grade points by 10.

For Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Electrical Engineering):
Candidates must have a Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education, or by a recognized University, or by an Institution recognized as equivalent by the Central/State Government. Candidates possessing qualifications declared equivalent must upload an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority, failing which their candidature will not be considered.

Age Limit (As on 22.12.2025)

Candidates applying for the UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025 must be above 18 years of age as on 22 December 2025. Upper age limits are governed by apprenticeship norms and Government of India rules, with reservation benefits applicable to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD as per directives.

Graduate & Technician Apprentice Selection Process 2025

The UCSL Apprentice selection is primarily based on shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by certificate verification and medical fitness. Only candidates who are domicile of Karnataka are considered, as clearly mentioned in the notification.

The UCSL apprenticeship selection process is carried out broadly in the following stages.

1. Screening & Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on the details furnished in the NATS portal such as educational qualification, marks, year of passing, and domicile criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for certificate verification, where original documents for age, qualification, percentage of marks, caste, disability etc. along with self-attested copies must be produced; failure to produce originals results in rejection.

2. Certificate Verification & Provisional Selection:
Candidates who successfully complete certificate verification are provisionally considered for selection against notified seats in the order of merit and reservation, subject to medical fitness. The final engagement is confirmed only after meeting minimum physical standards prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules 1992 and other general conditions.

Final Merit: The final merit list for apprenticeship seats is prepared based on eligibility, merit and reservation after certificate verification and medical fitness; there is no written test or interview mentioned for this notification.

How to Apply for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UCSL Graduate & Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2025 through the NATS portal only. The step-by-step application procedure differs slightly for candidates already registered in the old portal and for new users.

Step-by-Step Process:

For candidates already registered in old apprentice portal (portal.mhrdnats.gov.in):

  1. Visit https://nats.education.gov.in and go to the student login page
  2. Use the “Forgot password” option to activate your account in the new NATS portal.
  3. Login and complete your application/profile form ensuring all details are correct.
  4. After migration/activation, login again and search for “UDUPI COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED” under “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Click on “Apply”; the status will change to “applied”.

For candidates without registration in old apprentice portal:

  1. Go to https://nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Click on “Student” and then on “Student Register”.
  3. Complete the registration form; a unique enrolment number will be generated for each student.
  4. Login with the new credentials and search for “UDUPI COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED” under “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Click on “Apply”; the status will show “applied”.

For any issues related to the NATS portal, candidates can contact Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Southern Region, Chennai via email at [email protected].

Age as on Date 30/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Two Stage Selection: The selection process would involve two stages - Screening and Interview.
  • Stage 1 - Screening: Applications will be screened based on eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, and relevant experience.
  • Stage 2 - Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview on their registered email address.
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance (TA) or Dearness Allowance (DA) shall be paid for attending the interview.
  • Document Verification: At the time of interview, shortlisted candidates shall have to produce their bio data and certificates in original for verification.
  • Final Authority: The Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Karnataka & Goa, Bengaluru shall be the final authority for resolution of any dispute that may arise in course of administering the Young Professional Scheme.
  • Disqualification: Canvassing in any form shall constitute a disqualification.

General Information/Instructions

  • Contract Period: One year on full time basis. May be extended by another year subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Job Description: Young Professionals will be attached with the office of Commissioners of Income Tax (DR) and/or Senior Departmental Representatives in the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal for studying paper books of listed cases, analysing judgements relied upon by the assessee, finding out judgements in favour of the department, identifying distinguishing facts, and preparing briefing notes and written submissions. They will also undertake research/study on specific points as briefed by CIT(DR)/Sr. DR.
  • Orientation: CIT(DR) (Mentor concerned) will provide a brief orientation of deliverables expected from the Young Professional at the time of joining.
  • Leave Policy: Young Professionals shall be eligible for 8 days leave in a calendar year. The leave shall accrue on completed month basis calculated from date of joining on pro-rata basis. Un-availed leave shall not be carried forward to next calendar year. Intervening Saturdays, Sundays or Gazetted holidays during a spell of leave shall not be counted against the 8 days leave.
  • No Compensation: In the event of death, injury or illness of the Young Professional during the term of engagement, the Young Professional or dependents, legal heirs, claimant etc., shall not be entitled to any compensation.
  • Publication Restriction: Young Professional shall not publish a book or compilation of articles or participate in a broadcast involving electronic/social media or represent any entity in legal or commercial matters without previous sanction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Karnataka & Goa Region.
  • Confidentiality: Young Professional would be subject to the provisions of the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and will not divulge any information gathered either during the period of engagement or at any point of time thereafter. Young Professional shall sign a Declaration of Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement before reporting.
  • Termination: The engagement may be discontinued at any time by the Income Tax Department without assigning any reason. However, in the normal course, one month's notice will be given. Young Professional can also leave by giving one month prior notice to the mentor.
  • Automatic Termination: Absence for a continuous period of 8 days without information or any valid reason shall lead to automatic termination of engagement.
  • Sexual Harassment: The provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition & Redressal) Act, 2013, shall apply.
  • Single Application: Only one application is to be submitted by each candidate. Multiple applications from the same candidate are liable for rejection.

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online through Email
  • Step 1: Download the "Application Form" from the official website https://incometaxkarnatakagoa.gov.in/
  • Step 2: Fill the application form on computer system in MS Word format. Do not take a print and write in pen.
  • Step 3: After filling all relevant details from Sl. No. 1 to 13, take a printout of the application.
  • Step 4: Paste recent passport size photograph in the relevant box on the duly filled in printout.
  • Step 5: Fill in the details under the declaration viz., place, date, name and signature.
  • Step 6: Scan the duly filled in application and self-attested photocopies of all enclosures in a single PDF file (file size not to exceed 14 MB).
  • Step 7: Mail the PDF file (comprising the duly filled in scanned copy of application and self-attested scanned copies of supporting documents) to the email ID: [email protected]
  • Email Subject: "APPLICATION FOR YP - (Name of the candidate)"
  • Additional Requirement: While emailing the application, the MS Word version of application form shall also be mailed along with the PDF.

Reservation Policy

  • Reservation of posts is applicable as per Government of India Guidelines
  • Rules for Reservation will be implemented as per Govt. of India instructions
  • Presidential Directives on reservation will be followed
  • Seventeen Posts are horizontally reserved for PwD category in identified posts
  • Candidates appointed under PWD quota will be adjusted against vacancy of respective categories of SC/ST/OBC and UR quota

  • Candidates advised to check website regularly for any updated information

  • Candidates may contact office of Dean on email: [email protected] along with their contact number

  • Separate application form along with Demand Draft should be enclosed for multiple applications

  • Applicants belonging to UR, EWS, OBC (Non-creamy layer) & Ex-servicemen category shall be required to pay online non-refundable fee of Rs. 1,000/-.

  • The PwBD candidates have been exempted from the Application & Processing Fee.
  • The application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances (except the specified refund to Ex-servicemen as stated).

Details Date
Date of advertisement 02.01.2026
Opening date for online application 02.01.2026
Closing date for submission of online application 30.01.2026
Closing date for submission of hardcopy application 06.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Screening of online applications received may be done to restrict the number of applicants to be called for selection process. The Institute at its discretion may restrict the number of applicants to be called at any stage of the selection process.
  • List of shortlisted applicants to be called for the selection process on a given date and time will be published on the Institute website only, and such applicants may also be intimated on their registered email id.
  • The Institute may decide to conduct a selection process comprising of multiple stages of selection; details of selection process will be published along with the list of shortlisted candidates.
  • All details related to recruitment process shall be available on the Institute website only; applicants are advised to keep a regular watch on the Institute’s website.
  • Screening of applications will be done on the basis of requirements mentioned in the Recruitment Rules and as per the conditions laid down by the duly constituted Screening Committee.
  • Selection process may consist of Screening Test (only for the purpose of shortlisting of applicants), Skill Test (qualifying in nature) and Main Written Test.
  • Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for and must be fulfilling the eligibility criteria as on the closing date of online applications, failing which their application is liable for rejection at any stage.
  • Any requisite experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree will only be taken into consideration.
  • Applicants would be allowed to appear in the selection process on the basis of the information furnished by them in their application form; issuance of letter for the selection process will not confer any right for appointment.
  • If the applicants are found ineligible at any stage of recruitment process, their candidature may be cancelled and, if selected, appointment may also be cancelled. Hiding information or submitting false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage of recruitment and may invite penal action.
  • The applicants are required to apply through Online mode only. Application in any other form will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Applications which are not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures may be out rightly rejected.
  • NIT Tiruchirappalli strives to have a workforce which also reflects gender balance and hence eligible female applicants are especially encouraged to apply.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum prescribed in the advertisement and reserves the right to reject or accept the candidature of any applicant at any stage and to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement / recruitment process, if need arises, without issuing any further notice.
  • The Screening Test and Main Written Test will be conducted in the premises of the Institute. No request for change of venue / date of selection process shall be considered.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee being called for Screening Test / Main Written Test / Skill Test. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants to be called by short-listing on the basis of higher benchmark.
  • Persons serving in Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Bodies / Statutory Bodies / PSUs / PSBs should furnish a No Objection Certificate from the designated authority at the time of verification.
  • No vigilance/disciplinary cases should be pending against applicants working in any Govt./Semi-Govt./Autonomous organizations; in such cases, the application shall not be considered.
  • Original documents, along with one set of self-attested copies, must be produced at the time of certificate verification prior to skill test; without original certificates, candidature shall be rejected.
  • Applicants are advised to visit the Institute website regularly. Any addendum/corrigendum shall be published only on the Institute website; list of shortlisted applicants will be displayed only on the Institute website.
  • The Institute reserves the right not to fill up the posts and to cancel the advertisement in whole or in part, without assigning any reason.
  • Applicants should not have been convicted by any Court of Law and must be in sound health; selected candidates must be prepared to undergo medical examination before the District Medical Board and produce fitness certificate.
  • All appointments are subject to verification of academic qualifications, experience, conduct, community certificates, medical fitness and police verification; any discrepancy may lead to removal from service and legal action.
  • Applicants must carry at least one photograph-bearing Identity Proof in original (Driving Licence, Voter ID Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport) to the examination centre.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending the Screening Test / Certificate Verification / Skill Test / Main Written Test except PwD candidates, who may avail reimbursement as per Government/Institute norms.
  • All correspondence will be made by the Institute through e-mail only; no separate hard copy letters will be sent.
  • Any dispute with regard to the selection process will be subject to the jurisdiction of the appropriate court/tribunal having jurisdiction over Tiruchirappalli.
  • Applicants are warned not to furnish any false particulars or suppress material information and not to tamper with documents; such actions may result in cancellation/debarment and criminal action.

How to Apply

  • Applicants are required to apply online through SAMARTH portal (https://nittnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login) of the Institute website: www.nitt.edu from 02.01.2026 to 30.01.2026.
  • Applicants must click on the online application link, read the instructions carefully and fill in the online application form giving accurate information. If the online application is not successfully completed, the applicant is required to register again.
  • After successful submission of online application, applicants must keep a copy of the finally submitted online application, which will be required during the selection process.
  • Incomplete applications and applications received through any mode other than online will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • No request for change in any data entered by the applicant will be entertained once the online application is submitted successfully.
  • While applying online, applicants need to upload the scanned copy of their recent passport size colour photograph and signature.
  • The Institute will not be responsible for any applicant not being able to submit his/her online application within the last date on account of system error or any other reasons.
  • Application without payment of application fee will be an incomplete application and will be summarily rejected (where fee is applicable as per category).
  • Candidates have to upload the following documents at respective tabs while applying:
    • SSLC Certificate.
    • HSC Certificate.
    • ITI / Diploma / UG / PG Degree Certificate, whichever is applicable.
    • Certificate for typewriting / Shorthand / Computer skill obtained from Central/State Government Institutes such as MEITY, NIELIT, DOTE etc., for certain posts mentioned in the Recruitment Rules.

    • Recent passport size colour photograph as prescribed in the instructions.

  3. Candidates should apply online only in the website https://icsrstaff.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php - (Please check the advertisement number Advt.210/2025 displayed and submit the application for the relevant position).

  7. Candidates should not attempt to apply twice for the same post. If multiple applications are received from a candidate for the same post, the candidature will be liable to be rejected.
  8. Candidates should follow the prescribed procedure for submission of online application.
  9. Candidates are advised to fill their correct and active e-mail addresses in the online application as all correspondence will be made by the Institute through e-mail only.
  10. The candidates applying for any post should ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility conditions for the post.   11. After successful online submission of application, a printout of the application form must be obtained and submitted when called for test. It will be required at the time of document verification/test/interview. Hard copy of the application is NOT to be sent to the Institute.
  12. Candidates must be citizens of India. Persons who have migrated from Pakistan with the intention of permanently settling in India or subjects of Nepal are also eligible, but in their case a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India will be necessary for appointment.   15. The experience required is relaxable at the discretion of the Institute in the case of candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe, if at any stage of selection, the competent authority is of the opinion that sufficient number of candidates from these communities possessing the requisite experience are not likely to be available to fill up the vacancy reserved for them.
  16. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates for written / skill test / interview to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications, level and relevance of experience higher than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement and other academic achievements. The Institute also reserves the right of rejecting any or all the applications without assigning any reasons, therefore.
  17. Calling a candidate for test/interview merely indicates that it is felt that the candidate with others may be suitable for the post and conveys no assurance whatsoever that they will be recommended or selected or their conditions specified in the application will be accepted.
  18. Candidates will be short-listed for Test/Interview on the basis of the information provided by them in their online applications. They must ensure that such information is true. If at any subsequent stage or at the time of Test/Interview any information given by them or any claim made by them in their online applications is found to be false, their candidature will be liable to be rejected.
  19. The Institute shall verify the antecedents or documents submitted by a candidate at any time at the time of appointment or during the tenure of the service. In case, it is detected that the documents submitted by the candidates are fake or the candidate has clandestine antecedents/background and has suppressed the said information, then their services shall be liable to be terminated.
  20. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected at any stage even after the issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify/ withdraw/ cancel any communication made to the candidates.
  21. Applicants who are working in any one of the Project at IIT Madras, must apply through proper channel otherwise they will be required to produce No-Objection Certificate at the time of document verification/Test/Interview. Candidates without NOC will not be permitted to appear for Test/Interview.
  22. Candidates may send testimonials from persons intimately acquainted with their work and character. If the applicant is in employment, the candidate should submit testimonials from the most recent employer or immediate superior as a referee.
  23. The Institute has a right to decide the mode of screening and testing the applicant for short listing and selection.
  24. The Institute solely reserves the right not to fill any advertised position without assigning any reason
  25. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
  26. No correspondence whatsoever will be entertained from candidates regarding conduct and result of test/interview and reasons for not being called for interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  27. The crucial date for determining the eligibility criteria for all candidates in every respect shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of online application.
  28. The Institute strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.
  29. Any corrigendum/clarifications on this advertisement, if necessary, shall be uploaded on website and no separate communication will be sent for this purpose.
  30. If there is any issue to submit the application please send E-mail to : [email protected] / [email protected] Contact: 044- 2257 9796 on all working days from 9.00 AM to 05.30 PM (Monday to Friday – except National Holidays). (Please note, only technical issues will be accepted – No interim correspondence with reference to the selection process will be considered).

How to Apply

Name of the Post Pay Level as per Seventh CPC [equivalent PB & GP in Sixth CPC] Total
Superintendent Pay Level 6 [PB-2 & GP 4200/-] 4

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential qualification, Desirable qualifications, age and experience for the post of Superintendent are as per Recruitment Rules (2019) for Non-teaching staff in NITs notified vide No.F.35-5/2018-TS.III of MHRD’s letters dated 20.02.2019 and 04.04.2019.
  • Any requisite experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree will only be taken into consideration.

Salary / Stipend

  • The post of Superintendent carries Pay Level 6 [PB-2 & GP 4200/-] as per Seventh CPC [equivalent PB & GP in Sixth CPC].

Age Limit 

  • Maximum age limit shall be as per Recruitment Rules.
  • Age limit and other eligibility conditions for all the positions shall be determined on the last date of submission of online application, i.e., 30.01.2026.
  • Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen applicants shall be applicable as per Government of India norms.
  • SC/ST: 5 years age relaxation beyond the upper age limit.
  • OBC (NCL): 3 years age relaxation beyond the upper age limit.
  • PwD (UR): 10 years age relaxation beyond the upper age limit.
  • PwD + OBC (NCL): 13 years age relaxation beyond the upper age limit.
  • PwD + SC/ST: 15 years age relaxation beyond the upper age limit.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Age relaxation up to the extent of service rendered in Defence forces (Army, Navy & Airforce) plus 3 years, subject to production of required certificate.
  • Departmental candidates with three years continuous service in Central Government: 5 years age relaxation (additional to other applicable cases) for eligible Central Government / Autonomous / PSU / Centrally Funded Research Institute employees.
  • Regular staff of NIT Tiruchirappalli appointed before 2012 are allowed to participate in the selection process irrespective of age and percentage of marks, as per No.F.35-5/2018-TS.III dated 20th February 2019 – point 4.b.(iii).

Application Fee

  • UR, EWS, OBC (Non-creamy layer) & Ex-servicemen: Rs. 1,000/- (non-refundable); however, Rs. 500/- shall be refunded to Ex-servicemen candidates subject to appearing for the Screening Test.
  • SC/ST/Women applicants: Rs. 500/- towards online application.
  • PwBD candidates: Exempted from Application & Processing Fee.
  • The application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances (except the specified refund condition for Ex-servicemen).

Important Dates

Details Date
Date of advertisement 02.01.2026
Opening date for online application 02.01.2026
Closing date for submission of online application 30.01.2026
Closing date for submission of hardcopy of the applications 06.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Screening of online applications may be done to restrict the number of applicants to be called for the selection process.
  • The Institute may conduct a selection process comprising multiple stages of selection.
  • Selection process may consist of Screening Test (only for the purpose of shortlisting of applicants), Skill Test (qualifying in nature) and Main Written Test.
  • List of shortlisted applicants to be called for the selection process will be published on the Institute website and may also be intimated on registered email ID; no hard copy communication will be issued.
  • Screening of applications will be done on the basis of requirements mentioned in the Recruitment Rules and as per conditions laid down by the duly constituted Screening Committee.
  • Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.
  • Request for change in examination centres will not be entertained at any stage of the recruitment process.

General Information / Instructions

  • Applicants must satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for and must be fulfilling the eligibility criteria as on the closing date of online applications; failing this, their application is liable for rejection at any stage.
  • Applicants would be allowed to appear in the selection process based on information furnished in the application form; if found ineligible at any stage, candidature may be cancelled and, if selected, appointment may be cancelled.
  • Hiding information or submitting false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage and removal from service with possible penal action.
  • The Institute will retain data of online applications received for non-shortlisted applicants only for three months after completion of recruitment process.
  • Applications must be submitted through Online mode only; applications in any other form will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • Incomplete applications or applications without relevant supporting enclosures may be rejected without correspondence.
  • NIT Tiruchirappalli strives to have a workforce reflecting gender balance and eligible female applicants are especially encouraged to apply.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum prescribed in the advertisement and its decisions on recruitment shall be final and binding.
  • Institute reserves the right to reject or accept candidature at any stage and to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement or recruitment process without notice.
  • The Screening Test / Skill Test / Main Written Test will be conducted in the premises of NIT Tiruchirappalli only; no request for change of venue/date will be considered.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee being called for Screening Test / Main Written Test / Skill Test.
  • Persons serving in Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Bodies / Statutory Bodies / PSUs / PSBs must furnish a No Objection Certificate at the time of verification.
  • No vigilance/disciplinary cases should be pending against applicants working in any Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Organizations.
  • Original documents with one set of self-attested copies must be produced at the time of certificate verification prior to skill test; without originals, candidature shall be rejected.
  • Applicants are advised to visit the Institute website http://www.nitt.edu regularly for addendum/corrigendum and lists of shortlisted applicants; no separate communication will be issued.
  • The Institute reserves the right not to fill the posts and to cancel the advertisement in whole or in part.
  • Applicants should not have been convicted by any Court of Law.
  • Applicants must be in sound health and, if selected, be prepared to undergo medical examination and produce fitness certificate from the District Medical Board.
  • All appointments are subject to verification of academic qualifications, experience, conduct, community certificates, medical fitness and police verification.
  • Photograph must be recent (not earlier than three months from the date of application) colour passport size with clear front view without cap, scarf or sunglasses; identical extra photograph should be kept for verification.
  • Applicants must carry an original photo identity proof (Driving Licence, Voter ID Card, Aadhaar Card or Passport) to the examination centre.
  • No educational qualification shall be considered unless supported by Degree/Provisional Degree Certificate along with mark sheets; grade card/mark sheet alone will not be treated as proof of degree.
  • Selected candidates will be covered under the New Pension System as notified by Government of India, Ministry of Finance vide notification No.5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22nd December 2003.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending Screening test / Certificate Verification / Skill Test / Main Written Test, except PwD candidates who may avail reimbursement as per norms.
  • All correspondence will be made through e-mail only; schedule and details of selection process will be published on the Institute website.
  • Any dispute with regard to the selection process will be subject to court/tribunal having jurisdiction over Tiruchirappalli.
  • No correspondence will be entertained from not-shortlisted candidates.
  • Applicants are warned not to furnish false particulars or suppress material information, or tamper with documents; such actions may lead to cancellation/debarment and other actions listed in the notification.

How to Apply

  • Applicants are required to apply online through SAMARTH portal (https://nittnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login) of the Institute website www.nitt.edu from 02.01.2026 to 30.01.2026.
  • Applicants should click on the online application link, read the instructions carefully and fill in the online application form with accurate information.
  • If the online application is not successfully completed, the applicant is required to register again.
  • After successful submission of online application, applicants must keep a copy of the finally submitted online application for production during the selection process.
  • Incomplete applications or applications received through any mode other than online will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • No request for change in any data entered will be entertained once the online application is submitted successfully.
  • Applicants need to upload scanned copy of recent passport size colour photograph and signature while applying online.
  • Applicants called for selection process must produce original certificates, a copy of the same photo and other relevant documents as mentioned in the online application form.
  • The Institute will not be responsible if an applicant is unable to submit the online application within the last date due to system error or other reasons.
  • Application without payment of application fee will be incomplete and summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must upload the following documents: SSLC Certificate; HSC Certificate; ITI / Diploma / UG / PG Degree Certificate (whichever is applicable); Certificate for typewriting / Shorthand / Computer skill from specified Government institutes for certain posts as per RR; Community Certificate (if applicable); recent passport size colour photograph; scanned copy of signature.

  • Project scientist (Team Lead) Essential Qualification: Knowledge in Drone Rules and Regulations. Must have experience in leading Drone related Projects / heading a related organisation. Technical Management and Networking capability. Outstanding organizational and time management skills. Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills. Great communication and presentation skills. Problem-solving mindset. Have to be flexible with Timings and Various Field Conditions. Able to Adapt and Lead the Team under Various Circumstances.
  • Project scientist (Team Lead) Desired Qualification: Should have previous experience in BVLOS Projects. Preferably retired DGCA / Defence Sector professionals. DGCA Remote Pilot Instructor (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Associate- II (Technical Research & UAV Systems Engineer) Qualification: M.E./M.Tech or Ph.D. in Mechanical / Production / Aerospace / Applied Mechanics / Equivalent with 2+ years' experience. Or BE EEE/ECE Mechanical / Production / Aerospace / Aeronautical / Applied Mechanics / Equivalent with 4+ years' experience.
  • Project Associate- II (Technical Research & UAV Systems Engineer) Essential Qualification: Strong background in CAD/CAE, CFD, Thermal & Aerodynamic Analysis. Experience in engineering design, testing and analysis. Ability to prepare technical reports, SOPs, manuals and support BVLOS documentation. Excellent organization, academic writing, and technical presentation skills. Experience in training/teaching engineering subjects and developing technical content. Ability to support project coordination, data analysis, and multi-disciplinary tasks. Flexible with timings and field conditions.
  • Project Associate- II (Technical Research & UAV Systems Engineer) Desired Qualification: Prior exposure to UAV systems, aerodynamic studies or relevant simulation work. Familiarity with DGCA Drone Rules / UAV operations. Experience supporting large technical projects, workshops or research activities. DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Associate II (UAV System Engineer) Qualification: M.E/MS (Engg) Navigation / Avionics / Aerospace/ Aeronautical/ Electrical / Electronics / Communication engineering / Equivalent with 2+ years' experience Or BE EEE/ECE/Communication/CSE/Aero/Navigation / Equivalent with 4+ years' experience.
  • Project Associate II (UAV System Engineer) Essential Qualification: Must Have Vast Knowledge and Experience in UAV Control Systems. Must have wide Knowledge about the Current UAV Technologies. Must have Keen Knowledge about UAV Navigation, Guidance and Control. Must Have Wide Knowledge about UAV Communication Systems. Knowledge and Experience in UAV Operation Field co-ordination. Should have Knowledge in UAV avionics and Communication systems. Have to be flexible with Timings and Various Field Conditions.
  • Project Associate II (BVLOS Flight Operations & Field Testing Engineer) Qualification: M.E./M.Tech in Aerospace / Aeronautical / Avionics / Electronics & Communication / Electrical & Electronics / Instrumentation / Equivalent with 2+ years' experience Or BE in Aerospace / Aeronautical / Avionics / Electronics & Communication / Electrical & Electronics / Instrumentation / Equivalent with 4+ years' experience.
  • Project Associate II (BVLOS Flight Operations & Field Testing Engineer) Essential Qualification: Strong understanding of UAV systems, sensors, flight controllers, and communication links. Hands-on experience in field testing, flight trials, and test data collection. Ability to assist in BVLOS trial planning, range setup, safety procedures, and field coordination. Familiarity with Drone Rules 2021, UAS classifications, and DGCA operational requirements. Good skills in documentation, logs, checklists, and test reporting. Capable of working in outdoor, time-sensitive, and multi-agency environments.
  • Project Associate II (BVLOS Flight Operations & Field Testing Engineer) Desired Qualification: Experience with BVLOS or long-range UAV operations, GCS handling, telemetry, or RF systems. Exposure to risk assessment, safety management, or regulatory compliance activities. DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Associate II (Aerospace Structures Engineer) Qualification: ME/MS (Engg) Aerospace /Aerospace Structures /Avionics/ Aeronautical / Mechanical with 2+ Years' Experience Or BE Aerospace /Aerospace Structures / Aeronautical / Mechanical / CAD-CAM with 4+ Years' Experience.
  • Project Associate II (Aerospace Structures Engineer) Essential Qualification: Must Have Vast Knowledge in Aerospace Structures. Must have knowledge and experience on documentation handling. Must Have Knowledge and Experience in Structural Testing and Analysis. Must Have Knowledge in analysis Tools. Must Have Knowledge in Design Software's. Knowledge in 3D Printing, CNC Machining and Foam cutting. Have to be flexible with Timings and Various Field Conditions. DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Associate II (Communication Engineer) Qualification: B.E/BTech ECE/EEE/CSE/IT/ Equivalent with 2 years' Experience Or M.E/MS (Engg) Navigation /Avionics / Aerospace/ Electrical / Electronics / Communication engineering / Equivalent.
  • Project Associate II (Communication Engineer) Essential Qualification: Knowledge and Experience in RF Communication. Knowledge in Digital Electronics. Knowledge in Drone Avionics Components. Knowledge in Anti-Drone Technologies. Knowledge in programming Arduino and Embedded Systems. Knowledge in UAV Flight Controllers. Have to be flexible with Timings and Various Field Conditions. DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Associate II (GCS Software & BVLOS Systems Engineer) Qualification: B.E/BTech ECE/EEE/CSE/IT/ Equivalent.
  • Project Associate II (GCS Software & BVLOS Systems Engineer) Essential Qualification: Knowledge in Ground Control Station (GCS) software development for UAV operations. Experience with API development and integration for telemetry, tracking, and command systems. Understanding of BVLOS communication architecture, data links, and control protocols. Proficiency in Python, C/C++, and scripting for automation and tool development. Knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, SQL for dashboard/UI backend integration. Familiarity with mission planning tools, telemetry parsing, and real-time data visualisation. Ability to support simulation environment setup (SITL/HTTL). Flexibility to work in field conditions, trial sites, and varying operational timelines. DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Associate I (Drone Pilot – BVLOS Operations) Qualification: B.E / B-Tech Aero / Mech / ECE / EEE / Equivalent.
  • Project Associate I (Drone Pilot – BVLOS Operations) Essential Qualification: Hands-on experience in multirotor/fixed-wing drone flying, including mission execution. Knowledge in drone assembly, integration, fault diagnosis, and field troubleshooting. Proficiency in GCS operation, mission planning, telemetry monitoring, and failsafe handling. Experience in drone maintenance, pre-flight/post-flight checks, and log documentation. Must hold a valid DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any applicable class). Awareness of current UAV technologies, payloads, regulatory updates, and field practices. Ability to support BVLOS trial activities, range setup, and field operations under varying conditions. DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (any category / class) preferred but not mandatory.
  • Project Technician Qualification: Any Diploma/Degree.
  • Project Technician Essential Qualification: Basic knowledge of drone components, wiring, and assembly procedures. Ability to assist in routine maintenance, field checks, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with battery handling, charging protocols, and safety practices. Ability to support field operations, range setup, and trial preparations. Willingness to work in outdoor conditions, variable timings, and field environments. Capability to maintain logs, inventories, and equipment records.
  • Office Assistant Qualification: 10th / 12th Pass / Diploma.
  • Office Assistant Essential Qualification: Basic knowledge of Computer Operations. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Familiarity with email handling, data entry, and file management. Basic knowledge of office equipment (printer, scanner, photocopier). Should be able to travel with the team if required. Able to adapt multitasking.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Project Associate- II (Technical Research & UAV Systems Engineer): Rs.25,000 - Rs.60,000
  • Project Associate II (UAV System Engineer): Rs.25,000 - Rs.60,000
  • Project Associate II (BVLOS Flight Operations & Field Testing Engineer): Rs.25,000 - Rs.60,000
  • Project Associate II (Aerospace Structures Engineer): Rs.25,000 - Rs.60,000
  • Project Associate II (Communication Engineer): Rs.25,000 - Rs.60,000
  • Project Associate II (GCS Software & BVLOS Systems Engineer): Rs.25,000 - Rs.60,000
  • Project Associate I (Drone Pilot – BVLOS Operations): Rs.20,000 - Rs.35,000
  • Project Technician: Rs.15,000 - Rs.25,000
  • Office Assistant: Rs.12,000 - Rs.24,000

Important Dates

Notification Date 24 December 2025
Last Date for Submission of Application 10 January 2026

Selection Process

  • The shortlisted candidates will have the field evaluation round prior to the personal & technical interview.
  • The dates and venue for the field evaluation will be intimated over phone/ mail.
  • The selection criteria are as per the guidelines of Anna University, Chennai.

General Information / Instructions

  • The Candidate should be ready to work without time constrains.
  • Selected candidates are encouraged to pursue M.S (by Research)/ Ph.d (by Research) while working.
  • Application should reach us on or before the specified date (10.01.2026)
  • Candidates attending the interview will do so at their own expense.
  • The appointment is purely temporary.
  • If a candidate attending the interview is found suitable for a designation other than the one applied for, he/she may be considered and appointed to a different position, as deemed appropriate by the selection committee.

How to Apply

  • Eligible candidates should submit their CV’s on or before 10 January 2026 to the following address through post.
  • Also, the scanned copies of the application may be sent to the below mentioned E-mail id.
  • The Director, Centre for Aerospace Research MIT Campus, Anna University, Chennai – 600 044. E-mail: dirAnna [email protected], Anna [email protected]
  • Application form should be neatly typed or handwritten in CAPITAL LETTERS.
  • Enclose attested photocopies of relevant certificates/proofs wherever necessary.

CCUHM Various Health Posts Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Chennai City Urban Health Mission, Greater Chennai Corporation (CCUHM)
Post Name Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, MPHW/Health Inspector, Support Staff

Salary Rs. 8,500 - Rs. 60,000 Per Month

Designation Total Posts Consolidated Pay Per Month (Rs.)
Medical Officer 14 Rs. 60,000/-
Staff Nurse 10 Rs. 18,000/-
MPHW/Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Health Inspector-Grade-II) - Male 20 Rs. 14,000/-
Support Staff 40 Rs. 8,500/-
Total Vacancies 84 Posts

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Medical Officer (14 Posts): MBBS Degree awarded by a University or Institution recognized by the UGC for the purpose of its grants. The courses must have been approved by the Medical Council of India/NMC. Should have registered in Tamil Nadu Medical Council.
  • Staff Nurse (10 Posts): Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (DGNM) or B.Sc., Nursing from the Institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council.
  • MPHW/Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Health Inspector-Grade-II) - Male (20 Posts):
    • Must have passed plus two with Biology or Botany and Zoology
    • Must have passed Tamil language as a subject in SSLC level
    • Must possess two years for Multipurpose Health worker (male) / Health Inspector / Sanitary Inspector course training offered by recognized private institution / Trust / Universities / Deemed Universities including Gandhigram Rural Institute Training course certificate granted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine
  • Support Staff (40 Posts): Should have studied minimum 8th Standard. Must be able to read and write.

Essential Qualifications

  • For Medical Officer: Valid MBBS degree with Tamil Nadu Medical Council registration is mandatory
  • For Staff Nurse: DGNM or B.Sc. Nursing with Indian Nursing Council recognition required
  • For MPHW/Health Inspector: Plus Two with Biology subjects and 2-year MPHW training certificate from recognized institutions
  • For Support Staff: Minimum 8th standard education with reading and writing ability
  • Tamil language proficiency required for applicable posts

Desirable

  • Work experience in COVID-19 pandemic activities (Certificate required)
  • Working experience in any Healthcare Institution (Certificate required)
  • Character and conduct certificates from competent authorities
  • For foreign MBBS graduates: Foreign Medical Graduate Examination mark sheet issued by National Board of Examinations (NBE)

Experience

  • COVID-19 pandemic work experience preferred (Certificate to be enclosed if applicable)
  • Healthcare institution working experience considered as desirable
  • Experience certificates must be submitted from appropriate authority as per Government Orders

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Officer: Rs. 60,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Staff Nurse: Rs. 18,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • MPHW/Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Health Inspector-Grade-II) - Male: Rs. 14,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Support Staff: Rs. 8,500/- per month (Consolidated)
  • All salaries are consolidated amounts paid on a monthly basis
  • Payment will be made during the contractual period

Age Limit

  • Medical Officer: Below 40 Years
  • Staff Nurse: Below 50 Years
  • MPHW/Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Health Inspector-Grade-II) - Male: Below 35 Years
  • Support Staff: Below 45 Years
  • Age will be calculated as per the norms specified by the department

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the notification
  • Application is free for all candidates

Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date for Application Submission 09 January 2026 till 5:00 PM
Mode of Submission By Postal Service or In-Person

Selection Process

  • Candidates will be selected based on the scoring criteria described in the Government Orders for selection of Human Resource for Urban Health and Wellness Centres
  • Screening will be given based on required documents submitted with the application
  • Selection criteria will be as per Government Orders
  • Document verification will be conducted for shortlisted candidates
  • Selected candidates need to enter into an agreement with Chennai City Urban Health Mission

General Information/Instructions

  • Place of work will be in Greater Chennai Corporation limits
  • Contract Period is for 11 months only and it is purely on temporary basis
  • The candidate shall not claim any rights for permanency in the contractual job
  • The employer is Chennai City Urban Health Mission
  • The Chennai City Urban Health Mission Administration reserves the right not to specify any reason for such termination
  • Applications received beyond last date and time will not be entertained
  • Complete application in prescribed format with relevant certificates must be submitted
  • All documents must be self-attested photocopies
  • One recent passport size photograph must be attached
  • Certificate of Character and conduct should be recent (issued within 3 months prior to notification)
  • Character certificate from both Government Officer and Head of Institution required
  • Differently-abled persons must submit fitness certificate from Zonal Health Officer – GCC / Block Medical Officer
  • Tamil language eligibility must be proved through 10th or 12th standard mark sheet
  • Community certificate from Revenue Department or Competent Authority required
  • Proof of residency mandatory (any one: Nativity Certificate, Voter ID, Tax receipt, Aadhar Card, Ration Card)
  • Location-wise vacancy details are provided in Annexure-1 of the notification

How to Apply

  • Download the application format from the official website: www.chennaicorporation.gov.in
  • Fill the application form completely with all required details
  • Attach the following self-attested document photocopies:
    • One recent passport size photograph
    • Evidence of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC certificate)
    • Evidence for Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard mark sheet)
    • Community Certificate issued by Revenue Department / Competent Authority
    • Proof of residency (Nativity Certificate/Voter ID/Tax receipt/Aadhar/Ration Card)
    • Educational qualification certificates (10th, 12th, Degree/Diploma mark sheets)
    • Professional registration certificates (Medical Council/Nursing Council as applicable)
    • MPHW training certificate (for Health Inspector post)
    • Character and conduct certificates from Government Officer and Head of Institution
    • Disability certificate (if applicable)
    • COVID work experience certificate (if applicable)
    • Healthcare institution experience certificate (if applicable)
    • No objection certificate from competent authority (if applicable)
  • Submit completed application either by Postal Service or In-Person to:
  • Address: Member Secretary, CCUHM / City Health Officer, Public Health Department, 3rd Floor, Amma Maligai Greater Chennai Corporation, Ripon Buildings, Chennai – 600003
  • Last Date: 09/01/2026 till 5:00 PM
  • Applications received beyond the last date and time will not be entertained
  • For further details, contact: City Health Officer, Public Health Department, Ripon Buildings, Chennai – 600003
  • Phone: 044-2561 9330, 044-2561 9209 (during office hours on working days)

Security Guard W-3 30 UR – 15, EWS – 2, OBC(NCL) – 8, SC – 5 (ST candidates can apply against UR vacancies and will be considered under general standard of merit without age relaxation).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must have served in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force, holding the rank of Havildar / Petty Officer / Sergeant or below ranks in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force respectively, before discharge.
  • Candidates must possess minimum educational qualification of Pass in X Std. / SSLC / Matriculation from a recognized Board.
  • Candidates should have worked in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force for at least 15 years as on the crucial date and should also have registered with the District Sainik Welfare Board as on the crucial date.
  • Only those candidates whose Performance Rating is at least ‘Very Good’ and Medical Category is “AYE” or “SHAPE – I” on retirement, as mentioned in the Discharge certificate/Book from Indian Armed Forces, are eligible to apply.
  • Desirable qualifications include proficiency in reading, writing and speaking the local language (Tamil) and knowledge of playing band instruments in the Armed Forces.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have acquired the notified qualification from appropriate statutory authority in India are eligible to apply.

Salary/Stipend

  • The pay scale for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade is ₹ 20,000 – 81,000.
  • The approximate Cost to Company (CTC) per annum is ₹ 5.47 lakhs.
  • In addition to the CTC, selected candidates will be eligible for Unified Incentive Scheme (annually) as per rules.
  • Medical treatment for self and dependents and Group Insurance will be provided as per company rules.
  • Eligible type of unfurnished residential accommodation will be provided at standard rent in Company Townships, subject to availability.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Upper age limit for Security Guard (W-3) as on 01/12/2025: UR – 43 years, EWS – 43 years, OBC(NCL) – 46 years, SC – 48 years, ST – 43 years.
  • Age relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and SC candidates is as per Government of India guidelines and is applicable only when valid caste certificates are uploaded at the time of registration.
  • Candidates belonging to ST category can apply against UR vacancies and will be considered under general standard of merit without age relaxation.
  • OBC(NCL)/SC/ST candidates applying against UR vacancies will be considered under general standard of merit and no age relaxation will be extended.

Application Fee

  • Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Ex-servicemen candidates are required to pay a non-refundable amount of INR 236/- (inclusive of 18% GST) towards processing fee.
  • Payment of processing fee must be made through the prescribed online mode within the time limits specified in the important dates section.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Opening of Online registration of application 22/12/2025 at 10:00 Hrs
Closing of Online registration of application 20/01/2026 at 17:00 Hrs
Last Date for Online payment of Fees 20/01/2026 at 23:45 Hrs
Last date for Online submission of application for candidates already registered and paid fees within time limit 21/01/2026 at 17:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Only candidates who produce all necessary original documents and are found eligible during document verification will be allowed to attend the further selection process (Written Test & Physical Test).
  • Selection will be based on Written Test (100 marks – 70% weightage), Service Weightage and Performance Rating (20 marks – 15% weightage) and Physical Test (30 marks – 15% weightage).
  • The Written Test will be for 100 marks with three parts: Part-I (40 questions of General Awareness), Part-II (30 questions of Quantitative Aptitude) and Part-III (30 questions of Logical Reasoning), comprising 100 objective type questions with equal marks and no negative marking; duration is 120 minutes and the question paper will be in English language only.
  • Service Weightage is awarded based on years of service: above 20 years – 10 marks; above 18 years and up to 20 years – 8 marks; above 15 years and up to 18 years – 5 marks; Performance Rating based on entry in Discharge Book: Excellent/Outstanding – 10 marks, Very Good – 8 marks (maximum 20 marks).
  • Physical Test consists of Walk/Run (1.6 kms), Sit-up and Push-up, each graded as Excellent, Good and Pass with marks 10, 7 and 5 respectively, for a maximum total of 30 marks; candidates must pass all three tests to be considered for final selection.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are 50 out of 100 for UR/EWS candidates and 40 out of 100 for SC/OBC(NCL) candidates against reserved posts; only those who secure minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are eligible for Physical Test.
  • Project Affected Persons (PAPs) of NLCIL Neyveli Projects will be allowed 20 bonus marks in the Written Test, limited to one beneficiary per award, subject to prescribed conditions and supporting documents.
  • Final selection will be in order of merit based on total marks in Written Test, Service Weightage & Performance Rating and Physical Test, subject to candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in each component and meeting category-wise requirements; tie cases will be resolved first by date of birth (elder candidates placed higher) and then by alphabetical order of first name.

General Information/Instructions

  • NLC India Limited is a premier ‘NAVRATNA’ Government of India Enterprise, and applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade for NLCIL Neyveli Units.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have passed the notified qualification are eligible to apply, and the notified qualification must have been acquired from appropriate statutory authority in India.
  • NLCIL reserves the right not to fill up any or all posts notified and vacancies may be increased or decreased depending upon organizational requirements.
  • Candidates permitted to appear for the Written Test are eligible for reimbursement of to and fro travelling expenses to the extent of sleeper class rail fare by shortest route, on production of travel proof including reservation and tatkal charges, if any.
  • Candidates removed, terminated or who deserted their employment from any organisation will not be considered; persons already resigned from NLCIL may apply if they fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Scrutiny of applications and shortlisting will be based solely on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of online application; failure to upload legible and complete documents may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement or related to applications can be instituted only in Chennai, and the jurisdiction will be courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai.
  • NLCIL’s Appointing Authority’s decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, selection, posting and related issues will be final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Candidates should apply only through online mode in NLC India Limited website www.nlcindia.in.
  • Before registering or applying online, candidates should ensure that they have a mobile number and valid, active personal email ID and keep them active for the entire selection process, as all communications will be sent via SMS/email.
  • Candidates have to upload required scanned copies of documents/certificates in prescribed format to establish their eligibility; applications without required documents are liable for rejection.
  • Candidates should submit only a single application for the post; in case of multiple applications, the last registered application will be considered.
  • After uploading required documents, candidates should submit their application online, take a printout of the registration-cum-application form and produce it along with self-attested copies of certificates/documents at the time of document verification.
  • No manual or paper applications will be entertained and candidates should not send hard copies to NLCIL.

NLC India Limited (NLCIL), a prestigious 'NAVRATNA' Public Sector Enterprise under the Government of India, is inviting applications for the engagement of Airport Director (E6 grade) on a Fixed Term Employment (FTE) basis for its airport at Neyveli, Tamil Nadu (Advt. No. 10/2025). As a leading organization in energy and mining sectors, NLCIL is seeking experienced professionals to manage airport operations, ensuring compliance with aviation standards and statutory requirements. This opportunity is for one unreserved vacancy, offering a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 90,000/-, along with benefits like Provident Fund, Gratuity, medical facilities, leave entitlements, TA/DA for official tours, and accommodation or House Rent Allowance subject to availability.

The role requires candidates with a full-time or part-time degree (minimum 3 years duration) including Maths or Physics as a subject, coupled with at least 10 years of post-qualification experience in the Aviation Industry—specifically a minimum of 5 continuous years in Airport Operations, Air Traffic Services, or DGCA Licensing related works. Applicants should have served in E6 or equivalent grade or as a Commissioned Officer in defense, with proficiency in English and Tamil, working knowledge of Hindi, and willingness to travel for liaison with authorities like DGCA, BCAS, and IMD. The upper age limit is 62 years as on 01/12/2025, with the engagement period fixed at two years from the date of joining, and selection based on Personal Interview.

Selection Process

  • The Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts) comprises of two stages: Written Examination and Interview
  • Candidates shall be admitted to the written examination based on the claims made in the online application
  • Onscreen certificate verification will be conducted before admission to the physical certificate verification and interview
  • Candidates will be admitted to onscreen certificate verification in the ratio of 1:3/1:4 (posts not requiring experience) and 1:10 (posts requiring experience)
  • After onscreen certificate verification, based on the marks obtained in the written examination and subject to the rule of reservation of appointments, candidates shall be admitted to physical certificate verification and interview
  • The objective of the Interview is to assess the suitability of the candidate for the post by judging the candidate's personality, bearing, aptitude, general knowledge, technical knowledge etc.
  • Marks obtained by the candidates in the Written Examination (Part B and Part C of Paper I and Paper II) and Interview would determine final ranking
  • Appearance in Paper I, Paper II and the Interview is compulsory

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of vacancies and distribution of vacancies are tentative and liable for modification before the publication of results
  • The Commission reserves the right to include additional posts with different nomenclature and having similar eligibility conditions
  • Candidates should possess adequate knowledge in Tamil on the date of notification
  • Candidates not belonging to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s, and BCMs, who have put in 5 years or more of service are not eligible to apply (except for posts requiring experience and Accounts Officer Class-III)
  • Persons with benchmark disabilities are not eligible for Deputy Manager (Mechanical), Deputy Manager (Electrical), and Deputy Manager (Materials) posts
  • Candidates selected for appointment will be required to submit a certificate of physical fitness to the Appointing Authority at the time of joining
  • The admission to all stages of examination will be purely provisional, subject to satisfying eligibility conditions
  • The Commission reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage after due process
  • All recruitments by TNPSC are purely merit-based
  • Candidates are solely responsible for their claims in the online application
  • Mobile phones, pagers, electronic equipment, programmable devices, or any banned items are not allowed in the examination hall

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates are required to apply online using the Commission's website www.tnpscexams.in
  • Step 2: Register at the One Time Registration (OTR) platform by paying Rs. 150 as registration fee (valid for five years). If already registered, proceed to fill online application
  • Step 3: Fill in the online form with all relevant correct details. Choose the subject paper(s) in which you have obtained educational qualification
  • Step 4: Upload recent colour photograph (20KB-50KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) and signature (10KB-20KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) as per specifications
  • Step 5: Upload all required documents including educational certificates, community certificate (if applicable), experience certificates (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), and other supporting documents
  • Step 6: Choose two district centres as preference for Written Examination (candidates with benchmark disability can choose only one)
  • Step 7: Pay examination fee of Rs. 200 through online mode (Net Banking/Credit card/Debit card/UPI) unless exemption is claimed
  • Step 8: Preview the application carefully and make necessary corrections if required

Desirable: Degree in Pharmacy and experience in dispensing and/or storage and dispensing of drugs in a reputed hospital/Institution or pharmaceutical concern.

  • Junior Photographer (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma in Photography from a recognized Institute; two years’ experience in Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital OR Matriculation and five years’ experience in Medical Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science; Dental Mechanic course of two years duration from a recognized Dental Institution approved by Dental Council of India. Desirable: Two years’ experience as Dental Mechanic; special training/experience in crown and bridge chrome cobalt, myofunctional orthodontic appliances.
  • Hand Prosthesis Technician (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; Diploma from I.T.I. or equivalent in trade of turner, fitter or metal worker with five years’ experience in making and fitting splints, braces or appliances for disabled people.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma or certificate in Radiography of minimum one year duration from a recognized Institution. Desirable: One year’s experience as Dark Room Assistant in a hospital.
  • Animal Keeper (Level-2; Age 18–30 years): Matric with Science and two years’ experience in breeding and keeping of animals preferably in a medical or research Institution.
  • CSR Assistant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science and certificate course of Operation Theatre Assistant of one year duration from this Institute. Desirable: Diploma in Operation Theatre Techniques.
  • Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant) (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric/10th Standard with ITI certificate in the respective trade OR Matric with trade certificate from a recognized Institute/Board/authority with five years’ experience in the trade where ITI certificate is not available.

Desirable: Three years’ service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.
