  • Blood Transfusion Officer: Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Store Keeper and all Junior Engineer posts: Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II, Receptionist, Sanitary Inspector Grade-II, Junior Photographer: Level-5 (Rs. 29,200 – 92,300/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II and Hand Prosthesis Technician: Level-4 (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III, Animal Keeper, CSR Assistant Grade-II, Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant), Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade, Laboratory Attendant Grade-II: Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) and Security Guard Grade-II: Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 – 56,900/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.

Age Limit 

  • For Blood Transfusion Officer: 18–35 years.
  • For all other advertised posts: 18–30 years.
  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the last date of submission of online application form i.e. 16.02.2026.
  • Permissible relaxations in upper age limit for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Central Govt. Civilian Employees, Ex-Servicemen, Widows/Divorced women/women judicially separated and not remarried, candidates domiciled in J&K, Defence personnel disabled, Service Clerks and permanent employees of PGIMER are as per detailed table in the guidelines.

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • SC/ST category candidates: Rs. 800/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • All others including General/OBC/EWS candidates: Rs. 1500/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • Application fee is to be deposited through online payment gateway available at the application portal using Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking (payment through UPI may be avoided).
  • The cost of Application Form includes the fee for the Computer Based Test and is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Item / Activity Timeline / Remarks
Opening date for online registration for filling up of online application on PGIMER’s website (Recruitment link at Home Page) 01.01.2026
Closing date for online registration & submission of online applications 16.02.2026
Crucial date for determining eligibility w.r.t. essential qualification(s), age and experience 16.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates who successfully submit online applications will appear in an online Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted in English language only, on an all-India basis.
  • For Group ‘A’ posts: CBT of 85 MCQs (85 marks) and Interview of 15 marks; total 100 marks with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC).
  • For Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts: CBT of 100 MCQs (100 marks) with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC); no interview for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts.
  • There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in CBT.
  • Shortlisting will be done post-CBT for scrutiny of applications and document verification, using candidate-wise merit and prescribed ratios (3× or 5× of posts as applicable).
  • For Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade and Security Guard Grade-II, shortlisted candidates must qualify Trade Test/Physical Efficiency Test as per parameters given in the guidelines.
  • Final selection will be based purely on merit: marks in CBT for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts, and CBT plus Interview for Group ‘A’ posts, subject to verification of documents and eligibility conditions.

General Information/Instructions

  • Information relating to this recruitment including Addendum/Corrigendum, CBT notice, results, eligibility notice, provisional and final results will be displayed only on PGIMER’s website; no individual intimation will be sent.
  • All applicants must read the Guidelines and Help Manual carefully before online registration and ensure that no column is left blank and all entries are correct; once submitted, entries cannot be changed.
  • Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages and may be cancelled if eligibility conditions are not met or incorrect information is found at any stage, even after appointment.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without requisite documents, applications where fee is not paid properly, or where eligibility/age criteria are not met, are liable to be rejected without correspondence.
  • No offline application form or copy of downloaded application form will be accepted by PGIMER.
  • Roll Numbers/Admit Cards for the CBT will be available online only and must be downloaded from the website; they will not be sent by post.
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in document verification or further stages of recruitment.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant; candidates must be in good mental and bodily health as per medical examination requirements.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must visit PGIMER website (www.pgimer.edu.in), check the advertisement and confirm their eligibility before applying online.
  • Applicants should have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the recruitment process; these are required for initial registration and communication.
  • Candidates must first complete online registration by filling mandatory details like Advertisement Number, Date, Name (as per Matriculation), Date of Birth, Mobile Number and Email ID; these details cannot be changed once registered.
  • After registration, candidates should log in using their User ID and password, fill the Online Application Form section-wise (personal information, qualifications, experience, and document uploads), and then proceed to fee payment.
  • Application fee must be paid online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card using the payment gateway on the application portal; fee is non-refundable.
  • Candidates must upload legible scanned copies of required documents: educational qualifications (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificates, experience certificates, NOC (if applicable), etc.
  • Photograph must be a clear passport-size coloured photo with light background, in .jpg/.jpeg format, 50–80 KB in size, showing the candidate’s name and date of photograph (snapped on or after 01.10.2025).
  • After final submission and successful fee payment, candidates should take a printout of the completed application form for future reference; no changes are allowed after final submission.

    • Third preference: Higher marks in Matriculation examination
  • Document Verification/Counseling: Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for document verification/counseling. The number of candidates called will be decided by the Board or competent authority considering category-wise vacancies
  • Final Selection: Only after successful verification of all documents and fulfillment of eligibility criteria, candidates' names will be recommended to the concerned department based on available vacancies

  • Step 7 - Submit Application: After uploading all documents, submit the complete application form. The form will be accepted only after successful fee payment

Bihar.contentHtml:
BSEB has started the online application process for the Bihar Sakshamta Pariksha (Competency Test) 5th Phase 2026 for teachers working under local bodies in the state. The exam will be conducted in computer-based mode, and applications are being accepted from 31 December 2025 to 9 January 2026​

What is BSEB Sakshamta Pariksha 5th Phase?

Advertisement

  • This is a competency examination conducted for teachers appointed in primary, middle, secondary and higher secondary schools under local bodies in Bihar.

  • Teachers who did not appear in previous phases of the Sakshamta Pariksha, remained absent, or were declared not qualified are also allowed to apply in this phase, subject to eligibility conditions.

Important Dates

  • Notification release date: 31 December 2025.

  • Online application start date: 31 December 2025​

  • Last date to submit online form and pay fee: 9 January 2026 (up to 11:59 pm)​

  • Exam date, admit card release, answer key and result: To be announced later on the official website.

Application Fee

  • The application fee is Rs 1100 for all categories including General, BC, EBC, EWS, SC, ST and PWD.

  • The fee can be paid only through online modes such as debit card, credit card, net banking and other available digital payment options.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only teachers currently working in government schools under local bodies (such as Panchayat or Urban Local Bodies) in Bihar are eligible to apply.

  • Retired teachers or those who are no longer in service are not eligible, and candidates must also satisfy the educational and appointment conditions mentioned in the official notification.

Non-Executive Recruitment 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 invites bright, young and energetic Indian nationals seeking a career in refinery and petrochemical operations, utilities, maintenance, quality control, and fire & safety functions. The selection process of Indian Oil Corporation Limited includes a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT), where SPPT is of qualifying nature and final merit is prepared refinery-wise based on CBT scores only among candidates who qualify SPPT. Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice and there is no reservation for them
  • Apprentices are prohibited from joining/forming any Union Body
  • Bank may issue certificate to candidate upon successful completion of Apprenticeship
  • Successful Apprentice will be issued a proficiency certificate by Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)
  • Bank has the rights to cancel the engagement of apprenticeship at any point of time without prior notice in case of any misconduct
  • No change of category as well as any other details will be permitted at any stage after registration on the apprenticeship portal
  • Multiple applications will result in only the latest valid application being retained
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Any resulting dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Mumbai

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in by navigating to "Student Register/Login" section
  • Step 2: After registration, login to the NATS portal using user ID and password at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php
  • Step 3: Apply for Apprenticeship against the advertisement published by "Bank of India" by going to the section "Apply against advertised vacancies"
  • Step 4: Eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] within 48 hours of applying on NATS portal
  • Step 5: Fill the final "Application cum Examination Fee Form" by providing personal data, choice of zone, category, PWBD status
  • Step 6: Make online payment of the requisite examination fee
  • Step 7: Note down the Enrolment ID issued by NATS portal for future reference
  • Step 8: After successful payment, you will receive an email from [email protected] with copy of "Application cum Examination Fee Form" within 48 hours
  • Application Period: 25.12.2025 to 10.01.2026
  • Mode of Application: Online only through NATS Portal
  • Important: Application process is complete only when examination fee is deposited with BFSI SSC
  • For Help: Refer to the help manual available at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf or email queries to [email protected]

Advertisement

  • Multi Purpose Worker/Cook: Rs. 13,000

Notification Date 29 December 2025
Last Date for Submission of Application 15 days from the date of advertisement publication

Selection Process

  • Final merit list will be published based on the desired educational qualification, work experience and interview.
  • Candidates possessing the prescribed qualification will be invited for interview.
  • Information regarding participation in the interview will be given to the concerned candidate on their email ID mentioned in the application and on the district NIC website.
  • No correspondence will be made by the district office to any candidate by post.

General Information / Instructions

  • Employees will be entitled to EPF and ESIC in addition to the basic honorarium as per rules, EPF and ESIC will not be payable on posts with consolidated honorarium.
  • This appointment on contract basis will be completely temporary, which can be terminated without any prior notice or on one month's notice.
  • No claim for regular appointment will be valid in this regard.
  • No claim for regularization of service after employment will be valid for the appointed person.
  • The appointed person will not be considered a government servant nor will they be entitled to any facilities admissible to government servants.
  • Their employment will be under the district One Stop Centre.
  • Priority will be given to candidates having work experience in government department/institution/office in work experience.

  • No claim for regularization of service by employees appointed on honorarium basis will be valid.

How to Apply

  • Mentioning the applied post, candidates should submit their application in the prescribed format along with self-attested photocopies of educational qualification and experience related certificates/ mark sheets attached via Email ID: [email protected] within 15 days from the date of advertisement publication till 5:00 PM.
  • In case certificates are not attached, the application will be rejected at first sight.
  • Applications received after the above time limit will not be accepted.
  • Separate applications will be valid for more than one post.
  • Applications will not be accepted through any other medium.
  • Candidates will keep the print out of the filled application safe with them.

IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Positions Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts
Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor (All Grades), Professor/Associate Professor of Practice 76

Areas of Specialization: Economics, Marketing Management, Organizational Behaviour & Human Resource Management, Information Technology Systems & Analytics, Humanities & Liberal Arts, Business Communication, Strategy & Entrepreneurship, Finance & Accounting, Operations Management & Quantitative Techniques, Business Law

Eligibility Criteria

Professor (Academic Level 14A)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with 10 years of experience out of which 4 years should be as Associate Professor
  • Educational Requirements: First Class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's Degree with consistently good academic record
  • Relaxation: 5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's degree
  • Publications: Minimum eight ABDC-B/ABS-3 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 and 6 ABDC-B/ABS-3 or two ABDC-A/ABS-4 and 4 ABDC-B/ABS-3 or three ABDC-A/ABS-4 and 2 ABDC-B/ABS-3 or four ABDC-A/ABS-4 publications, indexed in either WOS or Scopus
  • Desirable: A book published by reputed publisher, one case with teaching note published in Harvard Case Publishing/Richard Ivey/Emerald, minimum two FPM/Ph.D. guided
  • Experience: Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes

Associate Professor (Academic Level 13A2)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with six years of experience out of which 3 years post Ph.D. experience should be as Assistant Professor or equivalent
  • Alternative: Candidates from Industry (Government/PSU/Research Organization) having experience of 6 years at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor
  • Educational Requirements: First class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's degree with consistently good academic record
  • Relaxation: 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's degree
  • Publications: Minimum five ABDC-B/ABS-3 or two ABDC-A/ABS-4 and one ABDC-B/ABS-3 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 and three ABDC-B/ABS-3 publications, indexed in either WOS or Scopus
  • Desirable: A book published by reputed publisher, one case with teaching note published in Harvard Case Publishing/Richard Ivey/Emerald, preference for FPM/Ph.D. guided
  • Experience: Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes

Assistant Professor (Academic Level 13A1)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with five years of experience out of which 3 years post Ph.D. experience should be as Assistant Professor or equivalent
  • Alternative: Candidates from Industry (Government/PSU/Research Organization) having experience of 5 years at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor
  • Educational Requirements: First class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's degree with consistently good academic record
  • Relaxation: 5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's degree
  • Publications: Minimum four ABDC-B/ABS-3 or two ABDC-A/ABS-4 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 and two ABDC-B/ABS-3 publications, indexed in either WOS or Scopus
  • Desirable: A book published by reputed publisher, one case with teaching note published in Harvard Case Publishing/Richard Ivey/Emerald, preference for FPM/Ph.D. guided/TAC membership
  • Experience: Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes

Assistant Professor, Grade I (Academic Level 12)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with three years of experience excluding Ph.D. experience
  • Alternative: Candidates from Industry (Government/PSU/Research Organization) having experience of 3 years at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor
  • Educational Requirements: First class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's Degrees with consistently good academic record
  • Relaxation: 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's degree
  • Publications: Minimum three ABDC-B/ABS-3 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 and one ABDC-B/ABS-3 publications, indexed in either WOS or Scopus
  • Equivalence: One paper in A rated journal equals two papers in B rated Journals
  • Desirable: One case with teaching note published in Harvard Case Publishing/Richard Ivey/Emerald, a book published by reputed publisher
  • Experience: Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes

Assistant Professor, Grade II (Academic Level 11)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. in the appropriate branch with more than one year of post-Ph.D. experience
  • Alternative: Candidates from Industry (Government/PSU/Research Organization) having experience of more than one year of post-Ph.D. experience at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor
  • Educational Requirements: First-class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's and Graduation Degrees, First-class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Class XII and Class X
  • Relaxation: 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's and Bachelor's degree
  • Publications: Minimum two ABDC-B/ABS-3 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 publications, indexed in either WOS or Scopus
  • Desirable: One case with teaching notes published in Harvard Case Publishing/Richard Ivey/Emerald
  • Experience: Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes

Assistant Professor, Grade II (Academic Level 10)

  • Essential Qualifications: Fresh Ph.D. in the appropriate branch with less than one year of post-Ph.D. experience excluding Ph.D. experience
  • Note: Candidates who have given viva voce with provisional award of Ph.D. may also apply
  • Educational Requirements: First-class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's and Graduation Degrees, First-class (Minimum 60%) or equivalent grade in Class XII and Class X
  • Relaxation: 5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's and Bachelor's degree
  • Publications: Minimum of one publication in ABDC-B/ABS-3 category journal indexed in WOS or Scopus is mandatory, while two or more such publications will be considered desirable
  • Experience: Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes

Professor/Associate Professor of Practice (Academic Level 14A/13A2)

  • Essential Experience: Substantial experience (minimum 20 years) in industry or government with demonstrated understanding of and impact on practice
  • Qualifications: While Ph.D. is desirable, it is not essential. However, lack of Ph.D. must be offset by demonstrated domain knowledge obtained from the field
  • Purpose: Must have interest and potential to teach Leadership Development Program (LDP) courses as full-time activity
  • Evaluation Criteria: Exceptional contributions due to unique expertise (not available internally) or potential contribution through teaching quality and exceptional service
  • Contract Period: Initially appointed for period of two years, renewable for maximum period of up to 5 years based on performance and Director's approval
  • Retirement Age: 65 years
  • Designation: Depending on relevant years of experience, candidate could be called Associate Professor of Practice or Professor of Practice

Salary/Stipend

Position Level Pay Scale (7th CPC) Entry Pay
Professor 14A ₹1,59,100 - ₹2,20,200 ₹1,59,100
Associate Professor 13A2 ₹1,39,600 - ₹2,11,300 ₹1,39,600
Assistant Professor Grade I 13A1 ₹1,31,400 - ₹2,04,700 ₹1,31,400
Assistant Professor Grade I 12 ₹1,01,500 - ₹1,67,400 ₹1,01,500
Assistant Professor Grade II 11 ₹68,900 - ₹1,17,200 ₹89,900
Assistant Professor Grade II 10 ₹57,700 - ₹98,200 ₹84,700
Professor of Practice 14A ₹1,59,100 - ₹2,20,200 ₹1,59,100
Associate Professor of Practice 13A2 ₹1,39,600 - ₹2,11,300 ₹1,39,600
  • Additional Allowances: DA (Dearness Allowance), HRA/Leased Accommodation, LTC (Leave Travel Concession), Medical Reimbursement, Children Education Allowance, NPS (National Pension System)
  • Other Benefits: Reimbursement of telephone bills, incentive for research publications, faculty development fund for attending national and international conferences, membership of professional bodies as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules
  • Consulting: Faculty members are permitted to pursue management consulting with income sharing with the Institute as per rules

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Release Date 31 December 2025
Application Start Date 31 December 2025
Last Date for Accepting Application 20 January 2026
Validity of Waitlisted Candidates 1 year from date of declaration of result

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Screening of applications based on qualifications, experience, and publications
  • Stage 2: Interview for shortlisted candidates
  • Screening Criteria: Papers published ONLY in ABDC Journals will be considered for shortlisting of applications
  • Screening Committee Authority: In case of overwhelming applications, the Screening Committee might use academic/publication/work-experience parameters as criteria for raising the bar and optimizing the application pool
  • Contractual Appointment: If candidate's academic credentials are excellent but does not have requisite research publications or experience, may be considered for contractual appointment
  • Special Provision for Fresh Ph.D.: Candidates who have completed Ph.D. from IIT/IIM/IISc/IISER/NITIE or equivalent level institution in last three years without requisite publications may be considered for contractual appointment
  • Lower Position Consideration: Candidates called for interview to fill a vacancy may be considered for lower post if they are otherwise found suitable
  • Important Note: Mere fulfillment of above-mentioned qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview

General Information/Instructions

  • Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya has been established by the Government of India, Ministry of Education in 2015 at Bodh Gaya – the Land of Enlightenment
  • IIM Bodh Gaya is looking for dedicated and committed faculty members who believe in institution building and have passion for excellence
  • Candidates should have demonstrated ability to make relevant intellectual contribution to experienced and potential managers through teaching, training research and published work
  • Candidates should have strong academic background and understanding of current developments in the related field
  • Faculty members are expected to carry out research, design and teach courses, engage in institution development and conduct training program and consultancy
  • For academic positions, the qualification, experience etc. shall be governed by the Ministry of Education guidelines
  • IIM Bodh Gaya follows Australian Bureau of Deans Council's ABDC Journal Quality List
  • Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained by the Institute
  • All qualifications must be from UGC recognized University/Deemed University or AICTE approved autonomous institution (wherever applicable)
  • The courses offered by autonomous institutions should be equivalent to the relevant course approved/recognized by Association of Indian University (AIU)
  • Relaxation in qualification and experience/higher start in the pay scale may be considered in case of exceptionally bright candidates
  • For regular appointment, there would be a probation period of 2 years
  • Depending on academic credentials of the candidate, the Institute may consider them for an offer on contractual basis of one/two years
  • The list of waitlisted candidates will remain valid for 1 year from the date of declaration of result
  • Reservation Policy will apply as per the Government of India Rules
  • The Institute reserves the right to consider and to fill or not to fill positions in any of the above and/or any other specialization(s)
  • No correspondence whatsoever will be entertained from candidates regarding conduct and result of interview and reasons for not being called for interview or selection
  • Candidates are advised to visit the website of IIM Bodh Gaya (www.iimbg.ac.in) regularly for updates
  • Amendment/Corrigendum (if any) will be placed on the Institute website only

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website of IIM Bodh Gaya at www.iimbg.ac.in
  • Download the detailed advertisement and application form from the website
  • Read all the instructions carefully before filling the application form
  • Fill the application form completely with all required details
  • Attach all necessary documents including educational certificates, experience certificates, publication details, and other supporting documents
  • Ensure all information provided is accurate and complete
  • Submit the completed application form along with all attachments before the last date
  • Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained by the Institute
  • Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference
  • Regularly check the IIM Bodh Gaya website for any updates, amendments, or corrigendum
  • For details and application form, visit www.iimbg.ac.in

NT 2025-12-Z Yoga Trainee Contract Rs. 25,000/- + accommodation Pool of suitable candidates
NT 2025-12-AA Graduate Trainee Contract Rs. 15,000 – 20,000 (Consolidated Stipend) Pool of suitable candidates

Eligibility Criteria

  • Chief Administrative Officer (Level-12): Postgraduate degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks OR Engineering Graduate with degree/diploma in management (MBA preferred); minimum 15 years’ relevant experience including 5 years in Level-11 or 10 years in Level-10 and above in supervisory/head roles in Central/State Govt, PSUs, Universities/Autonomous bodies or reputed higher education institutes; proficiency in computers, excellent English communication and man-management skills.
  • Legal Officer (Consolidated Rs. 50,000–60,000): Professional Law Graduate (LLB) with extensive experience in legal matters of Government/PSU organizations, service, labour, land laws and liaisoning; at least 5 years dealing with legal matters in Govt/PSU/companies; strong drafting/vetting experience; excellent English (Hindi preferred); Company Secretary qualification desirable; experience as Compliance Officer or Senior Legal Associate preferred.
  • Senior Administrative Officer / SAO (Programmes) (Level-11): Postgraduate in any discipline (10+2+3+2) with at least 55% (SAO) / 60% (Programmes) OR Engineering Graduate with management degree/diploma; 12 years’ experience in Central/State Govt/Autonomous/Statutory organizations/PSU/Universities/reputed institutions with 5+ years in Administrative Officer or equivalent in Level-10 (PB-3 GP-5400); proficiency in computers and excellent English and interpersonal skills; preference for IIM/IIT/IISER/CFTI/PSU experience.
  • Administrative Officer (Administration/Programs) & Executive Assistant (Level-10): Postgraduate degree (10+2+3+2) with at least 55% OR MBA; 8 years’ post-qualification experience (5 years independently handling admin/academic/admission functions) in reputed academic institutions/universities; computer proficiency and LMS exposure desirable.
  • Internal Audit Officer (Level-10): Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant with S.A.S or equivalent with at least 55% marks; minimum 8 years’ post-qualification experience in auditing, accounting, establishment, pay fixation, pension, stores & purchases, construction works, research and projects; familiarity with Tally/ERP/PFMS, GFR, CCS rules; retired Senior Audit Officer from AG/C&AG up to 65 years preferred.
  • AAO (Hindi Language & Administration) (Level-8): Master’s degree in Hindi with at least 55% marks; degree course with English/Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium; minimum 5 years’ experience in translation (English–Hindi & vice-versa) and academic administration; M.Phil. in Hindi, MS Office proficiency and course management exposure desirable.
  • AAO (Student Affairs) / AAO (International Relations) (Level-8): Graduate/Postgraduate (10+2+3+2) with at least 55%; 8 years (Graduate) / 5 years (Postgraduate) relevant admin experience with 3 years independently handling student-related or international relations functions; MBA and LMS/ERP knowledge preferred; preference for IIM/IIT/IISER/PSU and international partnership experience (for IR).
  • Assistant Student Counsellor (Level-8): Master’s degree in Clinical Psychology with 55% and 5 years’ relevant experience (2 years counselling in academic/medical institution) OR Master’s in Psychology with 55% plus diploma in Mental/Social Psychology and 5 years’ experience (3 years counselling); at least 2 years counselling young adults in fully residential campus; certifications in mental health/wellness and strong communication desirable.
  • Office Assistant (Level-6): Bachelor’s degree (10+2+3) with 55% and 5 years’ relevant office experience OR Master’s degree (10+2+3+2) with 55% and 3 years’ relevant office experience; preference for experience in IIMs/IITs/IISER; strong written and verbal communication essential.
  • Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical) (Level-6): Civil – Diploma (60%+) with 5 years’ relevant experience OR Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (60%+) with 3 years’ experience; Electrical – Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering (60%+) with 5 years’ relevant experience; preference for Govt/PSU/reputed institutions; strong technical and computer skills essential.
  • Senior Library & Information Assistant / IT & Computer Assistant (Level-6): Library – Bachelor’s or Master’s in Library Science with 60%+ and 5/3 years’ post-qualification experience; essential experience with library software; IT & Computer Assistant – BE/B.Tech (CS/IT) or MCA/M.Sc (CS/IT) with 3 years’ experience in web-portal/DBMS/admission/exam IT, preferably in IIM/IIT/IISER/Central institutions.
  • Junior Assistant / Junior Horticulturist (Level-4): Junior Assistant – BBA/BCA (or equivalent) with 60% and 2 years’ relevant experience; strong computer skills essential. Junior Horticulturist – B.Sc in Agriculture/Botany/Horticulture with 55% and 2 years’ horticulture/ornamental gardening experience in Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies.
  • CEO – INSPIRE (Consolidated Rs. 75,000–1,50,000): Postgraduate (preferably MBA) with 55%; at least 5 years’ post-qualification experience including independently handling Innovation/Incubation/Entrepreneurship functions in industry/Govt/PSU; sectoral expertise (agri/rural, wellness/healthcare, fintech etc.) and strong industry connections preferred.
  • Management/IT/Library/Accounts/Graduate/Yoga Trainees: Master’s in Management/CS/IT/Library Science/Commerce or Bachelor’s degree (for Graduate Trainee) with specified minimum percentages (generally 55–60%) and 1–2 years’ relevant experience preferred; Yoga Trainee requires Graduation/Postgraduation in Yogic Science with 6 months’ trainer experience and Yoga certification/diploma desirable.

Salary/Stipend

  • Chief Administrative Officer (Level-12): Pay Scale Rs. 78,800–2,09,200; Entry Pay Rs. 78,800 (7th CPC) with allowances as per IIM Bodh Gaya HR Policy/CCS Rules.
  • Senior Administrative Officer / SAO (Programmes) (Level-11): Pay Scale Rs. 67,700–2,08,700; Entry Pay Rs. 67,700.
  • Administrative Officer (Administration/Programs), Executive Assistant, Internal Audit Officer (Level-10): Pay Scale Rs. 56,100–1,77,500; Entry Pay Rs. 56,100.
  • AAO posts & Assistant Student Counsellor (Level-8): Pay Scale Rs. 47,600–1,51,100; Entry Pay Rs. 47,600.
  • Office Assistant, JE (Civil/Electrical), Senior Library & Information Assistant, IT & Computer Assistant (Level-6): Pay Scale Rs. 35,400–1,12,400; Entry Pay Rs. 35,400.
  • Junior Assistant, Junior Horticulturist (Level-4): Pay Scale Rs. 25,500–81,100; Entry Pay Rs. 25,500.
  • CEO – INSPIRE: Consolidated emoluments Rs. 75,000–1,50,000 per month depending on experience; initially for 2 years and extendable yearly based on performance and requirement.
  • Management/IT/Library/Accounts/Management Trainee cum Counsellor: Consolidated stipend Rs. 20,000–35,000 per month, normally for one year, extendable based on performance.
  • Yoga Trainee: Consolidated stipend Rs. 25,000/- per month with accommodation; contract initially for one year, extendable based on performance.
  • Graduate Trainee: Consolidated stipend Rs. 15,000–20,000 per month; contract for one year, extendable based on performance.

Age Limit (as on 20-01-2026)

  • Chief Administrative Officer: Upper Age Limit 50 years.
  • Legal Officer: Age Limit 65 years.
  • Senior Administrative Officer / SAO (Programmes), Administrative Officers, Executive Assistant, Internal Audit Officer, AAO posts, Assistant Student Counsellor, Office Assistant, JE (Civil/Electrical), Senior Library & Information Assistant, IT & Computer Assistant, Junior Assistant: Upper Age Limit 40 years.
  • Junior Horticulturist: Age Limit 32 years.
  • CEO – INSPIRE: Preferred Age Limit 30–35 years.
  • Management Trainee, Management Trainee–IT, Management Trainee cum Counsellor, Library Trainee, Accounts Trainee, Graduate Trainee: Upper Age Limit 30 years.
  • Yoga Trainee: Age Limit below 50 years.
  • Cut-off date for determining age, experience and educational qualification: 20th January 2026.
  • Age relaxation will be given to SC/ST/NC-OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen as per existing Central Government rules; candidates must produce proof to avail relaxation.

Application Fee

  • The RoR-Non-Faculty PDF specifies age relaxation and reservation as per Central Government rules but does not explicitly mention category-wise application fee amounts.
  • Candidates must refer to the main online application portal/advertisement on IIM Bodh Gaya website for any prescribed application/examination fee details and payment modes.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of RoR / Advertisement (Non-Faculty Positions) 31st December 2025
Cut-off date for determining age / experience / educational qualification 20th January 2026
Last date for online application submission 20th January 2026 (applications must be submitted online on or before this date)
Validity of pool for Trainee positions Pool of suitable candidates remains valid for 1 year from the date of declaration of results

Selection Process

  • Shortlisted candidates meeting qualifications as per RoR will be called for tests (written and/or skill) and/or personal interview; selection will be based on results of these stages as per IIM Bodh Gaya HR policy.
  • For trainee positions, a pool of suitable candidates will be prepared based on selection process and will remain valid for one year from date of declaration of results; appointments from the pool will be made as and when requirement arises.
  • The list of waitlisted candidates for Non-Faculty posts will remain valid for 1 year from the date of declaration of result.
  • In case of overwhelming applications, Screening Committee may use academic and work experience parameters to raise the bar and optimize the application pool.
  • Candidates called for tests/interview for a post may also be considered for a lower post if otherwise found suitable; only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted online with complete details of qualifications, experience, salary drawn and names of two referees; incomplete applications will not be entertained.
  • All qualifications must be from UGC-recognized Universities/Deemed Universities or AICTE-approved institutions; courses must be equivalent to those recognized by AIU.
  • Reservation policy applies as per Government of India rules; age relaxation will be granted to SC/ST/NC-OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates as per Central Government norms.
  • Candidates already in Government service must apply through proper channel or produce NOC from present employer at time of tests/interview; without NOC they will not be permitted to appear.
  • For regular appointments, probation period of 2 years applies; positions require full 24x7 commitment and candidates willing to dedicate themselves fully are expected to apply.
  • Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease number of vacancies, relax age/qualification/experience in exceptional cases, or cancel the recruitment process without assigning reasons.
  • Applications are processed solely on information/documents submitted by candidates; any false/incorrect information may lead to cancellation of candidature even after appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification; no correspondence on reasons for non-shortlisting, delays, or results will be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to visit IIM Bodh Gaya website regularly for updates; all corrigenda/ amendments will be placed on the Institute website only.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates must apply online, furnishing all particulars of qualifications, experience, salary drawn and names of two referees, preferably from the concerned industry/field/area.
  • Applications with missing or incomplete information will not be entertained; candidates must ensure that all essential requirements of the post and conditions in the advertisement are fulfilled as on last date of online application.
  • Candidates desirous of applying for more than one position are required to submit separate online applications for each post; submitting two or more applications for the same position will result in rejection.
  • All supporting documents (educational, experience, category, age, etc.) must be produced in original with self-attested copies when called for tests/interview or verification.
  • Online applications must be submitted on or before 20th January 2026 through the application link available on the IIM Bodh Gaya website (www.iimbg.ac.in); candidates should regularly check the website for recruitment-related updates.

A Post Graduate Degree i.e. MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch or equivalent in the concerned department recognized by MCI/NMC/NBE.

Special notes:
For Clinical Haematology, candidates with MD in General Medicine or MD in Paediatrics are also eligible to apply. For Dentistry, only candidates with MDS in Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics are eligible. PG students appearing in their final examination in the December 2025 session are also eligible to apply, but they must submit their passing certificate before the date of declaration of result in the Office of the Medical Superintendent, AIIMS Patna.

Age Limit (As on 10-01-2026)

The upper age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts is 45 years as on the last date of application (10 January 2026). Age relaxation is admissible for reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

Category Minimum Age Maximum Age
General Not specified 45 Years
OBC Not specified 45 Years + 3 Years relaxation
SC/ST Not specified 45 Years + 5 Years relaxation
PWD Not specified 45 Years + 10 Years relaxation

* Age relaxation for OBC-NCL, SC, ST and PwBD candidates is applicable as per Central Government norms. Candidates who have already completed 3 years of Senior Residency are not eligible to apply.

Senior Resident Selection Process 2025

The selection process for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025 is based on a combination of written test and personal interview. Candidates must qualify the written test with minimum prescribed marks to be shortlisted for the interview stage.

1. Screening of Candidates (Written Test):
An MCQ-based written test will be conducted for all eligible applicants for the advertised Senior Resident posts. The test will consist of 80 questions carrying one mark each, with no negative marking. The written examination will be held on 25 January 2026 from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Examination Hall, Admin. Building, AIIMS Patna.

Qualifying Marks in Written Test:
UR: 50% OBC-NCL/EWS: 45% SC/ST: 40%

2. Interview:
Candidates who qualify in the written examination (maximum three times the number of seats in each specialty) will be called for the personal interview. The interview will be conducted on 29th, 30th and 31st January 2026 at the Committee Hall, Admin. Building, AIIMS Patna, and will carry 20 marks. Candidates have to report at 9:00 AM in the E-Classroom, Administration Building, AIIMS Patna on the interview day.

Final Merit:
The final selection list will be prepared on the basis of combined marks of the written test and interview. In case of ties (same total marks), the tie will be resolved by date of birth, with the older candidate ranked higher.

Senior Resident Application Fee 2025

Candidates applying for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025 are required to pay the prescribed application fee through online mode only. The fee is non-refundable and no other mode of payment will be accepted.

Category Application Fee
General/OBC Rs. 1500/- + transaction charges
SC/ST/EWS Rs. 1200/- + transaction charges
Ex-servicemen Nil
Women Nil
PwBD Nil

Application fee must be remitted online using Internet banking, Debit/Credit cards or other options provided in the payment gateway. Candidates should retain proof of successful fee payment for verification during document checking.

AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Salary 2025

Candidates selected as Senior Resident (Non-Academic) at AIIMS Patna will be appointed under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 11 along with Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) and other admissible allowances as per rules. The pay structure is in line with Central Government norms for Senior Residents under the Residency Scheme.

Component Details
Post Senior Resident (Non-Academic)
Pay Level Level 11 as per 7th CPC
Basic Pay Rs. 67,700/- per month
Approx. Monthly Emoluments Basic Pay + NPA + usual allowances as admissible (DA, HRA etc. as per rules)
Training Stipend Not applicable (regular residency pay, not stipend)
Allowances & Benefits NPA, DA, HRA (where applicable) and other admissible benefits as per AIIMS rules
Career Growth Enhanced clinical and academic experience aiding future consultant/teaching positions

How to Apply for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025?

Candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Patna Senior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2025 through the official website within the prescribed dates. The step-by-step process for submitting the online application is given below.

  1. Visit the official website of AIIMS Patna: www.aiimspatna.edu.in.
  2. Click on the relevant link for “Senior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2025 – Phase III”.
  3. Read the detailed notification, instructions and eligibility criteria carefully before proceeding.
  4. Register with a valid email ID and mobile number to generate User ID and Password.
  5. Login as a new/existing user and fill in the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, experience, category, and other required information.
  6. Upload scanned copies of recent passport size photograph, signature, Date of Birth certificate, MBBS and PG degree/provisional degree, NMC/State registration, category/PwBD certificate, experience certificate, NOC (if applicable) and other relevant documents in specified formats and sizes.
  7. Proceed to pay the application fee online using available payment options and ensure successful transaction; retain payment proof.
  8. Submit the application form after verifying all details; note that post-submission editing in key fields is not allowed.
  9. Take a printout of the Registered Application Form and keep it safely for future reference.
  10. Produce the printed application along with original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of interview/document verification.

Important Links:
Official Notification PDF: Click Here
Apply Online: Click Here
Official Website: www.aiimspatna.edu.in

Important Instructions for Senior Resident Recruitment 2025

  • Fill the online application form carefully; corrections in key fields after fee payment are not permitted.
  • Ensure that the photograph and signature uploaded are clear and as per the prescribed size and format.
  • Use only online mode for payment of fees; applications with fee paid by any other mode will be rejected.
  • Carry all original certificates, mark sheets, registration certificates, experience certificates, category/PwBD certificates and application printout for document verification.
  • Candidates already completed three years of Senior Residency are not eligible to apply.
  • Reservation for EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST and 4% PwBD will be as per Central Government rules; proper and valid certificates in the prescribed format are mandatory.
  • Any incorrect information, suppression of facts or submission of fabricated documents will lead to cancellation of candidature and possible legal action.
  • Mobile phones, electronic gadgets, books and loose papers are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall; violation may lead to debarment.
  • All updates, admit cards, lists and results will be published only on the AIIMS Patna website; no separate individual communication is guaranteed.
  • The decision of the Executive Director/Competent Authority of AIIMS Patna in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025?

A1. The last date to submit the online application form is 10 January 2026.

Q2. What is the age limit for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025?

A2. The upper age limit is 45 years as on 10 January 2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwBD candidates as per rules.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025?

A3. A total of 117 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies have been announced across various departments.

Q4. What is the selection process for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025?

A4. Selection is based on a written test (MCQ, 80 questions, no negative marking) followed by an interview carrying 20 marks, and final merit is based on combined scores.

Q5. What is the application fee for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025?

A5. The application fee is Rs. 1500/- + charges for General/OBC candidates, Rs. 1200/- + charges for SC/ST/EWS candidates, while Ex-servicemen, Women and PwBD candidates are exempted from fee payment.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the written examination?

A6. No, there is no negative marking in the written test; each question carries one mark.

Q7. Can I edit my application form after submission?

A7. No major edits are allowed after payment and final submission; candidates are advised to fill details carefully before submitting the form.

Q8. What is the salary of AIIMS Patna Senior Resident?

A8. Senior Residents receive pay of Rs. 67,700/- per month in Level 11 of the 7th CPC matrix plus NPA and usual admissible allowances.

Q9. Are PG students appearing in December 2025 exam session eligible?

A9. Yes, final-year PG students appearing in the December 2025 session are eligible, provided they submit their passing certificate before declaration of result.

Q10. Where will the examination be conducted?

A10. The written examination will be conducted at the Examination Hall, Admin. Building, AIIMS Patna, followed by interviews at the Committee Hall, Admin. Building, AIIMS Patna.

The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is inviting applications for the Scientific Officer positions through the OCES/DGFS 2026 recruitment. This prestigious program offers engineering graduates and science postgraduates the chance to join the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) through two distinct training schemes: the one-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates (OCES-2026) and the two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates (DGFS-2026). Successful candidates will undergo intensive training, with a stipend of ₹74,000 per month during the training period. Upon appointment, they will be placed in Group-A posts with an attractive pay scale under the 7th CPC, totaling approximately ₹1,35,000 per month, along with various allowances.

This recruitment offers a unique opportunity to contribute to India's nuclear and atomic energy programs in various DAE units, such as BARC, IGCAR, and NPCIL. Candidates must meet specific educational qualifications, including a minimum of 60% marks in engineering or science degrees, and fulfill the age criteria (18 to 31 years). The selection process includes an online examination, GATE score-based shortlisting, and a final interview. Interested candidates can apply online from 22 December 2025 to 21 January 2026. This is an excellent opportunity for aspiring scientists to be part of a prestigious and impactful sector.

  • For screening based on GATE Score, candidates must have valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in the relevant GATE subjects/papers corresponding to their discipline as mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Only regular educational degrees obtained through full-time/on-campus mode are considered; degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education/learning, by research or part-time modes are not eligible.

Selection Process

  • Selection to OCES/DGFS-2026 is a two-step process consisting of screening of candidates followed by a Selection Interview.
  • Screening for Selection Interview is conducted through two alternative channels: an online screening examination and GATE-score-based shortlisting.
  • The online screening examination is conducted in eight engineering OCES disciplines (codes 21-28) and five science OCES disciplines (codes 41-43, 45 and 46) at more than fifty cities across India.
  • Candidates meeting eligibility criteria with valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in prescribed papers may be screened in for Selection Interview on the basis of GATE scores.
  • Cut-off GATE scores for Screening Interview are decided after conclusion of the online exam, and candidates are advised to maximize their chances by availing both screening avenues.
  • Selection Interviews for shortlisted candidates in all disciplines except Geology and Geophysics are conducted at BARC Training School, Mumbai; interviews in Geology and Geophysics disciplines are held in Hyderabad.
  • Outstation applicants travelling for Selection Interview are eligible for reimbursement of to-and-fro AC-III tier normal train fare by shortest route or actual fare, whichever is less, upon submission of original tickets.
  • Final selection is solely on the basis of performance in Selection Interview, subject to medical fitness as determined by DAE doctors.

General Information/Instructions

  • OCES-2026 is a one-year Orientation Course conducted at BARC Training Schools at BARC, Mumbai and AMD, Hyderabad for engineering graduates and science postgraduates, leading to appointment as Scientific Officers in DAE units or Atomic Energy Regulatory Board upon successful completion.
  • DGFS-2026 is a two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for engineering graduates who secure M.Tech. admission in designated DGFS institutes and specializations, and who perform well in OCES Selection Interviews.
  • On successful completion of OCES/DGFS training, Trainee Scientific Officers are posted as Scientific Officers in various DAE units such as BARC, IGCAR, RRCAT, VECC, HWB, NFC, BRIT, NPCIL, BHAVINI, AMD, UCIL, DCSEM and AERB, based on programme needs and trainee performance.
  • Selected candidates must execute an agreement and personal indemnity bond to serve DAE for at least three years after completion of training; the bond covers stipend, book allowance, tuition fee and contingency grants as applicable.
  • DAE strives to maintain gender balance and encourages women candidates to apply for OCES/DGFS-2026 programmes.
  • Only online applications are accepted, and applicants are advised to regularly visit the online application portal for important updates and information.
  • Records of applicants for BARC Training Schools OCES/DGFS-2026 programme will not be preserved beyond four months from the date of publication of the final selection result.
  • In all matters concerning OCES/DGFS-2026 recruitment, decisions of the competent authority in BARC, Mumbai are final and binding; disputes are subject to exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Mumbai, India.

How to Apply

  • Only online applications will be accepted for OCES/DGFS-2026 programme.
  • Candidates are required to visit the website https://www.barcocesexam.in during the period specified in the Important Dates table and submit the online application by following the instructions provided there.
  • Applicants should carefully read the Information Brochure and FAQs available on the online application portal before filling the online application form.
  • Candidates must enter accurate details regarding qualifying degree, discipline, GATE score (if applicable) and other required information as per the advertisement.
  • Candidates graduating in academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results must ensure that all academic requirements for award of qualifying degree are completed before 31 July 2026 and provide necessary certificates at the time of joining.

BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026 - FAQs

1. What is the starting date to apply for BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Starting date to apply is 22nd December 2025, the tentative date for launching of the online application portal for OCES/DGFS-2026.

2. What is the last apply date for BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Last date for online application is 21st January 2026.

3. What is the eligibility to apply for BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Eligibility includes specified B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engineering)/5-year Integrated M.Tech. degrees in approved engineering disciplines and M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. degrees in approved science disciplines with minimum 60% aggregate marks and other academic requirements detailed in the Eligibility Criteria section.

4. What is the maximum age limit to apply for BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Maximum age is 26 years for General category, 29 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and 31 years for SC/ST, Dependents of 1984 riots and persons domiciled in Kashmir Division during specified period, as on 01 August 2026.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited through BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026?

Ans: The notification does not specify the exact number of vacancies; selection is for Scientific Officers through OCES-2026 and DGFS-2026 training programmes as per requirements of DAE programmes.

6. What is the stipend during the OCES/DGFS-2026 training programme?

Ans: During training, OCES Trainee Scientific Officers and DGFS fellows receive a stipend of ₹ 74,000/- per month, and OCES Trainee Scientific Officers also receive a one-time book allowance of ₹ 30,000/-.

7. What is the pay scale on appointment as Scientific Officer after OCES/DGFS-2026?

Ans: On appointment, Scientific Officers are placed in Group-A post in Level 10 (basic pay ₹ 56,100/-) of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with total monthly emoluments of approximately ₹ 1,35,000/- for those posted in Mumbai, including allowances.

8. What are the screening modes for BARC OCES/DGFS-2026 selection?

Ans: Screening is conducted through an online screening examination in specified engineering and science disciplines and through GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in relevant GATE subjects.

9. Are final year students eligible to apply for OCES/DGFS-2026 programme?

Ans: Candidates graduating in academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results may apply, provided they complete all academic requirements before 31st July 2026 and submit final marksheets as per the conditions mentioned in the notification.

10. Is there any service bond for selected candidates of OCES/DGFS-2026?

Ans: Selected candidates are required to execute an agreement and a personal indemnity bond to serve the Department of Atomic Energy for at least three years after completion of training, covering stipend, book allowance, tuition fees and related grants as applicable.

  • Three year Diploma in relevant Engineering discipline from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks

  • Three year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks

  • Desirable: Experience in HVAC, Fire Fighting System, Cranes, Air Compressors, Pumps, Piping systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Electrical):

  • Three year Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of electrical systems
  • Desirable: Experience in PLC/SCADA/DCS Systems, HT/LT switchgear panels, power management systems

  • Three year Diploma in Electronics Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of control systems and electronic systems
  • Desirable: Experience in electronics systems manufacturing, microprocessor based embedded systems, wireless communication systems

  • Three year Diploma in Civil Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks

For Junior Technical Assistant (Instrumentation):

  • Three year Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Instrumentation works in Shipyard or Engineering Company and must be computer savvy

For Laboratory Assistant (Mechanical):

  • Essential: Three year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Metallurgical Engineering with minimum 60% marks

  • Bachelor's Degree in Arts (other than Fine Arts/Performing Arts) or Science or Commerce or Computer Applications or Business Administration with minimum 60% marks

Selection Process

  • Centre Based Online Aptitude Test: Conducted by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) as the assessment partner of Federal Bank.

    • Computer Knowledge - 15 Questions (15 Marks)

    • Mathematics - 15 Questions (15 Marks)
    • Total: 60 Questions (60 Marks) in 60 Minutes (Composite time)
  • Test Medium: English only.
  • Negative Marking: There will NOT be any negative marking for wrong answers.
  • Personal Interview: Candidates shortlisted from the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test only will be considered for Personal Interview round. The same will be scheduled at various centres across the country at the discretion of the Bank.

  • Name Matching: Name appearing on the admit card of the candidate should exactly match with the name that appears in the photo identity proof. Candidates who have changed their name will be allowed only if they produce Gazette notification/their registered marriage certificate indicating the changes.
  • Late Reporting: Candidates reporting late i.e. after the reporting time specified on the admit card will not be permitted to participate in the Centre Based Online Aptitude Test.

  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/ or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/ Tribunals/ Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any cause/ dispute.
  • Outstation candidates, who may be called for interview after short-listing will be reimbursed the cost of travelling fare (Eligibility will be mentioned in the Call letter) for the shortest route in India OR the actual travel cost in India (whichever is lower) on the basis of actual journey. Local conveyance like taxi/cab/personal vehicle expenses/fares will not be payable. A candidate, if found ineligible for the post will not be permitted to appear for the interview and will not be reimbursed any fare.
  • Bank reserves the Right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage without assigning any reasons thereof, whatsoever.
  • At the time of interview, the candidate will be required to provide details regarding criminal cases pending against him/her, if any.
  • Suppression of material facts will result in cancellation/ termination of candidature at any point, even if the candidate is selected. his/her selection will be canceled in such circumstances. The Bank may also conduct independent verification, inter alia, including verification of Police Records, etc. The Bank reserves the right to deny the engagement/appointment depending upon such disclosure and/or independent verification.

How to Apply

  • Candidates will be required to register themselves online through the link available on SBI website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and pay the application fee using Internet Banking/ Debit Card/ Credit Card etc.
  • Candidates should first scan their latest photograph and signature. Online application will not be registered unless candidate uploads his/ her photo and signature as specified on the online registration page (under 'How to Upload Document').
  • Candidates should fill the application carefully. Once application is filled-in completely, candidate should submit the same. In the event of candidate not being able to fill the application in one go, he can save the information already entered. When the information/ application is saved, a provisional registration number and password is generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the registration number and password. They can re-open the saved application using registration number and password and edit the particulars, if needed. This facility of editing the saved information will be available for three times only. Once the application is filled completely, candidate should submit the same and proceed for online payment of fee.
  • After registering online, the candidates are advised to take a printout of the system generated online application forms.
  • Login to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
  • Scroll down and click on the respective advertisement
  • Download advertisement no. CRPD/SCO/2025-26/21 (Carefully read the detailed advertisement)
  • Apply Online (Before final submission, please go through your application. Corrections will not be allowed after final submission)
