NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
Post Name Young Professional (14 Disciplines)
No of Posts 44
Salary ₹70,000/- Per Month (All Inclusive Stipend)
Qualification Bachelor's/Master's degree as per discipline requirement
Age Limit 21 to 30 years
Start Date for Apply 26th December 2025
Last Date for Apply 12th January 2026
Official Website www.nabard.org

NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Discipline/Post Name Total Vacancies Location
Climate Action & Sustainability 3 Mumbai (1), Lucknow (1), Shimla (1)
Economics 3 Mumbai (2), Ranchi (1)
Data Science 4 Mumbai (3), Dehradun (1)
Cyber Security 1 Mumbai (1)
Academic Administration 2 Lucknow (1), Mangaluru (1)
Graphic Designing 1 Lucknow (1)
PR, Outreach and Documentation 2 Mumbai (1), Guwahati (1)
Information Technology 12 Mumbai (9), Guwahati (1), Aizawl (1), Kolkata (1)
Geoinformatics 1 Shimla (1)
Development Management 3 Lucknow (1), New Delhi (2)
Project Monitoring 4 Mumbai (1), Chennai (2), Chandigarh (1)
Finance 6 Mumbai (6)
UI/UX Designing 1 Mumbai (1)
Software Testing 1 Mumbai (1)
Total 44

Note: A candidate shall be permitted to apply only for one discipline/location. Multiple applications under the same/different disciplines shall lead to cancellation of candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science/Climate Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Economics: Post Graduate Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Financial Economics/Statistics/Data Science/Finance/Public Policy with minimum 55% marks
  • Data Science: B.E./B.Tech in Information Technology/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with minimum 60% marks
  • Cyber Security: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Electronics and Communications Engineering with minimum 60% marks OR Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks
  • Academic Administration: Bachelor's degree in Education/Business Administration/Computer Science/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Master's degree in Education (M.Ed.)/Educational Management/HRD/MBA (HR)/PGDM-HR with minimum 55% marks
  • Graphic Designing: Bachelor's degree in Digital Media/Multimedia/Graphic Design with minimum 60% marks
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Post graduate degree in Mass Media/Development Communication/Visual Communication/Journalism with minimum 55% marks
  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks
  • Geoinformatics: Post graduate degree in Geoinformatics/Geography/Remote Sensing/Environmental Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025
Last Date for Online Application 12th January 2026
Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted
  • Application will be rejected if only photo uploaded without signature
  • Left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged
  • Hand written declaration must be in candidate's handwriting and in English only
  • Keep valid personal email ID and mobile number active till completion of recruitment
  • Name should be spelt correctly as in Certificates/Mark sheets/Identity proof
  • No change possible after clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' button
  • Photo must be uploaded at place of photo and signature at place of signature
  • If photo not uploaded properly, admission for examination will be rejected/denied
  • For any problem, use "Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism" at https://cgrs.ibps.in/
  • Mention "NABARD – Recruitment of Young Professionals" in subject of email

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty

  • Do not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Using unfair means will lead to disqualification
  • Impersonating or procuring impersonation will lead to criminal prosecution
  • Misbehaving in examination/interview hall will lead to disqualification
  • Carrying mobile phones or electronic devices in examination/interview hall not allowed
  • May be debarred permanently or for specified period from any examination conducted by bank
  • If already joined, services may be terminated

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization ITI Limited (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
Department Corporate Office & Various Units of ITI Limited
Exam Name Young Professional Recruitment 2026
Post Young Professional – Graduate / Technician / Operator / Generalist / Official Language
Total Vacancies 215 Posts
Mode of Application Online
Registration Dates From advertisement date (22-12-2025) to 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs)
Educational Qualification BE/B.Tech/MBA/PG/ Diploma/ITI/Graduation depending on post and domain
Age Limit Upper age limit generally 35 years for YP Technician/Generalist; internal candidates relaxation up to 45 years
Selection Process Shortlisting + GD & PI for Graduates; Shortlisting + Skill Test for Technicians & Operators
Official Website itiltd.in

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification from ITI Limited specifies the advertisement date and the last date for receipt of online applications. Candidates should strictly adhere to the application deadline and regularly visit the official website for any corrigendum or addendum regarding the schedule.

Event Date
Notification Release Date 22-12-2025 (Advertisement Ref No. ITI/CRP/HR/2025/1534)
Apply Online Starts 22-12-2025 (from publication of notification)
Last Date to Apply Online 12-01-2026 (up to 23:59 hrs)
Last Date to Pay Application Fee Not specified (no fee mentioned)
Correction Window Not mentioned in notification
Admit Card Release To be intimated via email/official website (if applicable)
Examination / GD-PI / Skill Test Date To be notified to shortlisted candidates
Result Declaration To be notified on official website/email
Document Verification/Interview As per schedule communicated by ITI Limited
Final Selection List To be published/communicated by ITI Limited

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

ITI Limited has announced a total of 215 Young Professional vacancies across multiple domains including Projects, Project Management, IS & IT, Computer Lab/Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, Production/Manufacturing, HR, Marketing, Finance and Hindi Cell. The posts are further classified as Young Professional – Graduate, Young Professional – Technician, Young Professional – Operator, YP Generalist (HR/Marketing/Finance) and YP – Official Language, with domain-wise distribution as given below.

Domain / Area Post Total Vacancies
Projects YP – Graduate (Projects) 20
Projects YP – Technician (Projects) 19
Projects YP – Operator (Projects) 12
YP – Project Management YP – Graduate (Project Management) 4
IS & IT YP – Graduate (IS&IT) 2
IS & IT YP – Technician (IS&IT) 2
Computer Lab YP – Graduate (Comp. Lab) 2
Computer Lab / Production Various Graduate/Technician roles (Chemistry/Chemical Engg/Testing) 14 (10 + 2 + 2) combined

Marketing YP – Generalist (Marketing) 10

Reservation, if any, and detailed breakup of vacancies by category are to be inferred as per ITI Limited policies and Government of India guidelines, though category-wise numbers are not explicitly mentioned in the notification. Posting locations include Leh/Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Bareilly, Kolkata, Tezpur, Bharatpur/Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, West Bengal, North Eastern states, Bengaluru, Palakkad, Mankapur, Rae Bareli, Naini, Delhi, Lucknow, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and Ahmedabad among others as indicated in Table-B.

Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Only Indian Nationals with qualifications from recognized universities/institutes (AICTE/UGC/other statutory authorities) are eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various Young Professional categories and domains are summarised below.

For YP – Graduate (Projects):
BE/B.Tech in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil or MCA/M.Sc. (Electronics/CS/IT) from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Technician (Projects):
Diploma in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Projects):
ITI Trade Certificate in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Graduate (Project Management):
MBA in Project Management/Operations Management or M.Sc. in Project Management from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Graduate (IS & IT):
Essential: BE/B.Tech in IT/CS/ECE/EEE or MCA/M.Sc. (IT/CS) from a recognised University/Institute; desirable skills include proficiency in PHP/Python/Java, HTML/CSS/JS, MySQL/PostgreSQL and Linux server environment.

For YP – Technician (IS & IT):
Essential: B.Sc (IT)/BCA/Diploma in CS from a recognised University/Institute; desirable knowledge of network fundamentals, VPN, firewall basics, Linux/Windows systems and end-user support.

For YP – Graduate (Comp. Lab):
BE/B.Tech in IT/CS from a recognised University/Institute.

For Comp. Lab/Production (Graduate/Technician roles):
- B.Sc in Chemistry or Diploma in Chemical Engineering with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience in conformal coating, OR Diploma in CS/Electronics with minimum 2 years’ experience in testing/measurement systems as specified.

For YP – Operator (Computer Lab/Production):
ITI Trade Certificate in Electronics/Electronic Mechanic with minimum 2 years’ experience and VSSC Soldering School certification; or ITI Fitter with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.

For YP – Graduate (TSTL):
BE/B.Tech in ECE/CS/Telecommunications or MCA/M.Sc.(CS/IT)/M.Sc. Cybersecurity from a recognised University/Institute with minimum 2–5 years post-qualification experience (depending on slot) and industry-recognised certifications in IT/Telecom Security Testing desirable.

For YP – Technician (Production/Manufacturing):
Diploma in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Production/Manufacturing):
ITI Trade Certificate in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical/Fitter from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Generalist (HR):
Any Degree from a recognised University with mandatory knowledge of computer and applications.

For YP – Graduate (Marketing):
Any Degree with MBA in Marketing from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Generalist (Marketing):

Age Limit 

Candidates applying for Young Professional posts must satisfy the prescribed upper age limits as on the date of advertisement, with relaxations for internal candidates as per ITI rules. Internal candidates with relevant experience are eligible for age relaxation up to a maximum of 45 years, while general upper age limit for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist is indicated as 35 years in Table-A.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

ITI Young Professional Salary 2025-26

Candidates selected as Young Professionals in ITI Limited will receive consolidated monthly remuneration as per Table-A of the notification without additional allowances like DA, accommodation, medical reimbursement etc. In case of posting in tough locations, Young Professionals will be entitled to benefits under ITI’s Tough Location Policy in addition to the consolidated pay.

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 through the official website within the specified timeline. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted and incomplete applications are liable to be rejected.

  4. Click on the application link / application format available under the notification and start filling the online form.
  5. Enter personal details, educational qualifications, experience details, and select your preferred initial posting locations as per instructions.
  6. Provide a valid email ID and mobile number as all important communication will be sent through email only.
  7. Upload required documents/certificates in legible form as per the prescribed format and size.
  8. Verify all details carefully before final submission; only the latest application will be considered if multiple are submitted.
  9. Submit the online application on or before 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).
  10. Keep a copy/print of the submitted application and email acknowledgements for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Q2. What is the age limit for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Company Name Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA)

Salary Medical Officer: Rs. 1,00,000/-; Physician/Anesthesiologist/Orthopaedician/Gynecologist: Rs. 1,15,000/-; Dietician/Biomedical Engineer: Rs. 60,000/- per month (consolidated, up to).
Qualification MBBS with experience for Medical Officer; MD/Diploma with specified experience for Physician/Anesthesiologist/Orthopaedician/Gynecologist; B.Sc./Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics; relevant technical qualification for Biomedical Engineer as per advertisement.

JNPA Medical Officers & Specialist Posts Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Min Age Max Age No. of Posts Consolidated Remuneration per month
Medical Officers 25 years 45 years 2 Rs. 1,00,000/-
Physician 25 years 45 years 1 Rs. 1,15,000/-

Gynecologist 25 years 45 years 1 Rs. 1,15,000/-
Dietician 25 years 45 years 1 Rs. 60,000/-
Biomedical Engineer 25 years 45 years 1 Rs. 60,000/-

Eligibility Criteria

  • Medical Officer (02 posts): Essential: MBBS degree from recognized University; (2) One year experience in Hospital after completion of one-year internship. Desirable: A post graduate medical degree from a recognized University.
  • Physician: Essential: MD General Medicine from recognized University; (2) Post-qualification experience of three years in reputed hospital in the relevant field of specialization.
  • Anesthesiologist: Essential: MD Anaesthesia from recognized University with minimum three years’ experience; OR (2) Diploma in Anaesthesia with minimum five years’ experience.
  • Orthopaedician: Essential: MS Orthopaedics from recognized University with minimum three years’ experience; OR (2) Diploma in Orthopaedics with minimum five years’ experience.
  • Gynecologist: Essential: MD Obstetrics & Gynecology from recognized University with minimum three years’ experience; OR (2) Diploma in Gynecology with minimum five years’ experience.
  • Dietician: Essential:  B.Sc./Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics or equivalent qualification from recognized University/Institution.
  • Biomedical Engineer: Essential: As printed in the PDF: B.Sc./Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics or equivalent qualification from recognized University/Institution (noted as such in the advertisement text).
  • Cut-off date for age, qualifications and experience is 01 December 2025.
  • Candidates must possess the essential qualifications mentioned against the post; candidates not possessing certificate of essential qualifications will not be eligible.

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Officers: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,00,000/-.
  • Physician: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Anesthesiologist: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Orthopaedician: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Gynecologist: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 1,15,000/-.
  • Dietician: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 60,000/-.
  • Biomedical Engineer: Consolidated gross monthly remuneration up to Rs. 60,000/-.
  • Remuneration is subject to tax deducted at source; no other financial benefits will be admissible, and monthly remuneration will be based on day-to-day attendance certified by Head of Department/Hospital-in-charge.

Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 25 years for all advertised posts.
  • Maximum age: 45 years for all advertised posts.
  • No age, qualification or experience relaxation will be provided to any candidate, except that age or experience norms may be relaxed for deserving candidates who: (1) Belong to local Project Affected Persons (PAP) families of Jawaharlal Nehru Port Project, (2) Have valid Jawaharlal Nehru Port PAP certificate in their own name issued by competent authority, and (3) Provide a self-declaration, subject to scrutiny, that is found correct. No relaxation is permitted in essential educational qualification criteria.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date
Cut-off date for age, qualifications and experience 01/12/2025
Last date for receipt of applications 13/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of performance in one or more rounds of trade test and/or oral interview, experience, additional qualifications etc.
  • Selection of shortlisted candidates will be subject to verification of required documents in original as indicated in the advertisement.
  • Non-submission of requisite documents during verification will disqualify candidature from further participation; if documents do not meet prescribed criteria, candidature will not be considered further.
  • JNPA reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for the selection process, by short-listing with reference to qualifications, age, relevant experience etc.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications shall be accepted only by post/speed post/registered post/courier during working hours; the envelope must clearly mention “Application for the post of ___(Mention the post name)___”.
  • Applications should reach on or before 13/01/2026 to: Deputy General Manager (P&IR) I/c, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai – 400707.
  • Along with application, details must be given in prescribed format, with self-attested photocopies of proof of age, qualifications, experience, training, caste, PWD certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge book (as applicable) and a passport size photograph.
  • A valid local Jawaharlal Nehru Port Project Affected Persons candidate will be given preference in selection process, subject to fulfillment of essential criteria.
  • List of documents to attach and produce at verification includes: proof of date of birth; proof of nationality; mark-sheets and certificates of educational qualifications and other eligibility documents; experience certificates on company letterhead; APARs/experience/service certificates; disability certificate where applicable.
  • Applicants should be of sound health and meet medical standards; engagement is subject to fitness certificate/medical report from Government recognized reputed Hospital.
  • If at any stage it is found that a candidate does not fulfill eligibility criteria or has furnished incorrect/false information or suppressed material facts, candidature will be cancelled; if detected after joining, services are liable to be terminated and candidate debarred from future JNPA recruitments.
  • JNPA does not assume responsibility for applications received after last date; such applications will be rejected without reasons.
  • Candidates must clearly mention valid mobile number and email address in application for correspondence; no other mode of correspondence will be accepted.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSUs must produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview/verification; selected candidates must produce unconditional relieving letter at joining.
  • No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in interview/document verification.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness and service/conduct rules of JNPA; JNPA decisions on eligibility, number of posts, conduct of tests and selection are final.
  • Any legal proceedings will be instituted only in Mumbai; courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai shall have sole jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by terms and conditions of service and other regulations of JNPA in force; no claim for benefits at par with regular employees except as explicitly provided will be entertained.
  • JNPA reserves the right to cancel the recruitment exercise at any stage without assigning reasons; in case of discrepancies, detailed advertisement/corrigendum on JNPA website Career section shall be final; canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted only by post/speed post/registered post/courier in working hours.
  • On the envelope, candidates must clearly mention “Application for the post of ___(Mention the post name)___”.
  • Applications should reach the Deputy General Manager (P&IR) I/c, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai – 400707, on or before 13/01/2026.
  • Applicants must use the prescribed proforma, providing full personal details, address, contact numbers, present employment details, date of birth, age as on 01/12/2025, category, educational qualifications, and details of employment/experience in chronological order.
  • Self-attested photocopies of all required documents must be attached; originals must be produced at the time of verification, failing which candidature will be cancelled.

Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
Age Limit UR/EWS: 28 years, OBC (NCL): 31 years, SC/ST: 33 years; relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL & 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.

CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Company Location of HQ with State Number of Training Slots

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

(Science) with prescribed experience as Laboratory Attendant (1 year or 2 years depending on service condition) and passing of Trade Test, with mandatory computer qualification (DOEACC CCC/O/A/B/C or MS-CIT/GECT or other Govt.-approved course) and SSC/Equivalent Marathi language requirement.
Age Limit No specific age limits are mentioned in the notification; service seniority and departmental rules apply.

Application End Date 09/01/2026
Application Mode Offline – through proper channel from concerned department/establishment, submitted to the office of Pramukh Vaidhakiya Adhikari, Seth A.J.B. Hospital.

BMC Laboratory Assistant 2025 Vacancy Details

The notification invites applications for 1 post of Prayogshala Sahayak (Laboratory Assistant) in the establishment of Seth A.J.B. Municipal Ear, Nose & Throat Hospital under Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation. This is an “Ekaki” (single) post in Group ‘C’, and as per circular MBC/1259 dated 13.04.2004 (Amendment 8, clause 3(1)(gha)), reservation does not apply to this isolated post.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • The candidate must be a B.Sc. (Science) graduate in a subject as specified (ravidnyan shakhichi B.Sc.) from a recognized institution.
  • He/She must be working as Laboratory Attendant (Prayogshala Parichar) in the establishments of:
    – Major Municipal Hospitals,
    – New & Medical Colleges,
    – Public Health Departments,
    – Pr. V.A. (Kha.Pra.Ma.A.Se.) and Pr. V.A. (Rav.Ru.) as specified in the notification.
  • For B.Sc. degree holders – at least 1 year of service as Laboratory Attendant is required.
    Otherwise (if not B.Sc. Science branch as above) – 2 years of service as Laboratory Attendant is required, as per approved rules.
  • Candidates must pass the departmental Vyavsay Chachani (Trade Test) conducted for the post of Prayogshala Sahayak.
  • Computer qualification: Candidate must possess DOEACC Society’s CCC / O Level / A Level / B Level / C Level certificate OR Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education MS-CIT OR GE.C.T. certificate OR any other government-approved course in computer handling/usage of at least 2 years as per Government orders.
  • Language: Candidate must have passed Secondary School Certificate (SSC) or equivalent with Marathi (50 marks question paper) as higher/lower level, and must be able to read, write and speak Marathi. Note: Those appointed before 06.11.2009 must be able to read, write and speak Marathi even without SSC language paper condition as per note.

2. Experience

  • Service in the cadre of Laboratory Attendant (Prayogshala Parichar) in the concerned BMC establishments as per the approved note:
    – 1 year post for B.Sc. Science branch degree holders, OR
    – 2 years for others as Laboratory Attendant.
  • Experience must be duly verified from the service record and certified by the concerned department head and service record officer.

3. Disability Criteria (Divyang Reservation Matrix)

  • The notification includes a Divyang post suitability table mentioning physical requirements such as sitting, standing, walking, bending, finger manipulation, reading/writing, seeing, hearing and communication, and Divyang categories like Deaf/Hard of Hearing, One Arm/One Leg/Both Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness and Multiple Disabilities.
  • It clarifies that Divyang candidates who can perform the duties of Laboratory Assistant (test sample handling, record-keeping, coordinating laboratory work and assisting laboratory technologists) as per the specified physical criteria may apply. However, this is an isolated post and reservation benefit does not apply; Divyang candidates will be considered as general if otherwise eligible.

Selection Process

  • The selection will be based on a Vyavsay Chachani (Trade Test), which is only a qualifying test.
  • Applications received through proper channel will be scrutinized, and eligible candidates will be called for Trade Test as per departmental schedule.
  • Candidates who qualify the Trade Test will be placed before a Selection Committee, which will consider:
    – Confidential Reports (Gopaniya Ahwal) of last 5 years,
    – Service record, inquiry reports and other documents,
    – Seniority in service (Sevajyeshtha) determined from date of entry into service and cadre as per circular MPM/03/2781 dated 07.04.2010 and related instructions.
  • Final selection will be made strictly on service seniority amongst Trade Test qualified candidates, and appointment orders will be issued as per committee’s recommendations.
  • If two or more candidates have the same date of entry and equal seniority, tie-breaking will be done by:
    – Giving preference to the candidate senior in age (higher date of birth priority),
    – If date of birth is also same, preference will be decided on the alphabetical order of the initial letter of the surname.

Application Fee

  • No application fee has been mentioned in the notification for the post of Prayogshala Sahayak.

How To Apply

  • Only eligible in-service BMC employees working as Laboratory Attendant in specified hospitals/colleges/departments may apply in the prescribed departmental format attached with the notification.
  • Applications must be filled legibly in Marathi with the candidate’s own handwriting and signed clearly.
  • Candidates must route their applications through their concerned department/ward head and Service Record Officer (Seva-abhilekh) as per rules.
  • Service details must be verified and certified; the application should bear the inward/outward number of the department and be forwarded to:
    Pramukh Vaidhakiya Adhikari, Seth A.J.B. Mahanagarpalika Kan Nak Ghsa Rugnalay, Prashaskiye Karyalaya, 7, Mahatma (Phule) Marg, Fort, Mumbai – 400001.
  • Applications must reach the office from 22.12.2025 to 09.01.2026 during working hours only.
  • Applications received before or after this period, applications sent by Speed Post, ordinary post, tapal or courier directly, incomplete applications, applications not as per prescribed format, or without the employee’s signature will not be accepted.
  • Candidates must attach the following attested documents with their application:
    – Service verification in prescribed Form-B (two copies),
    – Inquiry certificates based on service record and SAP system,
    – Confidential reports of last 5 years,
    – Caste certificate & Caste Validity Certificate where applicable,
    – Non-Creamy Layer certificate/validity as applicable,
    – Pay slips/pay fixation order & Municipal ID card,
    – Initial appointment order in BMC service,
    – Marriage registration and Gazette notification for name change (if applicable),
    – SSC or equivalent marksheet and certificate for those appointed after 2009 to prove Marathi language qualification,
    – Computer qualification certificates (DOEACC/MS-CIT/GECT/other approved).
  • Original certificates must be produced at the time of document verification; absence of originals will render the candidate ineligible for Trade Test and selection.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 17/12/2025
Start date for receipt of applications 22/12/2025 (during office hours)
Last date for receipt of applications 09/01/2026 (during office hours)
Document Verification Date & Time 19/01/2026, 11:00 am to 4:00 pm at Seth A.J.B. Municipal ENT Hospital
Trade Test Date & Time To be notified separately; candidates must attend at their own cost

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Prayogshala Sahayak is in revised pay scale M-13, Rs. 21,700 – 69,000/- as sanctioned by BMC orders.
  • Other allowances and benefits will be admissible as per Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation service rules and applicable government norms for Group ‘C’ posts.

Instructions

  • This recruitment is strictly departmental and limited to in-service BMC staff working as Laboratory Attendant in specified health establishments.
  • Backward category employees who have already availed reservation earlier or are shown as “adhik sankhya” (excess) or whose category change is under process must submit valid Caste and Caste Validity Certificates along with Non-Creamy Layer certificates as applicable; otherwise, their applications will not be considered.
  • All eligible candidates (including backward category) will be considered in general merit list for this isolated post; reservation is not applicable, but category must be correctly mentioned for record purposes.
  • Candidates appointed in Group ‘D’ and later promoted to Group ‘C’ posts must pass compulsory computer examination within 2 years from appointment; otherwise, they may be reverted to original post as per circular MPM/2/3221 dated 14.11.2014.
  • Candidates under departmental inquiry, preliminary inquiry, or suspension will not be considered for appointment until such proceedings are cleared.
  • Selected candidates for Prayogshala Sahayak must submit an application within 2 years from selection date for reversion to original post in case they do not wish to continue; otherwise, their rights to original post will lapse.
  • Applications received under this recruitment process will be considered only for this selection; future vacancies will require fresh recruitment/notification.
  • Waiting list (Pratiksha Yadi), if prepared, will remain valid for 2 years; after that, it will lapse automatically.
  • The administration reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • All department/establishment heads must display this notification prominently on office notice boards and give it wide publicity among eligible staff.

  • Question paper will be available both in Hindi & English. However, in case of any error in Hindi version the English version of the question shall be valid & final.
  • Candidates are required to appear in the Computer Based Online Test at their own expenses and if shortlisted in the Computer Based Online Test as per the criteria, they will be called for Personal Interview as per their merit in the ratio of 1:6 (6 candidates against 1 vacancy in respective category) keeping in view the provision of reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/EWS.

  • Application fee will be paid through Online mode only. There will be no other mode of payment of application fee.
  • MOIL will not be responsible, in case a candidate deposits the fee in any wrong account. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are therefore advised to verify their eligibility before applying.

How To Apply

  3. Fill in all personal, educational, and other details accurately in the application form. Verify all information before proceeding to upload documents.
  4. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration following the guidelines provided. Ensure all uploads meet the size and format requirements.
  5. Proceed to the payment section if applicable, and make the fee payment using Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or other modes. Wait for confirmation and generate the e-Receipt.
  6. Review the entire application in the Preview tab and make any necessary changes. Click on Final Submit only after ensuring all details are correct.
  7. Download and print the application form and e-Receipt for your records. Keep your registration details safe for future reference.
  8. Monitor your email and the MOIL website for updates on admit cards, test dates, and further instructions.

Further, if a candidate conveys his/her unwillingness to join after the issue of offer of appointment, he/she would be debarred for a period of two years from the date of offer of appointment for being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE other than the one to which the candidate belongs.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

    • Women candidates: Additional relaxation as per norms

Category Application Fee
General/Unreserved/OBC/Other Categories Rs. 1,000/-

Event Date

Online Application Last Date (Clerk-Typist & Accounts Clerk) 19/05/2025, up to 11:55 PM
Exam Fee Payment Last Date Same as application closing date
Exam Date Will be notified 7 days before exam on official website
Admit Card Release Date Will be available on NMMC website

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Computer-based test covering general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, technical subjects related to the post, and Marathi language
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in written test will be called for document verification. Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Personal Interview/Skill Test: For technical and specialist posts, candidates may have to appear for personal interview and/or skill test
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness test as per NMMC norms
  • Final Merit List: Final selection will be based on performance in written test, interview (if applicable) and document verification
  • Typing Test: For Clerk-Typist and similar posts, typing test in Marathi and English will be conducted

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the official notification carefully before applying
  • Only online applications through the official website www.nmmc.gov.in will be accepted
  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be active during the entire recruitment process
  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be rejected
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • NMMC reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage
  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply unless otherwise specified
  • Candidates already employed in government/semi-government organizations must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period as per NMMC rules
  • The decision of NMMC in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation at www.nmmc.gov.in
  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete

Candidates must possess the following educational qualification to apply for MRVC Drawing & Design Engineer (S&T) positions:

  • BE/B.Tech in Electronics & Communication / Electronics / Electrical / Mechanical / Computer Science Engineering from a recognized institution or equivalent; OR
  • Diploma in Electronics & Communication / Electrical / Mechanical / Computer Science Engineering from a recognized institution or equivalent.

2. Essential Experience

  • Minimum Post Qualification Experience:
    • For Degree holders: Minimum 4 years in Railway Signalling.
    • For Diploma holders: Minimum 7 years in Railway Signalling.
  • Definition of Railway Signalling: Execution/supervision/preparation of any Railway Signalling work which may/may not include drawing work.
  • Relevant Post Qualification Experience: At least 2 years (for Degree holders) and 4 years (for Diploma holders) experience of Designing Railway Signalling Drawings with Project Management Consultants or General Consultant or Construction Agency and/or with Signalling Contractors for Electronic/Relay Interlocking and/or with OEMs of Electronic Interlocking system either individually or combined.
  • Designing Railway Signalling: Includes preparation of Signal Interlocking Plan, Selection Table, Circuit Diagrams or any other drawings related to Railway Signalling.
  • Candidates having software skills such as Auto CAD and MS Office shall be preferred.

3. Age Limit

The age limit for MRVC Drawing & Design Engineer (S&T) Recruitment 2026 is as follows:

  • Maximum Age: Upper age should not exceed 35 years as on the date of issue of Vacancy Notification.

4. Nationality

Nationality criteria are not specifically mentioned in the notification; candidates must refer to the official notification and MRVC norms, if any, for detailed clarification.

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, only the eligible candidate(s) will be called for document verification and interaction.

  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC, and such candidates may be engaged as per project requirements within the validity of the panel.
  • The posts notified are not regular establishment posts and the selected candidates shall not be absorbed in MRVC regular service.

Important Dates

Online Registration Of Application & Payment Of Fees: From 03 January 2026
Online Registration Of Application & Payment Of Fees: To 23 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting & Interview followed by CTC Negotiation

General Information / Instructions

  1. The process of Registration is complete only when fee is deposited with the Bank through online mode on or before the last date for payment of fee / last date of online registrations.
  2. Before applying, candidates are requested to ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria for the Post(s) as on the date of eligibility.
  3. Candidates are required to upload all relevant documents including their resume, ID proof, age proof, Caste certificate, PwBD Certificate (if applicable), educational qualifications certifications, experience details, Biodata etc., failing which their application/candidature will not be considered for shortlisting/ interview.
  4. The process of Short-listing will be provisional and without verification of original documents. Candidature will be subject to verification of all details/ documents with the original when a candidate reports for interview (if called).
  5. In case a candidate is called for interview and is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification and Experience etc.) he/ she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled for reimbursement of any travelling expenses.
  6. Candidates are advised to check Bank's official website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings regularly for details and updates (including the list of shortlisted/ selected candidates). The Call (letter/ advice), where required, will be sent by e-mail only (NO HARD COPY WILL BE SENT).
  7. ALL REVISIONS/ CORRIGENDUM (IF ANY) WILL BE HOSTED ON THE BANK'S WEBSITE ONLY.
  8. In case more than one candidate scores same marks as cut-off marks in the final merit list (common marks at cut-off point), such candidates will be ranked in the merit according to their age in descending order.
  9. Hard copy of application & other documents need not to be sent to this office.
  10. TEACHING & TRAINING EXPERIENCE WILL NOT BE COUNTED FOR ELIGIBILITY.
  11. Mere fulfilment of the eligibility criteria (i.e. minimum required qualifications and experiences) shall not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and thereafter, adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank will be shortlisted and called for interview. the decision of the Bank to call the candidates for the interview shall be final. no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  12. Candidates against whom there is / are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude etc. are not eligible to apply for the post. If any such adverse orders / reports against the shortlisted/ selected candidates is found/ received by the Bank post their selection, their candidature/ service will be rejected forthwith.
  13. At the time of interview, the candidate will be required to provide details regarding criminal case(s) pending against him/ her, if any. The Bank may also conduct independent verification, inter alia, including verification of police records etc. The Bank reserves the right to deny appointment depending upon such disclosures and/ or independent verification.
  14. Candidates furnishing false information / suppressing the facts will be disqualified and shall be liable for debarment and legal/criminal action. Candidates who attempt fraud/impersonation shall be liable to be debarred from future recruitment process conducted by the Bank
  15. Candidates serving in Govt./ Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions and SBI Group companies are advised to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview, failing which their candidature may not be considered and travelling expenses, if any, otherwise admissible, will not be paid.

How to Apply

  • Candidates will be required to register themselves online through the link available on SBI website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and pay the application fee using Internet Banking/ Debit Card/ Credit Card etc.
  • Candidates should first scan their latest photograph and signature. Online application will not be registered unless candidate uploads his/ her photo and signature as specified on the online registration page (under 'How to Upload Documents').
  • Candidates should fill the application carefully. Once application is filled-in completely, candidate should submit the same. In the event of candidate not being able to fill the application in one go, he can save the information already entered. When the information/ application is saved, a provisional registration number and password is generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the registration number and password. They can re-open the saved application using registration number and password and edit the particulars, if needed. This facility of editing the saved information will be available for three times only. Once the application is filled completely, candidate should submit the same and proceed for online payment of fee.
  • After registering online, the candidates are advised to take a printout of the system generated online application forms.
  • Candidates seeking Age relaxation are required to submit copies of necessary certificates at the time of joining. No change in category of any candidate is permitted after registration of online application.
  • Login to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
  • Scroll down and click on the respective advertisement.
  • Download advertisement no. CRPD/SCO/2025-26/19 (Carefully read the detailed advertisement)
  • Apply Online (Before final submission, please go through your application. Corrections will not be allowed after final submission)

Eligibility Criteria

  • i. MBBS from an institution recognized by National Medical Council/Medical Council of India /Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • ii. Post-Graduation degree (MD/DNB, or equivalent) in relevant discipline from an institution recognised by National Medical Council/Medical Council of India/National Board of Examinations.
  • iii. A Super-Speciality Degree (DM/DNB or equivalent, as applicable) in concerned Super-speciality from an institution recognised by MCI/NMC/NBEiMS.
  • iv. Should be registered with National Medical Council /Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • i. A recognized MBBS degree qualification included in the First Schedule or Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of Educational qualifications included in Part II of the Third Schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in subsection (3) of section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956.
  • ii. Completion of compulsory rotating internship.
  • iii. Should be registered with National Medical Council / Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • i. MBBS from an institution recognized by National Medical Council/Medical Council of India / Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • ii. Post-Graduation Diploma / Degree (MD/MS/DNB) in relevant discipline from an institution recognised by National Medical Council/Medical Council of India/National Board of Examinations.
  • iii. Should be registered with National Medical Council / Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • i. MBBS from an institution recognized by National Medical Council/Medical Council of India/ Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • ii. Post-Graduation Diploma or Degree (MD/MS/DNB, or equivalent) in Critical Care Medicine (In case no candidate appeared in the above speciality, candidate having MD in Anaesthesia / Internal Medicine / Respiratory Medicine or equivalent, or Diploma in relevant discipline having at least 1 year Fellowship in Critical Care Medicine may be considered) from an institution recognised by National Medical Council/Medical Council of India/National Board of Examinations.
  • iii. Should be registered with National Medical Council / Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • i. MBBS from an institution recognized by National Medical Council/MCI/ Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • ii. Post-Graduation Diploma / Degree (MD/MS/DNB) in relevant discipline from an institution recognised by National Medical Council /Medical Council of India, National Board of Examinations.
  • iii. Should be registered with National Medical Council / Maharashtra Medical Council.
  • iv. However, if Post Graduate or Diploma doctors are not available, MBBS doctors without PG Degree with two years of experience out of which 1 year of experience in the concerned specialty from government hospital / private hospital, (Not a Private Clinic) may be appointed for 01 year, as Senior Resident - 1 Year on contract basis.
  • i. BDS from an institution recognized by Dental Council.
  • ii. Post-Graduation Degree in Endodontist or Orthodontist or equivalent) from an institution recognized by Dental Council.
  • iii. Should be registered with Dental Council.
  • 2 (two) years' experience after acquiring Super-speciality Degree.
  • Not essential
  • PG Degree or equivalent in concerned specialty from Recognized University With 3 (three) years' experience after acquiring PG Degree. OR minimum of 5 (Five) years' experience in the concerned specialty after acquiring PG Diploma.

Salary / Stipend

  • ESIC has adopted Consolidated Remuneration structure for Contractual Doctor as per ESIC Headquarters Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt.File), dated 13.04.2022 and subsequent instructions /modifications on the matter from time to time. Full Time: Rs. 2,00,000/- (Consolidated remuneration) Part Time: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for 16 hours per week (4 hours per day for 4 days in a week). Additional Rs. 20,000/- Charges for Emergency visit. Additional Rs. 1,200/- for every additional hour beyond 16 hrs/week. (The additional hour of work shall be subject to approval by MS/Dean).
  • Level -10 of Pay Matrix 7th CPC (Rs. 56,100/- plus allowances as admissible per month)
  • Full Time: Full time Specialist will be paid in the Level-11 of Rs.67,700/- plus other allowances (DA,HRA,NPA,TA,etc.) as envisaged in ESIC Headquarters Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV(Pt.File), dated 13.04.2022; Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI, dated 08.12.2022 and subsequent instructions/modifications on the matter from time to time. Part Time: Rs. 60,000/- per month for 16 hours per week (4 hours per day for 4 days in a week). Additional Rs. 15,000/- Charges for Emergency visit. Additional Rs. 800/- for every additional hour beyond 16 hrs/week. (The additional hour of work shall be subject to approval by MS/Dean).
  • The Senior Residents will be paid in the Pay Band 3, Level-11 of Rs. 67,700.00 plus other allowances (DA, HRA, NPA, TA, etc.) as applicable under Govt. Of India.
