Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on performance in the interview before the Selection Board.

General Information / Instructions

1. Only candidates who meet all eligibility criteria are invited to appear for the walk-in interview on the dates specified above.
2. Applicants are advised to carefully ensure they meet the eligibility requirements before applying. They must satisfy all criteria as of the date of the interview, including age criteria as of the date of advertisement.
3. Only candidates whose documents are verified and found eligible will be permitted to attend the walk-in interview.
4. Any changes to the interview schedule or related information will be notified only on the official ESIC website: https://bibyewadihospital.esic.gov.in. Candidates are advised to regularly check the website for updates.
5. ESIC Hospital reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel the number of posts advertised or the interview itself, at its discretion and without assigning any reason.
In case an insufficient number of candidates or no candidate appears for the interview in any particular speciality/post on the scheduled date, the walk-in interviews will continue to be held on subsequent Fridays, i.e., 23rd January 2026, 30th January 2026 and 06 February 2026, subject to the availability of vacancies. Updates regarding the conduct of these interviews will be published on the official websites: https://bibvewadihospital.esic.gov.in, https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments
No separate newspaper advertisement will be issued for these subsequent interviews. Please note that the interviews on 23rd January 2026, 30th January 2026 and 06 February 2026, will be held only if vacancies remain unfilled due to non-attendance, non-selection, or non-joining of suitable candidates.
1. Nature of Appointment: Recruitment is purely on a contractual basis. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of service in the hospital.
2. Selection Procedure:
a) Applications submitted on the day of the walk-in interview will be scrutinized by the authorized officer(s)/scrutiny committee. Only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear before the selection committee. If the number of applicants is large, the hospital may introduce shortlisting criteria, including a screening test, at its discretion.
b) Selection will be based on performance in the interview before the Selection Board.
c) The decision of the Recruiting Authority of the ESIC Hospital shall be final and binding. No further correspondence will be entertained.
d) Results will be published at https://bibvewadihospital.esic.gov.in / www.esic.gov.in/recruitments
e) Selected candidates must join within 7 days from the date of the Offer of Appointment.
3. Application Fee and Mode of Payment
a) Payment by any other mode will not be accepted.
b) Payment of interview fee is mandatory to appear for the walk-in interview.
c) Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
4. Candidates can apply for only one post at a time, except for Emergency Medicine and ICU specialities. Separate application forms must be submitted.
5. Mere submission of an application does not entitle a candidate to appear for the interview unless present at the scheduled date and time.
6. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format (Annexure-A). Incomplete or incorrectly formatted applications will be rejected.
7. Candidates must ascertain their eligibility and report at the scheduled time. Latecomers will not be allowed.
8. ESIC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage, and its decision shall be binding.
9. Permission to attend the interview is provisional and subject to verification of eligibility and documents.
10. Selected contractual doctors must sign a Contract Agreement on a Rs. 500/- stamp paper, purchased by the candidate.
11. All selected candidates must have a professional indemnity policy for the contract duration:
* Minimum sum assured: Rs. 10 Lakhs (General Medicine, Radiology, Anaesthesia, etc.)
* Rs. 20 Lakhs (Ophthalmology, ENT, Surgery, OBGY, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, etc.)
12. Private practice is not permitted for Medical Officers, Senior Residents, and Full-Time Specialists/Super Specialists on contract.
13. Candidates must appear for the interview with original documents and self-attested copies supporting their Date of Birth, Education, Experience, Caste, Non-Creamy Layer (OBC), etc., along with duly filled Annexure-A, one hour before interview time.
14. Offer of appointment will be issued based on hospital requirements at ESIC's discretion.
15. Candidates must join duty within 7 days from the date of the offer.
16. Selection is subject to medical fitness.
17. No accommodation will be provided by ESIC.
18. Security Deposit (for Medical Officers, SRs, and Full-Time Specialists/Super Specialists): Rs. 15,000/- Demand Draft in favour of 'ESI Fund A/c No. 1', payable at Pune, to be submitted at joining. Refunded (without interest) after successful completion, subject to performance. Forfeited in case of resignation without notice or misconduct.
19. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining.
20. PWD candidates will be adjusted against vacancies in their respective categories (SC/ST/OBC/UR).
21. The decision of the selection board is final. No correspondence will be entertained.
22. Candidates who have already completed 3 years as Senior Residents under Central Residency Scheme are not eligible for Senior Resident posts on contract under the 3-Year Scheme.
23. Reservation and age relaxation will be as per Central Government Rules.
24. Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation under SC/ST/OBC/PWD must ensure eligibility and provide certificates in the prescribed format. OBC candidates must provide a non-creamy layer certificate per Govt. of India DOPT O.M. No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 15.11.1993.
25. OBC candidates must submit a certificate as per DOPT O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt (Res) dated 30.05.2014. Failure to do so will result in consideration under the General category.
26. Posts reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS may be filled from other categories if suitable candidates are not available, for a 39-day contract (extendable for another 39 days or until regular appointment, whichever is earlier).
27. Service rendered by Senior Residents in ESIC will be considered as bonded service in Maharashtra per State Govt. decision No. MED/1013/Admin No.101/13/Edu-2 dated 31.01.2014.
28. Contractual doctors are eligible for leaves as per ESIC guidelines.
29. No claim for benefits like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowances, Seniority, Promotion, etc., will be admissible.
30. Candidates must be registered with the NMC/MCI/ Maharashtra Medical Council, as applicable, before joining.
31. Candidates in government service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview. Already employed candidates must produce a Relieving Order/NOC from their previous employer at the time of joining.
32. Selected candidates must submit a written acceptance/consent before the medical examination.
33. Contractual doctors found guilty of gross misconduct or negligence may be terminated without notice.
34. Absence for 15 days without permission will be treated as voluntary abandonment and lead to automatic termination.
35. Attendance must be marked manually and via Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS).
36. Duties include emergency, ward, clinical, outreach programs, health promotion & prevention programs and floor /shift duties as assigned.
37. Doctors may be assigned to other departments based on hospital needs.
38. If a selected candidate fails to join on time or resigns within 3 months, a waitlisted candidate may be offered the post. The waiting list is valid for 6 months.
39. Wrong declarations or submission of false information will lead to cancellation of candidature and legal action.
40. Documents Required for Verification (at the time of Walk-in Interview) Candidates must bring originals and one set of self-attested photocopies of the following:
a) Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhaar Card)
b) Address Proof (Ration Card, Passport, Driving License, Aadhaar Card)
c) Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate)
d) Two recent passport-sized photographs
e) Photocopies of Aadhaar/PAN Card and Bank Passbook (for selected candidates at joining)
f) Class 10th & 12th mark sheets/certificates
g) Proof of Educational Qualification: MBBS, MD/MS/DNB/MCH/DM as per NMC guidelines
h) Internship Completion Certificate
i) NMC/Maharashtra Medical Council Registration and Renewal
j) Maharashtra Medical Council Registration (within 30 days of joining if not already registered)
k) Maharashtra Medical Council Additional Medical Qualification Registration Certificate.
l) Experience Certificates
m) Reservation Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PH) as per Govt. of India format. OBC must be non-creamy layer from the central list.
n) NOC from current employer (if applicable)
o) Demand Draft (as per applicable fee)
Note: Candidates must report for document verification one hour before the scheduled interview time on the specified date.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates are requested to appear for the interview as per the schedule below, with the following: Duly filled application in the prescribed format Application fee (as applicable) All relevant original documents and a set of self-attested copies
  • Candidates must appear for the interview with original documents and self-attested copies supporting their Date of Birth, Education, Experience, Caste, Non-Creamy Layer (OBC), etc., along with duly filled Annexure-A, one hour before interview time.

  • Ordnance Factory Ambajhari or Yantra Institute of Technology & Management, Ambajhari reserves the right to terminate engagement at any stage in the event of serious failure to perform tasks or failure to observe standards of conduct.

Selection Process

  • The selection is by merit for which overall grading in the APARs should not be below “Very Good”.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of all the Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications and experience as mentioned at Annexure I.
  • The application shall be submitted through 'Online Application Portal (OAP)' of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways' (website http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) from 16.12.2025 to 15.01.2026. No application submitted other than OAP will be accepted.
  • The candidate has to submit the hard-copy of the application form uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding to MbPA.
  • The Administrative Ports are required to forward the applications of the candidates along with the following documents superscribing “Application for the post of Joint Director in Mumbai Port Authority” on or before 30.01.2026.
  • (i) certified copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each of the pages;
  • (ii) a statement showing year-wise availability of APARs and grading duly signed by the Head of Department/Secretary. If APAR for a particular year during the last 5 years is not available, "No Report Certificate" may be furnished along with APARs of the preceding years;
  • (iii) Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
  • (iv) No objection certificate from the respective Port.
  • (v) Undertaking of the applicant that he will not withdraw his candidature, if selected by Services Selection Committee;
  • (vi) Administrative clearance of the concerned port (Annexure II)
  • (vii) Vigilance report is to be furnished in the prescribed format (Annexure III).
  • (viii) Two passport size photographs.
  • (ix) If any major or minor penalty has been imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to such penalty along with necessary documents may be sent by the forwarding authority along with the application.
  • As per the Ministry's circular No. 29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021, in case of receipt of advance copy of application from any candidate, his candidature will not be considered if his application is not received through proper channel from the Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications. Therefore, Major Ports are requested to forward the applications with complete set of enclosures on or before 30.01.2026. Applications received after 30.01.2026 will not be considered.
  • While forwarding the application, the Major Ports are to enclose all relevant documents at a time. No piecemeal / part forwarding will be considered.
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be 15.01.2026 in terms of Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways' circular No.A-29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 11.8.2021 regarding filling up the Dy. HoD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official who withdraws his candidature for the post after his selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years.
  • Incomplete applications or applications received after due date will not be considered.

How to Apply for Mumbai Port Authority Joint Director Recruitment 2025

  • The application shall be submitted through 'Online Application Portal (OAP)' of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways' (website http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) from 16.12.2025 to 15.01.2026.
  • The candidate has to submit the hard-copy of the application form uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding to MbPA.

Ans: No specific maximum age limit is prescribed; eligibility is based on length of approved service as on the crucial date 01.07.2025.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited by SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: Tentative vacancies are 267 for Central Secretariat Stenographers Services, 8 for Railway Board Secretariat Stenographers Service, 37 for Armed Forces Headquarters Stenographers Service, 1 for Election Commission of India Stenographers Service, 13 for Indian Foreign Service Branch (B) Stenographers, and vacancies for Central Vigilance Commission will be intimated later.

6. What is the mode of application for this examination?

Ans: Candidates must apply online on the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in, complete One Time Registration and fill the online application form, and then get the printed application forwarded through proper channel.

7. Where will the Grade “C” Stenographers LDCE 2025 examination be conducted?

Ans: The Limited Departmental Competitive Examination will be conducted at Delhi only.

8. What is the exam pattern for this recruitment?

Ans: The selection comprises a Computer Based Examination of 200 marks, a Stenography Skill Test of 200 marks and evaluation of Record of Service (APARs) for 100 marks.

9. Is there any negative marking in the Computer Based Examination?

Ans: Yes, there will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the Computer Based Examination.

10. How will the final selection be made for SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: Candidates qualifying the Skill Test will be considered for final selection on the basis of their merit in the Computer Based Examination, Stenography Skill Test and APAR evaluation, and will be recommended for inclusion in select lists of the participating cadres/services to the extent of available vacancies.

Essential Educational Qualification

  • Individual Event (International): Sportsperson who have participated or won medals in any International Sports tournament/competition/Championship as member of the Indian contingent conducted/recognized by International Sports Federation affiliated/recognized by IOC/IOA/MOYAS
  • Individual Event (National): Players who have won medals in National Games/Senior National Championship/National Open Championship or Youth/Junior National Championship conducted/recognized by National Sports Federation affiliated/recognized by IOA/MOYAS

Selection Process

  • Stage 3 - Physical Standard Test (PST): Height, chest measurement (for male), and weight verification as per prescribed standards
  • Stage 4 - Merit List Preparation: Merit list will be drawn on the basis of marks obtained by candidates as per sports achievement marking table
  • Stage 5 - Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Candidates selected in order of merit will undergo DME as per medical guidelines issued by MHA
  • Stage 6 - Review Medical Examination (RME): Appeal against DME can be submitted within 24 hours with Rs. 25/- fee through Indian Postal Order along with Medical Fitness Certificate
  • Tie Breaking Rules: Higher marks, International achievement over National, National Games over Senior National Championship, younger age, alphabetical order in English
  • Final Selection: Based on merit, PST, and Medical fitness

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts have All India liability and selected candidates can be posted anywhere in India and even abroad
  • On appointment, candidates shall be governed by BSF Act 1968 and BSF Rule 1969
  • Selected candidates shall have to undergo Basic Training and other prescribed courses
  • These vacancies are not open for physically challenged persons or ex-servicemen

  • No TA/DA or other expenses for appearing for recruitment will be paid to candidates
  • Candidates should come prepared for more than one day stay under their own arrangements
  • Recruitment in BSF is totally transparent, fair and purely on the basis of performance. No payment is required except nominal application fee
  • Falsification of documents will lead to criminal action besides cancellation of candidature
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to summary rejection
  • Mere qualifying prescribed tests does not confer right for selection
  • Candidates involved/convicted/arrested in any criminal case will not be considered
  • Performance of sportspersons shall be reviewed every year. If standard is not up to required level, they will be given option to merge with combatised GD cadre or be discharged from service

  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of courts within territorial limits of Delhi only

  • Step 8: Submit the application form

IOCL Trade/Technician/Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

State-wise Total Vacancies

State Total Vacancies
Delhi 120

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications:

  • Trade Apprentice - Fitter (Code 107): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Electrician (Code 108): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Electronics Mechanic (Code 109): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Instrument Mechanic (Code 110): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Machinist (Code 111): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Technician Apprentice - Mechanical (Code 101): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Electrical (Code 102): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Instrumentation (Code 103): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Civil (Code 104): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Electrical & Electronics (Code 105): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Electronics (Code 106): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Graduate Apprentice (Code 112): Regular full time Graduate in any discipline (BBA/BA/B.Com/B.Sc.) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator Fresher (Code 113): Class 12th (but below graduate).
  • Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator Skill Certificate Holders (Code 114): Class 12th (but below graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications:

  • The qualification prescribed shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course in relevant disciplines.
  • Qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning mode shall render the candidate NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.
  • Diploma under recognized Institute/University lateral entry scheme (Class XII/ITI) admitted in the second year of Diploma course shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks.
  • Candidates must be registered with NAPS/NATS portal with valid and active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number.
  • Candidates must have an Aadhaar seeded bank account enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
  • Candidates must possess PAN Card and Aadhaar Card.
  • Candidates must be medically fit as per Indian Oil's pre-engagement medical standard.

Desirable:

  • Preference shall be accorded to candidates applying for Apprenticeship training for the first time.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s)/Vocational Rehabilitation Center for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) and meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria are required to apply through NAPS/NATS portal.

Experience:

  • A candidate who has already undergone one apprenticeship training is eligible to apply for a second apprenticeship training, provided that the second apprenticeship is in a different trade from the first.
  • There shall be a minimum gap of one year between the completion of the first apprenticeship training and commencement of the second apprenticeship training.
  • No gap shall be required in case of termination of previous apprenticeship training due to failure on the part of the employer.
  • Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E or equivalent, MBA or equivalent or MCA/CA/ICWA, LLB or any such equivalent or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining the apprenticeship training shall NOT be considered eligible.
  • Candidates applying under NATS/NAPS who have completed five years as on 31.12.2025 in relevant discipline after acquiring the prescribed qualification shall NOT BE ELIGIBLE for engagement as apprentices.

Salary/Stipend

  • Graduate Apprentice: Rs. 4,500/- per month from Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) + Remaining amount from IOCL + Rs. 2,500/- as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • Technician Apprentice: Rs. 4,000/- per month from Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) + Remaining amount from IOCL + Rs. 2,500/- as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • Trade Apprentice: Stipend as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019 (paid in full by IOCL) + Rs. 2,500/- as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019 as amended from time to time.
  • Over and above the statutory stipend, an additional amount of Rs. 2,500/- shall be paid to the Apprentices as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • The cost of stipend borne by the Central Government shall be restricted to the first-time training only.
  • Part of the Graduate and Technician apprentice stipend is disbursed by Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) directly in their bank accounts under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • General/UR/EWS: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 24 years
  • SC/ST: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 29 years (Relaxation of 5 years)
  • OBC-NCL: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 27 years (Relaxation of 3 years)
  • PwBD (General): Minimum 18 years and Maximum 34 years (Relaxation of 10 years)
  • PwBD (SC/ST): Minimum 18 years and Maximum 39 years (Relaxation of 15 years)
  • PwBD (OBC-NCL): Minimum 18 years and Maximum 37 years (Relaxation of 13 years)

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee is required for applying to IOCL Apprentice positions.
  • Candidates can apply free of cost through NAPS/NATS portal.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Notification Date 27.12.2025
Date of Opening of Application (NAPS/NATS Portal) 27.12.2025 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date of Submission of Application (NAPS/NATS Portal) 12.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM
Last Date for Microsoft Office Form Submission 12.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM
Cutoff/Reckoning Date (Qualification & Age Criteria) 31.12.2025
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID
Period of Apprenticeship Training 12 Months

Selection Process

  • There will be no written Test/Interview for selection.
  • Merit list of all candidates who have applied against respective posts in the portal and meeting the eligibility criteria shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the post.
  • In case of two candidates securing same percentage of marks, the candidate with earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered.
  • In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage marks in matriculation shall be considered.
  • Preference shall be accorded to candidates applying for Apprenticeship training for the first time.
  • The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification.
  • Candidates will have to complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test for being adjudged suitable for engagement.
  • Candidates successfully qualifying document verification and Pre-engagement medical fitness shall be adjudged suitable for engagement and shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • An amount of maximum up to Rs. 3,000/- shall be reimbursed to the candidate towards expenses incurred for conducting tests/investigations during pre-engagement medical, on production of receipt for the same.

General Information/Instructions

  • IndianOil Corporation Limited proposes to engage Technician, Graduate and Trade Apprentice under Apprentices Act, 1961 at its Locations in States and UTs (Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand).
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for recruitment applicable to the States/UT.
  • For PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) category, Government of India Guidelines shall apply.
  • The reservation for PwBD shall be applied on horizontal basis, across all categories, as per the Government guidelines.
  • PwBD are not eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101-111 (Technician and Trade Apprentice - Technical).
  • Candidates are required to submit a Disability Certificate issued by competent authority as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must be capable of performing the task assigned to them/take instructions using suitable aids and appliances.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL-Non Creamy Layer) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to their fulfilling the standards applicable to candidates belonging to General category.
  • Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE from the advertisement. Candidates applying for more than one discipline code will not be considered and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • In case it is detected at any stage that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms and/or has furnished any incorrect/false information/certificate, his/her candidature will stand cancelled.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.
  • The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process.
  • Applications which are incomplete or received in any other mode/form, or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria shall not be considered "Eligible".
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer regular employment to such apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim right for employment.
  • All ex-apprentices will have an equal opportunity along with other candidates to appear
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and Mobile number which must be valid for at least 1 year as all future communications will take place through email/SMS alerts.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum or updates shall be made available on official website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships ONLY.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register as Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice - ITI at NAPS portal: http://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
    • Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator at NAPS portal: http://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
    • Technician Apprentice - Diploma at NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Graduate Apprentice at NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Ensure that your profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category etc) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in the portal. Ensure 100% completion/updation of profile.
  • Step 3: LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using User ID/Email ID.
  • Step 4: APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (MD)-Northern Region Office:
    • NATS - NDLSDC000005
    • NAPS - E05200700003
  • Step 5: After applying on respective NATS/NAPS portal, candidate MUST also submit their details along with preferred State and three preferred locations in Microsoft Office Form by visiting: https://forms.office.com/r/JtB9aJALr9 (Latest by 12.01.2026, 05:00 PM)
  • Important: Candidates must submit only one response. Multiple submission of Microsoft Form shall NOT be entertained.
  • Step 6: Keep checking official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships and registered email/mobile for updates regarding document verification.
  • Step 7: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated about document verification on registered email ID.
  • Step 8: Appear for document verification with all original documents and self-attested copies.
  • Step 9: Complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test.
  • Step 10: Candidates successfully qualifying document verification and medical fitness shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully read the full advertisement for details of Educational Qualification and other eligibility criteria before applying.
  • Candidates are requested to apply sufficiently in advance before the closing date.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit official website as all future correspondence and latest information shall be only on website and/or by e-mail/SMS-alerts.

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is maximum five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Note: Mere qualifying at SSB interview does not confirm final selection. Selection is based on merit, medical fitness and availability of vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Type of Commission: Short Service Commission (SSC)
  • Training Duration: 49 weeks at Officers Training Academy, Gaya, Bihar
  • Rank After Training: Lieutenant
  • Commission Grant: Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant from the date of commencement of the course
  • Ante Date Seniority: One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates
  • Tenure of Engagement: Officers shall be liable to serve for ten years
  • Option for Release:
    • First option - After 5 years of service (with Army HQ approval)
    • Second option - After 10 years of service
    • Third option - After 14 years of service
  • Option for Permanent Commission: Officers desirous of seeking Permanent Commission may be considered in the 10th year of service based on eligibility and suitability
  • Service Extension: Ten year service tenure may be extendable by further four years subject to eligibility
  • Arms/Services Allocation: Primary Arms/Services are Corps of Engineers, Corps of Signals and Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers. Candidates may get commissioned in other Arms/Services as well based on organizational requirements
  • Training Cost: Entire cost of training at PCTA is at Government expense
  • Cost Recovery: Candidates withdrawn from training academy for personal reasons will be liable to refund cost of training at ₹16,260 per week (as on 2023) or as notified from time to time
  • Promotion Criteria: Promotion to Captain after 2 years, Major after 6 years, Lieutenant Colonel after 13 years of reckonable commissioned service
  • Liability of Service: Officers may be granted commission in any Arm/Service and will be liable for service in any part of the world
  • Marriage Restriction: Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at Officers Training Academy. Marriage during training will result in discharge and recovery of expenditure

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2: Click on 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then click 'Registration' (if not already registered)
  • Step 3: Fill the online registration form carefully after reading instructions
  • Step 4: After registration, click on 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  • Step 5: A page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Technical Graduate Course
  • Step 6: Fill Application Form with details under various segments - Personal information, Communication details, Education details and details of previous SSB
  • Step 7: Click 'Save & Continue' each time before moving to next segment
  • Step 8: After filling all details, review on 'Summary of your information' page
  • Step 9: After ascertaining correctness of all details, click on 'Submit'
  • Step 10: Take out two copies of application having Roll Number, 30 minutes after final closure of online application

SSCW Tech-67 (Oct 2026) Course 01 BE/B.Tech in any streams
SSCW (Non-Tech) (Non UPSC)-124 (Oct 2026) Course 01 Graduation in any stream

Note: The vacancies mentioned are tentative and may be changed or re-appropriated by the Army depending on organizational requirements during any stage of the selection process.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Essential Qualification: B.E./B.Tech degree in the notified Engineering streams from recognized Universities/Institutions by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other educational institutions established by an Act of parliament or declared to be deemed as Universities/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007 and IIIT Act 2024.
  • For Final Year Students: Candidates studying in the final year of Engineering degree course are eligible to apply. They must submit proof of passing Engineering Degree Examination alongwith marksheets of all semesters/years by 01 October 2026 and produce the Engineering Degree Certificate within 12 weeks from the date of commencement of training at PCTA.
  • Important Note: All final year appearing candidates whose final year/final semester exam will be scheduled after 01 October 2026 are not eligible to apply for this course.
  • For Widows of Defence Personnel: Educational qualification for SSCW (Tech) is BE/B.Tech in any engineering stream, and for SSCW (Non-Tech) (Non UPSC) is Graduation in any discipline.
  • Stream Requirement: Only the Engineering streams and their acceptable equivalent streams as strictly notified in the official notification will be accepted. Any variation between the nomenclature of Engineering stream on degree parchment/marksheet and online application will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Foreign Degrees Not Accepted: Candidates with graduation from foreign countries are not permitted to apply for this course.

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka and East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (certificate of eligibility required except for Gorkha subjects of Nepal)

Marital Status

  • Only unmarried female candidates are eligible to apply
  • Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel who died in harness are eligible, provided they have not remarried
  • Candidates will neither be allowed to marry during the period of training nor be allowed to live with Parents/Guardians
  • A candidate who marries subsequent to the date of application, though successful at SSB interview and medical examination, will not be inducted for training

Physical Standards

  • 2.4 Km Run: 13 Minutes
  • Push-Up: 15
  • Pull-Up: 02
  • Sit-Up: 25
  • Squats: Two sets of 30 repetitions
  • Lunges: Two sets of 10 repetitions
  • Swimming: Should know fundamentals of swimming

Salary/Stipend

During Training Period

  • Stipend: ₹56,100 per month (Starting pay in Level-10 of Pay Matrix)
  • Pay and allowances will be paid after successful completion of training

After Commissioning - Pay Structure

  • Lieutenant (Level-10): ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500
  • Captain (Level-10B): ₹61,300 - ₹1,93,900
  • Major (Level-11): ₹69,400 - ₹2,07,200
  • Lieutenant Colonel (Level-12A): ₹1,21,200 - ₹2,12,400
  • Colonel (Level-13): ₹1,30,600 - ₹2,15,900
  • Brigadier (Level-13A): ₹1,39,600 - ₹2,17,600
  • Major General (Level-14): ₹1,44,200 - ₹2,18,200
  • Lieutenant General HAG Scale (Level-15): ₹1,82,200 - ₹2,24,100
  • Lieutenant General HAG+ Scale (Level-16): ₹2,05,400 - ₹2,24,400
  • VCOAS/Army Commander/Lieutenant General (NFSG) (Level-17): ₹2,25,000 (Fixed)
  • COAS (Level-18): ₹2,50,000 (Fixed)

Other Allowances

  • Military Service Pay (MSP): ₹15,500 per month (Fixed) - for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier rank
  • Dearness Allowance: Admissible at the same rates and under same conditions as applicable to civilian personnel from time to time
  • Para Reserve Allowance: ₹2,625 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-I): ₹3,000 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-II): ₹4,500 per month
  • Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA (Higher TPTA Cities) / ₹3,600 + DA (Other Places)
  • Dress Allowance: ₹20,000 per year
  • Children Education Allowance: ₹2,250 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Hostel Subsidy: ₹6,750 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Ration in Kind: Provided in peace and field areas
  • Field Area Allowances: Risk and Hardship allowances depending upon rank and area of posting (maximum up to ₹42,500)

Additional Benefits

  • CTC (Cost to Company): Approximately ₹17-18 lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to hometown once a year)
  • Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF): Insurance coverage of ₹1.25 Crore
  • Academic Degree: Post Graduate Diploma in Defence Management and Strategic Studies upon successful completion of training

Age Limit (as on 01 October 2026)

  • For General Candidates:
    • Minimum Age: 20 years
    • Maximum Age: 27 years
    • Date of Birth: Candidates must be born between 01 October 1999 and 30 September 2006 (both dates inclusive)
  • For Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel:
    • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 01 October 2026
  • Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent examination certificate on the date of submission of application will only be accepted. No other document relating to age will be accepted and no subsequent request for its change will be considered or granted.

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the official notification
  • Candidates need to apply online through the official website only

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 06 January 2026 at 1500 hours
Online Application Closing Date 04 February 2026 at 1500 hours
Offline Application Last Date (For Widows of Defence Personnel) 19 February 2026
Publication of Cut-off % for Shortlisting First week of March 2026
SSB Interview Period April - June 2026 (Five day SSB)
Choice for SSB Dates and Centre Open Two weeks in March 2026
Proof of Passing Engineering Degree Submission Deadline (for final year students) 01 October 2026
Training Commencement October 2026
Training Completion September 2027

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in (Offline application for widows of defence personnel to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting)
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Note: Mere qualifying at SSB interview does not confirm final selection. Selection is based on merit, medical fitness and availability of vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Type of Commission: Short Service Commission (SSC)
  • Training Duration: 49 weeks at Officers Training Academy, Gaya, Bihar
  • Rank After Training: Lieutenant
  • Commission Grant: Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant from the date of commencement of the course
  • Ante Date Seniority: One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates
  • Tenure of Engagement: Officers shall be liable to serve for ten years
  • Option for Release:
    • First option - After 5 years of service (with Army HQ approval based on merit)
    • Second option - After 10 years of service
    • Third option - After 14 years of service
  • Option for Permanent Commission: Officers desirous of seeking Permanent Commission may be considered in the 10th year of service based on eligibility and suitability
  • Service Extension: Ten year service tenure may be extendable by further four years subject to eligibility
  • Arms/Services Allocation: Primary Arms/Services are Corps of Engineers, Corps of Signals and Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers. Candidates may get commissioned in other Arms/Services as well based on organizational requirements
  • Training Cost: Entire cost of training at PCTA is at Government expense
  • Cost Recovery: Candidates withdrawn from training academy for personal reasons will be liable to refund cost of training at ₹16,260 per week (as on 2023) or as notified from time to time
  • Promotion Criteria: Promotion to Captain after 2 years, Major after 6 years, Lieutenant Colonel after 13 years of reckonable commissioned service
  • Liability of Service: Officers may be granted commission in any Arm/Service and will be liable for service in any part of the world
  • Marriage Restriction: Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at Officers Training Academy. Marriage during training will result in discharge and recovery of expenditure
  • Special Provision for Widows: Widows of Indian Armed Forces Defence Personnel who died in harness, including those with children, are eligible provided they have not remarried. Their candidature will be considered only against specific vacancies released for said category.

How to Apply

For General Candidates (Online Application)

  • Step 1: Visit the official website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2: Click on 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then click 'Registration' (if not already registered)
  • Step 3: Fill the online registration form carefully after reading instructions. Aadhaar number and matriculation certificate is mandatory for registration
  • Step 4: After registration, click on 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  • Step 5: A page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Short Service Commission Technical Course
  • Step 6: Fill Application Form with details under various segments - Personal information, Communication details, Education details and details of previous SSB
  • Step 7: Click 'Save & Continue' each time before moving to next segment
  • Step 8: After filling all details, review on 'Summary of your information' page
  • Step 9: After ascertaining correctness of all details, click on 'Submit'
  • Step 10: Take out two copies of application having Roll Number, 30 minutes after final closure of online application

For Widows of Defence Personnel (Offline Application)

  • Application form to be downloaded from www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Application should be sent offline to: Rtg 'A'(TGC) section, Dte Gen of Rtg, AG's Branch, Integrated HQ, Ministry of Defence (Army), West Block-III, R K Puram, New Delhi-110066
  • Last date for receipt of offline applications: 19 February 2026 (15 days after closing of online applications)
  • Required Documents: Application form, Class 10th & 12th certificates and marksheets, Degree certificate and marksheet, Part II Order of Marriage, Part II Order of demise of husband, Initial report of Battle/Physical casualty, Detailed report of Battle/Physical casualty, Battle/Physical casualty certificate
  • Documents from serial (v) to (ix) must be attested by an officer ex MP Directorate (MP-5 & 6), IHQ of MoD (Army) for officers and by Concerned Record office for JCO/OR
  • Envelope should be superscribed in Red ink clearly indicating the name of Officer/JCO/OR with rank. For example, 'Widows of late________'

Documents Required for SSB Interview (For All Candidates)

  • One copy of printout of application duly signed and affixed with self-attested photograph
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent certificate and Marksheet issued by concerned Board of Education
  • 12th class marksheet and certificate or equivalent certificate/Diploma marksheet and certificate (for Diploma holders)
  • Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree issued by recognized university (Provisional Degree should not be more than six months old at time of joining Academy)
  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate issued by Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding formula for conversion of CGPA/Grades into marks
  • Certificate regarding cumulative percentage of marks upto 6th semester/3rd year (for final year appearing candidates)
  • Certificate from Principal/Head of Institution stating candidate is studying in final year and result will be declared by 01 October 2026 (for final year students)
  • Declaration by final year candidate about submission of degree proof by 01 October 2026
  • Documents related to civil verification
  • All original certificates must be carried for verification (DIGILOCKER certificates not accepted)

Important Notes

  • Online applications will only be accepted through the official website - no offline applications for general candidates
  • Candidates must submit only one online application. Multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature
  • No changes to details submitted in online application can be made after closure of application
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted into marks as per formulae adopted by concerned University
  • Candidate's name/Parent's name/Date of Birth in profile and online application must match Matriculation Certificate exactly
  • Candidates serving in Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer and get application countersigned
  • No hard copy needs to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting (except for widows of defence personnel)
  • Candidates applying for SSCW (Non-Tech) (Non UPSC)-124 should mention the correct course number on their application

TCIL Project Manager, Operation Lead  and More Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Telecommunications Consultants India Limited (TCIL)
Post Name Various posts including Project Manager, Operation Lead, Engineer L-3/L-2, Portal Administrator, VC Coordinator, Helpdesk Engineer, Store In charge
No of Posts 25
Salary Varies by post, up to Rs 1,80,370 per month

Start Date for Apply  24/12/2025
Last Date for Apply  09/01/2026
Official Website tcil.net.in

TCIL Project Manager, Operation Lead  and More Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Resource Designation Quantity (Qty)
Project Manager 1
Operation Lead 3
Engineer| L-3 Specialist 3
Portal Administrator 1
Engineer| L-2 Network & Monitoring 6
Helpdesk Engineer 6
Video Conferencing Coordinator 4
Store In charge 1
Total 25

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Manager: B.E/B-Tech/MCA or equivalent with MBA, minimum 12 years of experience (8 relevant), PMP/PRINCE 2 certification.
  • Operation Lead: B.E/B-Tech/MCA or equivalent (MBA preferable), minimum 10 years experience (6 relevant), experience in large IT projects (SWAN/SecLAN etc.), ITIL or ISO 20000 certification.
  • Engineer L-3 Specialist: B.E/B-Tech/MCA or equivalent, minimum 8 years experience (5 relevant), hands-on experience & relevant certification in Network (CCNP/JNCP), System (RHCA/MCSE), or Security (CCNP Security/CISA/OSCP).
  • Engineer L-2 Network & Monitoring: B.E/B-Tech/MCA or equivalent, minimum 5 years experience (4 relevant), CCNA/JNCA certification.
  • Portal Administrator: B.E/B-Tech/MCA or equivalent, minimum 5 years experience (4 relevant), relevant Certification in software development.
  • Video Conferencing Coordinator: B.E/B-Tech/MCA or equivalent, minimum 5 years experience (4 relevant in VC), CCNA/JNCA certification.
  • Helpdesk Engineer: Science Graduate/BCA or equivalent, minimum 3 years experience (2 in Help Desk), must have ITIL V4 Certified.
  • Store In charge: B.Sc./b.com or equivalent, minimum 5 years experience (3 relevant in storekeeping), minimum one year Diploma in Computer Science.
  • Experience period calculated from the date of attaining the minimum essential qualification.

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Remuneration varies by post:
  • Project Manager: Rs 1,80,370
  • Operation Lead: Rs 90,185
  • Engineer| L-3 Specialist: Rs 54,111
  • Portal Administrator: Rs 36,074
  • Engineer| L-2 Network & Monitoring: Rs 34,875
  • Helpdesk Engineer: Rs 22,546
  • Video Conferencing Coordinator: Rs 49,602
  • Store In charge: Rs 31,565
  • No HRA or medical coverage will be provided by BSEDC or TCIL.
  • Annual increment is applicable based on satisfactory performance.

Age Limit (as on 24-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age as on date of advertisement:
  • Project Manager: 45 years
  • Operation Lead: 42 years
  • Engineer| L-3 Specialist: 40 years
  • Portal Administrator, Engineer| L-2 Network & Monitoring, Video Conferencing Coordinator, Store In charge: 35 years
  • Helpdesk Engineer: 33 years

Application Fee

  • The PDF advertisement does not mention any specific application fee amount.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 24/12/2025
Last Date for receipt of offline applications 09/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Mode of selection will be solely by interview.
  • TCIL reserves the right to shortlist applicants for the interview.
  • Venue and date of interview shall be intimated separately to the shortlisted candidates via email only.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement is on a contract basis for a minimum period of 1 year, extendable yearly up to a maximum of five years.
  • The engagement is temporary in nature and does not entitle regularization of service in TCIL or BSEDC.
  • The project posts are for Project Manager, Operation Lead  and More, and manpower should be stationed at Beltron Bhawan. Video Conferencing Coordinators may be deputed at any location in Bihar.
  • Working hours may require shifts, working on public holidays, or being available beyond specified hours during critical incidents.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the duty.
  • Candidates must possess a valid and active email ID for all correspondence.

How To Apply

  • Interested candidates should send their applications in the prescribed format only in offline mode.
  • The application must be addressed to “ED (DT) Room No. 501, Telecommunications Consultants India Ltd., TCIL Bhawan, Greater Kailash –I, New Delhi – 110048”.
  • The name of the post applied for should invariably be mentioned on the top of the envelope containing the application form.
  • The application form must be accompanied by self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates (Educational, Professional Qualifications, Date of Birth, proof of CTC/Salary, Work Experience).
  • Incomplete or unsigned applications received after the last date will be rejected.

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization ITI Limited (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
Department Corporate Office & Various Units of ITI Limited
Exam Name Young Professional Recruitment 2026
Post Young Professional – Graduate / Technician / Operator / Generalist / Official Language
Total Vacancies 215 Posts
Mode of Application Online
Registration Dates From advertisement date (22-12-2025) to 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs)
Educational Qualification BE/B.Tech/MBA/PG/ Diploma/ITI/Graduation depending on post and domain
Age Limit Upper age limit generally 35 years for YP Technician/Generalist; internal candidates relaxation up to 45 years
Selection Process Shortlisting + GD & PI for Graduates; Shortlisting + Skill Test for Technicians & Operators
Official Website itiltd.in

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification from ITI Limited specifies the advertisement date and the last date for receipt of online applications. Candidates should strictly adhere to the application deadline and regularly visit the official website for any corrigendum or addendum regarding the schedule.

Event Date
Notification Release Date 22-12-2025 (Advertisement Ref No. ITI/CRP/HR/2025/1534)
Apply Online Starts 22-12-2025 (from publication of notification)
Last Date to Apply Online 12-01-2026 (up to 23:59 hrs)
Last Date to Pay Application Fee Not specified (no fee mentioned)
Correction Window Not mentioned in notification
Admit Card Release To be intimated via email/official website (if applicable)
Examination / GD-PI / Skill Test Date To be notified to shortlisted candidates
Result Declaration To be notified on official website/email
Document Verification/Interview As per schedule communicated by ITI Limited
Final Selection List To be published/communicated by ITI Limited

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

ITI Limited has announced a total of 215 Young Professional vacancies across multiple domains including Projects, Project Management, IS & IT, Computer Lab/Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, Production/Manufacturing, HR, Marketing, Finance and Hindi Cell. The posts are further classified as Young Professional – Graduate, Young Professional – Technician, Young Professional – Operator, YP Generalist (HR/Marketing/Finance) and YP – Official Language, with domain-wise distribution as given below.

Domain / Area Post Total Vacancies
Projects YP – Graduate (Projects) 20
Projects YP – Technician (Projects) 19
Projects YP – Operator (Projects) 12
YP – Project Management YP – Graduate (Project Management) 4
IS & IT YP – Graduate (IS&IT) 2
IS & IT YP – Technician (IS&IT) 2
Computer Lab YP – Graduate (Comp. Lab) 2
Computer Lab / Production Various Graduate/Technician roles (Chemistry/Chemical Engg/Testing) 14 (10 + 2 + 2) combined
Computer Lab / Production YP – Operator (Electronics/Electronic Mech./Fitter) 30 (25 + 5)
Telecom Security Testing Lab YP – Graduate (TSTL) 5 (4 + 1 higher experience slot)
Production/Manufacturing YP – Technician 23
Production/Manufacturing YP – Operator 29
HR YP – Generalist (HR) 15
Marketing YP – Graduate (Marketing) 10
Marketing YP – Generalist (Marketing) 10
Finance YP – Generalist (Finance) 10
Hindi Cell YP – Official Language 4
Total - 215

Reservation, if any, and detailed breakup of vacancies by category are to be inferred as per ITI Limited policies and Government of India guidelines, though category-wise numbers are not explicitly mentioned in the notification. Posting locations include Leh/Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Bareilly, Kolkata, Tezpur, Bharatpur/Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, West Bengal, North Eastern states, Bengaluru, Palakkad, Mankapur, Rae Bareli, Naini, Delhi, Lucknow, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and Ahmedabad among others as indicated in Table-B.

Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Only Indian Nationals with qualifications from recognized universities/institutes (AICTE/UGC/other statutory authorities) are eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various Young Professional categories and domains are summarised below.

For YP – Graduate (Projects):
BE/B.Tech in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil or MCA/M.Sc. (Electronics/CS/IT) from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Technician (Projects):
Diploma in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Projects):
ITI Trade Certificate in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Graduate (Project Management):
MBA in Project Management/Operations Management or M.Sc. in Project Management from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Graduate (IS & IT):
Essential: BE/B.Tech in IT/CS/ECE/EEE or MCA/M.Sc. (IT/CS) from a recognised University/Institute; desirable skills include proficiency in PHP/Python/Java, HTML/CSS/JS, MySQL/PostgreSQL and Linux server environment.

For YP – Technician (IS & IT):
Essential: B.Sc (IT)/BCA/Diploma in CS from a recognised University/Institute; desirable knowledge of network fundamentals, VPN, firewall basics, Linux/Windows systems and end-user support.

For YP – Graduate (Comp. Lab):
BE/B.Tech in IT/CS from a recognised University/Institute.

For Comp. Lab/Production (Graduate/Technician roles):
- B.Sc in Chemistry or Diploma in Chemical Engineering with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience in conformal coating, OR Diploma in CS/Electronics with minimum 2 years’ experience in testing/measurement systems as specified.

For YP – Operator (Computer Lab/Production):
ITI Trade Certificate in Electronics/Electronic Mechanic with minimum 2 years’ experience and VSSC Soldering School certification; or ITI Fitter with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.

For YP – Graduate (TSTL):
BE/B.Tech in ECE/CS/Telecommunications or MCA/M.Sc.(CS/IT)/M.Sc. Cybersecurity from a recognised University/Institute with minimum 2–5 years post-qualification experience (depending on slot) and industry-recognised certifications in IT/Telecom Security Testing desirable.

For YP – Technician (Production/Manufacturing):
Diploma in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Production/Manufacturing):
ITI Trade Certificate in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical/Fitter from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Generalist (HR):
Any Degree from a recognised University with mandatory knowledge of computer and applications.

For YP – Graduate (Marketing):

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The applicant should possess a higher qualification (Masters’ and above) from a reputed Indian or International Institution/University in Economics, Development Cooperation, Development Partnership, International Relations, International Law, International Development, Strategic Studies, Public Administration, International Trade, Environment and Climate, Trade, Agriculture, Labour Economics, Energy, Health, Disaster Management, Anti corruption or a related subject.
  • The applicant should have one year’s experience as a Consultant in relevant field.
  • The applicant should possess good writing and analytical skills and have experience in policy making and advocacy, including experience in speech writing, analytical writing and preparing negotiation strategy.
  • The applicant must be proficient in use of computers (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
  • The applicant should not be more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of applications.

Salary/Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 10 lakh per annum each, with deduction of applicable taxes.
  • The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.
  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidates, and no HRA shall be admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.

Age Limit 

  • The applicant should not be more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of applications.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Advertisement Date (Advertisement No. Q/PF/575/55/2025) 24/12/2025
Last date for receiving applications 16/01/2026 (up to 17:30 Hrs)

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test.
  • The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to applicants for attending interview.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/Instructions

  • The period of consultancy is 01 (one) year; the contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and requirement.
  • The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof; unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The selected Consultants will be attached to dedicated BRICS Working Groups like Trade, Industry, Finance, Agriculture, Energy, Environment, ICT, Labour etc., and will assist in developing concept notes, analytical notes and background documents for India’s BRICS Chairship.
  • They will assist in preparing draft outcome documents for BRICS meetings, help with the negotiation process including drafting documents during negotiations, and keep track of country positions on relevant subjects.
  • They will assist in preparing presentations, interventions, position papers, content for media and website for Ministerial meetings and Working Group meetings, take meeting records, coordinate with BRICS countries and International Organisations, and assist Sherpa meetings for work under different sectors.
  • They will keep track of the state of play on issues discussed in BRICS Working Groups and work towards proposals that may garner consensus in BRICS.
  • They will cover meetings and perform liaison duties with various Line Ministries/Departments of Government of India, Think Tanks, International Organisations and BRICS members and invitee countries.
  • They will undertake research and documentation work for BRICS in the run up to and during India’s BRICS Chairship including assessing key issues and country positions, and any other task assigned by Head of Division.
  • Job location will be Ministry of External Affairs (South Block/Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan/Sushma Swaraj Bhawan/Patiala House/ISIL Building/CCS Building), New Delhi.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis; normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs, subject to change, with Saturdays/Sundays as weekend off.
  • In exigencies, the Consultant may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays; no extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise, in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with the Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service, subject to the conditions in the advertisement; leave encashment will not be permissible and unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of duties, the Ministry will take care of travel, accommodation and per-diem costs as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format with effect from the actual date of engagement.
  • Applications received after the closing date and time or without the prescribed documents or otherwise found incomplete or not in the prescribed proforma will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.

How to Apply

  • Applicants who fulfil the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents/certificates in support of educational qualifications and experience in Government service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either offline or online mode.
  • Offline mode: By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Consultant in the MER Division of Ministry of External Affairs”, sent to: Under Secretary (PF&PG), Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011.
  • Online mode: Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted, to email address: [email protected].
  • Incomplete applications and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

  • Applicant eligibility will be assessed based on the information provided in the online application form.
  • If at any stage it is found that applicants have furnished false or wrong information, their candidature/apprenticeship will be rejected/cancelled/terminated.

  • The cut-off date for age, qualification etc. shall be 19 January 2026.
  • Relaxation in the upper age limit shall be applicable as per the Govt. of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD etc.

  • No accommodation and travel allowance/facility will be provided for the apprentices at IIT Delhi.

Analysis of protein-ligand binding interactions using Molegro, Maestro etc 3. Utilizing in-silico tools like Swiss Target Prediction, Swiss ADME to find drug like molecules using Lipinski rule of 5 and further eliminating the toxic molecules from the developed library 4. Synthesis, purification and characterization of novel heterocyclic compounds 5. Preformulation studies: solubility studies, permeability assays, solution & solid stability, compatibility studies 6. Analytical method development & validation HPLC/LC-MS 7. Development & optimization of the conventional & novel formulations (using QbD/Gastroplus) 8. Physicochemical & biological characterization (ex vivo, in vivo) of formulations 9. In vitro studies and analysis of formulations: study of in vitro drug release mechanism (kinetics study) 10. Preformulation studies: solubility studies, permeability assays, solution & solid stability, compatibility studies 11. Sample Tracking & Data collection- clinical metadata entry, Tissue Quality Control, Blood/Fecal Sample Processing: PBMC isolation using Ficoll gradient, Data Coordination. 12. Transcriptomics and Proteomics Profiling : RNA extraction. Library preparation. RNA-Seq workflow. Sample QC. Next-generation sequencing: data visualization. 13. Proteomics (Metaproteomics / Tumor Proteome): Protein extraction, protein quantification, trypsin digestion. Sample prep for LC-MS/MS. GO term enrichment and pathway mapping (e.g., DAVID, Metascape). Maintain sample record. QC records, and experiment run sheets, document SOPs 14. In Vivo Animal Modeling. In Vitro Efficacy Assays. Pharmacokinetics (PK) : Dosing and Sampling, Plasma separation, LC-MS/MS-based assay. Pharmacodynamics-Biomarker Evaluation. Documentation: logbooks with ethics compliance. 16. R package for analysis of biological data, R for meta, PhVID for disproportionality analysis (frequency based and Bayesian methods). GRADE pro for GRADE analysis, Evidence Gap Map Analysis. Genome-wide association analysis with longitudinal phenotypes using fGWAS of R package. GROMAC for molecular simulation studies includes DCCM and PCA analysis, Network creation and analysis.
