NRCD Young Professional Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National River Conservation Directorate, Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti (NRCD)
Post Name Young Professional (YP)
No of Posts 02 (01 YP Civil + 01 YP Environmental)
Salary ₹50,000/- per month (Consolidated)
Qualification B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Civil Engineering or Environmental Science
Last Date for Apply Within 21 days of publication of advertisement
Official Website nrcd.nic.in

NRCD Young Professional Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

S. No. Post Name Total Posts
1 Young Professional (Civil) 01
2 Young Professional (Environmental) 01
Total 02

Eligibility Criteria

Young Professional (Civil) - 01 YP

  • Essential Qualifications: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Civil Engineering or equivalent
  • Desirable: 2 years of experience in technical work related to implementation of Government schemes/projects in field of river cleaning and pollution abatement
  • Desirable: Experience in technical examination/preparation of DPRs in field of river cleaning and pollution abatement

Young Professional (Environmental) - 01 YP

  • Essential Qualifications: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Environmental Engineering or B.Sc in Environmental Science or equivalent
  • Desirable: 2 years of experience in technical work related to implementation of Government schemes/projects in field of river cleaning and pollution abatement
  • Desirable: Experience in technical examination/preparation of DPRs in field of river cleaning and pollution abatement

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Remuneration: Young Professionals will be paid consolidated monthly remuneration of ₹50,000/- only
  • Income tax and other tax liable to be deducted as per rules will be deducted at source
  • Allowance: No other allowances shall be admissible
  • TA/DA: No TA/DA shall be admissible for attending interview or joining the assignment
  • Leave: Young Professionals shall be entitled to 8 days leave in calendar year on pro-rata basis. Absence beyond 8 days will attract proportionate deduction. Leave cannot be carried forward

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Number J-11011/2/2025-NRCD
Last Date for Submission Within 21 days of publication of advertisement

Selection Process

  • Interested candidates may apply by submitting application in prescribed format (Annexure) along with self-attested copies of essential documents
  • Applications to be submitted through email only at [email protected] within 21 days of publication of advertisement
  • Applications submitted in physical form will not be entertained
  • NRCD reserves right to accept or reject applications without assigning any reason
  • All information and documents submitted by candidate are subject to verification
  • If at any stage it is found that information furnished is false, misleading or incomplete, candidate's engagement shall be terminated immediately without any notice

General Information/Instructions

  • Period of Engagement: Initially for one year and may be extended annually upto total period of three years subject to Departmental guidelines. Extension shall not be treated as matter of right
  • Nature of Engagement: Contractual
  • Place of Posting: NRCD, Pandit Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, New Delhi
  • Confidentiality Clause: Young Professionals engaged in NRCD shall maintain strict confidentiality regarding all information, documents, data, and work entrusted to them. They shall not disclose, share, reproduce, or communicate any information related to NRCD, its projects, schemes, or internal processes to any person or entity in any form without prior written approval from competent authority
  • Any breach of confidentiality will be treated as Serious Misconduct and may invite appropriate disciplinary action
  • YPs will also submit self-declaration of no pending criminal/disciplinary case
  • Conflict of Interest: YPs shall follow Government of India rules. Any conflict of interest or unsatisfactory performance may result in discontinuation
  • Termination of Contract: Either side may terminate contract with one month notice or salary in lieu thereof. Absence for more than 8 days without information will lead to automatic termination
  • Working Hours: Working hours shall be as per NRCD office hours. Depending on workload, YPs may be required to work beyond office hours without extra remuneration
  • Verification of Information: All information and documents submitted by candidate are subject to verification. If at any stage it is found that information furnished is false, misleading or incomplete, engagement shall be terminated immediately without any notice
  • Terms of services of YPs and other procedure of recruitment will be governed by guidelines issued by DoWR, RD & GR vide O.M. No. A-12034/1/2015-Admin dated 28.04.2022 and as amended from time to time
  • Eligible and interested candidates possessing requisite qualification for engagement as Young Professionals purely on contract basis
  • Profile of Young Professional and Terms and Conditions of Engagement are given in vacancy circular

Work Profile

  • Young Professional will assist NRCD's Senior Officers in technical examination of reports, datasets, and submissions related to river conservation and pollution abatement activities
  • Role includes providing analytical support for project appraisal, preparation of technical notes and briefs
  • YP will coordinate with States, technical institutions and stakeholders for timely completion of assigned tasks
  • They shall also perform any other work entrusted by reporting officer or senior officers
  • Assist in implementation of Government schemes/projects in field of river cleaning and pollution abatement
  • Examination and preparation of DPRs (Detailed Project Reports) in field of river cleaning and pollution abatement

How to Apply

  • National River Conservation Directorate (NRCD), New Delhi invites applications from eligible and interested candidates
  • Candidates must apply by submitting application in prescribed format (Annexure)
  • Fill the CV format for Young Professional in National River Conservation Directorate as given in Annexure
  • Provide complete details including Name, Father's Name, Date of Birth, Postal Address with PIN & Police Station
  • Affix passport size photograph on application
  • Provide Permanent Address with complete details
  • Provide Email ID, Mobile No., Contact No. (Tel)
  • Fill Educational Qualification details (Bachelor degree and above) with Course/Degree, Subject/Specialization, University/Institute, Year of Passing, and attach self-attested copies
  • Mention Work Experience if any with Organization/Institute, Period (From - To), Nature of Work
  • Provide Additional Information if any
  • Include Declaration: "This is to certify that I (complete name of applicant), S/o or D/o, resident of (complete address) do hereby declare that I have no pending administrative and/or criminal case before any court in India or authorized body. I further certify that I have never been found guilty/convicted of any administrative and/or criminal offense. I also certify that all information given by me is true to best of my knowledge and belief, and if selected and appointed, I will provide full time service and will not engage in any other activity"
  • Sign the application with Signature of applicant, Name and Date
  • Attach self-attested copies of essential documents
  • Submit application through email only at [email protected]
  • Applications must be submitted within 21 days of publication of advertisement
  • Applications submitted in physical form will not be entertained
  • Ensure all information is complete and accurate before submission

  3. Upload self-attested copies of required documents including educational certificates, experience letters, APARs (last 3 years), Form 16/ITR, and recent salary slips.

NDMA Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Nature of Post No. of Vacancies
Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) Contractual 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian nationals having requisite qualification and experience are eligible to apply.
  • Essential educational qualification: Master’s degree in Water Resources Management, Hydrology, Erosion (River/Coastal) Risk Management, Disaster Management or any other disciplines related to disaster management such as geography, geology, environment, civil/geo-technical engineering.
  • Desirable educational qualification: A research degree (M.Phil./Ph.D.) in disaster management or related field.
  • Post-qualification experience: Minimum 5 years’ experience in Erosion (River/Coastal) risk management or related subject.
  • Duration of research work (Ph.D./Post Doctoral) will be counted for work experience (actual duration or 5 years, whichever is less).
  • Field experience in community-based approaches to Erosion (River/Coastal) risk management and in projects with substantial use of disaster risk reduction and mitigation will be given more weightage in the selection process.
  • Both educational qualifications and work experience must prove the credentials of the applicant as an established expert in the field.
  • The applicant should not be more than 50 years of age for Senior Consultant; in case of retired Government employee, maximum age limit is 62 years.

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration band: Rs. 1,25,000/- to Rs. 1,75,000/- per month for Senior Consultant.
  • Remuneration in respect of retired Government employee engaged as a Consultant shall be regulated as per Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.III.A dated 09 December 2020.
  • The remuneration is consolidated and inclusive of all applicable taxes and no other allowance shall be provided, as per the recruitment handbook description and ToR.

Age Limit (as on last date of application)

  • Maximum age limit is 50 years for Senior Consultant.
  • In case of retired Government employees, maximum age limit is 62 years for engagement as Senior Consultant.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Date of advertisement 24/12/2025
Application window Within 20 days from date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website

Selection Process

  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experiences will be verified with original certificates.
  • Applications will be considered only when submitted through NDMA job portal; incomplete applications will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.
  • Detailed terms and conditions and eligibility criteria are available in the Terms of Reference (ToR) on the NDMA website; selection will be based on the criteria and processes outlined therein.

General Information/Instructions

  • NDMA is the apex-level institution for disaster management in India, mandated under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 to lay down policies, plans and guidelines for disaster management and implement related programmes.
  • The Disaster Management Act, 2005 provides for constitution of National, State and District Disaster Mitigation Funds to allocate resources for mitigation measures; large-scale structural interventions should be pursued through regular development schemes, while local and community-based interventions are supported by mitigation funds.
  • The position of Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) is in the Mitigation Division, focusing on Erosion (River/Coastal) as one of the key areas of mitigation due to its frequency, geographical impact, and associated human and physical losses.
  • Senior Consultant will work full time and shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with NDMA.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required; high-order skills in operating spreadsheets and databases and skill in making presentations are required competencies.
  • Allowances such as TA/DA, lodging and boarding expenses etc. for official tours/visits will be provided as per rules/regulations of Government of India/NDMA.
  • The engagement is temporary; NDMA can terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason, though normally one month’s notice will be given; Senior Consultant can also seek termination by giving one month’s notice.
  • Senior Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period not exceeding three years, with continuation contingent on satisfactory Annual Performance Review; extension beyond three years may be considered under exceptional circumstances, but no extension will be given beyond age 65 years.

How to Apply

  • Interested individuals may apply for the position online through NDMA website (http://ndma.gov.in) within 20 days from the date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website.
  • Applications will be considered only when applicants apply through the NDMA job portal; no other means of application will be considered.
  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experience documents must be uploaded and will be verified with original certificates at the appropriate stage.
  • For any assistance to apply online, applicants may call 9958136496 or 9873997934.
  • Incomplete applications will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.

Selection Process

  • As per The Selection Tests Rules, 2025, through a two-stage process as under:
  • Stage 1: Eligibility Test - A multiple-choice questions (MCQ) based screening test examining general awareness, analytical ability, aptitude, and logical ability
  • Stage 2: Selection Test - Qualifiers from Stage 1 (or exempted) will appear for a grade-specific written test on domain knowledge in civil engineering, infrastructure projects, and related areas
  • Personal Interview - Conducted by a nominated Selection Committee for shortlisted candidates based on written test scores
  • Special Provision: Applicants with experience of working in NHIDCL for a total period of 5 years (i.e. 1825 days or more) as on the date of this advertisement shall be exempted from Stage-1: Eligibility Test. However, they must undergo Stage-2: Selection Test (Specific Written Test and meet all other eligibility criteria
  • Syllabus for Eligibility Test and Specific Written Test: The detailed syllabus is available on the NHIDCL website
  • Final Selection: Final selection shall be based on NHIDCL Cadre Rules

General Information/Instructions

  • Eligibility for Availing Reservation: To avail community reservation, candidates must belong to a caste listed in the Central Government reserved communities list. Candidates would be required to submit valid SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificates at the time of document verification
  • PwBD category reservation will be limited to under mentioned disabilities: B. Deaf & hard of hearing D. Autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc
  • Functional Requirements for PwBD Categories are: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Bending, Jumping, Climbing, Manipulation by Fingers, Reading & Writing, Seeing (SE), Communication (C)
  • Reserved Category candidates applying for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any relaxations
  • Name variations in certificates should be supported by such legal documents, as may be required under provisions of law/guidelines
  • Government/PSU candidates are required to submit NOC / relieving letter from their current organizations at the time of document verification prior to issuance of "Offer of Employment"
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on NHIDCL requirements
  • Selected Candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad. NHIDCL at present operates through 14 Regional Offices in different States/UTs with its Corporate HQ at New Delhi
  • NHIDCL at any stage may cancel the advertisement or selection process without assigning any reasons
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year; no change in the email ID would be allowed
  • Corrigendum/addendum/errata will be posted only on NHIDCL's website at www.nhidcl.com under the heading "Career/Current Vacancies"
  • Canvassing or external influence will disqualify the candidate from selection
  • Candidates should avoid middlemen / recruitment agents / consultants and fraudulent job promises
  • All disputes are subject to Delhi High Court jurisdiction, with the English version prevailing for interpretation
  • All appointments in NHIDCL shall be subject to the successful completion of a background verification process (BGV). The BGV may inter alia include verification of the candidate's identity, address, educational and professional qualifications, character antecedents and any other information as deemed necessary by NHIDCL
  • If at any point of time, before or after the appointment, the outcome of the background verification is found to be unsatisfactory, NHIDCL reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the offer of employment/ appointment
  • The personal information collected during the verification process/selection process shall be handled in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and NHIDCL's policies. It shall be used only for purpose of assessment and verification relevant to employment

Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Notification Out for 71 Posts

Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD), a State University established by the Government of NCT of Delhi, has released the detailed Advertisement No. AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025 dated 03 December 2025 for recruitment to various Teaching and Other Academic Staff posts on regular basis. This recruitment covers Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Librarian, Assistant Librarian and Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports positions across multiple Schools and disciplines with a total of 71 teaching plus 4 other academic staff posts. The online application process will commence from 20 December 2025 and will remain open till 09 January 2026 on the University website https://aud.delhi.gov.in, while hard copy of the online application with documents must reach by 16 January 2026.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Notification 2025 Out

Advertisement

The Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment to Various Teaching and Other Academic Staff Posts 2025 has been issued by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi to fill faculty positions (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and other academic posts (Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports) on a regular basis.

Before applying, candidates must carefully read the notification PDF to understand school-wise and discipline-wise vacancies, pay levels, eligibility conditions as per UGC/AICTE/NCTE/other regulatory bodies, reservation including PwBD, application procedure, and selection process for the AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025. Applicants are required to apply online and then send the printed application with self-attested documents to the specified address within the last date, following all instructions given in the advertisement.

Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

The Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi invites applications from eligible candidates for 71 faculty posts (20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, 24 Assistant Professor across various Schools and disciplines) and 4 other academic staff posts (Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports) on regular basis. The University focuses on humanities and social sciences and offers programmes across four campuses at Kashmere Gate, Karampura, Lodhi Colony and Qutab Institutional Area, aiming to reconceptualise social sciences through innovative curriculum and pedagogy.

This recruitment offers attractive academic pay levels under the 7th CPC, including Pay Level 14 for Professor and Librarian, Level 13A for Associate Professor, and Level 10 for Assistant Professor, Assistant Librarian and Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports, with salary ranges up to Rs. 2,18,200/- depending on the post. The posts are distributed across Schools such as Culture and Creative Expressions, Design, Development Studies, Education Studies (including ITEP), Global Affairs, Public Policy & Governance, Human Ecology, Legal and Socio-Political Studies, Letters, Management, Undergraduate Studies, Vocational Studies, and Heritage Research & Management.

Interested and eligible candidates must first submit their application form online through the AUD website from 20 December 2025 to 09 January 2026 and then send a hard copy of the filled online application along with self-attested supporting documents to the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), AUD, Kashmere Gate Campus, so as to reach by 16 January 2026 up to 17:30 hrs. Applications will be shortlisted in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable norms, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for interviews or presentations, with details notified on the University website and via email.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Important Dates

The Detailed Advertisement No. AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025 clearly mentions the schedule for online application, last date and receipt of hard copies for the Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025. Candidates must adhere strictly to these dates as applications received after the deadlines will be summarily rejected and the University will not be responsible for postal delays.

Event Date
Notification (Detailed Advertisement) Date 03 December 2025
Commencement of Online Application 20 December 2025 (on University website)
Last Date to Apply Online 09 January 2026 (up to 23:59 hrs)
Last Date for Receipt of Hard Copy of Application 16 January 2026 (up to 17:30 hrs)

Final Selection / Issue of Offer After completion of interviews and approval by competent authority.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

The University has notified 20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, and 24 Assistant Professor posts across various Schools, along with 1 Librarian, 2 Assistant Librarian, and 1 Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports posts, making a total of 71 vacancies. Certain posts marked with an asterisk are backlog reserved vacancies for specific categories, and there is horizontal reservation of 7 posts for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) across various categories (a to e) as per DoPT OM dated 15.01.2018 and related notifications.

Post Category Total Posts
Professor (Pay Level 14) 20
Associate Professor (Pay Level 13A) 23
Assistant Professor (Pay Level 10) 24
Librarian 1 (UR)
Assistant Librarian 2 (UR-01, OBC-01)
Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports 1 (UR, Women only)
Total 71

PwBD reservation covers categories such as blindness and low vision, deaf and hard of hearing, locomotor disability including cerebral palsy and related conditions, autism and intellectual disability, and multiple disabilities, with functional requirements regulated as per Gazette of India notification dated 07.01.2021 and DoPT guidelines. The notification also clarifies that candidates who had applied earlier for certain Assistant Professor posts in Social Science & Humanities and Global Studies against previous advertisement must apply afresh but are exempted from paying application fee with reference to earlier payment.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Eligibility Criteria 2025

Candidates willing to apply for the Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and other academic staff posts must ensure that they satisfy the eligibility criteria as per UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable NCTE/AICTE/other regulatory body norms. The notification clearly states that eligibility conditions regarding qualifications, experience, research publications and research score will be as per the latest UGC/NCTE/AICTE rules and the detailed discipline-wise criteria given in the advertisement.

✨ Educational Qualification

The educational and professional qualifications vary by post and discipline but broadly follow UGC Regulations 2018 and related bodies.

For Professor (various disciplines):
An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, actively engaged in research with minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018, along with at least 10 years of teaching/research experience at University/National Level Institutions including supervision of doctoral candidates. Alternatively, an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and significant contribution to the field with at least 10 years’ experience and a national award instituted by Government of India and conferred by the President of India may be considered in specific cases as detailed in the notification.

For Associate Professor (various disciplines):
A good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), and minimum 8 years of teaching/research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University/College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with at least 7 publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018. Additional discipline-specific desirable qualifications such as experience with quantitative techniques, data handling, or interdisciplinary law and social science backgrounds are mentioned for some posts.

For Assistant Professor (various disciplines):
A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or equivalent foreign degree, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or exemption through Ph.D. in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations 2009/2016, with detailed conditions for candidates registered before 11 July 2009 (including viva voce, external evaluation, publications, and paper presentations) certified by the concerned University. In professional/technical disciplines such as Design or Management, qualifications include Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor’s or Master’s level, specified industry/teaching experience, and minimum numbers of SCI/UGC/AICTE-approved journal publications, as detailed in relevant sections of the advertisement.

For Librarian and Assistant Librarian:
Librarian requires a Master’s Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks, at least 10 years’ experience as Librarian at University/College/teaching level or College Librarian, evidence of innovative library services including ICT, and a Ph.D. in Library/Information/Documentation/Archives & Manuscript-Keeping. Assistant Librarian requires Master’s in Library/Information/Documentation Science with at least 55%, knowledge of computerization, and NET or exemption through Ph.D. meeting UGC norms, with detailed pre-2009 Ph.D. conditions.

For Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports (Women only):
Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science with 55% marks, record of representing University/College at Inter-University/Inter-Collegiate competitions or State/National championships, and NET (or Ph.D.-based exemption) in Physical Education/Physical Education & Sports/Sports Science. An alternative qualification is being an Asian Games or Commonwealth Games medal winner with at least a Post-Graduation degree, along with physical fitness test norms detailed for women candidates.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Selection Process 2025

The selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 is based on merit through all-India advertisement and recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees, as per UGC Regulations 2018 and AUD norms. Applications will be scrutinised and shortlisted according to academic qualifications, research publications, research score, and other criteria, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, presentation or seminar or a combination thereof as decided by the University.

The selection process is carried out in the following stages:

1. Scrutiny / Screening of Applications: A Scrutiny/Screening Committee will examine all applications and prepare a list of eligible and not-eligible candidates based on stipulated guidelines, eligibility conditions and shortlisting criteria as per UGC Regulations and University norms. The lists of eligible and not-eligible candidates (with reasons for ineligibility) will be uploaded on the University website, and candidates shown not-eligible will have an opportunity to submit grievances/clarifications with documentary evidence within a stipulated time.

2. Final Shortlisting & Interview Call: After considering grievances, the Committee will finalise the list of eligible candidates, and on the basis of academic record, publications, experience and research score, a reasonable number of candidates will be called for interview. If the number of applications is large, the University may restrict candidates by applying higher qualifications/experience than minimum prescribed, and in some cases may postpone interviews if there are not enough candidates.

3. Interview / Presentation / Seminar: Shortlisted candidates will be required to appear before the Selection Committee for interview and may be asked to give a presentation or seminar as part of the selection process. Candidates residing outside India may be interviewed via video conferencing (e.g., Skype or other modes) if requested in advance.

Final Merit: Final selection will be based on performance in the interview (and presentation/seminar where applicable), with academic/research scores used only for shortlisting, not for final selection. Appointments will be made in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and subsequent amendments, and the University reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel posts, and any dispute will fall under the jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Application Fee 2025

Applicants are required to pay a non-refundable application fee depending on their category while submitting the online application form. The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway (credit/debit card/net banking) provided on the University website and proof of payment should be retained by candidates.

Category Application Fee
UR / OBC / EWS Rs. 1000/- (Non-refundable)
SC / ST Nil (No application fee)
PwBD Nil (No application fee)
Women Candidates Nil (No application fee)
  • Payment must be made online only through the University portal; other modes are not accepted.
  • Candidates who had applied earlier for specified re-advertised posts are exempted from paying fee again against reference of their previous payment, subject to conditions mentioned in the notification.
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable, and incomplete applications or those without fee (where applicable) will be rejected.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Salary 2025

All posts carry UGC pay scales under the 7th Central Pay Commission along with admissible allowances as per University, Government of India and GNCTD norms. The notification provides clear academic pay levels and corresponding pay scales for various teaching and other academic staff positions.

Component Details
Post Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports
Pay Level – Professor Academic Pay Level 14: Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200/-
Pay Level – Associate Professor Academic Pay Level 13A: Rs. 1,31,400 – 2,10,800/-
Pay Level – Assistant Professor Academic Pay Level 10: Rs. 57,700 – 92,500/-
Pay Level – Librarian Academic Pay Level 14: Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200/-
Pay Level – Assistant Librarian Academic Pay Level 10: Rs. 57,700 – 92,500/-
Pay Level – Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports Academic Pay Level 10: Rs. 57,700 – 92,500/-
  • Along with basic pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other benefits as per applicable government and University rules.
  • Conditions of service, including age of superannuation and career advancement, will follow UGC/Government of India/GNCTD norms and AUD Statutes and Ordinances.

How to Apply for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 and subsequently submit hard copies as per the instructions. The step-by-step application process is as follows.

  1. Step 1: Visit the official University website https://aud.delhi.gov.in on or after 20 December 2025.
  2. Step 2: Click on the recruitment/careers/notification link for “Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment to Various Teaching and Other Academic Staff Posts – AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025”.
  3. Step 3: Read the detailed advertisement carefully, including school-wise posts, eligibility qualifications, UGC/AICTE/NCTE norms, reservation and instructions.
  4. Step 4: Click on “Apply Online” and complete registration using a valid email ID and mobile number.
  5. Step 5: Fill the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, teaching/research experience, publications and research score details as required.
  6. Step 6: Select the appropriate post, School, discipline and category; if applying for more than one discipline/post/category, submit separate applications and fees as applicable.
  7. Step 7: Upload scanned copies of relevant documents (certificates, mark sheets, experience letters, category certificates, Ph.D. compliance certificates Annexure I/II where required, etc.) as per the specified format and size.
  8. Step 8: Pay the non-refundable application fee online through credit/debit card/net banking/payment gateway, if applicable for your category.
  9. Step 9: Submit the application form online and take a printout of the successfully submitted online application.
  10. Step 10: Arrange self-attested copies of all supporting documents and index/paginate them in the order of essential eligibility criteria, and enclose with the printed application in an envelope clearly mentioning the name of post/discipline on top.
  11. Step 11: Send the hard copy by Registered/Speed Post so as to reach on or before 16 January 2026 (17:30 hrs) at: Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), Room No. 31A, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Kashmere Gate Campus, Delhi – 110 006.

Important Links:

  • Official Notification PDF: Download Here
  • Apply Online: https://audrec.samarth.edu.in/

Important Instructions for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

  • Application form must be submitted in online mode only within the prescribed time limit; hard copy of the online application with self-attested documents must also reach the University by the specified date and time.
  • Applicants applying for more than one discipline or for multiple categories of the same post must submit separate online applications and pay separate fees where applicable, selecting all relevant categories before final submission.
  • Hard copy applications must include proper indexing and pagination of all annexed documents in the order of essential eligibility criteria, failing which the application may not be taken up for screening and may be rejected without assigning reasons.
  • Applicants must possess the prescribed qualifications, experience and eligibility as on the closing date of application and should upload/submit specific certificates (including Ph.D. compliance certificates Annexure I/II) as required.
  • The University will shortlist/screen applications strictly as per UGC Regulations 2018, relevant regulatory body norms and AUD rules; academic and research score calculated online is indicative and subject to scrutiny.
  • The mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for interview; the University may restrict the number of candidates called for interview by prescribing higher criteria.
  • All communications, including lists of eligible/not-eligible candidates, interview dates and any updates, will be published on the University website and/or communicated via email; candidates must regularly check the website and email.
  • The University may verify authenticity of certificates/documents at any time; if any information is found false or suppressed, services of the candidate may be terminated without prejudice to further action.
  • The University reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel the number of advertised posts, and its decision in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding.
  • Any legal dispute in connection with this recruitment will fall under the territorial jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online is 09 January 2026 up to 23:59 hrs, and the hard copy of the application must reach the University by 16 January 2026 up to 17:30 hrs.

Q2. What is the age limit for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A2. Age and service conditions, including age of superannuation, are as per University/UGC/Government of India/GNCTD norms; candidates must satisfy these norms as on the closing date of application.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A3. There are 67 teaching posts (20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, 24 Assistant Professor) and 4 other academic staff posts (1 Librarian, 2 Assistant Librarian, 1 Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports), totaling 71 posts.

Q4. What is the selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through scrutiny/screening of applications using UGC norms and academic/research scores, followed by interview and possibly presentation/seminar before duly constituted Selection Committees, with final selection based on interview performance.

Q5. What is the application fee for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A5. UR/OBC/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 1000/- (non-refundable), while SC, ST, PwBD and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

Q6. Is there any written examination in this recruitment?
A6. The notification specifies recruitment on the basis of merit through advertisement and interviews by Selection Committees; it does not mention a separate written examination, and the process is primarily based on screening and interview.

    • Maximum Marks: 120

    • Maximum Admissible Mistakes: 7% of total dictated words (49 mistakes out of 700 words)

    • Total Marks: 80 Marks

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Eligibility Criteria

T-01: Professor (Medicinal Chemistry)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent grade at the preceding degree in the appropriate branch with very good academic record throughout
  • Experience: At least 10 years of Teaching/Research/Industrial experience with published works of high quality, well recognized and established reputation of having made conspicuous seminal contribution to knowledge in Pharmaceutical and allied areas
  • Desirable:
    • Expertise in Pharmacoinformatics/computational chemistry/Cheminformatics/Bioinformatics with strong knowledge in development of various software and webservers in drug discovery and development
    • Exposure in HPC (High Performance Computing) is preferable
    • Proven publication record in molecular docking, molecular dynamics, quantum medicinal chemistry, virtual screening QSAR (all from own independent work)
    • Experience in Artificial Intelligence in Drug Discovery is an added advantage
    • Preference to candidates with ability to collaborate with experimental pharmaceutical scientists
    • Experience in establishing computational facilities, software installation, system administration, bug fixing
    • Demonstrated adequate experience of independent Research in terms of guided Masters' students and minimum of 2 PhD students
    • Preference to candidates having minimum of 3 years' experience at the level of Associate Professor or equivalent industry experience
    • Completed EMR or Industry sponsored projects, technology transfers, strong record of undertaking consultancy work, Patents, demonstrated excellence in teaching

T-02: Associate Professor (Pharmaceutical Analysis)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent grade at the preceding degree in the appropriate branch with very good academic record throughout
  • Experience: At least 8 years of Teaching/Research/Industrial experience with published works of high quality, well recognized and established reputation of having made conspicuous seminal contribution to knowledge in Pharmaceutical and allied areas
  • Desirable:
    • Preference to candidates having Post Graduate Degree in Pharmaceutical Analysis
    • Experience and expertise in pharmaceutical and bio-analytical techniques, AQbD, impurity profiling, data integrity, cGMP, GLP, ICH guidelines, instruments' calibration, validation and regulatory requirements of DCGI, USFDA etc.
    • Hands-on experience in handling sophisticated instruments like HPLC, LC-MS-MS and GC-MS
    • Experience in using instruments for analysis of API/finished dosage forms as per IP, USP, BP
    • Knowledge in characterization of biological products and stability testing, trouble shooting skills
    • Demonstrated adequate experience of independent research in terms of guided Masters' students and at least one Ph.D. student
    • Execution and/or recipients of sponsored/EMR projects and publication in SCI journals

NT-01: Finance & Accounts Officer

  • Essential Qualifications: Post-Graduation in Commerce/Economics from a recognized University/Institution
  • Experience: 10 (Ten) years of experience in dealing with Finance and Accounts in Central/State Govt. organizations/University/Research Institutions or Central/State Autonomous Bodies/other recognized Institutions of repute
  • Desirable:
    • Five/Eight years of experience at Pay Level-11/10 dealing with Finance and Accounts
    • MBA in finance from a recognized University/Institution
    • Conversant with operation of computers for accounting software like Tally, etc.

NT-02: Estate & Security Officer

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institute
  • Experience: Five (05) years of experience in commissioned service in Army/Navy/Air Force/Para Military Force or Police only not below the rank of captain or equivalent/Dy. SP of police
  • Desirable: Experience in constructing and management of Civil/Electrical works of educational buildings and security arrangement to the institutes/campus & Hostels

NT-03: Public Relation Officer

  • Essential Qualifications: Post Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university/institute
  • Experience: At least Five (05) years of experience in Public Relation/Training and Placement Cell in Central/State Govt. Organizations or University/Research Institute or Central/State autonomous/other recognized institute of repute
  • Desirable:
    • MBA or Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Mass Communication
    • Ability to compose & edit press releases, newsletters
    • Preference to candidates having experience in placement activities
    • Experience in coordinating with central/state Govt./PSU/autonomous organizations
    • Experience in logistic arrangement of dignitaries/guest including hospitality arrangements for conferences/events/meetings

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

For Specialists (O&G, Pulmonary, Medicine, Orthopedics, Dermatology, Ophthalmology, Psychiatry, Radiology, Critical Care):

  • MBBS with PG Diploma / PG Degree / DNB in relevant specialty from a University/Institute

  • Must have valid medical Practitioner license and be enrolled in the State Register or National Register

For Super Specialist (Plastic Surgery):

  • MBBS with DM / Mch / DNB (Super Specialty) / DrNB (Super Specialty) in Plastic Surgery from a University/Institute
  • Doctors must be registered with Medical Council of India (MCI) / National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council (SMC)
  • Must have valid medical Practitioner license and be enrolled in the State Register or National Register

For GDMO:

  • MBBS from a University/Institute
  • Doctors must be registered with Medical Council of India (MCI) / National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council (SMC)
  • Must have valid medical Practitioner license and be enrolled in the State Register or National Register

For GDMO-OH:

  • MBBS with DIH (Diploma in Industrial Health) from a university/institute recognized by MCI in a recognized Medical College / Hospital / Institution
  • OR MBBS with Fellowship in Industrial Health
  • Must be registered with Medical Council of India (MCI) / National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council (SMC)
  • Must have valid medical Practitioner license and be enrolled in the State Register or National Register

Essential Requirements

  • Candidate must be an Indian national possessing requisite qualification from an institute recognized by the Medical Council of India / National Medical Commission / State Medical Council
  • Doctors who are registered with MCI / NMC / SMC or having valid medical Practitioner license and enrolled in the State Register or National Register are only eligible for engagement
  • The Consultants having relevant post qualification work experience shall be given preference

Who Cannot Apply

  • Ex-employees of SAIL and non-SAIL ex-employees who have been separated through Voluntary Retirement shall not be considered for engagement
  • Ex-employee applicants shall have to provide self-declaration in this regard

Additional Salary Details

  • The monthly remuneration rates are applicable for engagement for a minimum 8 hours a day for six days in a week or 48 hours a week
  • If engagement is for less than 8 hours per day / 48 hours a week, the rates would be pro-rated accordingly
  • The monthly rate shall not exceed the maximum prescribed limit of the respective category
  • No claim for extra remuneration/benefit for extra hours beyond normal assigned working hours

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates for engagement will be done through walk-in interview
  • Walk-in interview to be held at Office of CMO I/C (M&HS), Burnpur Hospital, Burnpur-713325, Dt: Paschim Bardhaman, West Bengal
  • Interview will be conducted from 10:00 AM onwards
  • Reporting time is from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM (registration will close after 10:00 AM)
  • In case of large number of candidates, interview may be staggered to the next working day subject to their reporting as per scheduled time
  • An advance copy of the application in the prescribed format may also be emailed to [email protected] with subject line "CONSULTANTS (DOCTORS IN MEDICAL DISCIPLINES) AT SAIL, ISP, BURNPUR" latest by 19.01.2026
  • Candidates selected for engagement shall be required to join the assignment as indicated in the Offer of Engagement
  • A discipline-wise category wise panel will be formed in order of merit (in the ratio of 1:1) which will be operated in case of non-joining of candidates
  • The panel will be valid for a period of six months from the date of approval
  • All certificates & documents in support of eligibility will be verified only during Walk-in-Interview
  • Any candidate who fails to produce required documents will not be allowed to appear in the interview

General Information/Instructions

Tenure of Engagement

  • The initial tenure of engagement would be for a period of one year from the date of joining
  • Contract can be further extended for a period of one year at the discretion of the Company
  • The maximum period for engagement would not be more than three (03) years
  • However, there will be no bar on re-engagement
  • The performance will be periodically reviewed on annual basis and tenure can be extended subject to satisfactory performance
  • The tenure of engagement shall be subject to the upper age limit of 70 years

Working Hours and Leave

  • Engagement for a minimum 8 hours a day for six days in a week or 48 hours a week
  • Consultants shall be liable to give their services in emergent conditions also or as per requirement even beyond their normal assigned working hours
  • Consultants engaged will be eligible to get 10 (ten) days leave in a year subject to prior approval
  • Eligible for Maternity leave as per Maternity Benefit Act, 1961

Other Benefits

  • Accommodation: Company accommodation (2BHK or equivalent category) may be provided on payment basis, if desired, subject to availability. Rent and other charges for electricity, water etc. will be as applicable for that category. No HRA will be payable
  • Communication Facility: Post-paid SIM under CUG and mobile phone expenses as per actuals within monthly ceiling (Rs. 350/- to Rs. 650/- based on qualification)
  • Medical Facility: For ex-employees of SAIL, medical benefits as per prevailing rules. In other cases, medical benefits available for self and spouse only at SAIL, ISP Hospital, Burnpur, without any referrals
  • Private Practice: Allowed subject to the condition that there shall be no disruption in the working hours assigned

Important Terms & Conditions

  • The engagement is purely of temporary nature and shall not create any right for regular appointment on any grounds
  • Consultants will not be entitled to any benefits which are not specifically laid out in the scheme / Advertisement
  • No PF/Gratuity or any other benefit unless specified shall be payable
  • Not eligible for Non-Practicing Allowance
  • Income Tax/GST shall be dealt in terms of applicable provisions
  • Presidential Directives on reservation will be followed as applicable
  • Joining of the candidate is subject to medical fitness
  • Engagement can be terminated by giving one month notice by either party
  • Engagement can be terminated by the Company forthwith in case of medical unfitness, poor performance, moral turpitude, conviction, insolvency, loss of license, grave misconduct or financial irregularity
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Asansol

Category Certificate Requirements

  • OBC candidates belonging to "CREAMY LAYER" are not entitled for OBC concession and should indicate category as "General"
  • OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates required to submit certificate in prescribed format issued in current financial year (2025-26) issued on or after 01/04/2025 and before 31/03/2026
  • For EWS candidates, Certificate should be issued on or after 01/04/2025 certifying the income for FY 2024-2025
  • Caste certificates should be submitted in the format for appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government/Public Sector Undertaking

Important Instructions

  • No request for change in date of interview and/or change in date of medical examination will be allowed
  • SAIL, ISP reserves the sole authority to consider the cases as per its rules and decision shall be final, firm & binding
  • SAIL, ISP reserves the right to reject any application or cancel the candidature or the whole process without assigning any reason
  • Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false
  • In case of any dispute on interpretation of any part of this advertisement, the decision of the Company shall be final and binding

Job Description

Post Job Description
GDMO To work in various departments of M&HS as may be required and also attend on call and emergent cases as per requirement
Specialists / Super Specialist To work in respective department of Specialty/Super Speciality or as may be required from time to time and also attend on call and emergent cases as per requirement

  • Email submission deadline: 19.01.2026
  • Bring filled application format (Annexure-B) with 2 additional passport sized recent colour photographs
  • Bring Letter of Undertaking (Annexure-A)
  • Carry all relevant original documents plus 1 set of self-attested photocopies

Documents Required for Walk-in Interview

  • Filled in application format (Annexure-B) with 2 passport sized recent colour photographs
  • Letter of Undertaking (Annexure-A)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Class X / Matriculation certificate)

CSIR-Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CMERI), a premier national laboratory under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), has released an official advertisement (No. 11/2025) inviting online applications from dynamic Indian citizens for 20 positions of Technician-I (Group – II (1)). Eligibility Criteria for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, one of the following must be met:

  • ITI certificate or national/state trade certificate in the relevant trade from a recognized institution, OR
  • 2 years’ full-time experience as an apprentice trainee in the relevant trade from a recognized institution, OR
  • 3 years of work experience in the relevant trade in a government organization/PSU/Autonomous Body.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for CSIR-CMERI Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years (as on the last date of online application: 21.01.2026)
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 10-15 years for PwBD, 5 years for Departmental/Govt. employees, and for Ex-Servicemen and Widows/Divorced Women as per government norms.

Application Fee for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

A non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred Only) is mandatory for applicants other than Ex-servicemen, SC/ST, Women, and PwBD candidates. The fee must be deposited online through the State Bank Collect system; payment through any other mode will result in application rejection.

Salary/ Stipend

The post is in the Pay Level – 2 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) Pay Matrix (₹19,900-₹63,200). The total emoluments (Basic Pay + DA + HRA + TA etc.) are approximately ₹ 37,000/- per month at the minimum of the scale when stationed at Durgapur/Ludhiana.

Selection Process for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

The selection process consists of two stages:

  • Trade Test: Online applications will be screened, and shortlisted candidates will be called for a trade test, which is qualifying in nature.
  • Competitive Written Examination: Candidates who qualify in the trade test will be called for a written examination (OMR or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination). The final merit list will be prepared solely on the marks obtained in Paper-II and Paper-III of this examination.

Eligible candidates are required to apply ONLINE only through the CSIR-CMERI website.

  1. Visit the official website: www.cmeri.res.in.
  2. Register with a valid email ID and mobile number.
  3. Log in and fill in the application form, ensuring all details are accurate.
  4. Pay the application fee online through State Bank Collect and upload the e-receipt.
  5. Upload scanned copies of a recent photograph, signature, and all relevant certificates (education, ITI, experience, category, Aadhaar Card, NOC if applicable).
  6. Submit the application online before the deadline. Candidates should not send a hard copy after online submission.

  • SC/ST & OBC candidates of other states shall be treated as General Candidates

  • Syllabus will be notified later on WBMSC website www.mscwb.org
  • Candidates now in service under Central or State Government / Semi Government / Local / Statutory Body must ensure No-Objection Certificate (N.O.C.) reaches the Commission office within 7 days preceding the date of Personality Test

  • The Commission reserves the right to increase/decrease or withdraw the number of any advertised post at any time
  • Candidates are advised to follow WBMSC official website at www.mscwb.org regularly for updates/corrigendum/notices

How to Apply

  • Click on the online application link for Advertisement No. 17 of 2025

  • Upload scanned copies of required documents (photograph, signature, educational certificates, caste certificate if applicable, PWD certificate if applicable, experience certificate if required)
  • Pay the application fee online through Indiaideas.com Limited (Bill Desk):
    • UR & OBC: Rs.200/- (Rs.150 Application Fee + Rs.50 Processing Charges)
    • SC/ST & PWD: Rs.50/- (Processing Charges only)
  • Review all filled information carefully before final submission
  • Submit the application form online
  • Take a printout of the completed application form for future reference
  • Complete the online application process by 17.01.2026
  • Candidates must mention their email address and mobile number correctly during filling up of online application
  • No modification/correction will be entertained after final submission of the application
  • Keep checking the official website regularly for admit card, examination schedule, and results

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Inspector of Factories & Boilers:
    • A degree in Mechanical or Production or Power Plant or Metallurgical Engineering from a recognised University or equivalent.
    • Two years experience as technical personnel in relevant fields related to boilers/Boilers Act, 1923 implementation.
  • For Inspector of Factories (Chemical):
    • B.E.(Chemical) of a University established by law in India or equivalent qualifications.
  • General requirements for both posts:

  • Minimum Age: 23 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years
  • Age relaxation is provided as per rules for various categories of Rajasthan state residents, such as SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women/Ex-servicemen.
  • There is no upper age limit for Widow and Divorcee Women applicants.

Application Fee

One Time Registration (OTR) fees are as follows:

  • General (Unreserved) / Backward Classes Creamy Layer / More Backward Classes Creamy Layer: ₹600/-
  • Reserved Categories (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/MBC Non-Creamy Layer/EWS/Sahariya): ₹400/-
  • Persons with Disabilities (PH): ₹400/-

Salary/Stipend

  • The posts are on Pay Matrix Level L-14.
  • During the probation period (Parivikshakaal) as per state government rules, a fixed monthly remuneration (Fix Pay) will be payable.

Selection Process

  • The selection of candidates will be made through a written examination.
  • Scaling/moderation/normalization methods may be adopted by the Commission if necessary.
  • The examination will be objective type (Offline/Online) with multiple choice questions.
  • Negative marking shall be applicable (one-third of marks for every wrong answer).
  • The exam duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes, consisting of 150 questions for 150 marks.

How To Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the RPSC website (https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in) or the SSO Portal (https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in).
  • One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for all candidates.
  • Candidates must verify their details (Name, Father's Name, DOB, Gender, etc.) carefully during OTR, as these cannot be changed later.
  • Candidates must upload a live photo, signature, and left thumb impression scan during the application process.
  • After final submission, candidates must take a printout of the application form for future reference.
